antonyms: National, International, Global, Universal, Central, Worldwide, Foreign
examples: They speak a regional dialect. The company opened a regional office. Regional cuisine varies across the country. There is regional cooperation on trade.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خاص علائقي سان لاڳاپيل، ملڪ جي ڪنهن حصي جي خصوصيت، مقامي معاملن سان تعلق رکندڙ، ڪجهه ملڪن جي هڪ گڏيل علائقي وارو، ڪجهه ضلعن جي خاصيت
urduMeaning: کسی خاص علاقے سے متعلق، ملک کے کسی حصے کی خصوصیت، مقامی معاملات سے تعلق رکھنے والا، کچھ ممالک کے ایک مشترکہ خطے کا، بعض اضلاع کی خصوصیت

englishMeaning: The state of feeling uncertain, unsafe, or anxious. Lack of confidence in oneself or one's situation. Vulnerability to danger or threat. Instability in social, economic, or political conditions. A feeling of self-doubt.
synonyms: Uncertainty, Anxiety, Doubt, Vulnerability, Instability, Fear, Nervousness, Self-doubt, Danger, Worry
antonyms: Security, Confidence, Certainty, Safety, Stability, Assurance, Trust, Protection, Composure
examples: She struggled with feelings of insecurity. There is growing insecurity in the region. His insecurity made him overly defensive. Job insecurity affects mental health.
sindhiMeaning: غير محفوظ  بيچين يا پريشان محسوس ڪرڻ جي حالت، پاڻ تي يا حالتن تي اعتماد نه هجڻ، خطري يا نقصان ڏانهن ڪمزوري، سماجي  معاشي يا سياسي بي استحڪامي، پاڻ تي شڪ جو احساس
urduMeaning: غیر محفوظ  بے چین یا پریشان محسوس کرنے کی حالت، اپنے آپ یا حالات پر اعتماد کی کمی، خطرے یا نقصان کے سامنے کمزوری، سماجی  معاشی یا سیاسی عدم استحکام، خود پر شک کا احساس

englishMeaning: A long and distinct period of history. A period marked by particular events, characteristics, or developments. A memorable or important stage in the history of a person, group, or civilization. A system of chronology reckoned from a notable event. A significant point in geological time.
synonyms: Age, Epoch, Period, Time, Aeon, Generation, Cycle, Phase, Chapter, Date
antonyms: Moment, Instant, Second
examples: The invention of the internet marked the beginning of a new era. We are living in an era of rapid technological change. The Victorian era produced many great writers. His presidency was seen as the end of an era.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ڊگهو ۽ خاص تاريخي دور، ڪا مخصوص خاصيتن يا واقعن سان سڃاتل زمانو، ڪنهن قوم يا شخصيت جي زندگيءَ جو يادگار دور، ڪنهن اهم واقعي کان شروع ٿيندڙ حساب جو زمانو، ارضياتي وقت جو هڪ مخصوص حصو
urduMeaning: ایک طویل اور مخصوص تاریخی دور، خاص واقعات یا خصوصیات سے پہچانا جانے والا زمانہ، کسی قوم یا شخصیت کی زندگی کا یادگار مرحلہ، کسی اہم واقعے سے شروع ہونے والا شمارِ زمانہ، ارضیاتی وقت کا ایک مخصوص حصہ

englishMeaning: To resume or begin again after an interruption. To extend the validity of a licence, contract, subscription, or agreement for a further period. To replace something old or worn with something new. To restore freshness, strength, or vitality to something. To repeat or reaffirm a promise, statement, or effort.
synonyms: Restore, Revive, Refresh, Extend, Prolong, Resume, Reinstate, Reactivate, Rejuvenate, Repeat
antonyms: Cancel, Terminate, End, Discontinue, Stop, Abandon, Expire, Weaken, Exhaust
examples: He went to the office to renew his passport. They renewed their vows on their tenth anniversary. The company plans to renew its contract with the supplier. A short holiday helped renew her energy.
sindhiMeaning: ٻيهر شروع ڪرڻ يا بحال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن معاهدي، لائسنس يا رڪنيت جي مدت وڌائڻ، پراڻي شيءَ کي نئين سان بدلائڻ، تازگي، طاقت يا زندگي بحال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن واعدي يا ڪوشش کي ٻيهر دهرائڻ
urduMeaning: دوبارہ شروع کرنا یا بحال کرنا، کسی معاہدے، لائسنس یا رکنیت کی مدت میں توسیع کرنا، پرانی چیز کی جگہ نئی لانا، تازگی، توانائی یا زندگی بحال کرنا، کسی وعدے یا کوشش کو دہرانا

englishMeaning: Resumed or started again after a pause. Given fresh strength, energy, or interest. Extended for a further period of time. Repeated or reaffirmed with new commitment. Restored to a former better condition.
synonyms: Refreshed, Revived, Restored, Reinvigorated, Reaffirmed, Extended, Reactivated, Rejuvenated
antonyms: Exhausted, Weakened, Cancelled, Expired, Abandoned, Discouraged
examples: There is renewed interest in electric vehicles. She returned to work with renewed enthusiasm. The two countries signed a renewed peace agreement. The team faced the second half with renewed determination.
sindhiMeaning: ٻيهر شروع ٿيل، نئين طاقت يا جوش سان ڀريل، وڌايل مدت وارو، نئين عزم سان دهرايل، پراڻي بهتر حالت ۾ بحال ٿيل
urduMeaning: دوبارہ شروع کیا گیا، نئی توانائی یا جوش سے بھرپور، مدت میں توسیع شدہ، نئے عزم کے ساتھ دہرایا گیا، پرانی بہتر حالت میں بحال

englishMeaning: A formal written request signed by many people appealing to an authority. A formal application made to a court in writing. To make a formal request to an authority. To earnestly request or plead for something. A solemn or humble request, especially in prayer.
synonyms: Request, Appeal, Plea, Application, Entreaty, Supplication, Prayer, Solicitation, Suit
antonyms: Demand, Command, Order, Refusal, Denial, Rejection
examples: Thousands of citizens signed a petition against the new law. The lawyer filed a petition in the high court. The residents petitioned the government to build a new hospital. They petitioned the king for mercy.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن اختياريءَ کي پيش ڪيل رسمي درخواست جنهن تي گهڻن ماڻهن جون صحيحون هجن، عدالت ۾ پيش ڪيل رسمي درخواست، رسمي طور تي درخواست ڪرڻ، عاجزيءَ سان گهر ڪرڻ، دعا يا فرياد
urduMeaning: کسی اتھارٹی کے سامنے پیش کی جانے والی باقاعدہ درخواست جس پر بہت سے لوگوں کے دستخط ہوں، عدالت میں پیش کی جانے والی باقاعدہ درخواست، باقاعدہ طور پر درخواست کرنا، عاجزی سے گزارش کرنا، دعا یا التجا

englishMeaning: A firm decision to do or not to do something. A formal expression of opinion or intention agreed on by a legislative body or committee. The act of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter. The quality of being determined or resolute. The degree of detail visible in a photograph or on a screen.
synonyms: Determination, Resolve, Decision, Commitment, Motion, Verdict, Solution, Settlement, Clarity
antonyms: Indecision, Hesitation, Doubt, Uncertainty, Weakness, Problem, Dispute
examples: Her New Year's resolution was to exercise every day. The council passed a resolution to increase the budget. We hope for a peaceful resolution of the conflict. The camera captures images in very high resolution.
sindhiMeaning: ڪا ڳالهه ڪرڻ يا نه ڪرڻ جو پڪو ارادو، ڪنهن اسيمبلي يا ڪاميٽيءَ جو رسمي فيصلو، ڪنهن مسئلي يا جهيڙي جو حل، پختو عزم يا ثابت قدمي، تصوير يا اسڪرين تي وضاحت جو معيار
urduMeaning: کسی کام کو کرنے یا نہ کرنے کا پختہ ارادہ، اسمبلی یا کمیٹی کی جانب سے منظور کردہ رسمی فیصلہ، کسی مسئلے یا تنازع کا حل، عزمِ صمیم اور ثابت قدمی، تصویر یا اسکرین کی وضاحت کا معیار

englishMeaning: The act of officially informing someone about something. A formal or official written or spoken statement giving information. A message or alert appearing on a phone, computer, or device. An announcement issued by a government or authority.
synonyms: Announcement, Alert, Notice, Intimation, Message, Communication, Declaration, Circular, Advisory
antonyms: Concealment, Silence, Suppression, Withholding
examples: The company sent a notification about the change in policy. I received a notification on my phone about the meeting. The government issued a notification regarding new tax rules. Please switch off notifications during the exam.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي رسمي طور تي اطلاع ڏيڻ جو عمل، رسمي طور تي معلومات ڏيندڙ لکت يا اعلان، فون يا ڪمپيوٽر تي ظاهر ٿيندڙ پيغام يا اطلاع، حڪومت يا اداري پاران جاري ڪيل اعلان
urduMeaning: کسی کو باقاعدہ طور پر مطلع کرنے کا عمل، معلومات دینے والا رسمی تحریری یا زبانی بیان، فون یا کمپیوٹر پر ظاہر ہونے والا پیغام یا اطلاع، حکومت یا ادارے کی جانب سے جاری کردہ اعلان

englishMeaning: To formally or officially inform someone of something. To give notice of or report a fact or occurrence. To bring information to the attention of a person or authority. To announce or publish something officially.
synonyms: Inform, Alert, Announce, Advise, Report, Tell, Warn, Intimate, Declare
antonyms: Conceal, Hide, Withhold, Suppress, Mislead
examples: Please notify the manager if you cannot attend the meeting. The school will notify parents about the new schedule. He notified the police about the missing bag. You must notify the bank of any change of address.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي رسمي طور تي ٻڌائڻ يا اطلاع ڏيڻ، ڪنهن واقعي جي خبر ڏيڻ، ڪنهن اختياريءَ يا شخص جي ڌيان ۾ آڻڻ، رسمي طور تي اعلان ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو باقاعدہ طور پر مطلع کرنا، کسی واقعے کی اطلاع دینا، کسی اتھارٹی یا شخص کے علم میں لانا، باقاعدہ طور پر اعلان کرنا

englishMeaning: Main roads or public highways connecting one place to another. Busy public streets used for travelling through a town or city. Passages or routes that are open at both ends allowing free movement.
synonyms: Highways, Roads, Streets, Avenues, Routes, Boulevards, Passages, Roadways, Arteries
antonyms: Alleys, Dead-ends, Cul-de-sacs, Byways, Backstreets
examples: The city's main thoroughfares were closed for the parade. Heavy traffic clogged the thoroughfares during rush hour. Vendors are not allowed to sell goods on public thoroughfares. Ambulances need clear thoroughfares to reach patients quickly.
sindhiMeaning: مکيه رستا يا شاهراهون جيڪي هڪ هنڌ کان ٻئي هنڌ ملائين، شهر جا مصروف عوامي رستا، ٻن پاسن کان کليل گذرگاهون جتان آسانيءَ سان لنگهي سگهجي
urduMeaning: بڑی سڑکیں یا شاہراہیں جو ایک جگہ کو دوسری جگہ سے ملاتی ہیں، شہر کی مصروف عوامی گزرگاہیں، دونوں سروں سے کھلی گزرگاہیں جہاں سے آسانی سے گزرا جا سکے

englishMeaning: Not in accordance with the constitution of a country or organisation. Violating the fundamental principles or rules laid down by a constitution. Contrary to established legal or governing principles.
synonyms: Illegal, Unlawful, Illegitimate, Invalid, Unauthorized, Unwarranted
antonyms: Constitutional, Legal, Lawful, Legitimate, Valid, Authorized
examples: The court declared the new law unconstitutional. Detaining a citizen without charge is unconstitutional. Many experts described the order as unconstitutional. The judges struck down the amendment as unconstitutional.
sindhiMeaning: آئين جي خلاف، ملڪ يا اداري جي بنيادي قانونن جي ابتڙ، آئيني اصولن جي خلاف عمل يا فيصلو
urduMeaning: آئین کے خلاف، ملک یا ادارے کے بنیادی قوانین کے منافی، آئینی اصولوں کے خلاف عمل یا فیصلہ

englishMeaning: The action, manner, or system of governing a country, organisation, or people. The process of decision-making and the process by which decisions are implemented. The exercise of authority and control in managing public affairs. The framework of rules, practices, and processes by which an institution is directed.
synonyms: Administration, Management, Rule, Leadership, Control, Authority, Regulation, Direction, Command
antonyms: Anarchy, Disorder, Chaos, Misrule, Mismanagement, Lawlessness
examples: Good governance is essential for economic development. The report highlighted weaknesses in corporate governance. Citizens demanded transparency in the governance of public funds. The new leadership promised better governance and accountability.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ملڪ  اداري يا ماڻهن جي حڪومت ڪرڻ جو عمل يا طريقو، فيصلا ڪرڻ ۽ انهن تي عمل ڪرڻ جو نظام، عوامي معاملن کي هلائڻ ۾ اختيار جو استعمال، اداري کي هلائڻ جي قاعدن ۽ اصولن جو ڍانچو
urduMeaning: کسی ملک  ادارے یا لوگوں پر حکومت کرنے کا عمل یا طریقہ، فیصلہ سازی اور ان کے نفاذ کا نظام، عوامی امور کے انتظام میں اختیار کا استعمال، ادارے کو چلانے کے قواعد و ضوابط کا ڈھانچہ

englishMeaning: A melody, especially one that is easy to remember. To adjust a musical instrument to the correct pitch. To adjust an engine or device so that it runs smoothly and efficiently. To set a radio or television to a particular frequency or channel. To bring into harmony or agreement.
synonyms: Melody, Song, Air, Strain, Harmony, Adjust, Regulate, Calibrate, Attune
antonyms: Discord, Noise, Disharmony, Unbalance, Disturb, Mistune
examples: She hummed a familiar tune while cooking. The guitarist paused to tune his instrument. The mechanic tuned the engine before the long journey. Millions of viewers tune in to the show every week.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ خوشگوار سُر يا راڳ جيڪو آسانيءَ سان ياد رهجي وڃي، ساز کي درست سُر تي آڻڻ، انجڻ يا مشين کي بهتر هلائڻ لاءِ سڌارڻ، ريڊيو يا ٽيليويزن کي ڪنهن مخصوص چينل تي ملائڻ، هم آهنگي پيدا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: ایک خوش کن راگ یا دھن جو آسانی سے یاد رہ جائے، ساز کو درست سُر پر لانا، انجن یا مشین کو بہتر چلانے کے لیے درست کرنا، ریڈیو یا ٹی وی کو کسی مخصوص چینل پر لگانا، ہم آہنگی پیدا کرنا

englishMeaning: To use something in a wrong or improper way. To treat someone or something badly or unfairly. The wrong or improper use of something. Application of something for a purpose other than intended.
synonyms: Abuse, Mishandle, Mistreat, Exploit, Squander, Pervert, Waste, Corrupt
antonyms: Use, Utilise, Employ, Respect, Preserve, Conserve, Cherish

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جو غلط يا ناجائز استعمال ڪرڻ، ڪنهن سان بدسلوڪي ڪرڻ، غلط يا ناروا استعمال، مقصد کان هٽي ڪري استعمال
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا غلط یا ناجائز استعمال کرنا، کسی کے ساتھ برا سلوک کرنا، غلط یا ناروا استعمال، مقصد سے ہٹ کر استعمال کرنا

englishMeaning: The funds or revenue of a state, institution, or society. A government department responsible for finance, budgeting, and taxation. A place where valuable items or money are kept. A collection of valuable or delightful things.
synonyms: Exchequer, Vault, Coffer, Fund, Repository, Storehouse, Reserve, Bank
antonyms: Debt, Deficit, Poverty, Emptiness
examples: The treasury announced new measures to reduce the deficit. All revenues are deposited in the national treasury. The museum is a treasury of ancient artefacts. He was appointed head of the state treasury.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن رياست  اداري يا سماج جو خزانو يا فنڊ، مالياتي ۽ ٽيڪس معاملن جو حڪومتي کاتو، اهو هنڌ جتي قيمتي شيون يا پيسو رکيا وڃن، قيمتي يا وڻندڙ شين جو مجموعو
urduMeaning: کسی ریاست  ادارے یا معاشرے کا خزانہ یا فنڈ، مالیات اور ٹیکس امور کا حکومتی محکمہ، وہ جگہ جہاں قیمتی اشیاء یا رقم رکھی جاتی ہے، قیمتی یا دلکش چیزوں کا مجموعہ

englishMeaning: Firmly fixed, not likely to move, change, or fail. Not easily upset or disturbed emotionally. A building in which horses or other livestock are kept. To keep or put a horse in a stable.
synonyms: Steady, Firm, Secure, Fixed, Balanced, Constant, Reliable, Solid, Sound
antonyms: Unstable, Shaky, Unsteady, Fragile, Changeable, Volatile, Insecure
examples: The patient's condition is now stable. The country needs a stable government. He keeps three horses in the stable. Prices have remained stable for the past year.
sindhiMeaning: مضبوط ۽ قائم، جيڪو آسانيءَ سان تبديل يا ڪري نه پوي، جذباتي طور تي مضبوط ۽ متوازن، اهو جاءِ جتي گهوڙا يا ٻيا جانور رکيا وڃن، گهوڙي کي ٿَنڀي ۾ رکڻ
urduMeaning: مضبوط اور قائم، جو آسانی سے بدلے یا گرے نہیں، جذباتی طور پر پرسکون اور متوازن، وہ عمارت جہاں گھوڑے یا مویشی رکھے جاتے ہیں، گھوڑے کو اصطبل میں رکھنا

englishMeaning: To charge someone with an offence or crime. To claim that someone has done something wrong. To blame someone for a fault or wrongdoing.
synonyms: Blame, Charge, Indict, Allege, Denounce, Incriminate, Impeach, Arraign
antonyms: Defend, Absolve, Exonerate, Acquit, Clear, Vindicate, Pardon
examples: The police accused him of theft. She was accused of lying to the committee. Do not accuse anyone without evidence. He accused his brother of breaking the vase.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن تي ڏوهه يا الزام لڳائڻ، ڪنهن تي غلط ڪم ڪرڻ جو دعويٰ ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي غلطي يا خطا جو ذميوار قرار ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی پر جرم یا الزام لگانا، کسی پر غلط کام کرنے کا دعویٰ کرنا، کسی کو غلطی یا خطا کا ذمہ دار ٹھہرانا

englishMeaning: A person or people charged with or on trial for a crime. Blamed or held responsible for a fault or offence. Formally charged with wrongdoing in a court of law.
synonyms: Defendant, Suspect, Charged, Alleged offender, Respondent
antonyms: Accuser, Plaintiff, Complainant, Innocent, Cleared
examples: The accused stood silently before the judge. The accused denied all the charges against him. Two of the accused were released on bail. The lawyer defended the accused with strong arguments.
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص جنهن تي ڏوهه لڳايو ويو هجي يا مقدمو هلي رهيو هجي، الزام هيٺ آيل، عدالت ۾ رسمي طور تي ملزم قرار ڏنل
urduMeaning: وہ شخص جس پر جرم کا الزام ہو یا مقدمہ چل رہا ہو، الزام کے تحت آیا ہوا، عدالت میں باقاعدہ طور پر ملزم قرار دیا گیا

englishMeaning: To convert or be converted into vinegar or acetic acid. To make sour or acidic in taste or nature.
synonyms: Sour, Ferment, Acidify, Turn, Curdle
antonyms: Sweeten, Alkalize, Neutralize, Freshen
examples: Wine can acetify if the bottle is left open. Bacteria acetify the liquid during fermentation. Warm temperatures may acetify unfinished wine. The chemist explained how alcohol begins to acetify.
sindhiMeaning: سرڪي يا اسيٽڪ ايسڊ ۾ تبديل ڪرڻ، ذائقي ۾ کٽو يا تيزابي بڻائڻ
urduMeaning: سرکہ یا ایسٹک ایسڈ میں تبدیل کرنا، ذائقے میں کھٹا یا تیزابی بنانا

englishMeaning: Sharp and bitter in taste. Harsh, severe, or biting in speech, manner, or tone. Cutting or sarcastic in expression.
synonyms: Bitter, Sour, Sharp, Harsh, Caustic, Acrid, Biting, Acerbic, Tart
antonyms: Sweet, Mild, Gentle, Pleasant, Kind, Bland, Soothing
examples: The critic gave an acerb review of the play. Her acerb remarks silenced the whole room. He had an acerb wit that few people appreciated. The lemon had an unpleasantly acerb taste.
sindhiMeaning: ذائقي ۾ تکو ۽ ڪوڙو، ڳالهائڻ يا مزاج ۾ سخت ۽ چڀندڙ، طنزيه يا ڪٽيندڙ اظهار وارو
urduMeaning: ذائقے میں تیز اور تلخ، بات یا مزاج میں سخت اور چبھتا ہوا، طنزیہ اور کاٹ دار اظہار والا

englishMeaning: Vinegar, especially as used in pharmacy or chemistry. A dilute solution of acetic acid used as a solvent for medicinal substances.
synonyms: Vinegar, Acetic solution, Sour wine

englishMeaning: A person who lives in the clouds of their own imagination or dreams. Someone who does not follow the rules of society, literature, or art. A dreamer who is disconnected from ordinary reality. An unconventional thinker guided by imagination rather than convention. A cloud-walker in a poetic, figurative sense.
synonyms: Dreamer, Visionary, Idealist, Romantic, Free spirit, Nonconformist, Daydreamer
antonyms: Realist, Pragmatist, Conformist, Materialist, Conventionalist
examples: She was a true nefelibata, always lost in her poetic dreams. The artist called himself a nefelibata who ignored trends. Only a nefelibata could imagine such a magical world. His writing shows the free spirit of a nefelibata.
sindhiMeaning: خوابن ۽ خيالن جي دنيا ۾ رهندڙ ماڻهو، سماج جي قاعدن کان آجو، تصور پرست، رواج کان بغاوت ڪندڙ، خيالي دنيا جو رهاڪو، بادلن تي هلندڙ
urduMeaning: خوابوں اور خیالوں کی دنیا میں رہنے والا شخص، سماج کے اصولوں سے آزاد، تصور پسند، روایات سے بغاوت کرنے والا، خیالی دنیا کا باسی، بادلوں پر چلنے والا

englishMeaning: To fail badly at something, especially through carelessness. To lose a good opportunity by making a mistake. To ruin one's chance of success. To perform very poorly when it matters most. To waste something valuable through poor judgment.
synonyms: Fail, Botch, Ruin, Mess up, Bungle, Spoil, Fumble, Waste
antonyms: Succeed, Achieve, Win, Nail it, Excel, Accomplish, Master
examples: Don't blow it, this is your best chance to get the job. He worked hard for months but blew it in the final interview. She was ahead in the race but blew it in the last lap. If you blow it now, you may not get another chance.
sindhiMeaning: ڪم خراب ڪري ڇڏڻ، سٺو موقعو وڃائي ڇڏڻ، غلطي سبب ناڪام ٿيڻ، ڪامياب موقعو گم ڪرڻ، سڀ ڪجهه برباد ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کام بگاڑ دینا، اچھا موقع کھو دینا، غلطی سے ناکام ہو جانا، اچھا موقع ضائع کر دینا، سب کچھ تباہ کر دینا

englishMeaning: To fail suddenly and dramatically. To end in a spectacular disaster. To be defeated completely and publicly. To collapse in a very visible way. To ruin one's plans or reputation in a dramatic manner.
synonyms: Fail, Collapse, Crash, Crumble, Perish, Flop, Sink, Falter
antonyms: Succeed, Triumph, Prosper, Flourish, Thrive, Win
examples: His political career went down in flames after the scandal. The startup went down in flames within a year. Their plans went down in flames due to poor planning. He fought bravely but went down in flames.
sindhiMeaning: شديد ناڪامي سان ختم ٿيڻ، ڏسندي ڏسندي تباه ٿي وڃڻ، اوچتو ۽ نمايان طور تي هارائجي وڃڻ، برباد ٿيڻ، عزت خاڪ ۾ ملي وڃڻ
urduMeaning: بری طرح ناکام ہونا، دیکھتے ہی دیکھتے تباہ ہو جانا، اچانک اور واضح طور پر شکست کھا جانا، منصوبہ برباد ہو جانا، عزت خاک میں مل جانا

englishMeaning: To make no progress at all. To achieve nothing despite effort. To fail to reach a goal or agreement. To end up in the same situation as before. To have no success in an attempt.
synonyms: Fail, Stall, Stagnate, Falter, Flounder, Halt, Struggle
antonyms: Advance, Progress, Succeed, Achieve, Prosper, Move forward
examples: We argued for hours but got nowhere. Without proper planning, you will get nowhere in life. The negotiations got nowhere after two days. She tried her best but got nowhere with the project.
sindhiMeaning: ڪا ترقي نه ڪرڻ، ڪوشش جي باوجود ڪجهه به حاصل نه ڪرڻ، مقصد تائين نه پهچڻ، ساڳي هنڌ رهجي وڃڻ، ڪامياب نه ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: کوئی ترقی نہ کرنا، کوشش کے باوجود کچھ حاصل نہ کرنا، مقصد تک نہ پہنچنا، وہیں کا وہیں رہ جانا، کامیاب نہ ہونا

englishMeaning: Complete with regard to every detail. Careful and accurate in performing a task. Absolute and unmitigated in nature. Painstaking and methodical in approach. Not superficial or partial.
synonyms: Complete, Detailed, Comprehensive, Exhaustive, Careful, Meticulous, Painstaking, Rigorous
antonyms: Incomplete, Superficial, Careless, Partial, Cursory, Sloppy, Hasty
examples: The police conducted a thorough investigation of the case. She is a thorough professional in her field. He gave the room a thorough cleaning before guests arrived. Our teacher provided a thorough explanation of the topic.
sindhiMeaning: مڪمل، هر پهلوءَ کان پورو، محتاط، تفصيلي، غور سان ڪم ڪندڙ، مڪمل طور تي، پورو پورو
urduMeaning: مکمل، ہر پہلو سے پورا، محتاط، تفصیلی، غور و فکر سے کام کرنے والا، مکمل طور پر، جامع

englishMeaning: A demonstration of how something works or what it can do. A sample recording made to showcase a musician's ability. A trial version of software or a product. A short display of a product's features for promotion. To show or explain how something functions.
synonyms: Demonstration, Sample, Trial, Preview, Example, Presentation, Showing
antonyms: Actual, Final version, Full product, Concealment
examples: The salesman gave us a quick demo of the new phone. She recorded a demo to send to record labels. You can try the free demo before buying the software. Let me demo how this machine works.
sindhiMeaning: مظاهرو، ڪنهن شيءِ جي ڪم ڪرڻ جو ڏيکاءُ، نموني وارو ريڪارڊنگ، آزمائشي نسخو، پروڊڪٽ جي وضاحت ڪرڻ، مثال طور ڏيکارڻ
urduMeaning: مظاہرہ، کسی چیز کے کام کرنے کا نمونہ دکھانا، نمونہ ریکارڈنگ، آزمائشی نسخہ، پروڈکٹ کی وضاحت، مثال کے طور پر دکھانا

englishMeaning: The common people of an ancient Greek state. The populace or ordinary citizens as a political unit. More than one demonstration or sample. Plural form of demo, referring to trial versions or samples. The people considered as the source of political power in a democracy.
synonyms: People, Populace, Citizens, Public, Masses, Community, Samples, Trials
antonyms: Elite, Aristocracy, Rulers, Nobility, Final versions
examples: In ancient Athens the demos held real political power. The band released several demos before their first album. The company shared free demos of its new software. True democracy respects the will of the demos.
sindhiMeaning: عام ماڻهو، عوام، قديم يوناني رياست جا شهري، ڪيترائي مظاهرا يا نمونا، جمهوريت جو بنيادي عنصر، عوام الناس
urduMeaning: عام لوگ، عوام، قدیم یونانی ریاست کے شہری، متعدد مظاہرے یا نمونے، جمہوریت میں طاقت کا سرچشمہ، عوام الناس

englishMeaning: A long and eventful journey or experience. A series of wanderings or adventures. A lengthy adventurous voyage. A long spiritual or intellectual quest. A great Greek epic poem by Homer describing such a journey.
synonyms: Journey, Voyage, Adventure, Expedition, Quest, Trek, Pilgrimage, Wandering
antonyms: Stagnation, Rest, Halt, Standstill, Idleness
examples: His life has been an odyssey of struggles and triumphs. The book describes an odyssey across seven countries. Their space mission was a real odyssey. Writing this novel was an emotional odyssey for her.
sindhiMeaning: ڊگهو ۽ واقعن سان ڀريل سفر، ڪيترن مهم جوئين وارو سفر، روحاني يا فڪري ڊگهي کوجنا، هومر جو مشهور يوناني رزميه، سفرِ زندگي
urduMeaning: لمبا اور واقعات سے بھرپور سفر، مہم جوئی سے بھرا سفر، روحانی یا فکری تلاش، ہومر کی مشہور یونانی رزمیہ نظم، طویل مہماتی سفر

englishMeaning: A journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially exploration. A short trip made for a specific reason. Promptness or speed in doing something. The group of people making such a journey. A military mission sent to a distant place.
synonyms: Journey, Voyage, Trip, Mission, Quest, Trek, Exploration, Tour, Speed
antonyms: Delay, Stagnation, Rest, Halt, Sluggishness
examples: They joined an expedition to the North Pole. The scientific expedition discovered a new species. He led an expedition into the deep jungle. The mail was delivered with great expedition.
sindhiMeaning: مهم، ڪنهن خاص مقصد لاءِ ڪيل سفر، تحقيق يا کوجنا وارو سفر، تڪڙ سان ڪم ڪرڻ، مهم تي ويندڙ ٽولو، فوجي مهم
urduMeaning: مہم، کسی خاص مقصد کے لیے کیا جانے والا سفر، تحقیق یا دریافت کا سفر، تیزی سے کام کرنا، مہم پر جانے والا گروہ، فوجی مہم

englishMeaning: A journey to a sacred place for religious reasons. A trip made to a place that is special or important to someone. A long journey involving a search for meaning or moral significance. A visit to a holy site as an act of devotion. Any journey undertaken for a deeply personal reason.
synonyms: Journey, Voyage, Trip, Expedition, Quest, Visitation, Hajj, Tour
antonyms: Stay, Rest, Halt, Idleness, Homecoming
examples: Every year millions of Muslims go on pilgrimage to Mecca. She made a pilgrimage to her grandfather's birthplace. The old church is a popular place of pilgrimage. Their trip felt like a spiritual pilgrimage.
sindhiMeaning: زيارت، مذهبي مقصد لاءِ مقدس هنڌ جو سفر، حج، روحاني مقصد سان ڪيل سفر، ڪنهن معنيٰ ڀرئي مقصد لاءِ ڊگهو سفر، عبادت جي نيت سان يڪر رخي سفر
urduMeaning: زیارت، مذہبی مقصد کے لیے مقدس مقام کا سفر، حج، روحانی مقصد سے کیا جانے والا سفر، کسی بامعنی مقصد کے لیے طویل سفر، عبادت کی نیت سے سفر

englishMeaning: The act of traveling, especially on foot. A journey or trip made by an ordinary traveler. Passage from one place to another. The experience or process of traveling along a road. Movement across a distance as part of a journey.
synonyms: Travel, Journey, Voyage, Trip, Passage, Trek, Roaming
antonyms: Stay, Rest, Settlement, Halt, Idleness
examples: His life of wayfare took him across many lands. The old man spoke of his years of wayfare with joy. Wayfare in ancient times was full of dangers. She loved the simple joy of wayfare on country roads.
sindhiMeaning: سفر ڪرڻ، خاص ڪري پيدل سفر، عام سفر، هڪ هنڌ کان ٻئي هنڌ وڃڻ، رستي تي هلڻ جو عمل، مسافري
urduMeaning: سفر کرنا، خاص طور پر پیدل سفر، عام سفر، ایک جگہ سے دوسری جگہ جانا، راستے پر چلنے کا عمل، مسافرت

englishMeaning: A person who travels, especially on foot. A traveler or wanderer. Someone who is on a journey through unfamiliar places. A pilgrim or roamer moving from place to place. A person who spends much of their life traveling.
synonyms: Traveler, Wanderer, Pilgrim, Roamer, Voyager, Trekker, Nomad, Rover
antonyms: Resident, Settler, Local, Native, Homebody
examples: An old wayfarer stopped at the inn to rest for the night. The wayfarer walked with a small bag on his back. Many wayfarers cross this mountain pass every year. She felt like a lonely wayfarer in a strange city.
sindhiMeaning: مسافر، پيدل سفر ڪندڙ، گهمندڙ، اڻ ڄاڻ رستن جو مسافر، سفر ڪندڙ شخص، پيرين پنڌ ويندڙ
urduMeaning: مسافر، پیدل سفر کرنے والا، گھومنے پھرنے والا، اجنبی راستوں کا مسافر، سفر کرنے والا شخص، راہ گیر

englishMeaning: An act of traveling from one place to another. A long and often difficult process of personal change and development. The distance covered or time taken in traveling. A trip made for a particular purpose. The passage or progress from one stage to another.
synonyms: Trip, Voyage, Expedition, Trek, Tour, Passage, Excursion, Odyssey
antonyms: Stay, Rest, Halt, Arrival, Settlement
examples: They set out on a long journey across the country. Life is a journey full of ups and downs. Her journey to success was inspiring. The journey by train takes about six hours.
sindhiMeaning: سفر، هڪ هنڌ کان ٻئي هنڌ وڃڻ، زندگيءَ جو ڊگهو تجربو، ذاتي ترقيءَ جو عمل، سفر جو فاصلو يا وقت، مسافري
urduMeaning: سفر، ایک جگہ سے دوسری جگہ جانا، زندگی کا لمبا تجربہ، ذاتی ترقی کا سفر، سفر کا فاصلہ یا وقت، مسافت

englishMeaning: A long and difficult journey, especially on foot. A journey involving hardship or adventure. To travel slowly and with effort over a difficult terrain. A migration of people or animals over a long distance. A hike undertaken for recreation or exploration.
synonyms: Hike, Journey, Expedition, March, Walk, Trip, Voyage, Trudge
antonyms: Rest, Stay, Halt, Idleness, Standstill
examples: They made a long trek through the Himalayas. The daily trek to school was tiring for the children. Our trek across the desert took two weeks. We plan to trek up the mountain next summer.
sindhiMeaning: ڊگهو ۽ ڏکيو سفر، خاص ڪري پيدل، محنت سان ڪيل سفر، پهاڙي علائقن ۾ گهمڻ، مهم جوئي وارو سفر، ماڻهن يا جانورن جي هجرت
urduMeaning: لمبا اور مشکل سفر، خاص طور پر پیدل، محنت سے کیا گیا سفر، پہاڑوں پر پیدل چلنا، مہم جوئی سفر، لوگوں یا جانوروں کی ہجرت

englishMeaning: A way or course taken to get from one place to another. A regular line of travel or delivery. A method or means of achieving something. The path chosen for a journey. To send or direct along a particular course.
synonyms: Path, Way, Course, Road, Track, Passage, Direction, Line
antonyms: Deviation, Detour, Obstruction, Standstill
examples: We took the shortest route to the airport. The bus follows the same route every day. Hard work is the surest route to success. Please route the package through Karachi.
sindhiMeaning: رستو، هڪ هنڌ کان ٻئي هنڌ وڃڻ جو طريقو، ڪنهن مقصد لاءِ اختيار ڪيل طريقو، مقرر رستو، ڪنهن شيءِ کي مقرر رستي تي موڪلڻ
urduMeaning: راستہ، ایک جگہ سے دوسری جگہ جانے کا طریقہ، کسی مقصد کے لیے اختیار کیا گیا طریقہ، مقررہ راستہ، کسی چیز کو مخصوص راستے پر بھیجنا

englishMeaning: An instrument for measuring the distance traveled by a vehicle. A device that records the total mileage of a car. A mechanical or digital tool showing distance covered. A gauge fitted in vehicles to track journey length. Any instrument for measuring distance in motion.
synonyms: Mileometer, Distance meter, Gauge, Meter, Measuring device
antonyms: Speedometer (measures speed, not distance)
examples: The odometer showed that the car had done 80,000 miles. He checked the odometer before selling the car. A faulty odometer can hide a vehicle's true mileage. The mechanic reset the odometer during repairs.
sindhiMeaning: گاڏيءَ ۾ لڳل اهو اوزار جيڪو طي ڪيل مفاصلو ماپي، ميل ماپيندڙ، فاصلو ٻڌائيندڙ آلو، سفر جو فاصلو ريڪارڊ ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: گاڑی میں لگا وہ آلہ جو طے کیا گیا فاصلہ ناپتا ہے، میل شمار کرنے والا آلہ، فاصلہ بتانے والا میٹر، سفر کا فاصلہ ریکارڈ کرنے والا

englishMeaning: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent. The end point of a journey. The purpose for which something is intended. A popular place that people travel to. The ultimate goal or aim of an action.
synonyms: Goal, Target, End, Terminus, Aim, Objective, Stop, Endpoint
antonyms: Origin, Start, Source, Departure point, Beginning
examples: Our final destination was a small village in the mountains. Dubai is a popular tourist destination. The package reached its destination on time. Hard work will take you to your destination in life.
sindhiMeaning: منزل، اهو هنڌ جتي ڪو ماڻهو يا شيءِ وڃي رهي هجي، سفر جو آخري هنڌ، مقصد، مشهور گهمڻ جو هنڌ، آخري نشانو
urduMeaning: منزل، وہ جگہ جہاں کوئی جا رہا ہو یا بھیجا جا رہا ہو، سفر کا آخری مقام، مقصد، مشہور سیاحتی مقام، آخری ہدف

englishMeaning: The act of leaving a place, especially to start a journey. A deviation from an accepted or usual course. The action of leaving a job or position. The starting point of a train, bus, or flight. A new or different way of doing something.
synonyms: Leaving, Exit, Start, Farewell, Withdrawal, Deviation, Divergence
antonyms: Arrival, Return, Coming, Entry, Homecoming
examples: His sudden departure surprised the whole family. The train departure is scheduled at 6 AM. Her new film is a departure from her usual style. They watched the departure of the ship from the harbor.
sindhiMeaning: روانگي، ڪنهن هنڌ ڇڏي وڃڻ، سفر جي شروعات، عام روش کان هٽڻ، نوڪري ڇڏڻ، نئون طريقو اختيار ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: روانگی، کسی جگہ سے چلے جانا، سفر کا آغاز، عام روش سے ہٹنا، نوکری چھوڑنا، نیا طریقہ اختیار کرنا

englishMeaning: The act of coming to or reaching a place. A person or thing that has come or been brought to a place. The moment when someone or something begins to exist or be used. The appearance of something new in a particular field. The reaching of a conclusion or decision.
synonyms: Coming, Entrance, Appearance, Approach, Advent, Landing, Reaching
antonyms: Departure, Leaving, Exit, Withdrawal, Absence
examples: We are waiting for the arrival of the train. Her arrival brought great joy to the family. The arrival of the internet changed our lives. A new arrival in the neighborhood was warmly welcomed.
sindhiMeaning: پهچڻ، ڪنهن هنڌ اچڻ جو عمل، تازو آيل ماڻهو يا شيءِ، ڪنهن نئين شيءِ جو منظر عام تي اچڻ، منزل تي پهچڻ، نتيجي تي پهچڻ
urduMeaning: آمد، کسی جگہ پہنچنے کا عمل، نیا آنے والا شخص یا چیز، کسی نئی چیز کا وجود میں آنا، منزل پر پہنچنا، کسی نتیجے پر پہنچنا

englishMeaning: A low, continuous humming sound made by insects or machines. A feeling of excitement, energy, or pleasant intoxication. A rumor or piece of news that is spreading quickly. To make a low humming sound. To call someone using a buzzer or intercom.
synonyms: Hum, Murmur, Drone, Rumor, Excitement, Whisper, Ring
antonyms: Silence, Quiet, Calm, Stillness, Hush
examples: There was a loud buzz of bees near the flowers. A buzz of excitement filled the stadium. There is a buzz that the company will launch a new product. Please buzz me when the guest arrives.
sindhiMeaning: ڀڻ ڀڻ، مکين يا مشين جو مسلسل هلڪو آواز، جوش يا ولولو، اڏامندڙ خبر، ڀڻڪو، بجليءَ جي گهنٽيءَ سان سڏڻ
urduMeaning: بھنبھناہٹ، مکھیوں یا مشین کی مسلسل ہلکی آواز، جوش و خروش، اڑتی ہوئی خبر، سرگوشی، بجلی کی گھنٹی سے بلانا

englishMeaning: Making a low, continuous humming or vibrating sound like that of a bee. Filled with lively activity, excitement, or energy. Feeling a sense of thrill, excitement, or pleasant tingling. Spreading quickly through talk, rumor, or gossip. Slightly intoxicated or lightheaded.
synonyms: Humming, Droning, Whirring, Murmuring, Vibrating, Bustling, Lively, Active, Thriving, Exciting, Thrilling
antonyms: Silent, Quiet, Still, Calm, Dull, Lifeless, Boring, Inactive, Peaceful, Motionless
examples: The bees were buzzing around the garden all afternoon. The city was buzzing with excitement before the festival. She felt her phone buzzing in her pocket. The office was buzzing with rumors about the new manager.
sindhiMeaning: ماکيءَ جي مکين وانگر گنگناهٽ جو آواز ڪندڙ، سرگرم ۽ چهل پهل سان ڀريل، جوش ۽ خوشيءَ سان ڀرپور، تيزيءَ سان پکڙيل ڳالهيون يا افواهون، ٿورو نشي واري حالت ۾، ٿرٿراهٽ يا لهرن جو محسوس ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: مکھی کی طرح گنگناہٹ کی آواز نکالنے والا، سرگرمی اور چہل پہل سے بھرپور، جوش و خروش سے معمور، تیزی سے پھیلنے والی افواہیں یا باتیں، ہلکے نشے کی کیفیت میں، سنسناہٹ یا لہر محسوس کرنا

englishMeaning: Dishonest, deceitful, or unprincipled behavior. A trick or act performed by a dishonest person. Cunning or roguish conduct intended to cheat others. The quality of being a knave or scoundrel. Mischievous or fraudulent dealings.
synonyms: Dishonesty, Trickery, Deceit, Fraud, Roguery, Mischief, Cheating, Villainy, Chicanery, Duplicity
antonyms: Honesty, Integrity, Sincerity, Truthfulness, Uprightness, Fairness, Virtue, Trustworthiness, Loyalty

urduMeaning: جمہوریت کی حمایت کرنے والا شخص, وہ شخص جو سمجھتا ہے کہ حکومت کو عوام کی نمائندگی کرنی چاہیے, جمہوری حقوق اور عوامی شرکت کا حامی, منتخب نمائندوں کی حکومت کا حامی, امریکہ کی  ڈیموکریٹک پارٹی کا رکن یا حامی

englishMeaning: A senior naval officer of very high rank. An officer who commands a fleet of warships. A high-ranking commander responsible for major naval operations. A title or rank used for senior officers in a navy. In some countries, "Admiral" is one of the highest ranks in the naval forces.
synonyms: Naval commander, Fleet commander, Officer, Sea lord, Commander, Flag officer
antonyms: Sailor, Soldier, Private, Recruit, Civilian, Subordinate
examples: The admiral inspected the fleet. She became the first female admiral in the navy. The admiral ordered the ships to return. A red admiral butterfly landed on the flower.
sindhiMeaning: بحري فوج جو تمام اعليٰ درجي وارو آفيسر, اهڙو فوجي آفيسر جيڪو جنگي جهازن جي وڏي بيڙي جي ڪمان ڪري, بحري فوجي ڪارروائين ۽ آپريشنن جي نگراني ڪندڙ اعليٰ ڪمانڊر, بحري فوج ۾ هڪ اعليٰ فوجي عهدو, ڪيترن ئي ملڪن ۾ ايڊمرل بحري فوج جي سڀ کان مٿين عهدن مان هڪ هوندو آهي
urduMeaning: بحری فوج کا نہایت اعلیٰ رتبے والا افسر۔, ایسا افسر جو جنگی بحری جہازوں کے بڑے بیڑے کی کمان کرتا ہے۔, بحری فوجی کارروائیوں کی نگرانی اور قیادت کرنے والا اعلیٰ کمانڈر۔, بحری فوج کا ایک اعلیٰ فوجی عہدہ۔, کئی ممالک میں ایڈمرل بحری فوج کے اعلیٰ ترین عہدوں میں سے ایک ہوتا ہے۔

englishMeaning: The process of making an idea, product, activity, subject, person, culture, or form of knowledge more widely known and accepted by the general public.  It can also mean explaining something complicated in a simple way so that ordinary people can understand it easily.
synonyms: Popularization, Promotion, Publicity, Spread, Dissemination, Simplification, Outreach
antonyms: Obscurity, Suppression, Concealment, Restriction, Unpopularity, Complexity
examples: The populariztion of science requires clear language. The campaign led to the populariztion of the new sport. In this sheet, populariztion means popularization. The populariztion of online learning changed education.
sindhiMeaning: مقبول بڻائڻ, وڏي پيماني تي مشهور ڪرڻ, عام ڪرڻ, عوامي دلچسپي وڌائڻ, ماڻهن ۾ خيال ڦهلائڻ, علم کي آسان بڻائي عام ڪرڻ, عوام ۾ واڌارو ڏيڻ / مشهور ڪرڻ, وڌيڪ ماڻهن تائين پهچائڻ
urduMeaning: مقبول بنانا, وسیع پیمانے پر مشہور کرنا, عام کرنا, عوامی دلچسپی بڑھانا, لوگوں میں خیال پھیلانا, علم کو آسان بنا کر عام کرنا, عوام میں فروغ دینا, زیادہ لوگوں تک پہنچانا

englishMeaning: Extremely pale in the face, usually because of fear, shock or illness. Having lost all colour from the face suddenly. Looking frightened or unwell to a noticeable degree. Very pale in appearance, like white cloth.
synonyms: Pale, Pallid, Ashen, Ghostly, Bloodless, Colourless, Wan, Blanched
antonyms: Rosy, Flushed, Ruddy, Glowing, Healthy-looking, Red-faced
examples: She went white as a sheet when she heard the news. He came out of the hospital room white as a sheet. You are white as a sheet, please sit down and drink some water. The boy turned white as a sheet after the loud crash.
sindhiMeaning: منهن جو رنگ لهي وڃڻ، خوف يا صدمي سبب بلڪل اڇو ٿي وڃڻ، بيماري سبب بيحد پيلو ٿيڻ، ڊپ کان منهن ڦڪو ٿي وڃڻ، ڪپڙي جيان اڇو ڏسڻ ۾ اچڻ
urduMeaning: چہرے کا رنگ اڑ جانا، خوف یا صدمے سے بالکل سفید پڑ جانا، بیماری کے باعث نہایت زرد ہو جانا، ڈر سے چہرہ فق ہو جانا، سفید کپڑے کی طرح پیلا دکھائی دینا

englishMeaning: Relating to office, professional or administrative work rather than manual labour. Describing employees who work in offices, usually in salaried positions. Referring to crimes committed by professionals for financial gain, such as fraud. A worker whose job requires education and clerical or managerial skills.
synonyms: Office-based, Clerical, Professional, Administrative, Salaried, Executive, Desk job
antonyms: Blue collar, Manual, Labouring, Industrial, Menial, Hands-on
examples: He left a factory job for a white collar position in the city. White collar crime often goes unreported for years. The company employs both white collar and blue collar staff. Many white collar workers now do their jobs from home.
sindhiMeaning: دفتري يا پيشيوراڻي ڪم سان لاڳاپيل، هٿن سان محنت جي بدران ڪلرڪي يا انتظامي نوڪري، دفتر ۾ ڪم ڪندڙ ملازم، تعليم يافته ملازم طبقو، دولت لاءِ پيشيورن پاران ڪيل ٺڳي وارا ڏوهه
urduMeaning: دفتری یا پیشہ ورانہ کام سے متعلق، جسمانی محنت کے بجائے کلرکی یا انتظامی ملازمت، دفتر میں کام کرنے والا ملازم، تعلیم یافتہ ملازم طبقہ، پیشہ ور افراد کی جانب سے مالی فائدے کے لیے کیے گئے فراڈ جیسے جرائم

englishMeaning: A possession that is costly to keep but of little or no use. A project or building that costs a great deal and gives little benefit. An unwanted item that is difficult to dispose of. Something impressive in size but a burden to its owner.
synonyms: Burden, Money pit, Liability, Albatross, Dead weight, Useless asset, Drain
antonyms: Asset, Bargain, Valuable, Godsend, Profitable venture, Treasure
examples: The new stadium turned out to be a white elephant for the city. That old boat is a white elephant we can neither use nor sell. Critics called the airport a costly white elephant. The mansion became a white elephant after the family lost its income.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا رکڻ ۾ مهانگي پر فائدي کان خالي هجي، اڇو هاٿي، اهڙو منصوبو جنهن تي خرچ گهڻو ۽ فائدو ٿورو، بيڪار پر بار وارو مال، جنهن مان جان ڇڏائڻ به ڏکي هجي
urduMeaning: ایسی چیز جسے رکھنا مہنگا مگر فائدہ کچھ نہ ہو، سفید ہاتھی، ایسا منصوبہ جس پر خرچ زیادہ اور فائدہ کم ہو، بیکار مگر بوجھ بنی ہوئی چیز، جس سے جان چھڑانا بھی مشکل ہو

englishMeaning: To deliberately hide unpleasant facts or wrongdoing. To present a false, favourable account in order to protect someone's reputation. To cover a surface with a white lime-based paint. In sport, to defeat an opponent in every game or match of a series.
synonyms: Cover up, Conceal, Gloss over, Camouflage, Sanitize, Suppress, Clean slate, Clean sweep
antonyms: Expose, Reveal, Disclose, Uncover, Admit, Investigate, Highlight
examples: The report was criticised as a whitewash of official failures. They tried to whitewash the scandal with a short apology. He spent the weekend whitewashing the garden wall. The team suffered a five-nil whitewash in the series.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن غلطي يا ڏوهه کي ڍڪڻ، سچ لڪائي معاملو صاف ڏيکارڻ، ڪنهن جي عزت بچائڻ لاءِ ڪوڙي وضاحت ڏيڻ، ڀت تي چوني جو سفيدو ڪرڻ، راند ۾ مخالف کي سڀ ميچون هارائڻ
urduMeaning: کسی غلطی یا جرم پر پردہ ڈالنا، سچ چھپا کر معاملہ صاف دکھانا، کسی کی ساکھ بچانے کے لیے جھوٹی توجیہ پیش کرنا، دیوار پر چونے کی سفیدی کرنا، کھیل میں حریف کو تمام میچوں میں شکست دینا

englishMeaning: Breakdown of an organized system. Collapse of structure or discipline. Gradual loss of order and stability. Movement from organization to disorder. Deterioration of a planned arrangement.
synonyms: Breakdown, Collapse, Disintegration, Disorder, Chaos, Deterioration, Decline, Disarray, Destabilization, Fragmentation
antonyms: Order, Organization, Stability, Structure, Harmony, Discipline, Coordination, Unity, Balance, Control
examples: The country's unravelling order created uncertainty among its citizens. The manager acted quickly to prevent the unravelling order of the company's operations. Historians studied the unravelling order of the ancient empire before its collapse. Without clear leadership, the team experienced an unravelling order that affected productivity.
sindhiMeaning: نظام جو بگڙجڻ، نظم جو ختم ٿيڻ، بي ترتيبي پيدا ٿيڻ، منظم نظام جو زوال، قانون ۽ نظم جو ڪمزور ٿيڻ، ترتيب جو آهستي آهستي ختم ٿيڻ، افراتفري يا بي ترتيبي ڏانهن وڃڻ، ڪنهن قائم ٿيل ڍانچي جو ڀڃ ڊاهه
urduMeaning: نظام کا ٹوٹنا، قائم شدہ نظام کا زوال، ترتیب کا آہستہ آہستہ ختم ہونا، انتشار اور بدنظمی پیدا ہونا، نظم و ضبط کا کمزور پڑ جانا، منظم ڈھانچے کا ٹوٹ جانا، نظم و ضبط کا آہستہ آہستہ بکھر جانا

englishMeaning: To explain or clarify the meaning of words, actions, signs, symbols, laws, dreams, or events. To understand something in a particular way, based on your own opinion or judgment. To translate spoken or signed language from one language into another. To perform or express the meaning of a piece of music, drama, or art in your own style.
synonyms: Explain, Clarify, Understand, Translate, Decipher, Elucidate, Expound, Construe, Analyze, Read
antonyms: Misinterpret, Misunderstand, Confuse, Obscure, Distort, Complicate, Ignore, Conceal
examples: The teacher helped the students interpret the poem correctly. Different people may interpret the same event in different ways. A professional interpreter can interpret the speech from English into Urdu. Scientists continue to interpret the data before reaching a conclusion.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن لفظ  جملي  قانون  خواب يا واقعي جي وضاحت ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه کي پنهنجي سمجهه يا راءِ موجب سمجهڻ، هڪ ٻولي ۾ ڳالهايل ڳالهه کي ٻي ٻولي ۾ زباني ترجمو ڪرڻ، موسيقي ، ڊرامي يا فن جي پنهنجي انداز سان پيشڪش ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی لفظ  قانون  خواب یا واقعے کی وضاحت کرنا، کسی بات کو اپنی سمجھ یا رائے کے مطابق سمجھنا، ایک زبان میں کہی گئی بات کو دوسری زبان میں زبانی منتقل کرنا، موسیقی  ڈرامہ یا فن کو اپنے انداز میں پیش کرنا

englishMeaning: Actively participating in an activity, event, or organization. Closely related to or connected with something. Having many details or parts that make something difficult to understand. Having strong emotional feelings for someone or something. Connected with an illegal act, problem, or difficult situation. (past tense and past participle of involve)
synonyms: Associated, Connected, Engaged, Participating, Concerned, Included, Related, Attached, Committed, Occupied, Entangled, Implicated
antonyms: Uninvolved, Detached, Independent, Separate, Disconnected, Isolated, Unconcerned, Unrelated, Excluded, Free
examples: She is involved in many charity projects. Several companies were involved in the project. The instructions are quite involved. She became emotionally involved with the family. He was involved in the robbery.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم  سرگرمي يا تنظيم ۾ سرگرم نموني شامل هجڻ، ڪنهن شخص  واقعي يا معاملي سان لاڳاپيل هجڻ، گهڻن حصن يا تفصيلن سبب پيچيده هجڻ، جذباتي طور وابسته يا دل لڳل هجڻ، ڪنهن ڏوهه  تڪرار يا مسئلي ۾ ملوث هجڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کام  سرگرمی یا تنظیم میں فعال طور پر شامل ہونا، کسی شخص  واقعے یا معاملے سے متعلق ہونا، بہت سے حصوں یا تفصیلات کی وجہ سے پیچیدہ ہونا، جذباتی طور پر وابستہ ہونا، کسی جرم  تنازع یا مسئلے میں ملوث ہونا

englishMeaning: To include someone or something as a necessary part. To cause a person to take part in an activity. To require or imply a particular action, risk, or result. To affect or concern someone directly.
synonyms: Include, Engage, Entail, Require, Concern, Affect, Implicate, Draw in, Connect, Comprise
antonyms: Exclude, Omit, Separate, Detach, Avoid, Free, Disconnect, Ignore
examples: The project will involve several local schools. Do not involve children in adult arguments. The job involves travel and long meetings. The decision may involve serious financial risk.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي يا شيءِ کي لازمي حصو بڻائڻ، ڪنهن کي ڪم ۾ شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن عمل خطري يا نتيجي جي ضرورت رکڻ، ڪنهن سان سڌو واسطو يا اثر رکڻ
urduMeaning: کسی شخص یا چیز کو لازمی حصہ بنانا، کسی کو کام میں شامل کرنا، کسی عمل خطرے یا نتیجے کی ضرورت رکھنا، کسی سے براہ راست تعلق یا اثر رکھنا

englishMeaning: The act or state of taking part in something. Participation or engagement in an activity. A connection with a person, event, or situation. Emotional or practical commitment.
synonyms: Participation, Engagement, Connection, Association, Role, Commitment, Concern, Inclusion, Attachment, Implication
antonyms: Noninvolvement, Exclusion, Detachment, Separation, Disinterest, Withdrawal, Absence, Distance
examples: Her involvement improved the whole campaign. Police questioned him about his involvement in the case. Parents are encouraged to increase their involvement in school life. His emotional involvement made the decision harder.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ۾ شامل ٿيڻ جي حالت، شرڪت يا عملي وابستگي، ڪنهن شخص واقعي يا حالت سان تعلق، جذباتي يا عملي ذميواري
urduMeaning: کسی کام میں شامل ہونے کی حالت، شرکت یا عملی وابستگی، کسی شخص واقعے یا حالت سے تعلق، جذباتی یا عملی ذمہ داری

englishMeaning: To make someone take part in an activity or situation. To include a person in a process, problem, or event. To connect someone with a matter. To draw someone into something, especially responsibility or difficulty.
synonyms: Include in, Engage in, Draw into, Bring into, Connect with, Implicate in, Enlist in, Associate with
antonyms: Exclude from, Keep out of, Remove from, Detach from, Free from, Separate from, Omit from
examples: The teacher tried to involve every student in the discussion. Do not involve me in your private dispute. The charity involves volunteers in community projects. The scandal involved several officials in serious accusations.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي ڪم يا حالت ۾ شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي عمل مسئلي يا واقعي جو حصو بڻائڻ، ڪنهن کي معاملي سان ڳنڍڻ، ڪنهن کي ذميواري يا ڏکيائي ۾ آڻڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو کام یا حالت میں شامل کرنا، کسی کو عمل مسئلے یا واقعے کا حصہ بنانا، کسی کو معاملے سے جوڑنا، کسی کو ذمہ داری یا مشکل میں لانا

englishMeaning: The insertion of extra words, numbers, or material into a text, data set, or sequence. An added passage not originally present. Estimation of a value between known values. A mathematical or textual insertion.
synonyms: Insertion, Addition, Insert, Estimate, Supplement, Extrapolation, Inclusion, Expansion, Amendment, Intercalation
antonyms: Deletion, Removal, Omission, Extraction, Subtraction, Original text, Exact value
examples: The editor marked a doubtful interpolation in the manuscript. Interpolation helped estimate the missing temperature value. The poem contains a later interpolation by another writer. The chart uses interpolation between measured points.
sindhiMeaning: وچ ۾ شامل ڪرڻ، وچ ۾ داخل ڪرڻ، وچ واري قيمت جو اندازو لڳائڻ، موجود ڊيٽا يا سلسلي ۾ اضافي لفظ انگ يا مواد داخل ڪرڻ، اصل ۾ نه هئڻ وارو وڌايل حصو، ڄاتل قدرن جي وچ وارو اندازو، رياضي يا متن ۾ اضافو
urduMeaning: متن ڈیٹا یا سلسلے میں اضافی الفاظ اعداد یا مواد داخل کرنا، اصل میں نہ موجود اضافہ شدہ حصہ، معلوم قدروں کے درمیان اندازہ، ریاضی یا متن میں اضافہ

englishMeaning: To insert words, figures, or material into a text or sequence. To estimate a missing value between known values. To add something between existing parts. To introduce material that was not originally present.
synonyms: Insert, Add, Estimate, Interject, Introduce, Supplement, Interpose, Fill in, Calculate, Include
antonyms: Remove, Delete, Omit, Extract, Subtract, Leave out, Preserve unchanged
examples: The software can interpolate missing data. The translator did not interpolate personal comments into the text. Scientists interpolate values between two measurements. A later scribe may have interpolated the sentence.
sindhiMeaning: موجود مواد جي وچ ۾ ڪا شيءِ شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنھن تحرير ۾ لفظ شامل ڪرڻ، معلوم قدرن جي وچ ۾ گم ٿيل قدر جو اندازو لڳائڻ، سلسلي ۾ خال ڀرڻ، اضافي معلومات شامل ڪرڻ، وچ وارو قدر معلوم ڪرڻ، اصل ڪم ۾ مواد شامل ڪرڻ، ٻن ڊيٽا نقطن جي وچ ۾ اندازو لڳائڻ
urduMeaning: متن یا سلسلے میں الفاظ اعداد یا مواد داخل کرنا، معلوم قدروں کے درمیان گم قدر کا اندازہ لگانا، موجود حصوں کے درمیان کچھ بڑھانا، اصل میں نہ موجود مواد شامل کرنا

englishMeaning: A reciprocal effect or interaction between people, forces, ideas, or things. The way different elements influence each other. A dynamic relationship of action and response.
synonyms: Interaction, Relationship, Exchange, Reciprocity, Connection, Influence, Cooperation, Dynamics, Interrelation, Mutual effect
antonyms: Isolation, Separation, Independence, Disconnection, Noninteraction, Detachment, One-sided action
examples: The film shows the interplay between memory and identity. Economic policy depends on the interplay of supply and demand. Their music relies on the interplay of two guitars. The study examines the interplay between diet and health.
sindhiMeaning: ماڻهن قوتن خيالن يا شين وچ ۾ گڏيل اثر، مختلف عنصرن جو هڪ ٻئي تي اثر وجهڻ، عمل ۽ ردعمل وارو متحرڪ تعلق
urduMeaning: لوگوں قوتوں خیالات یا چیزوں کے درمیان باہمی اثر، مختلف عناصر کا ایک دوسرے پر اثر ڈالنا، عمل اور ردعمل والا متحرک تعلق

englishMeaning: Existing, traveling, or occurring between planets. Relating to space between planets. Involving more than one planet. Suitable for travel from one planet to another.
synonyms: Space, Planet-to-planet, Celestial, Astronomical, Cosmic, Extraterrestrial, Solar-system, Between planets
antonyms: Terrestrial, Earthbound, Local, Planetary only, Atmospheric, Ground-based
examples: The probe entered interplanetary space. Scientists planned an interplanetary mission to Mars. Interplanetary dust can affect spacecraft. The novel imagines interplanetary trade.
sindhiMeaning: سيارن جي وچ ۾ موجود يا سفر ڪندڙ، سيارن جي وچ واري خلا سان لاڳاپيل، هڪ کان وڌيڪ سيارن سان واسطو رکندڙ، هڪ سياري کان ٻئي سياري تائين سفر لاءِ مناسب
urduMeaning: سیاروں کے درمیان موجود یا سفر کرنے والا، سیاروں کے درمیان خلا سے متعلق، ایک سے زیادہ سیاروں سے وابستہ، ایک سیارے سے دوسرے سیارے تک سفر کے لیے مناسب

englishMeaning: Mutual penetration or passing into one another. The blending or overlapping of two things so each affects the other. A deep mixing of ideas, cultures, forces, or substances.
synonyms: Intermixing, Blending, Overlap, Fusion, Integration, Mutual penetration, Mingling, Permeation, Interweaving

englishMeaning: A mass of short, soft, light fibres or hairs. A blurred or unclear appearance in an image or sound. A distorted electric guitar effect. To become blurred or indistinct. An informal and slang term for the police.
synonyms: Fluff, Down, Lint, Haze, Blur, Distortion, Nap, Frizz
antonyms: Clarity, Sharpness, Smoothness, Focus, Precision
examples: There was a soft fuzz on the surface of the peach. The old photograph has lost detail and shows only fuzz. He added fuzz to the guitar for a rougher sound. The picture began to fuzz as the signal weakened.
sindhiMeaning: نرم ۽ ننڍڙا وار يا ريشا، ڪنهن تصوير يا آواز جو ڌنڌلو هجڻ، گٽار جو ٿلهو ۽ بگڙيل آواز، ڌنڌلو ٿي وڃڻ، پوليس لاءِ عام ٻولي ۾ لفظ
urduMeaning: نرم اور چھوٹے بال یا ریشے، تصویر یا آواز کا دھندلا پن، گٹار کی بھاری اور بگڑی ہوئی آواز، دھندلا ہو جانا، پولیس کے لیے عامیانہ لفظ

englishMeaning: In a blurred or unclear manner. Without sharp definition or precise detail. In a soft, fluffy way. In a confused or vague manner of thinking or speaking.
synonyms: Blurrily, Vaguely, Indistinctly, Hazily, Unclearly, Dimly
antonyms: Clearly, Sharply, Distinctly, Precisely, Vividly
examples: The distant hills appeared fuzzily through the mist. He remembered the evening only fuzzily. The text was printed fuzzily on cheap paper. She spoke fuzzily after waking from a deep sleep.
sindhiMeaning: ڌنڌلي انداز ۾، صاف يا واضح نه، غير واضح طور تي، نرم ۽ ريشمي انداز سان، مونجهاري واري نموني سوچيندي يا ڳالهائيندي
urduMeaning: دھندلے انداز میں، غیر واضح طور پر، بغیر صفائی کے، نرم و ملائم انداز میں، الجھے ہوئے انداز میں سوچتے یا بولتے ہوئے

englishMeaning: The state of being blurred, unclear, or lacking sharp detail. The quality of being covered with soft short hairs. Vagueness or lack of precision in thought, language, or definition.
synonyms: Blurriness, Haziness, Vagueness, Ambiguity, Indistinctness, Softness
antonyms: Clarity, Sharpness, Precision, Definition, Exactness
examples: The fuzziness of the image made the text unreadable. There is some fuzziness in the definition of the term. He complained about the fuzziness of the old television screen. The fuzziness of the fabric made it pleasant to touch.
sindhiMeaning: ڌنڌلائي، وضاحت جي کوٽ، نرم وارن سان ڍڪيل هجڻ جي حالت، سوچ يا ٻوليءَ ۾ مونجهارو ۽ غير واضح پڻو
urduMeaning: دھندلاپن، وضاحت کی کمی، نرم بالوں سے ڈھکے ہونے کی حالت، سوچ یا زبان میں ابہام اور غیر واضح پن

englishMeaning: An electronic device that distorts the sound of an electric guitar. A guitar effects pedal used to create a rough, buzzing tone. A common name for a fuzz effect unit in music.
synonyms: Fuzz pedal, Distortion pedal, Effects pedal, Overdrive unit, Stompbox
antonyms: Clean channel, Acoustic sound, Unamplified tone
examples: He switched on the fuzzbox for the guitar solo. The band's sound depends heavily on an old fuzzbox. She bought a vintage fuzzbox from a music shop. A fuzzbox can turn a clean tone into a growling one.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ اليڪٽرانڪ اوزار جيڪو گٽار جي آواز کي بگاڙي ٿو، گٽار جو اثر پيڊل جيڪو ٿلهو ۽ گونجندڙ آواز پيدا ڪري، ميوزڪ ۾ فز اثر ڏيندڙ ڊبي
urduMeaning: ایک برقی آلہ جو گٹار کی آواز کو بگاڑتا ہے، گٹار کا ایفیکٹ پیڈل جو بھاری اور گونجتی آواز پیدا کرتا ہے، موسیقی میں فز ایفیکٹ کا آلہ

englishMeaning: A safety device in an electrical circuit that melts and breaks the connection when the current is too strong. A length of material that is burned to set off an explosive. To join or blend two or more things into a single whole. To melt together under heat. To stop working because a fuse has melted.
synonyms: Merge, Blend, Combine, Unite, Weld, Amalgamate, Melt, Integrate
antonyms: Separate, Divide, Split, Detach, Disconnect, Scatter
examples: The fuse blew when we switched on the heater. Engineers fuse copper wires with great care. The film fuses comedy and social criticism. He lit the fuse and stepped back quickly.
sindhiMeaning: بجليءَ جو حفاظتي اوزار جيڪو گهڻي ڪرنٽ تي پگهري ڪري رستو ڪٽي ٿو، ڌماڪي کي باهه ڏيندڙ تند، ٻن يا وڌيڪ شين کي ملائي هڪ ڪرڻ، گرميءَ سان گڏجي پگهرجڻ، فيوز اڏامڻ ڪري بند ٿي وڃڻ
urduMeaning: بجلی کا حفاظتی آلہ جو زیادہ کرنٹ پر پگھل کر رابطہ توڑ دیتا ہے، دھماکے کو آگ دینے والی بتی، دو یا زیادہ چیزوں کو ملا کر ایک کرنا، حرارت سے پگھل کر جڑ جانا، فیوز اڑنے سے بند ہو جانا

englishMeaning: A device that triggers the explosion of a bomb, shell, or missile. A mechanism designed to detonate an explosive at a chosen moment. An alternative spelling of fuse used mainly in military contexts. To fit an explosive device with such a mechanism.
synonyms: Detonator, Trigger, Igniter, Primer, Firing device
antonyms: Safety catch, Deactivator, Disarming device
examples: The shell was fitted with a delayed-action fuze. Engineers inspected the fuze before the test. A faulty fuze can make a weapon extremely dangerous. Technicians carefully fuze each device in the workshop.
sindhiMeaning: بم يا گولي کي ڦاٽائڻ وارو اوزار، مقرر وقت تي ڌماڪو ڪرائڻ وارو نظام، فوجي اصطلاح ۾ فيوز جو ٻيو لکڻي انداز، ڌماڪيدار شيءِ ۾ اهڙو اوزار لڳائڻ
urduMeaning: بم یا گولے کو پھاڑنے والا آلہ، مقررہ وقت پر دھماکہ کرانے والا نظام، فوجی اصطلاح میں فیوز کا متبادل ہجہ، دھماکہ خیز شے میں ایسا آلہ لگانا

englishMeaning: The degree of slope or steepness of a road, hill, or surface. A gradual change in colour, tone, or intensity from one point to another. The rate at which a physical quantity such as temperature or pressure changes over distance. In mathematics, a measure of the steepness of a line or curve.
synonyms: Slope, Incline, Slant, Grade, Pitch, Rise, Transition, Ramp
antonyms: Flat, Level, Plateau, Horizontal surface, Uniformity
examples: The road has a steep gradient near the top of the hill. The designer used a soft gradient from blue to green. Scientists measured the temperature gradient in the lake. Cyclists struggled with the sharp gradient of the mountain pass.
sindhiMeaning: لاهي يا چاڙهي جو درجو، رستي يا سطح جو ڍلائي وارو ماپ، رنگ يا شدت ۾ آهستي آهستي تبديلي، ڪنهن مقدار جي مفاصلي سان بدلجڻ جي رفتار، رياضيءَ ۾ لڪير جي ڍلائي
urduMeaning: ڈھلان یا چڑھائی کا درجہ، سڑک یا سطح کی ڈھال کی پیمائش، رنگ یا شدت میں بتدریج تبدیلی، کسی مقدار کے فاصلے کے ساتھ بدلنے کی شرح، ریاضی میں خط کی ڈھلان

englishMeaning: The apparent change in the position of an object when it is viewed from two different points. An effect in which nearer objects seem to move faster than distant ones as the viewer moves. In astronomy, a method of measuring the distance of stars using this shift. In web and game design, a scrolling effect that creates a sense of depth.
synonyms: Apparent shift, Displacement, Optical shift, Angular difference, Perspective change
antonyms: Fixed position, Stability, Alignment, Constancy
examples: Astronomers use parallax to calculate the distance of nearby stars. The parallax effect makes the background move slowly. Always read the scale straight on to avoid parallax error. The website uses parallax scrolling for a modern look.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جي جاءِ جو ظاهري بدلجڻ جڏهن ان کي ٻن مختلف نقطن مان ڏٺو وڃي، ويجهيون شيون پري وارين کان تيز چرندي محسوس ٿيڻ، فلڪيات ۾ تارن جو مفاصلو ماپڻ جو طريقو، ڊزائين ۾ گهرائي جو احساس ڏيندڙ اسڪرول اثر
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کی ظاہری جگہ کا بدلنا جب اسے دو مختلف مقامات سے دیکھا جائے، قریب کی اشیاء کا دور کی نسبت تیز حرکت کرتے محسوس ہونا، فلکیات میں ستاروں کا فاصلہ ناپنے کا طریقہ، ڈیزائن میں گہرائی کا احساس دینے والا اسکرول اثر

englishMeaning: Extremely small in size, scale, or scope. Relating to something very small or examined in fine detail. A prefix meaning one millionth of a unit. An informal short form of microcomputer or microphone.
synonyms: Tiny, Miniature, Minute, Small-scale, Minuscule, Microscopic
antonyms: Macro, Large, Huge, Giant, Massive, Large-scale
examples: The company focuses on micro loans for small farmers. Designers added micro animations to the buttons. A micro crack in the glass slowly grew larger. He studies changes at the micro level of the economy.
sindhiMeaning: تمام ننڍڙو، بلڪل خردبيني سطح جو، باريڪيءَ سان لاڳاپيل، ڪنهن يونٽ جو ڏهه لکَ وارو حصو ظاهر ڪندڙ اڳياڙي، مائيڪروفون يا ننڍي ڪمپيوٽر لاءِ عام لفظ
urduMeaning: نہایت چھوٹا، خردبینی سطح کا، باریک تفصیل سے متعلق، کسی اکائی کے دس لاکھویں حصے کو ظاہر کرنے والا سابقہ، مائیکروفون یا چھوٹے کمپیوٹر کے لیے عام لفظ

englishMeaning: The technique of making drawings or models appear to move on screen. A film or video created by this technique. Liveliness, energy, and enthusiasm in a person's manner. The act of bringing something to life or making it active.
synonyms: Cartoon, Motion graphics, Liveliness, Vitality, Energy, Enthusiasm, Vigour
antonyms: Stillness, Dullness, Lethargy, Apathy, Inactivity, Lifelessness
examples: The studio is famous for its hand-drawn animation. Children watched the animation with great excitement. She spoke with animation about her travels. The animation of the logo lasts only two seconds.
sindhiMeaning: تصويرن يا ماڊلن کي اسڪرين تي چرندو ڏيکارڻ جو فن، اهڙي طريقي سان ٺهيل فلم يا وڊيو، ڪنهن ماڻهوءَ جي انداز ۾ جوش ۽ چستي، ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ جان وجهڻ جو عمل
urduMeaning: تصاویر یا ماڈلز کو اسکرین پر متحرک دکھانے کا فن، اس طریقے سے بنی فلم یا ویڈیو، کسی شخص کے انداز میں جوش و توانائی، کسی چیز میں جان ڈالنے کا عمل

englishMeaning: To bring something to life or make it lively and active. To produce a film or sequence in which drawings or objects appear to move. To encourage or inspire someone with energy and enthusiasm. Alive or having life, as opposed to inanimate.
synonyms: Enliven, Invigorate, Energise, Inspire, Stimulate, Vitalise, Arouse
antonyms: Deaden, Depress, Discourage, Dull, Subdue, Weaken
examples: A warm smile animated her tired face. The team will animate the characters next month. His speech animated the whole audience. Biology studies both animate and inanimate matter.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ ۾ جان وجهڻ، چست ۽ جاندار بڻائڻ، تصويرن کي چرندو ڏيکاريندڙ فلم ٺاهڻ، ڪنهن کي جوش ۽ حوصلو ڏيڻ، جاندار يا زندگيءَ وارو
urduMeaning: کسی چیز میں جان ڈالنا، متحرک اور بارونق بنانا، تصاویر کو حرکت دیتی فلم بنانا، کسی کو جوش اور ولولہ دینا، جاندار یا زندہ

englishMeaning: Relating to the cinema or the making of films. Having the visual quality, atmosphere, or scale typical of a good film. Beautifully composed and dramatic in appearance. Suitable for being filmed or shown on the big screen.
synonyms: Filmic, Movie-like, Dramatic, Visual, Picturesque, Theatrical
antonyms: Plain, Undramatic, Ordinary, Flat, Literary, Unremarkable
examples: The documentary has a strikingly cinematic style. Sunset over the valley created a cinematic view. He praised the film's cinematic camera work. The novel is written in a highly cinematic manner.
sindhiMeaning: سئنيما يا فلم سازيءَ سان لاڳاپيل، فلم جهڙي خوبصورت ۽ اثرائتي منظرڪشي رکندڙ، ڊرامائي ۽ شاندار نظر ايندڙ، فلم لاءِ موزون
urduMeaning: سنیما یا فلم سازی سے متعلق، فلم جیسی خوبصورت اور بھرپور منظرکشی رکھنے والا، ڈرامائی اور شاندار دکھائی دینے والا، فلم بندی کے لیے موزوں

englishMeaning: Kind, calm, and careful in behaviour or manner. Not harsh, severe, or forceful in effect. Moderate in degree, strength, or slope. To make something softer or less severe.
synonyms: Kind, Mild, Tender, Soft, Soothing, Moderate, Placid, Considerate
antonyms: Harsh, Rough, Violent, Severe, Fierce, Brutal, Steep
examples: She has a gentle voice that calms the children. A gentle breeze moved the curtains. The doctor advised gentle exercise after the surgery. The path rises with a gentle slope towards the temple.
sindhiMeaning: نرم مزاج، مهربان ۽ سنجيده، سخت يا زوردار نه، هلڪو ۽ معتدل، ٿورڙي لاهي وارو، ڪنهن شيءِ کي نرم بڻائڻ
urduMeaning: نرم مزاج، مہربان اور شائستہ، سخت یا زوردار نہیں، ہلکا اور معتدل، ہلکی ڈھلان والا، کسی چیز کو نرم بنانا

englishMeaning: A soft rushing sound made by something moving quickly through the air. To move rapidly with such a sound. An exclamation imitating fast movement.
synonyms: Swish, Rush, Swoosh, Hiss, Zoom, Sweep
antonyms: Silence, Stillness, Hush, Crawl, Halt
examples: We heard the whoosh of the train as it passed. The car whooshed past us on the highway. With a soft whoosh, the door slid open. The rocket rose with a great whoosh of flame.
sindhiMeaning: تيزيءَ سان هوا مان لنگهڻ وقت پيدا ٿيندڙ سُر يا سرسراهٽ، اهڙي آواز سان تيز حرڪت ڪرڻ، تيز رفتاريءَ جي نقل ڪندڙ آواز
urduMeaning: ہوا میں تیزی سے گزرنے پر پیدا ہونے والی سرسراہٹ، ایسی آواز کے ساتھ تیزی سے حرکت کرنا، تیز رفتاری کی نقل کرنے والا آواز

englishMeaning: An exclamation used when a small mistake or accident happens. A word said to show mild surprise or apology. A cry of excitement or joy.
synonyms: Oops, Oh dear, Sorry, Yikes, Cheer, Shout
antonyms: Well done, Perfect, Silence, Groan, Complaint
examples: Whoops, I dropped the glass! Whoops, I think I sent that message to the wrong person. She said whoops and quickly picked up the papers. Whoops of joy rose from the crowd after the goal.
sindhiMeaning: ننڍڙي غلطي يا حادثي وقت چيو ويندڙ لفظ، هلڪي حيرت يا معذرت ظاهر ڪندڙ لفظ، خوشيءَ يا جوش جو نعرو
urduMeaning: چھوٹی سی غلطی یا حادثے پر کہا جانے والا لفظ، ہلکی حیرت یا معذرت ظاہر کرنے والا لفظ، خوشی یا جوش کا نعرہ

englishMeaning: A sudden cry or remark expressing surprise, anger, joy, or pain. A word or phrase spoken loudly and with strong feeling. In grammar, a sentence that expresses emotion and often ends with an exclamation mark.
synonyms: Cry, Shout, Outcry, Utterance, Yell, Interjection, Ejaculation
antonyms: Silence, Whisper, Murmur, Mutter, Quietness
examples: He gave an exclamation of surprise when he saw the bill. Her exclamation startled everyone in the room. The teacher explained the use of the exclamation mark. A loud exclamation came from the back of the hall.
sindhiMeaning: حيرت، ڪاوڙ، خوشي يا درد ظاهر ڪندڙ اوچتو رڙ يا لفظ، زور ۽ جذبي سان چيل لفظ يا جملو، گرامر ۾ جذبو ظاهر ڪندڙ جملو
urduMeaning: حیرت، غصے، خوشی یا تکلیف کا اظہار کرنے والی اچانک آواز یا کلمہ، زور اور جذبے سے کہا گیا لفظ یا جملہ، گرامر میں جذبہ ظاہر کرنے والا جملہ

englishMeaning: To cry out suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion. To say something quickly and with feeling, especially surprise or anger. To declare something forcefully in speech.
synonyms: Shout, Cry out, Call out, Yell, Blurt, Proclaim, Declare
antonyms: Whisper, Murmur, Mumble, Keep quiet, Suppress
examples: "What a beautiful garden!" she exclaimed. He exclaimed in pain when the door hit his hand. The children exclaimed with delight at the snow. She exclaimed that the news could not be true.
sindhiMeaning: جذبي جي زور تي اوچتو رڙ ڪري چوڻ، حيرت يا ڪاوڙ ۾ تيزيءَ سان ڪجهه چوڻ، زور ڏئي ڪا ڳالهه بيان ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: جذبے کی شدت میں اچانک بلند آواز سے کہنا، حیرت یا غصے میں تیزی سے کچھ کہنا، زور دے کر کوئی بات کہنا

englishMeaning: In a way that causes excitement, interest, or enthusiasm. So as to make something thrilling or full of energy. In a manner that stirs strong positive feelings.
synonyms: Thrillingly, Stirringly, Dramatically, Vividly, Impressively
antonyms: Boringly, Dully, Tediously, Flatly, Uninterestingly
examples: The match ended excitingly in the final minute. The project developed excitingly fast. She spoke excitingly about her new business. The story begins slowly but ends excitingly.
sindhiMeaning: جوش ۽ ولولو پيدا ڪندڙ انداز ۾، دلچسپ ۽ سنسني خيز نموني، اهڙي طرح جو خوشي ۽ اتساهه پيدا ٿئي
urduMeaning: جوش و ولولہ پیدا کرنے والے انداز میں، دلچسپ اور سنسنی خیز طریقے سے، ایسے کہ خوشی اور جذبہ پیدا ہو

englishMeaning: A strong feeling of enthusiasm and eagerness. A state of being emotionally stirred or lively. An event or situation that causes such feelings. Increased activity or agitation in a person or place.
synonyms: Thrill, Enthusiasm, Eagerness, Anticipation, Elation, Stimulation, Buzz
antonyms: Boredom, Calm, Apathy, Indifference, Dullness, Depression
examples: There was great excitement before the final match. She could hardly hide her excitement about the trip. The news created excitement across the whole village. In his excitement, he forgot to lock the door.
sindhiMeaning: جوش ۽ اتساهه جو مضبوط احساس، جذباتي طور تي بيتاب يا خوش هجڻ جي حالت، اهڙو موقعو جيڪو جوش پيدا ڪري، ڪنهن جاءِ تي وڌيل چهل پهل يا هلچل
urduMeaning: جوش اور بے تابی کا شدید احساس، جذباتی طور پر پرجوش ہونے کی کیفیت، ایسا موقع جو جوش پیدا کرے، کسی جگہ بڑھی ہوئی ہلچل

englishMeaning: Causing strong feelings of interest, enthusiasm, or pleasure. Full of activity, energy, or thrilling events. Likely to make someone eager and emotionally stirred.
synonyms: Thrilling, Stirring, Stimulating, Gripping, Electrifying, Inspiring
antonyms: Boring, Dull, Tedious, Monotonous, Uninteresting, Bland
examples: It was the most exciting game of the season. She has an exciting new job in Karachi. The film has an exciting opening scene. Travelling alone can be both exciting and difficult.
sindhiMeaning: دلچسپي ۽ جوش پيدا ڪندڙ، سنسني خيز ۽ ولولي وارو، خوشي ۽ اتساهه ڏيندڙ، سرگرميءَ ۽ توانائيءَ سان ڀرپور
urduMeaning: دلچسپی اور جوش پیدا کرنے والا، سنسنی خیز اور پرجوش، خوشی اور ولولہ دینے والا، سرگرمی اور توانائی سے بھرپور

englishMeaning: To make someone feel very enthusiastic, eager, or emotionally stirred. To cause a particular feeling or reaction to arise. To stimulate a physical or chemical activity. To arouse interest or curiosity in something.
synonyms: Thrill, Stimulate, Arouse, Inspire, Stir, Provoke, Animate
antonyms: Bore, Calm, Soothe, Dull, Pacify, Discourage
examples: The idea of studying abroad excites her. His speech excited the crowd. The discovery excited great interest among scientists. Loud noises can excite young children before bedtime.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي جوش ۽ اتساهه ۾ آڻڻ، ڪو خاص جذبو يا ردعمل پيدا ڪرڻ، ڪنهن جسماني يا ڪيميائي عمل کي تحريڪ ڏيڻ، دلچسپي يا تجسس پيدا ڪرڻ

urduMeaning: کسی فیصلے کو اگلے دن تک ٹال دینا تاکہ اچھی طرح سوچا جا سکے، جواب دینے سے پہلے سوچنے کے لیے وقت لینا، جلد بازی سے بچنے کے لیے ٹھنڈے دل سے غور کرنا، رات گزار کر فیصلہ کرنا

englishMeaning: To make a serious mistake and spoil something. To handle a task so badly that it fails. To twist or crumple something tightly, such as paper. To tighten the eyes or face into a wrinkled expression.
synonyms: Botch, Bungle, Mess up, Spoil, Ruin, Blunder, Mishandle, Fumble
antonyms: Succeed, Perfect, Manage well, Accomplish, Handle properly, Excel
examples: I hope I don't screw up the presentation tomorrow. He screwed up the order and sent the wrong parcel. She screwed up the letter and threw it in the bin. He screwed up his eyes against the bright sunlight.
sindhiMeaning: ڪم خراب ڪري ڇڏڻ، وڏي غلطي ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڪم کي ايترو خراب نموني ڪرڻ جو ناڪام ٿي وڃي، ڪاغذ وغيره کي مروڙي گڏ ڪرڻ، منهن يا اکيون گھنڊ وجهي سيڪوڙڻ
urduMeaning: کام بگاڑ دینا، سنگین غلطی کرنا، کسی کام کو اس قدر خراب انداز میں کرنا کہ ناکام ہو جائے، کاغذ وغیرہ کو مروڑ کر گولا بنانا، آنکھیں یا چہرہ سکیڑنا

englishMeaning: A serious mistake or badly handled situation. A failure caused by carelessness or poor judgement. An informal word for a person who often makes mistakes. A muddle or mess created by someone's error.
synonyms: Blunder, Mistake, Mess, Botch, Error, Fiasco, Mix-up, Bungle
antonyms: Success, Achievement, Triumph, Accuracy, Perfection, Accomplishment
examples: The delay was caused by an administrative screw-up. It was a small screw-up, but the client noticed it. He apologised for the screw-up in the accounts. Losing the file was a major screw-up on my part.
sindhiMeaning: وڏي غلطي يا خراب ڪيل ڪم، لاپرواهي سبب ٿيل ناڪامي، اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو گھڻيون غلطيون ڪري، غلطي سبب پيدا ٿيل گڙٻڙ
urduMeaning: سنگین غلطی یا بگڑا ہوا کام، لاپرواہی کے باعث ہونے والی ناکامی، ایسا شخص جو بار بار غلطیاں کرے، غلطی سے پیدا ہونے والی گڑبڑ

englishMeaning: To pay regularly in order to receive a service, magazine, or newspaper. To sign up to follow a channel, newsletter, or online content. To agree with or support an opinion, belief, or theory. To sign one's name at the end of a document as a formal agreement.
synonyms: Sign up, Enrol, Join, Support, Endorse, Agree, Contribute, Register
antonyms: Unsubscribe, Cancel, Withdraw, Reject, Oppose, Disagree, Renounce
examples: We subscribe to two daily newspapers at home. Thousands of people subscribe to her cooking channel. I do not subscribe to the view that money brings happiness. Both partners subscribed to the agreement in front of a witness.
sindhiMeaning: باقاعدي رقم ڏئي ڪا خدمت، اخبار يا رسالو حاصل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن چينل يا آن لائين مواد سان جڙڻ ۽ نالو داخل ڪرائڻ، ڪنهن راءِ يا نظريي سان اتفاق ڪرڻ، ڪاغذ تي دستخط ڪري رضامندي ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: باقاعدہ رقم دے کر کوئی خدمت، اخبار یا رسالہ حاصل کرنا، کسی چینل یا آن لائن مواد سے منسلک ہونا، کسی رائے یا نظریے سے اتفاق کرنا، دستاویز پر دستخط کر کے رضامندی دینا

englishMeaning: Childishly silly and immature in behaviour or speech. Foolish in a way that is expected of a young child rather than an adult. Trivial and lacking seriousness or good sense. Relating to a boy or to childhood in a formal or medical sense.
synonyms: Childish, Immature, Silly, Juvenile, Infantile, Foolish, Trivial, Babyish
antonyms: Mature, Adult, Sensible, Serious, Grown-up, Wise, Thoughtful
examples: His puerile jokes annoyed everyone at the meeting. Such puerile behaviour is unacceptable in a professional office. The argument soon turned into a puerile shouting match. She dismissed the letter as puerile nonsense.
sindhiMeaning: ٻاراڻو ۽ نامڪمل رويو، بالغ ماڻهوءَ لاءِ نه سونهندڙ ٻاراڻي بيوقوفي، بي معنى ۽ سنجيدگي کان خالي، ٻالڪپڻ سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: بچکانہ اور ناپختہ رویہ، بالغ شخص کے لیے نامناسب بچوں جیسی حرکت، بے معنی اور غیر سنجیدہ، بچپن سے متعلق

englishMeaning: Relating to or showing a difference between two or more things. A difference in amount, rate, or quality between comparable items. A gear system in a vehicle that lets wheels turn at different speeds. In mathematics, relating to very small differences or rates of change.
synonyms: Distinctive, Distinguishing, Variable, Unequal, Gap, Margin, Disparity, Variation
antonyms: Identical, Equal, Uniform, Same, Undifferentiated, Consistent
examples: There is a wide wage differential between the two departments. The company applies a differential rate for weekend work. The mechanic replaced the differential in the rear axle. Differential treatment of employees can cause resentment.
sindhiMeaning: فرق ڏيکاريندڙ يا فرق سان لاڳاپيل، ٻن شين جي وچ ۾ مقدار، شرح يا معيار جو فرق، گاڏي جو اهو گيئر نظام جيڪو ڦيٿن کي مختلف رفتار تي ڦيرائي، حسابي لحاظ کان تمام ننڍي تبديلي سان واسطو رکندڙ
urduMeaning: فرق ظاہر کرنے والا یا فرق سے متعلق، دو چیزوں کے درمیان مقدار، شرح یا معیار کا فرق، گاڑی کا وہ گیئر نظام جو پہیوں کو مختلف رفتار پر گھمائے، ریاضی میں انتہائی معمولی تبدیلی سے متعلق

englishMeaning: To prove that a statement or accusation is false. To argue against a claim by offering evidence or reasoning. To reply to criticism in order to disprove it. To formally contradict an argument in a debate or court case.
synonyms: Refute, Disprove, Contradict, Deny, Counter, Confute, Invalidate, Challenge
antonyms: Confirm, Support, Prove, Accept, Endorse, Uphold, Agree
examples: The lawyer rebutted the charges with solid evidence. He wrote an article to rebut the false claims. She rebutted every point her opponent raised. The scientist rebutted the theory using new data.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن دعوى يا الزام کي غلط ثابت ڪرڻ، دليل يا ثبوت ڏئي ڳالهه رد ڪرڻ، تنقيد جو جواب ڏئي ان کي غلط ڪوٺڻ، بحث يا عدالت ۾ باقاعده مخالفت ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی دعوے یا الزام کو غلط ثابت کرنا، دلیل یا ثبوت دے کر بات رد کرنا، تنقید کا جواب دے کر اسے غلط ثابت کرنا، بحث یا عدالت میں باقاعدہ تردید کرنا

englishMeaning: A doctor who specialises in the heart and blood vessels. A medical expert who diagnoses and treats heart diseases. A specialist who performs tests such as ECG and echocardiography. A physician trained in the branch of medicine known as cardiology.
synonyms: Heart specialist, Heart doctor, Cardiac physician, Cardiac specialist
antonyms: Patient, Layperson, Non-specialist
examples: The cardiologist advised him to reduce salt and fat. She was referred to a cardiologist after her chest pain. A cardiologist examined the patient's heart rhythm carefully. My uncle visits his cardiologist every three months.
sindhiMeaning: دل ۽ رت جي نالين جو ماهر ڊاڪٽر، دل جي بيمارين جي سڃاڻ ۽ علاج ڪندڙ ماهر، ECG ۽ ايڪو جھڙا ٽيسٽ ڪندڙ ماهر، دل جي علم يعني ڪارڊيالاجي جو ماهر طبيب
urduMeaning: دل اور خون کی نالیوں کا ماہر ڈاکٹر، دل کی بیماریوں کی تشخیص اور علاج کرنے والا ماہر، ای سی جی اور ایکو جیسے ٹیسٹ کرنے والا ماہر، امراضِ قلب کا ماہر طبیب

englishMeaning: A doctor who specialises in the kidneys and their diseases. A medical expert who treats kidney failure and related disorders. A specialist who manages dialysis and kidney transplant care. A physician trained in the branch of medicine called nephrology.
synonyms: Kidney specialist, Kidney doctor, Renal physician, Renal specialist
antonyms: Patient, Layperson, Non-specialist

sindhiMeaning: گڙدن جو ماهر ڊاڪٽر، گڙدن جي بيمارين ۽ ناڪامي جو علاج ڪندڙ ماهر، ڊائيلاسز ۽ گڙدي جي مَنتقلي جي سنڀال ڪندڙ ماهر، نيفرالاجي جو ماهر طبيب

englishMeaning: A doctor who specialises in bones, joints, muscles, and ligaments. A surgeon who treats fractures, deformities, and spinal problems. A specialist who performs joint replacement and bone surgery. A physician trained in the branch of medicine called orthopaedics.

antonyms: Patient, Layperson, Non-specialist

sindhiMeaning: هڏن، جوڙن ۽ مسلن جو ماهر ڊاڪٽر، ڀڳل هڏن، ٽيڏائي ۽ ريڙهه جي مسئلن جو علاج ڪندڙ سرجن، جوڙ مٽائڻ ۽ هڏن جي آپريشن ڪندڙ ماهر، آرٿوپيڊڪس جو ماهر طبيب

antonyms: Patient, Layperson, Non-specialist

A specialist who can prescribe medicines as well as recommend therapy. A physician trained in the branch of medicine called psychiatry.

antonyms: Patient, Layperson, Non-specialist

englishMeaning: An informal way of saying that something is not possible. A casual refusal of a request or suggestion. Used to tell someone politely but firmly that you cannot help. A short way of saying that a task cannot be done.

englishMeaning: A large, dark seabird with a long neck and hooked bill that dives for fish. A waterbird known for its excellent underwater swimming and fishing ability. Figuratively, a greedy person who takes far more than a fair share. Used in literature as a symbol of greed and endless appetite.
