urduMeaning: ایک ہی مرکز رکھنے والے، خاص طور پر دائرے یا گولے، ایک ہی مرکزی نقطہ بانٹنے والے مگر مختلف شعاع رکھنے والے، ایک ہی نقطے کے گرد دائروں یا گولوں میں ترتیب دیے گئے

englishMeaning: Two or more circles that share the same center point but have different radii. Circles arranged around a common central point with varying sizes. Nested circles with a single shared center.
synonyms: Coaxial circles, Nested circles, Circles with common center, Centered circles
antonyms: Eccentric circles, Separate circles, Non-concentric circles, Overlapping circles
examples: The target is made of concentric circles. Ripples in water form concentric circles. The design features beautiful concentric circles. Tree rings are natural examples of concentric circles.
sindhiMeaning: ٻه يا وڌيڪ دائرا جيڪي هڪ ئي مرڪزي نقطي کي ونڊين پر مختلف شعاع رکن، هڪ گڏيل مرڪزي نقطي جي چوڌاري مختلف سائزن ۾ ترتيب ڏنل دائرا، هڪ ئي مرڪز سان گهيرايل دائرا
urduMeaning: دو یا زیادہ دائرے جو ایک ہی مرکزی نقطہ بانٹیں مگر مختلف شعاع رکھیں، ایک مشترکہ مرکزی نقطے کے گرد مختلف سائز میں ترتیب دیے گئے دائرے، ایک ہی مرکز کے ساتھ گھیرے ہوئے دائرے

englishMeaning: A three-dimensional solid with a circular base tapering to a point at the top. A shape formed by rotating a right triangle around one of its legs. An object shaped like a cone, such as a traffic marker.
synonyms: Conical shape, Pyramid shape, Funnel, Spire, Peak
antonyms: Cube, Sphere, Cylinder, Flat surface, Inverted cone
examples: An ice cream cone is a familiar cone shape. The volcano has a perfect cone shape. Traffic cones mark the construction zone. Calculate the volume of the cone.
sindhiMeaning: ٽن طرفن وارو ٺوس شڪل جنهن ۾ هڪ گول بنياد هجي جيڪا مٿي تي هڪ نقطي تي سڪڙجي، هڪ شڪل جيڪو هڪ قائم مثلث کي ان جي هڪ رخ جي چوڌاري گھمائڻ سان بڻجي، مخروطي شڪل وارو شڪل جهڙوڪ ٽريفڪ جو نشان
urduMeaning: تین جہتی ٹھوس شکل جس میں ایک گول بنیاد ہو جو اوپر ایک نقطے پر سکڑ جائے، ایک شکل جو ایک قائم مثلث کو اس کی ایک ضلع کے گرد گھمانے سے بنے، مخروطی شکل والی چیز جیسے ٹریفک کا نشان

englishMeaning: To change from a liquid into a thick or solid state, especially by cooling. To become thick, firm, or clotted. To take a definite or fixed form. To make something become solid or thick.
synonyms: Solidify, Thicken, Clot, Coagulate, Harden, Set, Stiffen, Gel, Curdle, Freeze
antonyms: Melt, Liquefy, Dissolve, Soften, Flow, Thaw, Loosen, Fluidify
examples: The melted wax congealed into a hard lump as it cooled. The blood on the wound began to congeal. Fat congeals on the surface of the cold soup. Vague ideas slowly congealed into a clear plan.
sindhiMeaning: مائع مان ٿڌو يا سخت ٿي وڃڻ خاص ڪري ٿڌو ٿيڻ سان، گاڙهو يا لتاڙ ٿي وڃڻ، ڪنهن مخصوص شڪل اختيار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي سخت يا گاڙهو ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: مائع سے گاڑھا یا سخت ہو جانا خاص طور پر ٹھنڈا ہونے سے، گاڑھا یا لوتھڑا بن جانا، کوئی مخصوص شکل اختیار کرنا، کسی چیز کو سخت یا گاڑھا کرنا

englishMeaning: Relating to a congregation, that is, a group of people gathered for religious worship. Involving the participation of the whole assembly of worshippers. Relating to Congregationalism, a system in which each local church governs itself. Belonging to a Congregational church.
synonyms: Communal, Collective, Ecclesiastical, Parochial, Assembled, Church-based, Shared
antonyms: Individual, Private, Solitary, Personal, Secular, Hierarchical
examples: Congregational singing filled the whole hall. The church follows a congregational form of government. She attends a small congregational chapel nearby. Congregational meetings are held once every month.
sindhiMeaning: عبادت لاءِ گڏ ٿيل جماعت سان لاڳاپيل، سموري جماعت جي شرڪت وارو، ان مذهبي نظام سان تعلق رکندڙ جنهن ۾ هر مقامي ڪليسا پنهنجو انتظام پاڻ هلائي، جماعتي
urduMeaning: عبادت کے لیے جمع ہونے والی جماعت سے متعلق، پوری جماعت کی شرکت والا، اس مذہبی نظام سے تعلق رکھنے والا جس میں ہر مقامی کلیسا اپنا انتظام خود چلاتا ہے، جماعتی

englishMeaning: A form of Protestant church organization in which each local congregation governs itself independently. The beliefs and practices of Congregational churches. The principle that authority in church matters rests with the members of each congregation. A movement based on self-governing local churches.
synonyms: Independency, Church autonomy, Protestantism, Nonconformity, Self-government
antonyms: Episcopacy, Hierarchy, Papacy, Centralism, Authoritarianism
examples: Congregationalism spread widely in seventeenth-century England. The church follows the principles of Congregationalism. He wrote a detailed history of Congregationalism in America. Congregationalism stresses the independence of each local church.
sindhiMeaning: پروٽيسٽنٽ عيسائيت جو اهو نظام جنهن ۾ هر مقامي ڪليسا پنهنجو انتظام پاڻ هلائي، جماعتي نظام، انهن ڪليسائن جا عقيدا ۽ رسمون، اختيار جماعت جي ميمبرن وٽ هجڻ جو اصول، خودمختيار ڪليسائن جي تحريڪ
urduMeaning: پروٹسٹنٹ عیسائیت کا وہ نظام جس میں ہر مقامی کلیسا اپنا انتظام خود چلاتا ہے، جماعتی نظام، ان کلیساؤں کے عقائد و رسوم، اختیار جماعت کے اراکین کے پاس ہونے کا اصول، خود مختار کلیساؤں کی تحریک

englishMeaning: A member or follower of a Congregational church. A person who supports the system of independent, self-governing churches. Relating to Congregationalism or its followers. Describing beliefs or practices connected with Congregational churches.
synonyms: Nonconformist, Protestant, Independent, Dissenter, Churchgoer, Believer
antonyms: Episcopalian, Catholic, Conformist, Atheist, Centralist
examples: Her grandfather was a devoted Congregationalist. The Congregationalist minister welcomed the visitors. He wrote from a clearly Congregationalist point of view. Several Congregationalist families settled in the valley.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جماعتي ڪليسا جو ميمبر يا پيروڪار، خودمختيار ڪليسائن جي نظام جو حامي، جماعتي نظام سان لاڳاپيل، انهن ڪليسائن جي عقيدن سان تعلق رکندڙ
urduMeaning: کسی جماعتی کلیسا کا رکن یا پیروکار، خود مختار کلیساؤں کے نظام کا حامی، جماعتی نظام سے متعلق، ان کلیساؤں کے عقائد سے تعلق رکھنے والا

englishMeaning: A formal meeting or assembly of representatives to discuss important matters. The national legislative body of some countries, especially the United States. A large gathering of delegates from many organizations or countries. The name of certain political parties.
synonyms: Assembly, Parliament, Convention, Legislature, Conference, Council, Synod
antonyms: Dissolution, Disbandment, Individual, Recess, Adjournment
examples: Congress passed the bill after a long debate. The medical congress attracted doctors from thirty countries. She was elected to Congress last November. The party held its annual congress in the capital.
sindhiMeaning: نمائندن جو رسمي اجلاس يا اجتماع، ڪجهه ملڪن جي قومي قانون ساز اداري جو نالو خاص ڪري آمريڪا جو، مختلف ادارن يا ملڪن جي وفدن جو وڏو گڏجاڻ، ڪن سياسي پارٽين جو نالو
urduMeaning: نمائندوں کا باقاعدہ اجلاس یا اجتماع، بعض ممالک کے قومی قانون ساز ادارے کا نام خاص طور پر امریکہ کا، مختلف اداروں یا ممالک کے وفود کا بڑا اجتماع، بعض سیاسی جماعتوں کا نام

englishMeaning: Identical in shape and size, able to be superimposed exactly. Having the same dimensions and form. In agreement or harmony with something. Corresponding or matching perfectly.
synonyms: Identical, Equal, Matching, Corresponding, Similar, Equivalent, Same
antonyms: Different, Unequal, Dissimilar, Incongruent, Mismatched, Distinct
examples: The two triangles are congruent. Congruent shapes have equal corresponding sides and angles. The architect ensured all windows were congruent. These statements are congruent with the evidence.
sindhiMeaning: شڪل ۽ ماپ ۾ هڪجهڙا، هڪ ٻئي تي بلڪل رکڻ جوگا، هڪجهڙا طول ۽ شڪل رکڻ وارا، ڪنهن شيءِ سان مڪمل موافقت يا همٿيو، بلڪل ملندا يا ساڳيا
urduMeaning: شکل اور سائز میں یکساں، ایک دوسرے پر بالکل رکھے جا سکنے والے، ایک جیسے طول اور شکل رکھنے والے، کسی چیز سے مکمل موافقت یا ہم آہنگی میں، بالکل ملتے یا برابر

englishMeaning: Circles that have exactly the same radius and therefore the same size. Circles that are identical in dimensions and can be superimposed perfectly. Circles with equal diameters and circumferences.
synonyms: Equal circles, Identical circles, Same-sized circles, Matching circles
antonyms: Unequal circles, Different-sized circles, Concentric circles, Non-congruent circles
examples: Two congruent circles have equal radii. The wheels are congruent circles. Congruent circles can overlap perfectly. All coins of the same denomination are congruent circles.
sindhiMeaning: دائرا جيڪي بلڪل ساڳي شعاع رکن ۽ تنهن ڪري ساڳي ماپ جا هجن، دائرا جيڪي طول ۾ هڪجهڙا هجن ۽ بلڪل هڪ ٻئي تي رکي سگهجن، برابر قطر ۽ محيط رکڻ وارا دائرا
urduMeaning: دائرے جو بالکل برابر شعاع رکھیں اور اس لیے برابر سائز کے ہوں، دائرے جو طول میں یکساں ہوں اور بالکل ایک دوسرے پر رکھے جا سکیں، برابر قطر اور محیط رکھنے والے دائرے

englishMeaning: A curve obtained by cutting a cone with a plane. A mathematical figure such as a circle, ellipse, parabola, or hyperbola formed by slicing a cone. Any of the curves studied in geometry that result from intersecting a plane with a cone.
synonyms: Ellipse, Parabola, Hyperbola, Circle (in context), Cone curve
examples: The ellipse is a conic section formed by slicing a cone at an angle. Students studied conic sections in their mathematics class. Planets move in orbits that are conic sections. The teacher drew each conic section on the board.
sindhiMeaning: مخروط کي هڪ سطح سان ڪٽڻ سان حاصل ٿيل وکر، رياضي جو اهو نقشو جهڙوڪ دائرو، بيضوي، پرابولا يا هائيپربولا جيڪو مخروط کي ڪٽڻ سان ٺهي، هندسي ۾ پڙهيا ويندڙ اهي وکر جا مخروط کي سطح سان ڪٽڻ مان نتجن
urduMeaning: مخروط کو ایک سطح سے کاٹنے سے حاصل ہونے والی لکیر، ریاضی کی وہ شکل جیسے دائرہ، بیضوی، پیرابولا یا ہائیپربولا جو مخروط کو کاٹنے سے بنتی ہے، ہندسے میں پڑھی جانے والی وہ لکیریں جو مخروط کو سطح سے کاٹنے سے نکلتی ہیں

englishMeaning: Shaped like a cone. Having the form of a circle tapering to a point. Round at the base and narrowing toward the top. Relating to or resembling a cone.
synonyms: Cone-shaped, Tapered, Pointed, Funnel-shaped, Pyramidal
antonyms: Cylindrical, Flat, Spherical, Cubical
examples: The tower had a conical roof covered with red tiles. The volcano formed a perfect conical shape. She bought a conical flask for the chemistry lab. The huts in the village had conical thatched roofs.
sindhiMeaning: شنڪ يا مخروط جي شڪل جو، دائري کان نقطي ڏانهن گھٽجندڙ شڪل وارو، تلي کان گول ۽ مٿي ڏانهن تنگ هوندڙ، مخروط سان لاڳاپيل يا مخروط جهڙو
urduMeaning: مخروط کی شکل کا، دائرے سے نقطے کی طرف تنگ ہوتی شکل والا، تلے سے گول اور اوپر کی طرف تنگ ہوتا ہوا، مخروط سے متعلق یا مخروط جیسا

englishMeaning: The state of being awake, aware, and able to respond to one's surroundings. Awareness or perception of something, such as a fact, feeling, or situation. The totality of a person's thoughts, feelings, and sensations at a given time. The shared beliefs, awareness, and attitudes of a group or society. The condition of being alive and mentally alert as opposed to being unconscious.
synonyms: Awareness, Alertness, Sentience, Perception, Wakefulness, Realization, Mindfulness, Cognizance
antonyms: Unconsciousness, Coma, Oblivion, Ignorance, Insensibility, Unawareness, Stupor
examples: He slowly regained consciousness after the operation. There is a growing consciousness of climate change among young people. She lost consciousness for a few minutes after the fall. The novel explores the consciousness of a lonely traveller.
sindhiMeaning: هوش ۽ سجاڳيءَ جي حالت، پنهنجي ماحول جو احساس ۽ ادراڪ، ڪنهن ڳالهه جي ڄاڻ يا شعور، انسان جي سوچن ۽ احساسن جو مجموعو، ڪنهن قوم يا گروهه جو گڏيل شعور ۽ سوچ، بيهوشيءَ جي ابتڙ حالت
urduMeaning: ہوش اور بیداری کی حالت، اپنے ماحول کا ادراک اور احساس، کسی بات کی آگاہی یا شعور، انسان کے خیالات و احساسات کا مجموعہ، کسی قوم یا گروہ کا اجتماعی شعور، بے ہوشی کے برعکس کیفیت

englishMeaning: Important; having significant results or effects. Following as a result or effect of something else. Self-important or pompous in manner. In law, describing loss or damage that follows indirectly from an act.
synonyms: Significant, Important, Momentous, Weighty, Resulting, Ensuing, Far-reaching
antonyms: Insignificant, Trivial, Unimportant, Minor, Inconsequential, Negligible
examples: The meeting led to several consequential decisions. Consequential damage to the machinery was covered by insurance. His speech was one of the most consequential of the year. She dismissed the issue as hardly consequential.
sindhiMeaning: اهم يا وڏي اثر وارو، نتيجي طور پيدا ٿيندڙ، غير سڌي طرح پيدا ٿيندڙ نقصان، پاڻ کي وڏو سمجهندڙ يا مغرور
urduMeaning: اہم یا نتیجہ خیز، کسی چیز کے نتیجے میں پیدا ہونے والا، بالواسطہ پیدا ہونے والا نقصان، خود کو بڑا سمجھنے والا یا مغرور

englishMeaning: In a way that follows as a consequence. As an indirect result of something. In an important or significant manner. In a self-important or pompous way.
synonyms: Resultantly, Accordingly, Indirectly, Significantly, Importantly, Subsequently
antonyms: Insignificantly, Trivially, Directly, Independently, Negligibly
examples: The loss arose consequentially from the delayed shipment. His decision consequentially affected the whole department. She nodded consequentially, as if her approval mattered most. The policy consequentially reduced waste across the city.
sindhiMeaning: نتيجي جي طور تي، غير سڌي طرح ٿيندڙ نموني، اهم نموني، مغروراڻي انداز ۾
urduMeaning: نتیجے کے طور پر، بالواسطہ طور پر، اہم انداز میں، مغرورانہ انداز میں

englishMeaning: As a result; therefore. Following as an effect of an earlier action or event. For that reason; because of this. Used to show a logical outcome of what has been stated.
synonyms: Therefore, Thus, Hence, As a result, Accordingly, So, Subsequently, For that reason
antonyms: Nevertheless, However, Nonetheless, Yet, Regardless, Independently
examples: He missed the deadline and consequently lost the contract. Rain fell all week; consequently, the match was cancelled. She studied hard and consequently passed with distinction. The road was closed, consequently traffic was diverted.
sindhiMeaning: نتيجي ۾، انهيءَ ڪري، ان جي ڪري، اهڙيءَ طرح، جنهن جو نتيجو هي نڪتو
urduMeaning: نتیجتاً، اس کے نتیجے میں، چنانچہ، اسی وجہ سے، جس کے سبب

englishMeaning: An organisation or body that protects the environment and natural resources. Official supervision of a river, forest, port, or protected area. The act of conserving or preserving something valuable. A protected area of land managed for wildlife.
synonyms: Trust, Preservation body, Protection agency, Reserve, Custodianship, Stewardship
antonyms: Exploitation, Neglect, Destruction, Development, Abandonment
examples: The conservancy manages ten thousand acres of grassland. A local conservancy bought the land to protect the birds. The river conservancy issued new fishing rules. Villagers joined the conservancy to guard the forest.
sindhiMeaning: تحفظ ڪندڙ اداره، ماحول ۽ قدرتي وسيلن جي نگراني ڪندڙ تنظيم، ندي يا ٻيلي جي سرڪاري نگراني، محفوظ علائقو، حفاظت يا بچاءُ جو عمل
urduMeaning: تحفظ کرنے والا ادارہ، ماحول اور قدرتی وسائل کی نگرانی کرنے والی تنظیم، دریا یا جنگل کی سرکاری نگرانی، محفوظ علاقہ، حفاظت یا بچاؤ کا عمل

englishMeaning: The protection of the natural environment and wildlife. Careful use of resources to prevent waste. The preservation and repair of works of art, buildings, or historic objects. In physics, the principle that a quantity such as energy remains constant in a closed system.
synonyms: Preservation, Protection, Safeguarding, Upkeep, Maintenance, Care, Husbandry
antonyms: Waste, Destruction, Neglect, Squandering, Exploitation, Ruin
examples: Water conservation is essential during the dry season. The museum spent years on the conservation of the manuscript. Conservation efforts have helped the tiger population recover. He studies energy conservation in mechanical systems.
sindhiMeaning: تحفظ، ماحول ۽ جهنگلي جيوت جي حفاظت، وسيلن جو ڪفايتي استعمال، فن پارن ۽ تاريخي عمارتن جي سنڀال، توانائي جي بقا جو اصول
urduMeaning: تحفظ، ماحول اور جنگلی حیات کی حفاظت، وسائل کا کفایت شعاری سے استعمال، فن پاروں اور تاریخی عمارتوں کی دیکھ بھال، توانائی کی بقا کا اصول

englishMeaning: A person who works to protect the natural environment. Someone who supports the careful preservation of wildlife, forests, water, and natural resources. A person who advocates for the protection of historic buildings or cultural heritage.
synonyms: Environmentalist, Preservationist, Ecologist, Green activist, Naturalist, Protector
antonyms: Developer, Exploiter, Polluter, Destroyer, Industrialist
examples: The conservationist warned that the wetland was disappearing. A group of conservationists replanted the burnt hillside. She became a conservationist after studying marine biology. Conservationists campaigned to save the old town hall.
sindhiMeaning: ماحول جي حفاظت ڪندڙ، قدرتي وسيلن جي بچاءَ لاءِ ڪم ڪندڙ، جهنگلي جيوت ۽ ٻيلن جو محافظ، تاريخي ورثي جي حفاظت جو حامي
urduMeaning: ماحول کا تحفظ کرنے والا، قدرتی وسائل کے بچاؤ کے لیے کام کرنے والا، جنگلی حیات اور جنگلات کا محافظ، تاریخی ورثے کے تحفظ کا حامی

englishMeaning: Having the power to establish, form, or make up something. Forming an essential part of a whole. Relating to the basic elements that define the nature of something.
synonyms: Essential, Fundamental, Basic, Formative, Component, Integral
antonyms: Incidental, Secondary, Superficial, Nonessential, Peripheral
examples: Trust is a constitutive element of any friendship. The assembly had constitutive powers over the new state. Language is constitutive of human thought. These rules are constitutive rather than merely regulative.
sindhiMeaning: بنيادي جز جي حيثيت رکندڙ, ڪنهن شيءِ کي ٺاهيندڙ يا قائم ڪندڙ, لازمي حصو, تشڪيل ڏيندڙ
urduMeaning: بنیادی جزو کی حیثیت رکھنے والا, کسی چیز کو بنانے یا قائم کرنے والا, لازمی حصہ, تشکیل دینے والا

englishMeaning: Causing or likely to cause disagreement and argument. Relating to a dispute or controversy. Involving heated debate between opposing sides. Describing a person who tends to argue and quarrel readily.
synonyms: Controversial, Disputed, Debatable, Divisive, Argumentative, Quarrelsome, Combative, Touchy
antonyms: Uncontroversial, Agreeable, Peaceful, Harmonious, Amicable, Accepted, Undisputed, Cooperative
examples: Land ownership remains a contentious issue in the region. The proposal proved highly contentious among the members. He avoided contentious topics at the family dinner. Her contentious manner made teamwork difficult.
sindhiMeaning: تڪراري، جھيڙو يا اختلاف پيدا ڪندڙ، بحث طلب معاملو، جھڳڙالو طبيعت وارو ماڻهو، متنازع
urduMeaning: متنازع، جھگڑا یا اختلاف پیدا کرنے والا، بحث طلب معاملہ، جھگڑالو مزاج رکھنے والا شخص، اختلافی

englishMeaning: The process of becoming smaller or shorter. A shortened form of a word or group of words. A tightening of a muscle, especially during childbirth. A decline in economic activity or size.
synonyms: Shrinkage, Reduction, Decrease, Shortening, Tightening, Compression
antonyms: Expansion, Growth, Enlargement, Extension, Augmentation, Dilation
examples: Metal undergoes contraction when it cools. The word "can't" is a contraction of "cannot". Her contractions started early in the morning. The country faced a sharp economic contraction last year.
sindhiMeaning: سُسڻ يا ننڍو ٿيڻ جو عمل، لفظن جي مختصر صورت، عضون جو ڇڪجڻ خاص ڪري ڄمڻ وقت، معيشت ۾ گهٽتائي، سُڪڙجڻ
urduMeaning: سکڑنے یا چھوٹا ہونے کا عمل، الفاظ کی مختصر شکل، پٹھوں کا سکڑنا خاص طور پر زچگی کے دوران، معیشت میں کمی، انقباض

englishMeaning: The act or process of changing something from one form, use, or purpose into another. A change in a person's religious faith or strong beliefs. The adaptation of a building or space for a new use. In finance, the exchange of one currency, security, or unit into another.
synonyms: Transformation, Change, Alteration, Adaptation, Transition, Modification, Metamorphosis, Switch
antonyms: Retention, Preservation, Stagnation, Permanence, Stability, Continuation
examples: The conversion of the old mill into flats took two years. His conversion to Islam surprised many of his old friends. The conversion of miles into kilometres is easy with this app. Solar panels allow the conversion of sunlight into electricity.
sindhiMeaning: تبديلي, هڪ صورت مان ٻي صورت ۾ آڻڻ, مذهب بدلائڻ, عمارت جو نئون استعمال ۾ آڻڻ, ڪرنسي يا ماپ جي مٽاسٽا, ڦيرڦار
urduMeaning: تبدیلی, ایک شکل سے دوسری شکل میں لانا, مذہب کی تبدیلی, عمارت کو نئے استعمال میں لانا, کرنسی یا پیمانے کا تبادلہ, رد و بدل

englishMeaning: A polygon where all interior angles are less than 180 degrees. A polygon in which any line segment connecting two points inside stays completely inside. A polygon that curves outward at every vertex.
synonyms: Outward-curved polygon, Non-concave polygon, Protruding polygon
antonyms: Concave polygon, Indented polygon, Inward-curved polygon
examples: A regular hexagon is a convex polygon. All triangles are convex polygons. A convex polygon has no indentations. Convex polygons are easier to work with mathematically.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو شڪل جنهن جا سڀ اندريون ڪنڊ 180 درجا کان گهٽ هجن، اهڙو ڪثير الاضلاع جنهن ۾ ڪنهن به ٻن نقطن کي ڳنڍڻ واري لڪير مڪمل طور اندر رهي، اهڙو شڪل جيڪو هر نقطي تي ٻاهر طرف مڙيل هجي
urduMeaning: ایسی شکل جس کے تمام اندرونی زاویے 180 ڈگری سے کم ہوں، ایسا کثیر الاضلاع جس میں کسی بھی دو نقاط کو ملانے والی لکیر مکمل طور پر اندر رہے، ایسی شکل جو ہر نقطے پر باہر کی طرف مڑی ہوئی ہو

englishMeaning: A quadrilateral in which every interior angle is less than 180 degrees. A four-sided figure with no inward-pointing corners. A quadrilateral whose diagonals both lie completely inside the shape. The usual type of quadrilateral, including squares and rectangles.
synonyms: Non-concave quadrilateral, Regular quadrilateral, Simple quadrilateral
antonyms: Concave quadrilateral, Re-entrant quadrilateral, Complex quadrilateral
examples: Every square is a convex quadrilateral. The diagonals of a convex quadrilateral intersect inside it. All interior angles of a convex quadrilateral are less than 180 degrees. He shaded the convex quadrilateral in the figure.
sindhiMeaning: اهو چوڪنڊو جنهن جو هر اندروني ڪنڊ 180 درجن کان گهٽ هجي, اهو چئن پاسن وارو شڪل جنهن جو ڪوبه ڪنڊ اندر ڏانهن دٻيل نه هجي, اهو چوڪنڊو جنهن جا ٻئي قطر مڪمل طور اندر رهن ٿا, چوڪنڊن جو عام قسم جنهن ۾ چورس ۽ مستطيل شامل آهن
urduMeaning: وہ رباعی جس کا ہر اندرونی زاویہ 180 درجے سے کم ہو, وہ چار اضلاع والی شکل جس کا کوئی کونا اندر کی طرف دبا ہوا نہ ہو, وہ رباعی جس کے دونوں قطر مکمل طور پر اندر رہتے ہیں, رباعیوں کی عام قسم جس میں مربع اور مستطیل شامل ہیں

englishMeaning: Willing to work with others or help when asked. Involving cooperation or mutual assistance between people or groups. An organization or business owned and operated by its members for their mutual benefit. Done by people working together.
synonyms: Collaborative, Helpful, Willing, Accommodating, Supportive, Joint, Collective, United, Mutual
antonyms: Uncooperative, Obstructive, Unhelpful, Resistant, Competitive, Individual, Independent, Antagonistic
examples: She was very co-operative during the investigation. The project requires a co-operative effort from all teams. They formed a co-operative to sell their products directly. The witness was helpful and co-operative with police.
sindhiMeaning: ٻين سان گڏ ڪم ڪرڻ يا پڇڻ تي مدد ڪرڻ لاءِ تيار، ماڻهن يا گروهن جي وچ ۾ تعاون يا گڏيل مدد شامل ڪندڙ، اهڙي تنظيم يا ڪاروبار جيڪا پنهنجي ميمبرن جي ملڪيت ۽ انهن جي گڏيل فائدي لاءِ هلائي وڃي، ماڻهن جي گڏيل ڪم سان ڪيل
urduMeaning: دوسروں کے ساتھ کام کرنے یا پوچھنے پر مدد کرنے کے لیے تیار، لوگوں یا گروہوں کے درمیان تعاون یا باہمی مدد شامل کرنے والا، ایسی تنظیم یا کاروبار جو اپنے ممبروں کی ملکیت میں ہو اور ان کے مشترکہ فائدے کے لیے چلائی جائے، لوگوں کے مشترکہ کام سے کیا گیا

englishMeaning: In a manner that involves working together with others toward a common goal. Acting in a helpful, willing, and collaborative way. Through cooperation and mutual assistance. In the spirit of teamwork and joint effort.
synonyms: Collaboratively, Jointly, Together, Collectively, Unitedly, In cooperation, In tandem, Harmoniously
antonyms: Competitively, Independently, Separately, Individually, Antagonistically, Uncooperatively, Adversarially
examples: Students were asked to work cooperatively on group assignments. The nations acted cooperatively to address the crisis. Employees cooperatively shared their expertise. The community cooperatively raised funds for the project.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طريقي سان جنهن ۾ گڏيل مقصد لاءِ ٻين سان گڏجي ڪم ڪرڻ شامل هجي، مددگار، رضامند، ۽ تعاون ڪندڙ طريقي سان ڪم ڪرڻ، تعاون ۽ گڏيل مدد ذريعي، ٽيم ورڪ ۽ گڏيل ڪوشش جي جذبي سان
urduMeaning: ایسے طریقے سے جس میں مشترکہ مقصد کے لیے دوسروں کے ساتھ مل کر کام کرنا شامل ہو، مددگار، راضی، اور تعاون کرنے والے طریقے سے کام کرنا، تعاون اور باہمی مدد کے ذریعے، ٹیم ورک اور مشترکہ کوشش کی روح سے

englishMeaning: In a manner that involves working together with others toward a common goal. Acting in a helpful, willing, and collaborative way. Through cooperation and mutual assistance. In the spirit of teamwork and joint effort.
synonyms: Collaboratively, Jointly, Together, Collectively, Unitedly, In cooperation, In tandem, Harmoniously
antonyms: Competitively, Independently, Separately, Individually, Antagonistically, Uncooperatively, Adversarially
examples: The team worked co-operatively to complete the project on time. Children were encouraged to play co-operatively. The departments functioned co-operatively to solve the problem. Communities must work co-operatively to address climate change.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طريقي سان جنهن ۾ گڏيل مقصد لاءِ ٻين سان گڏجي ڪم ڪرڻ شامل هجي، مددگار، رضامند، ۽ تعاون ڪندڙ طريقي سان ڪم ڪرڻ، تعاون ۽ گڏيل مدد ذريعي، ٽيم ورڪ ۽ گڏيل ڪوشش جي جذبي سان
urduMeaning: ایسے طریقے سے جس میں مشترکہ مقصد کے لیے دوسروں کے ساتھ مل کر کام کرنا شامل ہو، مددگار، راضی، اور تعاون کرنے والے طریقے سے کام کرنا، تعاون اور باہمی مدد کے ذریعے، ٹیم ورک اور مشترکہ کوشش کی روح سے

englishMeaning: Having the reddish-brown color of copper. Resembling copper in color or shine. Tasting or smelling like copper or metal. Made of or containing copper.
synonyms: Copper-colored, Reddish-brown, Bronzy, Rusty, Metallic
antonyms: Silvery, Pale, Colorless, Dull grey
examples: Her hair shone with a coppery glow in the sunlight. The autumn leaves turned a coppery red. He noticed a coppery taste in his mouth after the fall. The old coins had a dull coppery shine.
sindhiMeaning: ٽامي وانگر ڳاڙهو-ناسي رنگ وارو، رنگ يا چمڪ ۾ ٽامي جهڙو، ذائقي يا بوءِ ۾ ٽامي يا ڌات وانگر، ٽامي جو ٺهيل يا ان ۾ ٽامو شامل
urduMeaning: تانبے جیسا سرخ بھورا رنگ رکھنے والا، رنگ یا چمک میں تانبے جیسا، ذائقے یا بو میں تانبے یا دھات جیسا، تانبے کا بنا ہوا یا اس میں تانبا شامل

englishMeaning: A hard, stony substance formed by tiny sea creatures in warm oceans. The colourful marine structure known as a reef built by these creatures. A pinkish-orange colour resembling coral. Made of or having the colour of coral.
synonyms: Reef, Polyp, Madrepore, Sea stone, Pinkish orange, Salmon, Peach
antonyms: Deep sea floor, Barren rock, Sand, Dull grey, Colourless, Inland stone
examples: Divers explored the colourful coral near the island. Rising sea temperatures are damaging coral reefs. She wore a coral necklace with her white dress. The walls were painted a soft coral shade.
sindhiMeaning: سمنڊ ۾ ننڍڙن جيوَن مان ٺهندڙ سخت پٿر جهڙو مادو، مرجان، سمنڊ اندر ٺهندڙ رنگين ڇپون، هلڪو گلابي نارنگي رنگ، مرجان مان ٺهيل
urduMeaning: سمندر میں ننھے جانداروں سے بننے والا سخت پتھر نما مادہ، مونگا، سمندر میں بننے والی رنگین چٹانیں، ہلکا گلابی نارنجی رنگ، مونگے سے بنا ہوا

englishMeaning: Relating to the arteries that supply blood to the heart muscle. Concerning the blood vessels surrounding the heart. Associated with heart disease or heart attacks. Of or relating to a crown or crown-like structure.
synonyms: Heart-related, Cardiac, Cardiovascular, Heart artery
antonyms: Non-cardiac, Peripheral, Distant from heart
examples: He suffered a coronary artery blockage. Coronary heart disease is a leading cause of death. The patient underwent coronary bypass surgery. Regular checkups can detect coronary problems early.
sindhiMeaning: شريانن سان لاڳاپيل جيڪي دل جي عضلات کي رت فراهم ڪن، دل جي چوڌاري رت جي رڳن سان لاڳاپيل، دل جي بيماري يا دل جي دوري سان لاڳاپيل، تاج يا تاج جهڙي اڏاوت سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: شریانوں سے متعلق جو دل کے پٹھوں کو خون فراہم کریں، دل کے گرد خون کی رگوں سے متعلق، دل کی بیماری یا دل کے دورے سے منسلک، تاج یا تاج نما ساخت سے متعلق

englishMeaning: Having a close similarity, connection, or equivalence to something else. Matching or analogous in character, form, or function. Related or connected in a systematic way. Communicating by exchanging letters.
synonyms: Matching, Equivalent, Analogous, Comparable, Related, Similar, Parallel, Correlating, Associated
antonyms: Different, Unrelated, Dissimilar, Contrasting, Opposite, Disparate, Unmatched, Independent
examples: Each number has a corresponding letter in the code. The map shows cities with their corresponding populations. Sales figures show a corresponding increase in customer satisfaction. They maintained a corresponding relationship through letters.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ٻي شيءِ سان ويجهڙي مشابهت، لاڳاپو، يا برابري رکندڙ، ڪردار، شڪل، يا ڪم ۾ ملندڙ يا هڪجهڙائي رکندڙ، منظم طريقي سان لاڳاپيل يا ڳنڍيل، خطن جي مٽا سٽا ذريعي رابطو ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: کسی دوسری چیز سے قریبی مشابہت، تعلق، یا برابری رکھنے والا، کردار، شکل، یا کام میں ملتا جلتا یا یکساں، منظم طریقے سے متعلق یا جڑا ہوا، خطوں کے تبادلے کے ذریعے رابطہ کرنے والا

englishMeaning: In a way that matches, relates to, or is in agreement with something else. In a similar or proportional manner. Accordingly or in response to something. In a way that shows a connection or relationship.
synonyms: Accordingly, Similarly, Proportionally, Likewise, In the same way, Analogously, Commensurately, Equally
antonyms: Differently, Contrarily, Oppositely, Inversely, Disproportionally, Unequally, Independently
examples: As temperatures rise, ice melts correspondingly faster. Sales increased and profits grew correspondingly. The workload decreased, and stress levels dropped correspondingly. When demand rises, prices increase correspondingly.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪو ملندو هجي، لاڳاپو رکندو هجي، يا ڪنهن ٻي شيءِ سان اتفاق ۾ هجي، ساڳي يا متناسب طريقي سان، تنهن مطابق يا ڪنهن شيءِ جي جواب ۾، اهڙي طريقي سان جيڪو ڪنيڪشن يا تعلق ڏيکاري
urduMeaning: ایسے طریقے سے جو میل کھاتا ہو، تعلق رکھتا ہو، یا کسی اور چیز سے اتفاق میں ہو، ایک جیسے یا متناسب طریقے سے، اسی کے مطابق یا کسی چیز کے جواب میں، ایسے طریقے سے جو تعلق یا رشتہ دکھائے

englishMeaning: A circular hollow on a mountainside, typically formed by glacial erosion. A bowl-shaped depression in a mountain, also known as a cirque. A geological feature created by ice and snow accumulation.
synonyms: Cirque, Cwm, Hollow, Basin, Depression, Glacial hollow, Mountain bowl
antonyms: Peak, Summit, Ridge, Crest, Plateau, Mountain top
examples: The climbers rested in a sheltered corrie below the summit. Ancient glaciers carved out numerous corries in the mountain range. A small lake had formed in the corrie. The corrie provided natural protection from the wind.
sindhiMeaning: جبل جي پاسي تي گول ٿلهو، عام طور تي برفاني تيزابيت سان ٺهيل، جبل ۾ پيالي جي شڪل وارو گهٽ حصو، جنهن کي سرڪيو به چيو ويندو آهي، برف ۽ برفباري جي جمع ٿيڻ سان پيدا ٿيندڙ جيولوجيڪل خاصيت
urduMeaning: پہاڑ کی طرف پر گول کھوکھلا حصہ، عام طور پر برفانی کٹاؤ سے بنا ہوا، پہاڑ میں پیالے کی شکل کا نشیب، جسے سرک بھی کہا جاتا ہے، برف اور برف باری کے جمع ہونے سے پیدا ہونے والی ارضیاتی خصوصیت

englishMeaning: To confirm or support a statement, theory, or finding with evidence or proof. To provide evidence that strengthens or verifies something already believed or stated. To give supporting testimony or validation.
synonyms: Confirm, Verify, Substantiate, Support, Validate, Authenticate, Back up, Bear out, Attest, Prove
antonyms: Contradict, Refute, Disprove, Deny, Oppose, Challenge, Dispute, Negate, Undermine
examples: The evidence corroborates the witness's testimony. Scientific research corroborates the health benefits of exercise. Documents were found that corroborate her version of events. Several people corroborated his alibi.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن بيان، نظريي، يا نتيجي جي ثبوت يا سبوت سان تصديق يا حمايت ڪرڻ، اهڙو ثبوت فراهم ڪرڻ جيڪو اڳ ۾ مڃيل يا ڄاڻايل شيءِ کي مضبوط يا تصديق ڪري، معاون گواهي يا تصديق ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی بیان، نظریے، یا نتیجے کی ثبوت یا سبوت کے ساتھ تصدیق یا حمایت کرنا، ایسا ثبوت فراہم کرنا جو پہلے سے مانی یا بیان کی گئی چیز کو مضبوط یا تصدیق کرے، معاون گواہی یا تصدیق دینا

englishMeaning: The action or process of confirming or supporting something with evidence or proof. Evidence or testimony that confirms or supports a statement, theory, or finding. Additional proof that strengthens the credibility of something.
synonyms: Confirmation, Verification, Substantiation, Support, Validation, Evidence, Proof, Authentication, Attestation
antonyms: Contradiction, Refutation, Denial, Opposition, Disproof, Challenge, Dispute, Negation
examples: The investigation found corroboration for the allegations. We need independent corroboration of these claims. His testimony provided important corroboration of the facts. The documents offer corroboration of her account.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي ثبوت يا سبوت سان تصديق يا حمايت ڪرڻ جو عمل يا طريقو، اهڙو ثبوت يا گواهي جيڪو ڪنهن بيان، نظريي، يا نتيجي جي تصديق يا حمايت ڪري، اضافي ثبوت جيڪو ڪنهن شيءِ جي معتبريت کي مضبوط ڪري
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو ثبوت یا سبوت کے ساتھ تصدیق یا حمایت کرنے کا عمل یا طریقہ، ایسا ثبوت یا گواہی جو کسی بیان، نظریے، یا نتیجے کی تصدیق یا حمایت کرے، اضافی ثبوت جو کسی چیز کی ساکھ کو مضبوط کرے

englishMeaning: Serving to confirm, support, or give evidence to something already stated or believed. Providing additional proof or verification. Tending to strengthen or make more certain. Acting as supporting evidence or testimony.
synonyms: Confirmatory, Supporting, Substantiating, Verifying, Validating, Reinforcing, Backing, Attesting
antonyms: Contradictory, Refuting, Opposing, Conflicting, Denying, Disproving, Undermining, Negating
examples: The witness provided corroborative testimony to the victim's account. DNA evidence was corroborative of the suspect's presence at the scene. Her statement was corroborative of what we already knew. The documents serve a corroborative function in proving the claim.
sindhiMeaning: اڳ ۾ ڄاڻايل يا مڃيل ڪنهن شيءِ جي تصديق، حمايت، يا ثبوت ڏيڻ جو ڪم ڪندڙ، اضافي ثبوت يا تصديق فراهم ڪندڙ، مضبوط ڪرڻ يا وڌيڪ يقيني بڻائڻ جو رجحان رکندڙ، معاون ثبوت يا شاهدي طور ڪم ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: پہلے سے بیان شدہ یا یقین شدہ کسی چیز کی تصدیق، حمایت، یا ثبوت دینے کا کام کرنے والا، اضافی ثبوت یا تصدیق فراہم کرنے والا، مضبوط کرنے یا زیادہ یقینی بنانے کا رجحان رکھنے والا، معاون ثبوت یا گواہی کے طور پر کام کرنے والا

englishMeaning: Having the ability to gradually destroy or damage something through chemical action. Tending to eat away or wear down materials, especially metals. Having a harmful or destructive effect on something, especially relationships or morale. Bitterly critical or sarcastic in a harmful way. A substance that causes corrosion.
synonyms: Caustic, Erosive, Destructive, Harmful, Damaging, Acidic, Eating away, Wearing, Biting, Cutting
antonyms: Protective, Preservative, Harmless, Beneficial, Constructive, Healing, Soothing, Gentle
examples: Acid is a highly corrosive substance that can burn skin. The corrosive effects of salt water damaged the metal pipes. His corrosive criticism destroyed the team's morale. Constant negativity can have a corrosive effect on relationships.
sindhiMeaning: ڪيميائي عمل ذريعي آهستي آهستي ڪنهن شيءِ کي تباهه يا نقصان پهچائڻ جي صلاحيت رکندڙ، شين کي، خاص ڪري ڌاتن کي، ختم ڪرڻ يا گهٽائڻ جو رجحان رکندڙ، ڪنهن شيءِ تي، خاص ڪري رشتن يا حوصلي تي، نقصانڪار يا تباهه ڪندڙ اثر رکندڙ، نقصانڪار طريقي سان سخت تنقيدي يا طنزيه، اهڙو مادو جيڪو زنگ پيدا ڪري

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي بي ايماني يا غير اخلاقي ڪم ڪرڻ تي مجبور ڪرڻ، خاص ڪري رشوت يا غير اخلاقي اثر ذريعي، ڪنهن شيءِ کي خراب ڪرڻ يا ان جي اصل حالت کان ناپاڪ يا گهٽ معيار جو بڻائڻ، بي ايماني يا غير اخلاقي رويي سان منسوب، خاص ڪري اقتدار ۾ ويٺل ماڻهن لاءِ، اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا خراب، تبديل يا ناپاڪ ٿي وئي هجي، خراب ڪرڻ يا خراب ٿيڻ جو عمل

urduMeaning: معدے اور آنتوں میں کھانے کو توڑنا، کھانے سے غذائی اجزاء کو پراسیس اور جذب کرنا، معلومات کے بارے میں مکمل طور پر سوچنا اور سمجھنا، تحریری مواد کا خلاصہ یا مختصر نسخہ

englishMeaning: The process of breaking down food into nutrients the body can absorb. The chemical and mechanical breakdown of food in the digestive system. The conversion of food into substances that can be used for energy and growth. The body's system for processing food from mouth to intestines.

englishMeaning: Relating to or aiding the process of digestion. Concerning the breakdown of food in the body. Associated with the digestive system and its organs. Having the function of processing food.

antonyms: Non-digestive, Respiratory, Circulatory, Unrelated to digestion

urduMeaning: ہضم کے عمل سے متعلق یا مدد کرنے والا، جسم میں کھانے کی ٹوٹ پھوٹ سے متعلق، نظام انہضام اور اس کے اعضاء سے منسلک، کھانے کو پروسیس کرنے کے کام کے ساتھ

englishMeaning: The group of organs that work together to break down food and absorb nutrients. The biological system consisting of the mouth, esophagus, stomach, intestines, and related organs. The body's mechanism for converting food into energy and waste. The pathway from mouth to anus involved in processing food.

englishMeaning: The act of making a liquid weaker or thinner by adding water or another substance. The state of being diluted. A reduction in strength, value or effect, as of shares or authority.

englishMeaning: To put something quickly into a liquid and take it out again. To go downward or become lower for a short time. A thick sauce into which food is dipped. A brief swim.

englishMeaning: Going straight from one point to another without stopping or changing direction. Honest and clear in speech or behavior; saying exactly what you mean. To control, manage, or guide an activity, organization, or group of people. To aim or point something in a particular direction.

antonyms: Indirect, Roundabout, Evasive, Devious, Crooked, Follow, Misguide
examples: We took a direct flight from Karachi to Dubai. She gave a direct answer to the journalist's question. He was chosen to direct the new film. Please direct your complaints to the manager.
sindhiMeaning: سڌو، بغير ڪنهن رڪاوٽ يا ڦيري جي، صاف ۽ کُليل ڳالهائڻ وارو، ڪنهن سرگرمي يا اداري کي سنڀالڻ يا هدايت ڏيڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي خاص طرف اشارو ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: سیدھا، بغیر کسی رکاوٹ یا چکر کے، صاف اور کھلی بات کرنے والا، کسی سرگرمی یا ادارے کو چلانا یا ہدایت دینا، کسی چیز کو خاص سمت میں اشارہ کرنا

englishMeaning: The way or path along which someone or something moves, faces, or points. Guidance or instructions about how to do something or where to go. Control, management, or leadership of an activity or organization. A general aim, purpose, or course of development.

sindhiMeaning: طرف، سمت، اهو رستو جنهن ۾ ڪو هلي يا اشارو ڪري، رهنمائي يا هدايتون، ڪنهن سرگرمي جي نگراني يا قيادت، مقصد يا ترقي جو رستو
urduMeaning: سمت، رخ، وہ راستہ جس میں کوئی چلتا یا اشارہ کرتا ہے، رہنمائی یا ہدایات، کسی سرگرمی کی نگرانی یا قیادت، مقصد یا ترقی کا راستہ

englishMeaning: Relating to direction or the way something moves or points. Designed to send or receive signals in a particular direction. Giving guidance about which way to go.

antonyms: Non-directional, Omnidirectional, Aimless, Undirected

englishMeaning: Having no clear direction, purpose, or goal. Lacking guidance or leadership. Moving or drifting without a definite aim.
synonyms: Aimless, Purposeless, Goalless, Adrift, Rudderless, Lost, Wandering
antonyms: Purposeful, Focused, Determined, Goal-oriented, Directed, Ambitious
examples: After losing his job, he felt directionless for months. The company seemed directionless under weak leadership. The boat drifted directionless in the open sea. Without a plan, the project quickly became directionless.
sindhiMeaning: بغير ڪنهن واضح طرف يا مقصد جي، بي مقصد، رهنمائي يا قيادت کان محروم، بغير منزل جي ڀٽڪندڙ

urduMeaning: نئی یا خفیہ معلومات کو معلوم یا عوامی کرنے کا عمل، پہلے چھپی ہوئی حقیقتوں یا تفصیلات کا انکشاف، وہ معلومات جو ظاہر یا افشاء کی گئی ہو، کچھ معلومات ظاہر کرنے کی قانونی ذمہ داری، خاص طور پر کاروباری یا مالیاتی حوالوں میں

A particular way of understanding what counts as valid knowledge. The study of the difference between genuine knowledge and mere opinion.

antonyms: Ignorance, Superstition, Dogma, Blind belief

antonyms: Normal thyroid, Healthy thyroid gland, No thyroid swelling
examples: Iodine deficiency can cause goiter. The patient has a visible goiter on the neck. Goiter may require medication or surgery. Using iodized salt helps prevent goiter.
sindhiMeaning: ڳچيءَ ۾ تايرائڊ غدود جو غير معمولي وڌڻ، ڳچيءَ ۾ سوڄ جيڪا تايرائڊ جي خرابي يا آئوڊين جي گهٽتائي سبب ٿئي، ڳلي جي علائقي ۾ نظر ايندڙ گولو تايرائڊ جي مسئلن سبب، هڪ حالت جيڪا هارمون جي پيداوار ۽ ميٽابولزم کي متاثر ڪري سگهي ٿي
urduMeaning: گردن میں تھائیرائڈ غدود کا غیر معمولی بڑھاؤ، گردن میں سوجن جو تھائیرائڈ کی خرابی یا آئوڈین کی کمی سے ہو، گلے کے علاقے میں نظر آنے والا گلٹی تھائیرائڈ کے مسائل کی وجہ سے، ایک حالت جو ہارمون کی پیداوار اور میٹابولزم کو متاثر کر سکتی ہے

englishMeaning: Friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings towards others. A kindly attitude and desire for the welfare of people. The established reputation of a business regarded as a valuable asset. Willingness to be generous or forgiving.
synonyms: Kindness, Benevolence, Friendliness, Favour, Amity, Reputation, Cordiality
antonyms: Ill will, Hostility, Malice, Animosity, Enmity, Spite
examples: The visit was made as a gesture of goodwill between the two nations. She has earned the goodwill of everyone in the neighbourhood. The company's goodwill was valued at several million rupees. He released the prisoners as a sign of goodwill.
sindhiMeaning: خير خواهي يا نيڪ نيتي، ٻين جي ڀلائي جي خواهش، ڪاروبار جي قائم ٿيل ساک جيڪا هڪ قيمتي اثاثو هجي، فراخدلي ۽ معاف ڪرڻ جو جذبو
urduMeaning: خیر سگالی یا نیک نیتی، دوسروں کی بھلائی کی خواہش، کاروبار کی قائم شدہ ساکھ جو ایک قیمتی اثاثہ ہو، فیاضی اور درگزر کا جذبہ

englishMeaning: An extremely complicated problem that seems impossible to solve. A difficulty that can only be resolved by bold or unconventional action. A tangled situation requiring a decisive solution.
synonyms: Dilemma, Quandary, Impasse, Deadlock, Tangle, Complex problem, Conundrum
antonyms: Simple matter, Easy task, Solution, Clarity, Straightforward issue, Resolution
examples: The dispute over water rights became a Gordian knot. He cut the Gordian knot by resigning from both posts. Reforming the system is a Gordian knot for any government. Their finances had turned into a real Gordian knot.
sindhiMeaning: انتهائي پيچيده مسئلو جيڪو حل ٿيڻ ناممڪن لڳي، اهڙي مشڪل جيڪا صرف جرئتمند فيصلي سان حل ٿئي، منجهيل ۽ ڳتيل صورتحال، وڏي ڳنڍ جهڙو مسئلو
urduMeaning: انتہائی پیچیدہ مسئلہ جو ناقابلِ حل معلوم ہو، ایسی مشکل جو صرف جرأت مندانہ فیصلے سے حل ہو، الجھی ہوئی صورتحال، بڑی گرہ جیسا مسئلہ

englishMeaning: Moving in a smooth, elegant, and attractive way. Having or showing beauty of form, movement, or expression. Polite and pleasant in behavior, especially in difficult situations. Characterized by charm, ease, and refinement.
synonyms: Elegant, Fluid, Smooth, Agile, Poised, Refined, Lithe, Supple, Delicate, Charming
antonyms: Clumsy, Awkward, Gawky, Ungainly, Rude, Harsh, Stiff, Coarse, Graceless
examples: The dancer moved across the stage with graceful steps. She accepted her defeat in a graceful manner. The swan glided gracefully across the calm lake. His graceful handwriting impressed the teacher.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ جهڙي نرم ۽ خوبصورت انداز سان هلڻ وارو، صورت حرڪت يا اظهار جي خوبصورتي رکڻ وارو، مشڪل حالتن ۾ به شائستہ ۽ خوشگوار رويو رکندڙ، نفاست ۽ سهولت وارو
urduMeaning: ہموار، شائستہ اور پرکشش انداز میں چلنے والا، صورت، حرکت یا اظہار کی خوبصورتی رکھنے والا، مشکل حالات میں بھی شائستہ اور خوشگوار رویہ رکھنے والا، نفاست اور آسانی والا

englishMeaning: Relating to grammar. Following the rules of grammar correctly. Concerning the structure and form of sentences.
synonyms: Syntactic, Linguistic, Correct, Well-formed, Proper
antonyms: Ungrammatical, Incorrect, Faulty, Improper, Erroneous
examples: The essay contains a few grammatical errors. He explained the grammatical rules with examples. That form is not grammatical in standard English. Grammatical accuracy improves with regular reading.
sindhiMeaning: گرامر سان لاڳاپيل، قواعد جي اصولن مطابق درست، جملي جي بناوت سان تعلق رکندڙ
urduMeaning: گرامر سے متعلق، قواعد کے اصولوں کے مطابق درست، جملے کی ساخت سے تعلق رکھنے والا

englishMeaning: In a way that follows the rules of grammar. With regard to grammar. Correctly in terms of sentence structure and word form.
synonyms: Correctly, Syntactically, Linguistically, Properly, Accurately
antonyms: Incorrectly, Ungrammatically, Improperly, Wrongly, Loosely
examples: The sentence is grammatically correct but sounds odd. Grammatically, the phrase needs a comma here. She writes grammatically even in informal messages. The translation is grammatically sound and clear.
sindhiMeaning: گرامر جي اصولن مطابق، قواعد جي لحاظ کان، جملي جي بناوت جي لحاظ کان درست نموني
urduMeaning: قواعد کے اصولوں کے مطابق، گرامر کے لحاظ سے، جملے کی ساخت کے اعتبار سے درست انداز میں

englishMeaning: Containing or covered with gravel. Rough, deep and harsh in sound, as of a voice. Having a coarse, grainy texture. Resembling small stones in feel or appearance.
synonyms: Rough, Harsh, Gritty, Rasping, Coarse, Stony, Husky
antonyms: Smooth, Soft, Melodious, Fine, Silky, Clear
examples: We walked slowly along the gravelly path. He spoke in a deep, gravelly voice. The soil here is dry and gravelly. Her gravelly laughter filled the room.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنڪر يا ريتيءَ سان ڀريل، آواز جو ڳرو ۽ کهرو هجڻ، کهري ۽ داڻيدار بناوت وارو، ننڍن پٿرن جهڙو
urduMeaning: کنکریلا یا بجری سے بھرا ہوا، آواز کا بھاری اور کھردرا ہونا، کھردری اور دانے دار ساخت والا، چھوٹے پتھروں جیسا

englishMeaning: A humorous saying used when two people have the same idea at the same time. An expression suggesting that intelligent people often reach similar conclusions. A light-hearted remark acknowledging a shared thought.
synonyms: Same wavelength, Like-minded, In agreement, Of one mind
antonyms: Difference of opinion, Disagreement, Clash of views, Dissent
examples: I was just about to call you — great minds think alike! We both ordered the same dish; great minds think alike. She laughed and said, great minds think alike, when they submitted identical plans. Great minds think alike, though fools seldom differ.
sindhiMeaning: وڏا ذهن هڪجهڙو سوچيندا آهن, ٻن ماڻهن جو هڪ ئي وقت هڪجهڙو خيال اچڻ, داناءَ ماڻهو هڪجهڙي نتيجي تي پهچن ٿا
urduMeaning: بڑے ذہن ایک جیسا سوچتے ہیں, دو افراد کا ایک ہی وقت میں ایک جیسا خیال آنا, دانا لوگ ایک جیسے نتیجے پر پہنچتے ہیں

englishMeaning: Total amount before any deductions. Extremely unpleasant or repulsive. Very obvious and unacceptable, as of an error. A quantity equal to twelve dozen.
synonyms: Total, Entire, Whole, Vulgar, Flagrant, Coarse, Disgusting
antonyms: Net, Refined, Pleasant, Minor, Partial, Delicate
examples: His gross income last year exceeded all expectations. The kitchen was in a gross condition. It was a gross violation of the rules. They ordered a gross of pencils for the school.
sindhiMeaning: ڪل رقم بغير ڪنهن ڪٽوتيءَ جي، انتهائي ناپسنديده يا ڪراهت جوڳو، تمام واضح ۽ ناقابل قبول غلطي، ٻارهن درجن جي مقدار
urduMeaning: کٹوتی سے پہلے کل رقم، انتہائی ناگوار یا گھناؤنا، بالکل واضح اور ناقابلِ قبول غلطی، بارہ درجن کی مقدار

englishMeaning: A small picturesque cave, especially one that is artificial. A cave-like recess or shelter, often decorated with shells or stones. A natural hollow in rock used as a shrine or retreat. An ornamental structure imitating a cave in a garden.
synonyms: Cave, Cavern, Grot, Hollow, Recess, Alcove, Den, Cavity
antonyms: Peak, Summit, Open ground, Plain, Hilltop, Clearing
examples: The garden contains a small grotto with a fountain. Pilgrims gather to pray at the grotto every evening. We sheltered from the rain inside a sea grotto. The grotto was lit with hundreds of tiny candles.
sindhiMeaning: ننڍڙي ۽ خوبصورت غار خاص ڪري مصنوعي طور تي ٺاهيل، پٿرن يا سپن سان سينگاريل غار جهڙي جاءِ، پهاڙ ۾ قدرتي کوٽ جيڪا عبادت يا آرام لاءِ استعمال ٿئي، باغ ۾ ٺاهيل غار نما سينگار
urduMeaning: چھوٹا اور خوبصورت غار  خاص طور پر مصنوعی طور پر بنایا گیا، سیپیوں یا پتھروں سے سجی غار نما جگہ، چٹان میں قدرتی کھوہ جو عبادت یا آرام کے لیے استعمال ہو، باغ میں بنایا گیا غار نما تعمیراتی نمونہ

englishMeaning: Introducing new ideas or methods; highly innovative. Marking an important first step or discovery in a field. Relating to the ceremony of beginning construction on a new building.
synonyms: Innovative, Pioneering, Revolutionary, Trailblazing, Original, Novel, Path-breaking, Inventive, Landmark, Cutting-edge
antonyms: Conventional, Traditional, Ordinary, Outdated, Unoriginal, Derivative, Routine, Old-fashioned, Familiar, Commonplace
examples: Her ground-breaking research changed how doctors treat the disease. The film was ground-breaking for its time. Scientists published a ground-breaking study on climate change. The mayor attended the ground-breaking ceremony for the new hospital.
sindhiMeaning: نئين راهه کوليندڙ، جدت ڀريو ۽ نئون تصور پيش ڪندڙ، ڪنهن شعبي ۾ پهريون اهم قدم، نئين عمارت جي تعمير جي شروعات سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: نئی راہ کھولنے والا، جدت پر مبنی اور انوکھا، کسی شعبے میں پہلا اہم قدم، نئی عمارت کی تعمیر کے آغاز سے متعلق

englishMeaning: Dirty, grimy, or covered in dust and stains. Shabby and unwashed in appearance. Morally unpleasant, sordid or contemptible.
synonyms: Dirty, Grimy, Filthy, Soiled, Mucky, Unwashed, Squalid, Sordid, Shabby
antonyms: Clean, Spotless, Immaculate, Pristine, Tidy, Fresh, Washed, Honourable
examples: The child came home with grubby hands and a torn shirt. He wiped the table with a grubby cloth. They uncovered a grubby deal between the two officials. Her grubby little office had not been cleaned in weeks.
sindhiMeaning: مٽيءَ ڀريو، گندو، ڌوٻي کان سواءِ ميرو، داغن سان ڀريل, ڦٽل ۽ اڻ صاف, اخلاقي طور تي گندو يا بڇڙو
urduMeaning: میلا، گندا، مٹی اور داغوں سے بھرا, بدحال اور بغیر دھلا, اخلاقی طور پر گھٹیا یا ناپسندیدہ

englishMeaning: Rough and low in sound, especially of a voice. Abrupt or unfriendly in speech or manner. Outwardly stern but often kind underneath.
synonyms: Hoarse, Husky, Rough, Brusque, Surly, Curt, Abrupt, Grumpy, Blunt
antonyms: Gentle, Soft, Melodious, Friendly, Polite, Warm, Courteous, Smooth
examples: He answered in a gruff voice from behind the door. Despite his gruff manner, the old man was very kind. The coach gave a gruff nod of approval. She was startled by his gruff reply.
sindhiMeaning: ڪرڙو ۽ ٿلهو آواز، رکو ۽ اڻ وڻندڙ نموني ڳالهائيندڙ، مٿاڇري تي سخت پر اندران نرم دل، بي رخو لهجو
urduMeaning: بھاری اور کھردری آواز، رُوکھے اور ناخوشگوار انداز میں بات کرنے والا، بظاہر سخت مگر اندر سے نرم دل، بے رخا لہجہ

englishMeaning: Full of cunning and deceit. Skilled in using tricks to mislead others. Sly and crafty in behaviour or intention. Marked by deliberate dishonesty.
synonyms: Cunning, Deceitful, Crafty, Sly, Wily, Devious, Treacherous, Artful, Scheming
antonyms: Honest, Sincere, Guileless, Straightforward, Naive, Frank, Truthful, Innocent
examples: His guileful promises tricked several investors. She saw through his guileful smile at once. The story features a guileful fox and a trusting crow. Their guileful tactics eventually came to light.
sindhiMeaning: مڪار ۽ فريبي، چالاڪيءَ سان ٻين کي دوکو ڏيندڙ، حيلا ۽ چالبازيون ڪندڙ، دغاباز ۽ ٺڳيءَ وارو، ڪپٽي
urduMeaning: مکار اور فریبی، چالاکی سے دوسروں کو دھوکہ دینے والا، حیلے اور چالبازیاں کرنے والا، دغاباز اور دھوکے باز، عیار

englishMeaning: To delay taking action or making a decision. To remain unresolved or held up for a time. To wait before proceeding with a plan. Originally, of a gun, to be slow in firing after the trigger is pulled.
synonyms: Delay, Wait, Postpone, Stall, Hold off, Pause, Defer, Hesitate
antonyms: Proceed, Act, Hurry, Advance, Rush, Decide, Move ahead
examples: Let's hang fire until we hear from the lawyers. The project has hung fire for several months. She decided to hang fire before replying to the offer. The old musket would sometimes hang fire in damp weather.
sindhiMeaning: ڪم يا فيصلو ملتوي ڪرڻ، ڪجهه وقت لاءِ رڪجي وڃڻ، اڳتي وڌڻ کان اڳ انتظار ڪرڻ، بندوق جو دير سان هلڻ
urduMeaning: کام یا فیصلہ مؤخر کرنا، کچھ وقت کے لیے رک جانا، آگے بڑھنے سے پہلے انتظار کرنا، بندوق کا دیر سے چلنا

englishMeaning: A heavy farming implement with spikes or discs used to break up and level ploughed soil. To draw a harrow over land in order to prepare it for sowing. To cause someone acute distress, pain, or torment. To wound the feelings deeply and repeatedly.
synonyms: Rake, Cultivator, Till, Break up, Distress, Torment, Anguish, Trouble, Afflict
antonyms: Comfort, Soothe, Console, Calm, Relieve, Please, Reassure, Delight
examples: The farmer used a harrow to level the field before sowing. They harrowed the land after the first rains. The harrowing details of the accident shocked everyone. Memories of the war continued to harrow him.
sindhiMeaning: زمين کي هموار ڪرڻ وارو ڏندن يا ٿالهين وارو زرعي اوزار، ٻج پوکڻ کان اڳ زمين تي اهو اوزار هلائڻ، ڪنهن کي سخت ذهني تڪليف ۽ ڏک ڏيڻ، دل کي ڏکوئڻ ۽ ايذاءُ پهچائڻ، بار بار زخمي ڪرڻ جذباتي طور تي
urduMeaning: زمین ہموار کرنے کا دندانے دار یا قرصوں والا زرعی آلہ، بیج بونے سے پہلے زمین پر یہ آلہ چلانا، کسی کو شدید ذہنی اذیت اور دکھ دینا، دل دکھانا اور تکلیف پہنچانا، جذباتی طور پر بار بار زخمی کرنا

englishMeaning: A three-dimensional spiral shape like a corkscrew or spring. A curve that winds around a cylinder or cone at a constant angle. The spiral structure of the DNA molecule. The curved outer rim of the ear. A thing having a spiral form.
synonyms: Spiral, Coil, Corkscrew, Twist, Screw shape, Whorl
antonyms: Straight line, Flat plane
examples: The staircase wound upward in a graceful helix. DNA has the shape of a double helix. The metal spring was formed into a tight helix. The snail's shell grows in a spiral helix.
sindhiMeaning: ڪارڪ اسڪرو يا اسپرنگ وانگر ٽي جڳهه واري گھمندڙ شڪل، اها وکر جيڪي سلنڊر يا مخروط جي چوڌاري هڪجهڙي زاوي تي گھمي، ڊي اين اي جو گھمندڙ بناوت، ڪن جي ٻاهران ڦڪيل ڪنارو، گھمندڙ شڪل واري شيءِ
urduMeaning: کارک اسکرو یا اسپرنگ جیسی تین جہتی گھومتی شکل، وہ لکیر جو سلنڈر یا مخروط کے گرد ایک جیسے زاویے پر گھومے، ڈی این اے کی گھومتی بناوٹ، کان کی بیرونی دہلیز دار کنارہ، گھومتی شکل والی چیز

englishMeaning: One half of a sphere or globe divided by a plane passing through its centre. Either half of the Earth as divided by the equator into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres, or by a meridian into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. Either of the two halves of the brain, known as the cerebral hemispheres. A dome-shaped object or structure having the form of half a ball.
synonyms: Half-sphere, Semisphere, Dome, Half, Cupola, Vault
antonyms: Whole, Sphere, Globe, Entirety, Totality
examples: Australia lies in the Southern Hemisphere. Winter in the Northern Hemisphere begins in December. The right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body. The roof was built as a perfect hemisphere of glass and steel.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن گول شيءِ جو اڌ حصو، ڌرتيءَ جو اڌ حصو جيڪو ڀونوَ جي وچين ليڪ سان ورهايل هجي، اتر يا ڏکڻ اڌ گولو، اوڀر يا اولهه اڌ گولو، دماغ جي ٻن حصن مان هڪ حصو، اڌ گنبذ جهڙي شڪل واري شيءِ
urduMeaning: کرہ کا نصف حصہ، زمین کا نصف حصہ جو خطِ استوا سے تقسیم ہو، شمالی یا جنوبی نصف کرہ، مشرقی یا مغربی نصف کرہ، دماغ کے دو حصوں میں سے ایک، آدھے گنبد جیسی شکل والی چیز

englishMeaning: A plane geometric figure with eleven straight sides and eleven angles. An eleven-sided polygon, also called an undecagon. Any shape or design based on an eleven-sided figure.
synonyms: Undecagon, Endecagon, Polygon, Eleven-sided figure
antonyms: Circle, Oval, Ellipse, Curve
examples: The teacher drew a hendecagon on the whiteboard. A hendecagon has eleven equal sides when it is regular. Students measured each angle of the hendecagon carefully. The coin was minted in the shape of a hendecagon.
sindhiMeaning: يارهن پاسن ۽ يارهن ڪنڊن واري جاميٽري شڪل، يارهن ڪنڊو، اهڙو نقشو يا ڊزائين جيڪو يارهن پاسن واري شڪل تي ٻڌل هجي
urduMeaning: گیارہ اضلاع اور گیارہ زاویوں والی ہندسی شکل، گیارہ ضلعی شکل، ایسا نقشہ یا ڈیزائن جو گیارہ اضلاع والی شکل پر مبنی ہو

englishMeaning: A seventeen-sided polygon with seventeen angles. A geometric shape with seventeen straight sides and seventeen vertices. Any flat shape with seventeen corners and seventeen edges.
synonyms: Seventeen-sided polygon, Heptakaidecagon, Heptadecagonal shape, Seventeen-gon
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Simple polygon, Irregular shape
examples: A regular heptadecagon has seventeen equal sides and angles. The rare geometric construction showed a perfect heptadecagon. Mathematicians proved that a heptadecagon can be constructed with compass and straightedge. The decorative ceiling had a heptadecagonal pattern.
sindhiMeaning: سترهن رخن ۽ سترهن ڪنڊن وارو هڪ شڪل، سترهه سڌي پاسن ۽ سترهه نقطن وارو جيوميٽري شڪل، سترهه ڪنڊن ۽ سترهه ڪنارن وارو ڪو به برابر شڪل
urduMeaning: سترہ اضلاع اور سترہ زاویوں والی شکل، سترہ سیدھی اطراف اور سترہ نقاط والی ہندسی شکل، سترہ کونوں اور سترہ کناروں والی کوئی بھی چپٹی شکل

englishMeaning: A seven-sided polygon with seven angles. A geometric shape with seven straight sides and seven vertices. Any flat shape with seven corners and seven edges.
synonyms: Seven-sided polygon, Heptagonal shape, Septagon, Seven-gon
antonyms: Circle, Triangle, Square, Hexagon, Irregular shape

urduMeaning: ضروری، لازمی، کسی مقصد کے لیے درکار، قانون یا حالات کے مطابق واجب، ناگزیر اور یقینی، اختیاری نہیں بلکہ بنیادی

englishMeaning: Something that is essential and cannot be done without. The state of being required or unavoidable. A situation of urgent need or hardship that forces action. A basic requirement for living or working.
synonyms: Need, Requirement, Essential, Prerequisite, Must, Obligation, Demand
antonyms: Luxury, Extra, Option, Choice, Nonessential, Superfluity
examples: Clean drinking water is an absolute necessity. Necessity forced them to sell the family land. There is no necessity to arrive before eight. For many households, a mobile phone is now a necessity.
sindhiMeaning: ضرورت، اهڙي شيءِ جنهن کان سواءِ گذارو نه ٿئي، لازمي هجڻ جي حالت، مجبوري يا سخت گهرج، زندگيءَ جي بنيادي گهرج
urduMeaning: ضرورت، ایسی چیز جس کے بغیر گزارہ نہ ہو، لازمی ہونے کی حالت، مجبوری یا شدید حاجت، زندگی کی بنیادی ضرورت

englishMeaning: A person living next door to or very near another person. A country, town, or thing situated next to another. A fellow human being, especially in a moral or religious sense. To be situated next to or adjoin something.
synonyms: Resident nearby, Next-door, Fellow citizen, Adjacent party, Neighbor, Border on, Adjoin
antonyms: Stranger, Foreigner, Outsider, Alien, Distant party, Enemy
examples: Our neighbour looks after the house when we travel. India and Nepal are close neighbours. We are taught to love our neighbour as ourselves. Their farm neighbours the river on the eastern side.
sindhiMeaning: ڀرسان رهندڙ ماڻهو، پاڙيسري، ڀرپاسي وارو ملڪ  شهر يا شيءِ، اخلاقي يا مذهبي لحاظ کان ٻيو انسان، ڪنهن شيءِ جي ڀرسان واقع هجڻ
urduMeaning: ساتھ یا قریب رہنے والا شخص، ہمسایہ، ساتھ واقع ملک  شہر یا چیز، اخلاقی یا مذہبی لحاظ سے دوسرا انسان، کسی چیز کے ساتھ متصل ہونا

englishMeaning: A district or area within a town or city, especially one with distinctive characteristics. The people who live near one another in a particular area. The surrounding region or vicinity of a place. An approximate amount or range, as in “in the neighbourhood of”.
synonyms: District, Locality, Area, Vicinity, Quarter, Community, Surroundings, Precinct
antonyms: Distance, Remoteness, Wilderness, Faraway place, Outskirts, Isolation
examples: They moved to a quiet neighbourhood near the park. The whole neighbourhood came out to help. There are three schools in the neighbourhood of the station. The repairs will cost in the neighbourhood of fifty thousand rupees.
sindhiMeaning: شهر جو ڪو علائقو يا محلو خاص ڪري جنهن جي پنهنجي سڃاڻپ هجي، ڀرپاسي ۾ رهندڙ ماڻهو، ڪنهن جاءِ جي آسپاس وارو علائقو، لڳ ڀڳ مقدار يا اندازو، پاڙو
urduMeaning: شہر کا کوئی علاقہ یا محلہ خاص طور پر جس کی اپنی پہچان ہو، آس پاس رہنے والے لوگ، کسی جگہ کے گرد و نواح کا علاقہ، تقریباً مقدار یا اندازہ، پڑوس

englishMeaning: Not one nor the other of two people or things. Used to show that a negative statement applies equally to a second person or thing. Used with nor to link two negative alternatives. Not either of the two options mentioned.
synonyms: Not either, Nor, None of the two, Not one
antonyms: Both, Either, Each, All
examples: Neither answer was completely correct. He speaks neither French nor German. She did not agree, and neither did her brother. Neither of the two applicants had the required experience.
sindhiMeaning: ٻنهي مان ڪوبه نه، نه هي نه هو، ٻي ڳالهه لاءِ به نفي ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ لفظ، نار سان گڏجي ٻن منفي ڳالهين کي ڳنڍيندڙ
urduMeaning: دونوں میں سے کوئی بھی نہیں، نہ یہ نہ وہ، دوسری بات کے لیے بھی نفی ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا لفظ، نار کے ساتھ مل کر دو منفی باتوں کو جوڑنے والا

englishMeaning: The branch of medicine and surgery concerned with the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system. A surgical operation performed on the nervous system, especially the brain. The medical specialty that diagnoses and surgically treats disorders of the nerves, brain, and spine.
synonyms: Brain surgery, Neurological surgery, Cranial surgery, Spinal surgery
antonyms: Non-surgical treatment, Conservative therapy, Medication, Physiotherapy
examples: He underwent neurosurgery to remove a small tumour. The hospital is well known for its advances in neurosurgery. She spent ten years training in neurosurgery. Modern neurosurgery relies heavily on precise imaging technology.
sindhiMeaning: دماغ، ريڙهه جي هڏي ۽ اعصابي نظام جي جراحي، دماغي آپريشن جو شعبو، نسن ۽ دماغ جي بيمارين جو جراحي علاج، طب جي اها شاخ جيڪا اعصابي نظام جي آپريشن سان تعلق رکي
urduMeaning: دماغ، ریڑھ کی ہڈی اور اعصابی نظام کی جراحی، دماغی آپریشن کا شعبہ، اعصاب اور دماغ کی بیماریوں کا جراحی علاج، طب کی وہ شاخ جو اعصابی نظام کے آپریشن سے متعلق ہے

englishMeaning: Suffering from or affected by excessive anxiety, worry, or emotional instability. Behaving in an obsessive, overly sensitive, or irrationally fearful way. Relating to neurosis, a mild mental disorder involving distress but not loss of contact with reality. A person who is habitually anxious or obsessive.
synonyms: Anxious, Obsessive, Nervous, Unstable, Compulsive, Overwrought, Paranoid, Highly strung
antonyms: Calm, Stable, Relaxed, Composed, Balanced, Rational, Easy-going, Untroubled
examples: He becomes neurotic about cleanliness whenever guests are expected. Her neurotic fear of flying kept her from travelling. The film portrays a neurotic writer struggling with deadlines. Being a neurotic, he double-checked every detail of the plan.
sindhiMeaning: حد کان وڌيڪ پريشان يا وهمي، ذهني بي چينيءَ ۾ ورتل، بي جا خوف ۽ وسوسن جو شڪار، اهڙو شخص جيڪو هر وقت فڪرمند رهي، نفسياتي بي آراميءَ سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: حد سے زیادہ پریشان یا وہمی، ذہنی بے چینی میں مبتلا، بلاوجہ خوف اور وسوسوں کا شکار، ایسا شخص جو ہر وقت فکرمند رہے، نفسیاتی بے چینی سے متعلق

englishMeaning: In a way that shows excessive anxiety, worry, or obsessive behaviour. In a manner marked by unreasonable fear or emotional instability. Behaving with nervous, compulsive, or over-sensitive tendencies.
synonyms: Anxiously, Obsessively, Compulsively, Nervously, Fretfully, Hysterically, Restlessly
antonyms: Calmly, Serenely, Coolly, Rationally, Confidently, Placidly, Steadily
examples: He neurotically checked the locks three times before leaving. She worried neurotically about every small mistake at work. The character behaves neurotically whenever he is under pressure. They neurotically rearranged the files again and again.
sindhiMeaning: انتهائي پريشاني ۽ وسوسن واري انداز ۾، بي جا خوف يا ذهني بي چينيءَ سان، وهم ۽ جنون واري نموني، حد کان وڌيڪ حساسيت سان
urduMeaning: انتہائی پریشانی اور وہم کے انداز میں، بلاوجہ خوف یا ذہنی بے چینی کے ساتھ، جنونی اور وسوسوں بھرے طریقے سے، حد سے زیادہ حساسیت کے ساتھ

englishMeaning: A poison or substance that damages, destroys, or impairs the function of nerve tissue. A toxic chemical that acts on the nervous system, often produced by animals, plants, or bacteria. Any agent that interferes with the normal activity of nerves and the brain.
synonyms: Nerve poison, Toxin, Venom, Poison, Toxic agent, Nerve agent
antonyms: Antidote, Antitoxin, Remedy, Cure, Nutrient, Tonic
examples: Snake venom contains a powerful neurotoxin that paralyses the muscles. Long exposure to this metal acts as a neurotoxin in young children. Scientists isolated the neurotoxin to develop an antidote. The bacteria release a neurotoxin that affects breathing.
sindhiMeaning: اهو زهر جيڪو اعصابي نظام کي نقصان پهچائي، دماغ ۽ نسن جي ڪم کي متاثر ڪندڙ زهريلو مادو، سانپ، وڇون يا جراثيمن مان پيدا ٿيندڙ زهر، اعصابن کي تباهه ڪندڙ ڪيميائي مادو
urduMeaning: وہ زہر جو اعصابی نظام کو نقصان پہنچائے، دماغ اور اعصاب کے افعال کو متاثر کرنے والا زہریلا مادہ، سانپ، بچھو یا جراثیم سے پیدا ہونے والا زہر، اعصاب کو تباہ کرنے والا کیمیائی مادہ

englishMeaning: A chemical substance that carries signals from one nerve cell to another across a synapse. A messenger molecule released by neurons to communicate with muscles, glands, or other nerve cells. A brain chemical such as dopamine, serotonin, or acetylcholine that influences mood, movement, and thinking.
synonyms: Chemical messenger, Signalling molecule, Brain chemical, Transmitter substance
antonyms: Neurotoxin, Blocker, Inhibitor, Antagonist
examples: Dopamine is a neurotransmitter linked to pleasure and motivation. Low levels of this neurotransmitter can affect a person's mood. The drug works by blocking a particular neurotransmitter in the brain. Researchers studied how the neurotransmitter travels across the synapse.
sindhiMeaning: اهو ڪيميائي مادو جيڪو هڪ عصبي خليي کان ٻئي تائين پيغام پهچائي، دماغي پيغام رسان مادو، ڊوپامين يا سيروٽونين جهڙو ڪيميائي مواد جيڪو مزاج ۽ سوچ تي اثر انداز ٿئي، نسن ۽ عضون جي وچ ۾ رابطي جو ذريعو
urduMeaning: وہ کیمیائی مادہ جو ایک عصبی خلیے سے دوسرے تک پیغام پہنچاتا ہے، دماغی پیغام رساں مادہ، ڈوپامین یا سیروٹونن جیسا مادہ جو مزاج اور سوچ پر اثر ڈالتا ہے، اعصاب اور عضلات کے درمیان رابطے کا ذریعہ

englishMeaning: Having patterns of thought, behaviour, and brain development that are considered typical or standard. Not having autism or another neurodevelopmental condition. A person whose neurological development follows the common pattern of the general population.
synonyms: Typical, Standard, Ordinary, Non-autistic, Conventional, Normative
antonyms: Neurodivergent, Autistic, Atypical, Neurodiverse, Unconventional
examples: The school welcomes both autistic and neurotypical students. Neurotypical people often misunderstand these sensory difficulties. She explained the idea in a way that neurotypical listeners could relate to. The study compared neurotypical children with those on the spectrum.
sindhiMeaning: اهو شخص جنهن جي دماغي نشوونما ۽ رويو عام معيار مطابق هجي، آٽزم يا ڪنهن ٻي دماغي ترقياتي ڪيفيت کان سواءِ، عام ذهني ساخت رکندڙ، معمول مطابق سوچ ۽ ورتاءُ رکندڙ
urduMeaning: وہ شخص جس کی دماغی نشوونما اور رویہ عام معیار کے مطابق ہو، آٹزم یا کسی اور اعصابی نشوونما کی کیفیت سے پاک، عام ذہنی ساخت رکھنے والا، معمول کے مطابق سوچ اور برتاؤ رکھنے والا

englishMeaning: Not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, or competition. Having no strong opinion, feeling, or bias. Not distinctive or emotionally expressive in tone, colour, or style. In chemistry, neither acidic nor alkaline. In physics, carrying no positive or negative electric charge. The position of gears in which the engine is not connected to the driving wheels.
synonyms: Impartial, Unbiased, Objective, Detached, Indifferent, Non-aligned, Uninvolved, Fair, Colourless, Muted
antonyms: Biased, Partial, Prejudiced, Partisan, Committed, Involved, Opinionated, Vivid, Charged
examples: Switzerland remained neutral throughout the war. She kept her voice neutral so no one could guess her feelings. The room was painted in neutral shades of beige and grey. He put the car in neutral before starting the engine.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبدار، ڪنهن به فريق جي حمايت نه ڪندڙ، ڪنهن راءِ يا تعصب کان آجو، بيرنگ يا هلڪو رنگ جيڪو نمايان نه هجي، ڪيميا ۾ نه تيزابي نه القلي، بجليءَ جي لحاظ کان بي چارج، گاڏيءَ جي گيئر جي اها حالت جنهن ۾ انجڻ ڦيٿن سان ڳنڍيل نه هجي
urduMeaning: غیر جانبدار، کسی فریق کی حمایت نہ کرنے والا، رائے یا تعصب سے پاک، ہلکا یا غیر نمایاں رنگ یا لہجہ، کیمیا میں نہ تیزابی نہ اساسی، برقی اعتبار سے بے بار، گاڑی کے گیئر کی وہ حالت جس میں انجن پہیوں سے جڑا نہ ہو

englishMeaning: A person who supports or follows a policy of neutrality, especially in international politics. Someone who believes a country should not take sides in wars or alliances. Relating to or characteristic of a policy of political neutrality.
synonyms: Non-interventionist, Non-aligned, Isolationist, Pacifist, Impartialist, Fence-sitter
antonyms: Interventionist, Partisan, Ally, Belligerent, Advocate, Supporter, Militarist
examples: The neutralists argued that the country should stay out of the alliance. He was known as a lifelong neutralist in foreign affairs. Neutralist opinion grew stronger as the conflict widened. The party adopted a firmly neutralist position on the war.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبداريءَ جي پاليسيءَ جو حامي شخص، اهو ماڻهو جيڪو سمجهي ٿو ته ملڪ کي جنگين ۾ ڪنهن به طرف نه ٿيڻ گهرجي، غير وابستگيءَ جي سوچ رکندڙ، غير جانبدار پاليسيءَ سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: غیر جانبداری کی پالیسی کا حامی شخص، وہ فرد جو سمجھتا ہے کہ ملک کو جنگوں میں کسی فریق کا ساتھ نہیں دینا چاہیے، غیر وابستگی کے نظریے کا پیروکار، غیر جانبدار پالیسی سے متعلق

englishMeaning: The act or process of making something ineffective or harmless. A chemical reaction in which an acid and a base combine to form a salt and water, producing a neutral solution. The act of counteracting or cancelling out an effect or force. The act of declaring a state or territory politically neutral.
synonyms: Counteraction, Nullification, Cancellation, Offsetting, Deactivation, Negation, Balancing
antonyms: Activation, Intensification, Reinforcement, Aggravation, Strengthening, Escalation
examples: The students observed the neutralization of acid by an alkali. Neutralization of the poison took several hours. The treaty led to the neutralization of the disputed border region. Neutralization reactions always produce a salt and water.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي بي اثر يا بي ضرر بڻائڻ جو عمل، ڪيميا ۾ تيزاب ۽ القليءَ جي ملڻ سان لوڻ ۽ پاڻي ٺهڻ وارو عمل، ڪنهن اثر يا قوت کي ختم ڪرڻ، ڪنهن علائقي کي غير جانبدار قرار ڏيڻ جو عمل
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو بے اثر یا بے ضرر بنانے کا عمل، کیمیا میں تیزاب اور اساس کے ملنے سے نمک اور پانی بننے کا عمل، کسی اثر یا قوت کو زائل کرنے کا عمل، کسی علاقے کو غیر جانبدار قرار دینے کا عمل

englishMeaning: To stop something from having an effect by applying an opposite force or influence. To make a substance chemically neutral, neither acidic nor alkaline. To make an enemy, threat, or opponent harmless, often by disabling or eliminating them. To counteract or cancel out the impact of something. To declare a country or area politically neutral.
synonyms: Counteract, Nullify, Cancel out, Offset, Disable, Counterbalance, Negate, Subdue, Deactivate
antonyms: Intensify, Strengthen, Activate, Aggravate, Reinforce, Provoke, Enhance, Support
examples: Baking soda is often used to neutralize acid in the stomach. The security team moved quickly to neutralize the threat. Tax cuts were introduced to neutralize the effect of rising prices. Their strong defence neutralized the opposing team's best striker.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جو اثر ختم يا بي اثر ڪرڻ، ڪيميائي طور تيزابيت يا القلائيت ختم ڪري متوازن بڻائڻ، ڪنهن دشمن يا خطري کي بي ضرر بڻائڻ، ڪنهن اثر کي رد ڪرڻ يا برابر ڪرڻ، ڪنهن علائقي کي غير جانبدار قرار ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا اثر ختم یا بے اثر کر دینا، کیمیائی طور پر تیزابیت یا اساسیت ختم کر کے متوازن بنانا، کسی دشمن یا خطرے کو بے ضرر بنا دینا، کسی اثر کو زائل یا برابر کر دینا، کسی علاقے کو غیر جانبدار قرار دینا

englishMeaning: In an impartial way that does not favour either side. Without showing emotion, opinion, or bias. In a plain, understated, or non-distinctive manner. In a balanced position that is neither one extreme nor the other.
synonyms: Impartially, Objectively, Fairly, Dispassionately, Evenly, Indifferently, Blandly
antonyms: Partially, Subjectively, Emotionally, Prejudicially, Passionately, Vividly
examples: The reporter described the incident neutrally and without comment. She answered neutrally to avoid offending anyone. The walls were painted neutrally to suit any furniture. He held his face neutrally as the verdict was read out.
sindhiMeaning: غير جانبدارانه انداز ۾، ڪنهن به طرف جي حمايت کان سواءِ، بنا ڪنهن جذبي يا راءِ ظاهر ڪرڻ جي، سادي ۽ غير نمايان نموني، متوازن حالت ۾
urduMeaning: غیر جانبدارانہ انداز میں، کسی فریق کی حمایت کیے بغیر، جذبات یا رائے ظاہر کیے بغیر، سادہ اور غیر نمایاں طریقے سے، متوازن حالت میں

englishMeaning: An extremely small subatomic particle that has almost no mass and carries no electric charge. A fundamental particle produced in nuclear reactions such as those in the sun, which passes through matter almost undisturbed. One of the most abundant particles in the universe, very difficult to detect.
synonyms: Subatomic particle, Elementary particle, Lepton, Fundamental particle
antonyms: Compound, Molecule, Macroscopic body, Composite particle
examples: Billions of neutrinos pass through your body every second. The detector was built deep underground to capture a neutrino. Scientists study the neutrino to understand the sun's core. A neutrino carries no electric charge at all.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ انتهائي ننڍڙو ذيلي ايٽمي ذرو جنهن جو ڪوبه بار ناهي ۽ ماس نه هجڻ برابر آهي، سج ۽ ايٽمي ردعمل مان پيدا ٿيندڙ بنيادي ذرو، اهو ذرو جيڪو مادي مان بنا رڪاوٽ گذري وڃي، ڪائنات جو انتهائي عام پر مشڪل سان پڪڙجندڙ ذرو
urduMeaning: ایک نہایت باریک ذیلی ایٹمی ذرہ جس پر کوئی برقی بار نہیں اور کمیت نہ ہونے کے برابر ہے، سورج اور جوہری تعاملات سے پیدا ہونے والا بنیادی ذرہ، وہ ذرہ جو مادے میں سے بغیر رکاوٹ گزر جاتا ہے، کائنات کا عام مگر مشکل سے قابلِ شناخت ذرہ

englishMeaning: A subatomic particle found in the nucleus of an atom that carries no electric charge. A neutral particle with a mass slightly greater than that of a proton. One of the two main building blocks of the atomic nucleus, alongside the proton, whose number determines the isotope of an element.
synonyms: Nuclear particle, Subatomic particle, Nucleon, Neutral particle
antonyms: Proton, Electron, Ion, Charged particle
examples: A neutron has no electric charge, unlike a proton. The nucleus of this atom contains six protons and eight neutrons. Firing a neutron at uranium can start a chain reaction. Neutron numbers differ between isotopes of the same element.
sindhiMeaning: ايٽم جي مرڪز ۾ موجود اهو ذرو جنهن تي ڪوبه برقي بار ناهي، پروٽان کان ٿورو وڌيڪ وزن رکندڙ غير جانبدار ذرو، ايٽمي مرڪز جو بنيادي جزو، اهو ذرو جنهن جو تعداد عنصر جي آئسوٽوپ کي طئي ڪري
urduMeaning: ایٹم کے مرکزے میں موجود وہ ذرہ جس پر کوئی برقی بار نہیں ہوتا، پروٹون سے قدرے زیادہ کمیت رکھنے والا غیر جانبدار ذرہ، ایٹمی مرکزے کا بنیادی جزو، وہ ذرہ جس کی تعداد عنصر کے آئسوٹوپ کا تعین کرتی ہے

englishMeaning: A type of nuclear weapon designed to release most of its energy as deadly neutron radiation rather than blast and heat. A weapon intended to kill people through radiation while causing relatively little damage to buildings and infrastructure. An enhanced radiation warhead developed during the Cold War era.
synonyms: Enhanced radiation weapon, Nuclear weapon, Radiation bomb, Atomic warhead
antonyms: Conventional weapon, Disarmament, Peace treaty, Non-nuclear arms
examples: The neutron bomb was designed to kill people while leaving buildings standing. Many countries condemned the development of the neutron bomb. A neutron bomb releases intense radiation over a limited area. The treaty aimed to halt production of the neutron bomb.

urduMeaning: فرسودہ، جو اب کارآمد نہ رہا ہو، پرانا اور زمانے سے پیچھے، جس کی مدت ختم ہو چکی ہو، جدید ضروریات سے ہم آہنگ نہ ہونے والا

englishMeaning: A rounded elongated shape like an egg. An ellipse-like figure that is not perfectly circular. A shape that is longer in one direction than the other. An egg-shaped or elliptical form.
synonyms: Elliptical, Egg-shaped, Oblong, Ellipse, Elongated circle, Ovoid
antonyms: Circular, Square, Rectangular, Angular, Triangular

sindhiMeaning: هڪ گول ڊگهو شڪل انڊيءَ وانگر، هڪ بيضوي جهڙو شڪل جيڪو مڪمل گول نه آهي، هڪ شڪل جيڪا هڪ رخ ۾ ٻئي کان ڊگهي آهي، هڪ انڊي جي شڪل وارو يا بيضوي روپ
urduMeaning: ایک گول لمبی شکل انڈے کی طرح، ایک بیضوی جیسی شکل جو مکمل گول نہیں ہے، ایک شکل جو ایک سمت میں دوسری سے لمبی ہے، ایک انڈے کی شکل والا یا بیضوی شکل

englishMeaning: To be under obligation to pay or repay money to someone. To have a duty to give something to someone, especially gratitude or respect. To have something because of a particular reason or cause. To be indebted to someone for help, kindness, or favors received.
