examples: I would love to go to dinner, but I have to take a rain check. Can I take a rain check on our movie night until next Friday? He was too busy to attend the party and asked to take a rain check. She decided to take a rain check on the shopping trip because she felt ill.
sindhiMeaning: وعدو ملتوي ڪرڻ, ٻيهر وقت وٺڻ, معذرت ڪرڻ پر پوءِ ملڻ جو واعدو ڪرڻ, وقت مٽائڻ, ايندڙ وقت لاءِ رکڻ
urduMeaning: معذرت کرنا, التوا میں ڈالنا, اگلی بار کے لیے چھوڑنا, بعد میں ملنے کا وعدہ کرنا, موقع موخر کرنا

englishMeaning: To keep something under control or within limits. To restrain an emotion or a physical force. To prevent something from growing or spreading uncontrollably. To maintain order or balance by limiting an action.
synonyms: Restrain, Curb, Control, Limit, Constrain, Repress, Suppress, Moderate, Master, Govern, Hinder, Checkmate, Contain, Stifle
antonyms: Release, Unleash, Liberate, Encourage, Free, Stimulate, Indulge, Loose
examples: The new regulations are designed to hold inflation in check. You must learn to hold your temper in check during arguments. The dam was built to hold the floodwaters in check. Security guards were stationed to hold the crowd in check.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنٽرول ۾ رکڻ, روڪڻ, ضابطي ۾ آڻڻ, حد ۾ رکڻ, روڪي رکڻ
urduMeaning: قابو میں رکھنا, روکنا, ضبط کرنا, حد میں رکھنا, قابو پانا

englishMeaning: To prevent something from increasing or becoming too great. To maintain constant control over a situation or feeling. To ensure that something stays within manageable bounds. To regulate or monitor something to avoid excess.
synonyms: Regulate, Monitor, Curb, Bridle, Contain, Temper, Subdue, Inhibit, Restrict, Command, Manage, Rule, Check, Oversee
antonyms: Neglect, Disregard, Ignore, Agitate, Excite, Expand, Overlook, Permit
examples: She struggled to keep her laughter in check during the meeting. Natural predators help keep the insect population in check. We need to keep our spending in check this month. Regular exercise helps keep blood pressure in check.
sindhiMeaning: قابو ۾ رکڻ, ضابطو رکڻ, حد اندر رکڻ, نگراني ڪرڻ, روڪڻ
urduMeaning: قابو میں رکھنا, قابو کرنا, روک تھام کرنا, کنٹرول میں رکھنا, اعتدال میں رکھنا

englishMeaning: To become aware of something secret or private. To hear a rumor or gain indirect information about a situation. To discover a hidden plot or clandestine activity. To detect the beginning of a development before it is public.
synonyms: Overhear, Detect, Learn, Discover, Hear, Sense, Uncover, Discern, Find out, Ascertain, Trace, Eavesdrop, Catch, Grasp
antonyms: Ignore, Miss, Overlook, Disregard, Neglect, Misinterpret, Suppress, Conceal
examples: The authorities managed to get wind of the protest before it even started. She didn't want the media to get wind of her secret wedding plans. We need to be careful so that the competitors don't get wind of our new product. Once the neighbors got wind of the scandal, the rumors spread quickly.
sindhiMeaning: سُڻس وٺڻ, پُت وٺڻ, ڳُجھي خبر پوڻ, سُڌ پائڻ, پتو لڳائڻ
urduMeaning: بھنک پڑنا, خبر ملنا, افواہ سننا, سن گن لینا, راز معلوم ہونا

englishMeaning: A formal split or division within a group or organization due to a difference of opinion. A breach of unity in a church or religious body. A profound disagreement that leads to the formation of opposing factions. The state of being divided into two or more separate parties.
synonyms: Division, Split, Rift, Breach, Rupture, Separation, Dissension, Discord, Disconnection, Break, Faction, Partition, Disunity, Severance
antonyms: Unity, Union, Agreement, Harmony, Concord, Alliance, Cohesion, Unification
examples: The political party suffered a major schism after the leadership election. Religious historians study the Great Schism that divided the church. Internal disputes eventually led to a permanent schism within the board of directors. The ideological schism between the two factions seems impossible to bridge.
sindhiMeaning: ڦُٽ, وڇوٽي, گروھ بندي, اختلاف, مذهبي وڇوڙو
urduMeaning: پھوٹ, افتراق, نفاق, تفرقہ, گروہ بندی

englishMeaning: To express one's opinions in a way that is considered annoyingly pompous or dogmatic. To speak or write with an air of superior authority. To perform the duties and functions of a pope or bishop. To deliver a discourse in a self-important or opinionated manner.
synonyms: Declaim, Expound, Dogmatize, Sermonize, Preach, Moralize, Lecture, Orate, Harangue, Pronounce, Spout, Sound off, Pompous, Authority
antonyms: Humble, Listen, Suggest, Propose, Doubt, Whisper, Retract, Acquiesce
examples: He tends to pontificate on subjects he actually knows very little about. The politician began to pontificate about moral values during the interview. No one likes to listen to a colleague pontificate during a casual lunch break. She was known to pontificate at length during every board meeting.
sindhiMeaning: وڏايون ڪرڻ, پاڻ کي وڏو سمجھڻ, اجائي فتويٰ ڏيڻ, وڏا وڏا بيان ڏيڻ, پاپائيت ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: حاکمانہ گفتگو کرنا, شیخی بگھارنا, پاپائی فرائض انجام دینا, بڑائی جتانا, خود پسندی سے بولنا

englishMeaning: Relating to the pope or the high priesthood of the Roman Catholic Church. Characterized by a self-important or pompous manner of expression. Pertaining to the office or dignity of a bishop. Showing an air of infallibility or authoritative solemnity.
synonyms: Papal, Apostolic, Episcopal, Pompous, Dogmatic, Authoritative, Solemn, Stately, Pretentious, Overbearing, Magisterial, Hierarchical, Ecclesiastical, Formal
antonyms: Humble, Modest, Lowly, Secular, Unpretentious, Submissive, Ordinary, Simple
examples: The cardinal arrived at the cathedral wearing his full pontifical vestments. He answered the criticism with a pontifical wave of his hand. The decree was issued with pontifical authority that left no room for debate. We were surprised by the pontifical tone of his recent letter.
sindhiMeaning: پاپائي, مذهبي پيشوا سان لاڳاپيل, وڏائيءَ وارو, بااختيار, عالماڻو
urduMeaning: پاپائی, کلیسائی, متکبرانہ, حاکمانہ, پادری کا

englishMeaning: A structure, plan, or organization that is very weak and likely to collapse. A situation that is extremely unstable and precarious. A metaphor for a fragile arrangement based on unstable foundations. Something that is easily destroyed because it lacks a solid basis.
synonyms: Fragile, Unstable, Precarious, Flimsy, Vulnerable, Insecure, Shaky, Weak, Unsound, Perilous, Temporary, Rickety, Dubious, Unsteady
antonyms: Fortress, Stronghold, Bedrock, Stable, Solid, Secure, Durable, Foundation, Sturdy
examples: Their financial empire turned out to be nothing more than a house of cards. The new government’s coalition proved to be a fragile house of cards. Without proper funding, the entire project is just a house of cards waiting to fall. The legal defense was a house of cards that collapsed under cross-examination.
sindhiMeaning: ڪاغذي گھر, ڪمزور بنياد, بنھ اڻپورو انتظام, نازڪ حالت, واريءَ جي ڀت
urduMeaning: ریت کی دیوار, ناپائیدار منصوبہ, کچی بنیاد کا گھر, نازک صورتحال, کمزور ڈھانچہ

englishMeaning: A metric prefix denoting a factor of one trillion (1012) of the base unit. Used before units such as byte, watt, or hertz to express extremely large quantities. Represented by the symbol T in the International System of Units.
synonyms: Trillion, 1012, T (symbol)
antonyms: Milli, Micro, Nano, Pico, Femto
examples: One terabyte of storage can hold hundreds of hours of video. The new supercomputer performs calculations at terascale speed. Scientists measure the explosion in terajoules of energy. Modern data centers routinely manage several terabytes of information.
sindhiMeaning: ميٽرڪ نظام ۾ اڳواٽ جيڪو بنيادي يونٽ جي هڪ ٽرلين (1012) ڀاڱي کي ظاهر ڪري ٿو، وڏين مقدارن کي ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ بائيٽ واٽ يا هرٽز وغيره جي اڳيان لڳايو وڃي ٿو، انٽرنيشنل سسٽم آف يونٽس ۾ T علامت سان ڏيکاريو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: میٹرک نظام میں سابقہ جو بنیادی یونٹ کے ایک ٹرلین(1012)گنا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، بڑی مقداروں کو دکھانے کے لیے بائٹ واٹ یا ہرٹز وغیرہ کے آگے لگایا جاتا ہے، انٹرنیشنل سسٹم آف یونٹس میں T علامت سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A metric prefix denoting a factor of one quadrillion (1015) of the base unit. Placed before units such as byte or watt to express very large amounts of data or energy. Represented by the symbol P in the International System of Units.
synonyms: Quadrillion, 1015, Exa, Tera
antonyms: Milli, Micro, Nano, Pico
examples: The telescope collects several petabytes of data each year. Global internet traffic is now measured in petabytes per month. A petabyte equals one thousand terabytes. The project archives more than two petabytes of satellite images.
sindhiMeaning: ميٽرڪ نظام ۾ اڳواٽ جيڪو بنيادي يونٽ جي هڪ ڪواڊرلين (1015) ڀاڱي کي ظاهر ڪري ٿو، ڊيٽا يا توانائي جي تمام وڏين مقدارن کي ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ بائيٽ يا واٽ وغيره جي اڳيان لڳايو وڃي ٿو، P علامت سان ڏيکاريو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: میٹرک نظام میں سابقہ جو بنیادی یونٹ کے ایک کواڈریلین (1015) گنا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، ڈیٹا یا توانائی کی بہت بڑی مقداریں دکھانے کے لیے بائٹ یا واٹ وغیرہ کے آگے لگایا جاتا ہے، P علامت سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A metric prefix meaning one quintillion (1018) times the base unit. Used for measuring enormous quantities of data, such as the total digital information in the world. Represented by the symbol E in the International System of Units.
synonyms: Quintillion, 1018, Zetta, Peta
antonyms: Milli, Micro, Nano, Pico
examples: The world's total data is expected to reach hundreds of exabytes soon. An exabyte is one billion gigabytes. Researchers estimate global data creation in exabytes per year. Cloud providers now design systems that scale to exabytes.
sindhiMeaning: ميٽرڪ نظام ۾ اڳواٽ جيڪو بنيادي يونٽ جي هڪ ڪوئنٽلين (1018) ڀاڱي جو مطلب رکي ٿو، سڄي دنيا جي ڊجيٽل معلومات جھڙين غير معمولي وڏين مقدارن کي ماپڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿئي ٿو، E علامت سان ڏيکاريو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: میٹرک نظام میں سابقہ جو بنیادی یونٹ کے ایک کوئنٹلین (1018) گنا کا مطلب رکھتا ہے، پوری دنیا کی ڈیجیٹل معلومات جیسی غیر معمولی بڑی مقداریں ناپنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، E علامت سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A metric prefix denoting a factor of one sextillion (1021) of the base unit. Applied to units like byte to measure planetary-scale amounts of digital information. Represented by the symbol Z in the International System of Units.
synonyms: Sextillion, 1021, Yotta, Exa
antonyms: Milli, Micro, Nano, Pico
examples: By 2030, global data may exceed several zettabytes annually. A zettabyte equals one trillion gigabytes. Storage engineers plan for zettabyte-scale archives. The network can handle zettabytes of traffic over its lifetime.
sindhiMeaning: ميٽرڪ نظام ۾ اڳواٽ جيڪو بنيادي يونٽ جي هڪ سيسٽلين (1021) ڀاڱي کي ظاهر ڪري ٿو، سياري جي سطح جيتري وڏي ڊجيٽل معلومات جي مقدار کي ماپڻ لاءِ بائيٽ وغيره سان لڳايو وڃي ٿو، Z علامت سان ڏيکاريو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: میٹرک نظام میں سابقہ جو بنیادی یونٹ کے ایک سیکسٹلین (1021) گنا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، سیارے کی سطح جتنی بڑی ڈیجیٹل معلومات کی مقدار ناپنے کے لیے بائٹ وغیرہ کے ساتھ لگایا جاتا ہے، Z علامت سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A metric prefix meaning one septillion (1024) times the base unit. The largest prefix in the International System of Units, used for describing astronomical or planetary-scale measurements. Represented by the symbol Y.
synonyms: Septillion, 1024, Zetta
antonyms: Milli, Micro, Nano, Pico
examples: A yottabyte could store the entire contents of millions of data centers. The prefix yotta was added to the SI system in 1991. Astronomers sometimes describe enormous energies in yottajoules. One yottabyte equals one thousand zettabytes.
sindhiMeaning: ميٽرڪ نظام ۾ اڳواٽ جيڪو بنيادي يونٽ جي هڪ سيپٽلين (1024) ڀاڱي جو مطلب رکي ٿو، انٽرنيشنل سسٽم آف يونٽس ۾ سڀ کان وڏو اڳواٽ، فلڪي يا سياري جي سطح جون ماپون بيان ڪرڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿئي ٿو، Y علامت سان ڏيکاريو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: میٹرک نظام میں سابقہ جو بنیادی یونٹ کے ایک سپٹلین (1024) گنا کا مطلب رکھتا ہے، انٹرنیشنل سسٹم آف یونٹس میں سب سے بڑا سابقہ، فلکیاتی یا سیاروی سطح کی پیمائش بیان کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، Y علامت سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A year containing 366 days instead of the usual 365, with an extra day added to February (February 29). A year whose number is divisible by four, except for century years, which must be divisible by 400. Added to the calendar to keep it synchronized with the Earth's orbit around the Sun.
synonyms: Bisextile year, Intercalary year, 366-day year
antonyms: Common year, Non-leap year
examples: February has twenty-nine days in a leap year. People born on February 29 celebrate their birthday once every four years. The year 2024 was a leap year. A leap year keeps our calendar aligned with the seasons.
sindhiMeaning: اھڙو سال جيڪو عام 365 ڏينهن بدران 366 ڏينهن رکي ٿو ۽ فيبروري ۾ هڪ اضافي ڏينهن (29 فيبروري) هوندو آهي، اھڙو سال جنھن جو نمبر چار سان قابل تقسيم هجي، سواءِ صدي جين سالن جي جن کي 400 سان قابل تقسيم ٿيڻ ضروري آهي، ڪئلينڊر کي زمين جي سج جي گرد چڪر سان هم آهنگ رکڻ لاءِ شامل ڪيو ويندو آهي
urduMeaning: ایسا سال جو 365 دنوں کے بجائے 366 دن ہوتے ہیں اور فروری میں ایک اضافی دن (29 فروری) ہوتا ہے، ایسا سال جس کا نمبر چار سے قابل تقسیم ہو، سوائے صدی کے سالوں کے جن کو 400 سے تقسیم ہونا ضروری ہے، کیلنڈر کو زمین کے سورج کے گرد چکر کے ساتھ ہم آہنگ رکھنے کے لیے شامل کیا جاتا ہے

englishMeaning: Extending or spread throughout the entire world. Existing or happening in all parts of the globe. On a global scale; everywhere in the world.
synonyms: Global, International, Universal, Planetary, Pandemic
antonyms: Local, Regional, National, Domestic, Parochial
examples: The company sells its products worldwide. The news of the discovery spread worldwide within hours. Climate change is a worldwide concern. The concert was broadcast live to a worldwide audience.
sindhiMeaning: سڄي دنيا ۾ پکڙيل يا پڌريل، زمين جي سڀني حصن ۾ موجود يا ٿيندڙ، عالمي سطح تي، دنيا جي هر هنڌ
urduMeaning: پوری دنیا میں پھیلا ہوا، زمین کے تمام حصوں میں موجود یا ہونے والا، عالمی سطح پر، دنیا بھر میں

englishMeaning: In a genuine, real, and true manner. In a way that faithfully represents the original or actual source. Sincerely and honestly, without pretending or copying.
synonyms: Genuinely, Truly, Honestly, Sincerely, Really, Legitimately
antonyms: Falsely, Artificially, Insincerely, Deceptively, Dishonestly
examples: The restaurant serves authentically prepared regional dishes. She spoke authentically about her struggles. The museum displays artifacts authentically restored to their original condition. He lived authentically, never pretending to be someone else.
sindhiMeaning: اصل ۽ سچي انداز ۾، حقيقي ماخذ کي وفاداريءَ سان ظاهر ڪندڙ طريقي سان، سچائي ۽ اخلاص سان، بنا بناوت جي
urduMeaning: اصل اور سچے انداز میں، حقیقی ماخذ کی وفاداری سے ظاہر کرنے والے انداز میں، سچائی اور اخلاص سے، بنا بناوٹ کے

englishMeaning: A film director whose individual style, vision, and creative control are so strong that they are regarded as the primary author of the film. An artist with a distinctive personal signature across their body of work.
synonyms: Filmmaker, Director, Cineaste, Visionary, Film author
antonyms: Amateur, Non-creator, Collaborator, Follower
examples: The festival honored him as a great auteur of modern cinema. Critics study her films as the work of a true auteur. Auteur theory argues that the director is the main creative force behind a film. Many consider him the most influential auteur of his generation.
sindhiMeaning: اھڙو فلم ڊائريڪٽر جنھنجي ذاتي انداز وڏي پئماني تي ڏس ۽ تخليقي تسلط ايترو مضبوط هجي جو کيس فلم جو بنيادي خالق سمجهيو وڃي، اھڙو فنڪار جيڪو پنھنجي سڄي ڪم ۾ پنھنجي منفرد نشاني ڏئي ٿو
urduMeaning: ایسا فلم ڈائریکٹر جس کا ذاتی انداز وژن اور تخلیقی تسلط اتنا مضبوط ہو کہ اسے فلم کا بنیادی خالق سمجھا جائے، ایسا فنکار جو اپنی تمام کارکردگی میں اپنی منفرد پہچان چھوڑتا ہو

englishMeaning: To prove or confirm that something is genuine, real, and not a forgery or copy. To verify the identity or origin of a person, document, or object. To establish the authority or validity of something officially.
synonyms: Verify, Validate, Certify, Confirm, Attest, Substantiate, Vouch for, Ratify
antonyms: Forge, Fake, Falsify, Fabricate, Disprove, Reject
examples: Experts were called in to authenticate the ancient painting. The system uses passwords to authenticate users before granting access. Notaries authenticate documents with their official seal. Scientists worked to authenticate the origin of the rare manuscript.
sindhiMeaning: ثابت يا تصديق ڪرڻ ته شيء اصل ۽ سچي آهي نقل يا جعلي ناهي، ڪنھن شخص دستاويز يا شيء جي سڃاڻپ يا ماخذ جي تصديق ڪرڻ، رسمي طور تي ڪنھن شيء جي صحت يا اختيار کي ثابت ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: ثابت یا تصدیق کرنا کہ کوئی چیز اصل اور سچی ہے نقل یا جعلی نہیں، کسی شخص دستاویز یا چیز کی شناخت یا ماخذ کی تصدیق کرنا، سرکاری طور پر کسی چیز کی صحت یا اختیار کو ثابت کرنا

englishMeaning: Not genuine; not being what it claims to be or what it purports to be. Lacking sincerity or originality; fake or copied. Not true to one's own personality, spirit, or values.
synonyms: Fake, False, Counterfeit, Bogus, Fraudulent, Phony, Imitation, Sham
antonyms: Authentic, Genuine, Real, Original, Sincere, True
examples: The museum removed the inauthentic sculpture from display. Critics dismissed the speech as inauthentic and staged. She felt inauthentic pretending to agree with the decision. Inauthentic documents were used to support the false claim.
sindhiMeaning: جيڪو اصل ناهي، جيڪو ٿي هجڻ جو دعويٰ ڪري سو ناهي، اخلاص يا اصليت کان خالي، نقلي يا جعلي، پنھنجي شخصيت روح يا قدرن جي وفادار ناهي
urduMeaning: جو اصل نہیں، جو ہونے کا دعویٰ کرتا ہے وہ نہیں، اخلاص یا اصالت سے خالی، نقلی یا جعلی، اپنی شخصیت روح یا اقدار سے وفادار نہیں

englishMeaning: A small, flat, sweet baked food made from flour, sugar, and butter, often with added chips, nuts, or dried fruit. A small piece of data stored on a user's computer by a web browser to remember information about the user. A person of a specified kind (informal).
synonyms: Biscuit, Baked good, Treat, Snack, Tracker (computing), Data file
antonyms: No Antonym
examples: She baked a batch of chocolate chip cookies for the children. The website stores a cookie on your browser to remember your login details. He is one tough cookie who never gives up under pressure. Please accept cookies to continue browsing the site.
sindhiMeaning: ننڍي چپٽي مٺي پڪي کاڌي جيڪا اٽي چيني ۽ مکڻ مان بڻجي ٿي ۽ گهڻو ڪري چپس ميوا يا خشڪ ميوا شامل هوندا آهن، ويب برائوزر ذريعي صارف جي ڪمپيوٽر تي محفوظ ٿيندڙ ننڍڙي ڊيٽا جي ٽڪڙي جيڪا صارف بابت معلومات ياد رکي ٿي، مخصوص قسم جو ڄڻو (ادبي)
urduMeaning: چھوٹی چپٹی میٹھی پکی خوراک جو آٹے چینی اور مکھن سے بنتی ہے اور اکثر چپس میوہ یا خشک میوہ شامل ہوتے ہیں، ویب براؤزر کے ذریعے صارف کے کمپیوٹر پر محفوظ ہونے والی چھوٹی ڈیٹا کی ٹکڑی جو صارف کے بارے میں معلومات یاد رکھتی ہے، مخصوص قسم کا شخص (ادبی)

englishMeaning: A unit for measuring the power of engines, equal to about 746 watts or 550 foot-pounds of work per second. The rate at which work is done or energy is transferred, originally defined by comparing engines to the work of horses.
synonyms: Engine power, Mechanical power, Output, Wattage, HP
antonyms: Powerlessness, Weakness, Impotence, Low power
examples: The sports car has an engine with over four hundred horsepower. One horsepower equals approximately 746 watts. Farmers once measured tractors in horsepower to compare them with horses. The motor delivers enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
sindhiMeaning: انجڻن جي طاقت ماپڻ جو يونٽ، جيڪو تقريبن 746 واٽ يا سيڪنڊ ۾ 550 فوٽ پائونڊ ڪم جي برابر آهي، ڪم ڪرڻ يا توانائي منتقل ڪرڻ جي رفتار، جنھن کي شروعات ۾ انجڻن جي ڪم کي گهوڙن سان ڀيٽي وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: انجنوں کی طاقت ناپنے کا یونٹ، جو تقریباً 746 واٹ یا سیکنڈ میں 550 فٹ پاؤنڈ کام کے برابر ہے، کام کرنے یا توانائی منتقل کرنے کی رفتار، جسے شروع میں انجنوں کے کام کو گھوڑوں سے تشبیہ دی جاتی تھی

englishMeaning: To make something smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance. To bring someone or something to a lower or weaker state or condition. To change something into a simpler or different form. To lessen the price of something. To lose weight by dieting. In chemistry, to remove oxygen from or add electrons to a substance. To boil a liquid so that it becomes thicker and more concentrated.
synonyms: Decrease, Lessen, Diminish, Lower, Cut, Minimize, Curtail, Shrink, Mitigate, Abate
antonyms: Increase, Raise, Enlarge, Expand, Amplify, Augment, Boost, Intensify, Grow
examples: The new measures aim to reduce traffic in the city center. Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease. The shop decided to reduce prices before the holidays. She is trying to reduce her sugar intake. Heat the sauce gently to reduce it until thick.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنھن شيء کي سائيز مقدار درجه يا اهميت ۾ گهٽ ڪرڻ، ڪنھن کي گهٽ يا ڪمزور حالت ۾ آڻڻ، ڪنھن شيء کي سادي يا مختلف شڪل ۾ تبديل ڪرڻ، قيمت گهٽ ڪرڻ، خوراڪ جي ذريعي وزن گھٽائڻ، ڪيمسٽريءَ ۾ مادن مان آڪسيجن هٽائڻ يا اليڪٽران شامل ڪرڻ، مائع کي اباليندي ڳڙهو ۽ هضيم ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو سائز مقدار درجہ یا اہمیت میں کم کرنا، کسی کو کم یا کمزور حالت میں لانا، کسی چیز کو سادہ یا مختلف شکل میں تبدیل کرنا، قیمت کم کرنا، خوراک کے ذریعے وزن گھٹانا، کیمسٹری میں مادوں سے آکسیجن ہٹانا یا الیکٹران شامل کرنا، مائع کو ابال کر گھنا اور مرکز بنانا

englishMeaning: Having the capacity or quality of an agent; able to act independently and make choices. Exercising control over one's own actions and decisions. In modern usage, describes artificial intelligence systems that can plan and act toward goals autonomously.
synonyms: Autonomous, Self-directed, Proactive, Independent, Empowered, Self-governing
antonyms: Passive, Dependent, Submissive, Helpless, Reactive, Obedient
examples: The research focuses on building more agentic AI systems. Children become more agentic as they learn to make their own choices. An agentic approach gives employees real control over their work. The new framework supports agentic behavior in language models.
sindhiMeaning: ايجنٽ واري صلاحيت يا خاصيت رکندڙ، خودمختار انداز ۾ عمل ڪرڻ ۽ چونڊ ڪرڻ جي قابل، پنھنجي عملن ۽ فيصلن تي قبضو رکندڙ، جديد استعمال ۾ انهن AI سسٽمن کي بيان ڪري ٿو جيڪي مقصدن ڏانهن خودڪار طريقي سان منصوبه بندي ۽ عمل ڪن ٿا
urduMeaning: ایجنٹ والی صلاحیت یا خصوصیت رکھنے والا، خودمختیار انداز میں عمل کرنے اور انتخاب کرنے کے قابل، اپنے عملوں اور فیصلوں پر قابو رکھنے والا، جدید استعمال میں ان AI سسٹمز کو بیان کرتا ہے جو مقاصد کی طرف خودکار طریقے سے منصوبہ بندی اور عمل کرتے ہیں

englishMeaning: Past tense and past participle of zero: set or adjusted to zero. Brought a value or reading to zero. Aimed or directed precisely at a target.
synonyms: Reset, Calibrated, Adjusted, Balanced, Nullified, Cleared
antonyms: Maximized, Increased, Raised, Boosted
examples: The technician zeroed all the gauges before the experiment started. Once the meter was zeroed, the measurements matched perfectly. The account was zeroed after the final payment. The gun was zeroed at a distance of one hundred meters.
sindhiMeaning: صفر ڪرڻ جي ماضي جي صورت، صفر تي رکيل يا ترتيب ڏنل، قدر يا پڙهڻ صفر تي آندل، نشاني ڏانهن صحيح هدف ڏنل
urduMeaning: صفر کرنے کی ماضی کی صورت، صفر پر رکھا ہوا یا ترتیب دیا ہوا، قدر یا پڑھائ صفر پر لائی گئی، نشانے کی طرف صحیح نشانہ دیا گیا

englishMeaning: Focused attention or aim precisely on a target. Having narrowed down to the exact person, thing, or answer. Adjusted sights or instruments so they point accurately.
synonyms: Focused on, Targeted, Pinpointed, Homed in on, Locked onto, Narrowed down to
antonyms: Ignored, Overlooked, Missed, Dismissed, Lost track of
examples: The police have zeroed in on two possible suspects. Once she zeroed in on the problem, the fix was easy. The camera zeroed in on the speaker's face. Scientists have zeroed in on the gene responsible for the condition.
sindhiMeaning: نشاني يا هدف تي ڌيان يا نشانو بالڪل صحيح لڳايل، مخصوص شخص شيء يا جواب تي تنگ ڪيل، هٿيار يا اوزار ترتيب ڏنل ته صحيح نشانو لڳي
urduMeaning: نشانے یا ہدف پر توجہ یا نشانہ بالکل صحیح لگایا ہوا، مخصوص شخص چیز یا جواب پر تنگ کیا ہوا، ہتھیار یا اوزار ترتیب دیا ہوا تاکہ صحیح نشانہ لگے

englishMeaning: The process of focusing steadily and closely on a specific target, goal, or detail. Concentrating resources or attention on one particular thing. Progressively narrowing a search or investigation toward the exact answer.
synonyms: Focusing on, Concentrating on, Homing in on, Closing in on, Targeting, Pinpointing
antonyms: Ignoring, Overlooking, Diverting from, Missing, Avoiding
examples: Investigators are zeroing in on the source of the leak. The company is zeroing in on quality instead of quantity. She kept zeroing in on the smallest details of the design. The missile is zeroing in on its target.
sindhiMeaning: مخصوص هدف مقصد يا تفصيل تي پوري توجہ ڏيڻ جي عمل، وسيلن يا ڌيان کي هڪ خاص شيء تي مرڪوز ڪرڻ، ڳولا يا تحقيق کي تدريجي صحيح جواب ڏانهن تنگ ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: مخصوص ہدف مقصد یا تفصیل پر پوری توجہ دینے کا عمل، وسائل یا توجہ کو ایک خاص چیز پر مرکوز کرنا، تلاش یا تحقیق کو بتدریج صحیح جواب کی طرف تنگ کرنا

englishMeaning: To direct one's attention, efforts, or resources precisely toward a specific target or goal. To adjust a device or weapon so that it aims accurately. To move steadily closer to a target or objective. Often written as a compound or brand-style spelling of the phrase "zero in".
synonyms: Focus, Target, Home in, Close in, Zero in, Concentrate, Pinpoint, Aim
antonyms: Distract, Divert, Drift, Ignore, Overlook, Scatter
examples: The team needs to zero in on the most urgent issues first. The app helps users zero in on the best deals nearby. After calibrating, the telescope zeroed in on the distant star. We should zero in our marketing on younger audiences.
sindhiMeaning: پنھنجي توجھ ڪوشش يا وسيلن کي مخصوص هدف ڏانهن بالڪل رخ ڏيڻ، ڊوائيس يا هٿيار ترتيب ڏيڻ ته صحيح نشانو لڳي، هدف يا مقصد ڏانهن مسلسل ويجهو وڃڻ، گهڻو ڪري زيرو ان جملي جي ڏنل صورت طور لکيو وڃي ٿو
urduMeaning: اپنی توجہ کوشش یا وسائل کو مخصوص ہدف کی طرف بالکل رخ دینا، ڈیوائس یا ہتھیار ترتیب دینا تاکہ صحیح نشانہ لگے، ہدف یا مقصد کی طرف مسلسل قریب جانا، اکثر زیرو ان جملے کی دی گئی صورت کے طور پر لکھا جاتا ہے

englishMeaning: To serve or support a worthy purpose, principle, or aim that benefits others. To be engaged in an effort that is morally right or socially beneficial. To justify an action because it supports a noble objective.
synonyms: Serve a noble purpose, Support a worthy aim, Advance a good cause, Champion a principle
antonyms: Serve a bad cause, Pursue an unworthy aim, Harm others
examples: Working to educate poor children is to be in a good cause. He gave up his weekends because he knew he was in a good cause. She felt proud to be in a good cause that helped the elderly. Volunteers joined the project, knowing they were in a good cause.
sindhiMeaning: قابل قدر مقصد اصول يا هدف جي خدمت يا حمايت ڪرڻ، اهڙي ڪوشش ۾ شامل هجڻ جيڪا اخلاقي طور صحيح يا سماجي فائدي واري هجي، عمل کي ان ڪري درست سمجهڻ جو اهو بلند مقصد جي حمايت ڪري ٿو
urduMeaning: قابل قدر مقصد اصول یا ہدف کی خدمت یا حمایت کرنا، ایسی کوشش میں شامل ہونہ جو اخلاقی طور پر درست یا سماجی فائدے والی ہو، عمل کو اس لیے درست سمجھنا کیونکہ وہ بلند مقصد کی حمایت کرتا ہے

englishMeaning: In support of a purpose that is helpful, charitable, or morally right. Done to raise money or awareness for people in need or for society's benefit. Justified by the worthy objective it serves.
synonyms: For charity, For a noble purpose, For a worthy cause, In the public interest, For humanitarian ends
antonyms: For selfish ends, For a bad cause, For personal gain, For a corrupt purpose
examples: They organized a charity run for a good cause. Donating to the flood relief fund is money spent for a good cause. The concert was held for a good cause, raising funds for the hospital. She volunteers every weekend for a good cause.
sindhiMeaning: مددگار خيراتي يا اخلاقي طور صحيح مقصد جي حمايت ۾، ضرورت مندن يا سماج جي فائدي لاءِ پيسا يا آگاهي گڏ ڪرڻ لاءِ ڪيل، قابل قدر مقصد جي ڪري درست
urduMeaning: مددگار خیراتی یا اخلاقی طور پر درست مقصد کی حمایت میں، ضرورت مندوں یا سماج کے فائدے کے لیے پیسے یا آگہی جمع کرنے کے لیے کیا گیا، قابل قدر مقصد کی وجہ سے درست

englishMeaning: In support, defense, or furtherance of a particular idea, aim, or principle. For the sake of achieving or protecting something. As part of the effort on behalf of a goal.
synonyms: In support of, In defense of, In the interest of, For the sake of, On behalf of
antonyms: Against, In opposition to, In defiance of, Contrary to
examples: Many scientists risked their lives in the cause of medical research. He worked tirelessly in the cause of freedom and justice. She donated generously in the cause of education. They united in the cause of environmental protection.
sindhiMeaning: مخصوص خيال هدف يا اصول جي حمايت دفاع يا واڌاري ۾، ڪنھن شيء حاصل يا بچائڻ لاءِ، مقصد جي طرفان ڪيل ڪوشش جو حصو
urduMeaning: مخصوص خیال مقصد یا اصول کی حمایت دفاع یا آگے بڑھانے میں، کسی چیز کو حاصل یا بچانے کے لیے، مقصد کی طرف سے کی گئی کوشش کا حصہ

englishMeaning: The sound or movement of liquid striking or being scattered. A small quantity of liquid that falls or is thrown onto something. A striking, noticeable display or effect. To scatter liquid on a surface. To move through water noisily.
synonyms: Spatter, Splatter, Spray, Plop, Dash, Swash, Stir, Sensation, Impact
antonyms: Trickle, Drip, Stillness, Calm, Silence, Bore
examples: The stone fell into the river with a loud splash. She added a splash of milk to her coffee. The new product made a splash in the tech market. Children love to splash water at each other in the pool. Rain splashed against the window all night.
sindhiMeaning: مائع جي لڳڻ يا ٿرڻ جي آواز يا حرڪت، ڪنھن شيء تي ڪري يا اڇلائجي ويل مائع جي ننڍي مقدار، ڏسڻ ۾ اچڻ وارو نمايان مظاهرو يا اثر، مائع کي سطح تي ٿرڻ، پاڻيءَ ۾ شور سان هلڻ
urduMeaning: مائع کے لگنے یا چھڑکنے کی آواز یا حرکت، کسی چیز پر گری یا اچھالی گئی مائع کی چھوٹی مقدار، دکھنے میں آنے والا نمایاں مظاہرہ یا اثر، مائع کو سطح پر چھڑکنا، پانی میں شور سے چلنا

englishMeaning: To unite or join with a person or group in order to achieve a shared aim. To cooperate with someone toward a common goal or against a common opponent. To form an alliance for a mutual purpose.
synonyms: Unite with, Ally with, Join forces with, Team up with, Cooperate with, Side with, Band together
antonyms: Oppose, Fight against, Compete with, Break with, Betray
examples: Several small parties made common cause with the opposition. The two rivals made common cause to defeat a stronger competitor. Environmental groups made common cause with local farmers. During the crisis, neighbors made common cause to protect their community.
sindhiMeaning: گڏيل مقصد حاصل ڪرڻ لاءِ ڪنھن شخص يا گروهه سان هٿ ملائڻ، گڏيل هدف يا گڏيل مخالف ڏانهن ڪنھن سان تعاون ڪرڻ، گڏيل مقصد لاءِ اتحاد ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: مشترکہ مقصد حاصل کرنے کے لیے کسی شخص یا گروہ سے ہاتھ ملانا، مشترکہ ہدف یا مشترکہ مخالف کے لیے کسی سے تعاون کرنا، مشترکہ مقصد کے لیے اتحاد کرنا

englishMeaning: To attract a great deal of attention or public notice. To make a strong, impressive first appearance or debut. To create excitement or a strong impression quickly.
synonyms: Create a sensation, Attract attention, Cause a stir, Make an impact, Make waves, Hit the headlines
antonyms: Go unnoticed, Pass unnoticed, Fade into obscurity, Make no impression
examples: The young singer made a splash with her very first album. The startup made a splash at the technology fair. His controversial speech made a splash in the media. The new restaurant made a splash with its grand opening.
sindhiMeaning: تمام ڳڻتي يا عوامي ڌيان کي ڇڪي وٺڻ، تڪڙو مضبوط يا ڏسڻ ۾ اچڻ وارو پهريون ظهور ڪرڻ، جلدي جوش يا مضبوط تاثر پيدا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: بہت زیادہ توجہ یا عوامی توجہ کو اپنی طرف کھینچنا، تیز مضبوط یا دکھنے میں آنے والا پہلا ظہور کرنا، جلدی جوش یا مضبوط تاثر پیدا کرنا

englishMeaning: To create a strong public reaction or stir. To produce a noticeable and often controversial effect. To make something that draws widespread attention.
synonyms: Create a stir, Cause a sensation, Make waves, Stir up attention, Spark controversy, Make headlines
antonyms: Pass unnoticed, Cause no reaction, Go quietly, Be ignored
examples: The unexpected announcement caused a splash in the industry. Her bold design caused a splash at the fashion show. The report caused a splash by revealing hidden corruption. The celebrity's visit caused a splash in the small town.
sindhiMeaning: مضبوط عوامي ردعمل يا هلچل پيدا ڪرڻ، ڏسڻ ۾ اچڻ وارو ۽ گهڻو ڪري متنازع اثر پيدا ڪرڻ، اهڙي شيء پيدا ڪرڻ جيڪا وڏي ڌيان کي ڇڪي وٺي
urduMeaning: مضبوط عوامی ردعمل یا ہلچل پیدا کرنا، دکھنے میں آنے والا اور اکثر متنازع اثر پیدا کرنا، ایسی چیز پیدا کرنا جو بڑی توجہ کو اپنی طرف کھینچے

englishMeaning: A person who makes a humble and earnest request, especially in prayer. One who pleads or begs for help, mercy, or favor from a higher authority. A petitioner who approaches with deep humility.
synonyms: Petitioner, Pleader, Beggar, Suitor, Solicitor, Requester, Beseecher
antonyms: Demander, Commander, Ruler, Authority, Dictator
examples: The supplicants knelt before the temple altar. A long line of supplicants waited outside the governor's office. The king listened patiently to every supplicant. She approached the committee as a humble supplicant, not a demander.
sindhiMeaning: عاجزيءَ سان مدد، رحم  ٻاجهه يا ڪا شيءِ گهرندڙ شخص، جيڪو ڪنهن ٻئي شخص  بااختيار اداري يا اعليٰ هستيءَ کان عاجزي  نماڻائي ۽ سچي دل سان مدد  رحم  ٻاجهه  معافي يا ڪا خاص شيءِ گهري، اهڙي شخص جي درخواست ۾ اڪثر بي وسيم ضرورت  اميد ۽ ڪنهن ٻئي جي مهربانيءَ تي ڀاڙڻ جو احساس شامل هوندو آهي، اهو لفظ خاص طور تي مذهبي  رسمي  ادبي ۽ جذباتي حالتن ۾ استعمال ٿيندو آهي
urduMeaning: ایسا شخص جو نرمی سے اخلاص والی درخواست کرتا ہے  خاص طور پر دعا میں، ایسا شخص جو بڑے اختیار والے سے مدد رحم یا رعایت کے لیے التجا کرتا ہے، گہری تواضع سے آنے والا درخواست گزار

englishMeaning: Serving to supply or make up for a deficiency. In linguistics, describing forms that come from a different root than the base word, such as "went" as the past tense of "go". Related to or functioning as a supplement.
synonyms: Supplementary, Supplemental, Substitutive, Complementary, Replacement, Filling
antonyms: Basic, Fundamental, Primary, Original, Root-derived
examples: The language uses suppletive forms for several common verbs. "Worse" is a suppletive comparative form of "bad". Suppletive allomorphs cannot be derived by regular rules. The committee played a suppletive role in funding the project.
sindhiMeaning: ڪمي پوري ڪرڻ يا ڀرڻ لاءِ خدمت ڪندڙ، لسانيات ۾ اهڙين صورتن کي بيان ڪندڙ جيڪي بنيادي لفظ کان مختلف جڙ مان اچن جھڙوڪ وينٽ جو گو جي ماضي واري صورت بڻجي، ضمني يا تڪميلي طور تي ڪم ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: کمی پوری کرنے یا بھرنے کے لیے خدمت کرنے والا، لسانیات میں ایسی صورتوں کو بیان کرنے والا جو بنیادی لفظ سے مختلف جڑ سے آئیں جیسے وینٹ کا گو کے ماضی کے طور پر، ضمنی یا تکمیلی طور پر کام کرنے والا

englishMeaning: The phenomenon in language where a regular word form is replaced by a completely different word from another root. The use of unrelated forms to fill gaps in a paradigm, such as "go" and "went" or "good" and "better". The act of supplying something to fill a lack.
synonyms: Replacement, Substitution, Irregular inflection, Form replacement, Suppletive formation
antonyms: Regular inflection, Rule-based formation, Patterning
examples: The pair "go" and "went" is a classic example of suppletion. Suppletion makes some verb paradigms irregular in English. Linguists study suppletion to understand how languages evolve. There is suppletion between "good," "better," and "best".
sindhiMeaning: ٻوليءَ ۾ اھو مظھر جتي باقاعده لفظي صورت مڪمل مختلف جڙ جي لفظ سان تبديل ٿي وڃي، هم معنيٰ صورتن جي استعمال سان پيٽرن ۾ خالي جاءِ ڀرڻ جهڙوڪ گو ۽ وينٽ يا گڊ ۽ بيٽر، ڪمي پوري ڪرڻ لاءِ ڪجهه فراهم ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: زبان میں وہ مظہر جہاں باقاعدہ لفظی صورت مکمل مختلف جڑ کے لفظ سے تبدیل ہو جائے، ہم معنی صورتوں کے استعمال سے پیٹرن میں خالی جگہ بھرنا جیسے گو اور وینٹ یا گڈ اور بیٹر، کمی پوری کرنے کے لیے کچھ فراہم کرنا

englishMeaning: To beg or ask someone earnestly and urgently to do something. To ask, beg, or plead with someone in a very earnest, emotional, and urgent way. It is used when a person desperately wants someone to do something, stop doing something, or grant a request. It often expresses strong feelings such as fear, desperation, sorrow, concern, or deep hope. The word is stronger than simply asking or requesting because it conveys a sense of urgency and emotional appeal.
synonyms: Beg, Beseech, Plead, Entreat, Supplicate, Crave, Importune, Adjure, Appeal to
antonyms: Demand, Command, Order, Insist, Dictate, Threaten
examples: The prisoner implored the judge for mercy. "Please don't go," she implored him. Doctors implore people to stop smoking. He implored his parents to forgive him.
sindhiMeaning: منٿ ڪرڻ، التجا ڪرڻ، عاجزيءَ سان عرض ڪرڻ، زور ڀري درخواست ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي انتهائي عاجزي  منٿ  التجا ۽ دلي تڙپ سان ڪنهن ڪم ڪرڻ يا نه ڪرڻ لاءِ عرض ڪرڻ، جڏهن ڪو ماڻهو ڪنهن کان تمام گهڻي اميد  پريشاني  خوف يا ڏک جي حالت ۾ ڪا ڳالهه مڃرائڻ لاءِ بار بار يا شدت سان درخواست ڪري ته ان لاءِ هي لفظ استعمال ٿيندو آهي
urduMeaning: گڑگڑانا، عاجزی سے درخواست کرنا، التجا کرنا، منت سماجت کرنا، کسی سے نہایت عاجزی  بے بسی  درد مندی اور شدتِ جذبات کے ساتھ کسی کام کو کرنے یا نہ کرنے کی درخواست کرنا، جب کوئی شخص کسی سے کسی بات کو منوانے  مدد حاصل کرنے یا کسی عمل سے روکنے کے لیے انتہائی بے قراری اور التجا کے ساتھ درخواست کرے تو اس لفظ کا استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

englishMeaning: To ask someone earnestly and anxiously to do something. To make an urgent, heartfelt request or plea. To beg with politeness and deep feeling.
synonyms: Beg, Beseech, Implore, Plead, Supplicate, Request earnestly, Urge, Appeal
antonyms: Demand, Order, Command, Compel, Force, Dictate
examples: She entreated her brother to stay a little longer. The villagers entreated the soldiers to spare their homes. He entreated them to believe his story. "Help us," the refugees entreated the border guards.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي منٿ ڪرڻ، التجا ڪرڻ  يا ڪنهن ڪم ڪرڻ لاءِ دل سان گذارش ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ماڻهوءَ کي ڪنهن ڪم ڪرڻ لاءِ نهايت خلوص  عاجزي ۽ سنجيدگيءَ سان درخواست ڪرڻ، منٿ ڪرڻ يا التجا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو اخلاص اور فکر سے کچھ کرنے کے لیے پوچھنا، تیز اور دل سے درخواست یا التجا کرنا، ادب اور گہرے احساس سے التجا کرنا

englishMeaning: In a serious, sincere, and determined manner. With genuine effort and deep conviction. In a way that shows strong feeling or commitment.
synonyms: Seriously, Sincerely, Genuinely, Honestly, Fervently, Zealously, Heartily, Keenly
antonyms: Casually, Insincerely, Frivolously, Lightly, Indifferently, Halfheartedly
examples: She earnestly believes that education can change lives. He spoke earnestly about the need for reform. The volunteers worked earnestly to finish the project on time. I earnestly hope that peace will return to the region.
sindhiMeaning: سنجيده اخلاص ۽ عزم واري انداز ۾، حقيقي ڪوشش ۽ گهري يقين سان، مضبوط احساس يا عهد ڏيکاريندڙ طريقي سان
urduMeaning: سنجیدہ اخلاص اور عزم والے انداز میں، حقیقی کوشش اور گہرے یقین سے، مضبوط احساس یا عہد دکھانے والے طریقے سے

englishMeaning: The quality of being serious, sincere, and deeply committed. An attitude of genuine dedication and honest effort. Intense conviction and wholehearted devotion to a purpose.
synonyms: Sincerity, Seriousness, Gravity, Zeal, Fervor, Dedication, Commitment, Devotion, Eagerness
antonyms: Insincerity, Frivolity, Indifference, Apathy, Casualness, Flippancy
examples: Her earnestness impressed everyone at the interview. He spoke with such earnestness that no one doubted his words. The earnestness of the students showed in their work. I admired the earnestness with which he pursued his goals.
sindhiMeaning: سنجيدگي/ خلوص، سچائي، دل جي گهراين سان وابستگي, ڪنهن ڪم ڳالهه  مقصد يا ذميواريءَ ڏانهن سچي دل سان سنجيدگي، خلوص ۽ پوري نيت سان ڌيان ڏيڻ جي خوبي, اهڙي ڪيفيت جنهن ۾ ماڻهو بنا ڪنهن ڏيکاءَ جي پنهنجي ڳالهه يا ڪم کي اهميت ڏئي ۽ ان کي پورو ڪرڻ لاءِ سچي دل سان ڪوشش ڪري
urduMeaning: سنجیدگی اخلاص اور گہرے عہد والی معیار، حقیقی لگاؤ اور سچی کوشش کا رویہ، مضبوط یقین اور مقصد کے لیے پوری دل کی وابستگی

englishMeaning: An earnest or humble request; a plea. A serious appeal made with deep feeling. An act of begging or pleading for help or favor.
synonyms: Plea, Appeal, Petition, Request, Supplication, Prayer, Solicitation, Suit
antonyms: Demand, Order, Command, Ultimatum, Dictate, Requirement
examples: She ignored his tearful entreaties to stay. The prisoner's entreaty for mercy moved the court. At his mother's entreaty, he agreed to visit home. The letter was a desperate entreaty for help.
sindhiMeaning: اخلاص يا نمريءَ واري درخواست، التجا، گهري احساس سان ڪيل سنجيده اپيل، مدد يا رعايت لاءِ ڳوڙها ڳالھ يا التجا
urduMeaning: اخلاص یا نرمی والی درخواست، التجا، گہرے احساس سے کی گئی سنجیدہ اپیل، مدد یا رعایت کے لیے التجا

englishMeaning: To catch someone or something in a trap. To trick someone into a difficult or illegal situation, often by deception. To lure into a position from which escape is difficult.
synonyms: Trap, Snare, Ensnare, Catch, Lure, Deceive, Trick, Ambush, Enmesh, Corner
antonyms: Free, Liberate, Release, Rescue, Let go, Disentangle, Exonerate
examples: The hunters used nets to entrap the birds. The undercover agent tried to entrap him into selling stolen goods. She felt entrapped in a loveless marriage. The scheme was designed to entrap innocent investors.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنھن کي ٺاهه ۾ ڦاسائڻ، فريب سان ڪنھن کي مشڪل يا غير قانوني صورت ۾ ورائڻ، اهڙي جاءِ تي ڇڪي آڻڻ جتان بچڻ ڏکيو هجي
urduMeaning: کسی کو جال میں پھنسانا، فریب سے کسی کو مشکل یا غیر قانونی صورت میں پھنسانا، ایسی جگہ پر کھینچ لانا جہاں سے بچنا مشکل ہو

englishMeaning: The act of entrapping or the state of being entrapped. In law, the action of tricking someone into committing a crime so that they can be prosecuted. A situation in which someone is caught or confined against their will.
synonyms: Trapping, Snaring, Ensnarement, Deception, Ambush, Framing, Setup, Incrimination
antonyms: Liberation, Freedom, Release, Exoneration, Rescue, Fair play
examples: The court dismissed the case, ruling it was entrapment. He claimed police entrapment and refused to accept guilt. The narrow cave became a deadly entrapment for the climbers. Entrapment by false promises ruined many families.
sindhiMeaning: ٺاهه ۾ ڦاسائڻ يا ڦاسجي وڃڻ جو عمل، قانون ۾ ڪنھن کي فريب ڏيئي ڏوهه ڪرائڻ جو عمل تانجو کيس سزا ڏيي سگهجي، اهڙي صورت جتي ڪو بي اختيار ڦاسيل يا بند هجي
urduMeaning: جال میں پھنسانے یا پھنس جانے کا عمل، قانون میں کسی کو فریب دے کر جرم کروانے کا عمل تاکہ اسے سزا دی جا سکے، ایسی صورت جہاں کوئی بے اختیار پھنسا یا بند ہو

englishMeaning: The act of digging trenches for defense. The process by which an attitude, habit, or system becomes firmly established and difficult to change. Something that protects or strengthens a position.
synonyms: Establishment, Consolidation, Fortification, Embedding, Fixation, Institutionalization
antonyms: Removal, Dislodgment, Weakening, Abandonment, Abolition, Displacement
examples: The entrenchment of old habits makes reform difficult. Winter brought the entrenchment of troops along the border. The entrenchment of corruption weakened the institutions. Continuous conflict led to the entrenchment of both sides.
sindhiMeaning: دفاع لاءِ خندقون کٽڻ جو عمل، اھو عمل جنهن ۾ رويو عادت يا نظام مضبوطيءَ سان قائم ٿي وڃي ۽ تبديل ڪرڻ ڏکيو ٿي وڃي، اھڙي شيء جيڪا مقام کي بچائي يا مضبوط ڪري
urduMeaning: دفاع کے لیے خندقیں کھودنے کا عمل، وہ عمل جس میں رویہ عادت یا نظام مضبوطی سے قائم ہو جائے اور تبدیل کرنا مشکل ہو جائے، ایسی چیز جو مقام کو بچائے یا مضبوط کرے

englishMeaning: Suggested or understood without being directly stated. Expressed indirectly or hinted at. Contained or included as a natural consequence.
synonyms: Implicit, Suggested, Hinted, Indirect, Unspoken, Inferred, Tacit, Understood, Allusive
antonyms: Explicit, Stated, Expressed, Direct, Declared, Spelled out, Overt
examples: There was an implied agreement between the two firms. His smile carried an implied threat. The contract has several implied conditions. She gave an implied consent by nodding her head.
sindhiMeaning: بنا سڌي طرح ڏنل مشورو يا سمجھيل، غير سڌو ڏيکاريل يا اشارو ڪيل، قدرتي نتيجي طور شامل
urduMeaning: بنا سیدھے بتائے مشورہ یا سمجھا ہوا، غیر سیدھا دکھایا ہوا یا اشارہ کیا ہوا، قدرتی نتیجے کے طور پر شامل

englishMeaning: Begging earnestly and desperately. Making an intense and heartfelt plea. Expressing urgent request through words, looks, or actions.
synonyms: Beseeching, Pleading, Begging, Entreating, Supplicating, Appealing
antonyms: Demanding, Commanding, Ordering, Insisting, Threatening
examples: The child looked at his mother with imploring eyes. She sent him an imploring message to come back. His imploring voice made everyone emotional. The refugees stood there, imploring for shelter.
sindhiMeaning: منٿ ڪندڙ/ التجا ڪندڙ/ ٻاڏائيندڙ، آزيون ڪندڙ، عاجزيءَ سان عرض ڪندڙ، رحم لاءِ ٻاڏائيندڙ، ڪنهن کان ڪنهن شيءِ لاءِ انتهائي عاجزي  دل جي گهري خواهش  بيچيني يا مجبوريءَ سان منٿ ڪرڻ، التجا ڪرڻ يا ٻاڏائڻ
urduMeaning: سخت اخلاص سے التجا کرنا، گہری دل سے التجا کرنا، الفاظ نظر یا عملوں کے ذریعے تیز درخواست ظاہر کرنا

englishMeaning: The bursting inward of an object or structure due to external pressure. A collapse inward, opposite of explosion. A sudden and complete inward failure of an organization or system.
synonyms: Collapse, Cave-in, Inward burst, Inward collapse, Crash, Downfall
antonyms: Explosion, Eruption, Expansion, Bursting outward, Inflation
examples: The old building was brought down by controlled implosion. Submarines are designed to withstand deep-sea implosion. The company's financial implosion shocked investors. The vacuum tube collapsed with a sudden implosion.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنھن شيء جي ٻاهرين دٻاءَ سبب اندر ڏانهن ڦاٽڻ، ڌماڪي جي برعڪس اندر ڏانهن ڍهڻ، تنظيم يا نظام جو اچانڪ مڪمل اندر ڏانهن زوال
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کے بیرونی دباؤ کی وجہ سے اندر کی طرف پھٹنا، دھماکے کے برعکس اندر کی طرف گرنا، تنظیم یا نظام کا اچانک مکمل اندر کی طرف زوال

englishMeaning: To bring someone or something to a particular state or condition, often a worse one. To change something into a simpler, smaller, or different form. To force into a lower rank, level, or status.
synonyms: Bring to, Change into, Turn into, Degrade to, Lower to, Transform into, Convert to
antonyms: Elevate to, Raise to, Build up, Upgrade to, Enhance
examples: The fire reduced the house to ashes. Poverty reduced him to begging on the streets. The problem can be reduced to a simple equation. The defeat reduced the team to tears.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنھن کي خاص حالت ۾ آڻڻ، خاص ڪري بدتر حالت، ڪنھن شيء کي سادي ننڍي يا مختلف شڪل ۾ تبديل ڪرڻ، گهٽ درجه سطح يا حيثيت ۾ مجبور ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو خاص حالت میں لانا، خاص کر برے حالت، کسی چیز کو سادہ چھوٹی یا مختلف شکل میں تبدیل کرنا، کم درجے سطح یا حیثیت میں مجبور کرنا

englishMeaning: Capable of being reduced, made smaller, or simplified. Able to be brought to a lower or simpler state. In mathematics, capable of being expressed in a simpler form or divided by a common factor.
synonyms: Decreasable, Lowerable, Diminishable, Simplifiable, Contractible, Compressible, Modifiable
antonyms: Irreducible, Indivisible, Fixed, Permanent, Unchangeable, Inseparable
examples: The costs are easily reducible with better planning. The fraction is reducible to its simplest form. Many diseases are reducible through vaccination. The complex system is reducible to a few key principles.
sindhiMeaning: گھٽ ڪري سگهجڻ يا سادي ڪري سگهجڻ وارو، گهٽ يا سادي حالت ۾ آڻي سگهجڻ وارو، رياضيءَ ۾ سادي صورت ۾ ظاهر ڪري سگهجڻ يا عام عنصر سان قابل تقسيم هجڻ وارو
urduMeaning: گھٹ کیا جا سکنے والا، کم یا سادہ حالت میں لایا جا سکنے والا، ریاضی میں سادہ صورت میں ظاہر کیا جا سکنے والا یا عام عنصر سے تقسیم کیا جا سکنے والا

englishMeaning: A switch or lever that changes between two states or settings. To alternate between two options, modes, or conditions. A fastener or pin used to hold or secure something.
synonyms: Switch, Flip, Alternate, Button, Lever, Change, Shift, Click, Key
antonyms: Fix, Lock, Hold, Maintain, Stabilize, Freeze
examples: Press the toggle to switch the device on or off. The software allows you to toggle between day and night modes. Use the toggle button to enable notifications. The jacket has a wooden toggle instead of a button.
sindhiMeaning: ٻن حالتن يا سيٽنگن جي وچ ۾ تبديل ڪندڙ سوئچ يا بٽڻ، ٻن آپشنن موڊ يا حالتن جي وچ ۾ تبديل ٿيڻ، کيسڻ يا محفوظ رکڻ لاءِ واپرائجندڙ کنڊي يا پن
urduMeaning: دو حالتوں یا سیٹنگوں کے درمیان تبدیل کرنے والا سوئچ یا بٹن، دو آپشنز موڈ یا حالتوں کے درمیان تبدیل ہونا، لگانے یا محفوظ رکھنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والی کنڈی یا پن

englishMeaning: With each other; in the company of one another. In combination, cooperation, or agreement. At the same time; simultaneously. Into a united or organized whole.
synonyms: Jointly, Collectively, Mutually, In unison, Side by side, As one, Concurrently, Cooperatively
antonyms: Separately, Apart, Individually, Alone, Dividedly, Singly
examples: The family eats dinner together every evening. Let's work together to solve this problem. The two events happened together by coincidence. She gathered her notes together before the meeting.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ٻئي سان گڏ، هڪڙي دٻاءَ اتفاق يا تعاون ۾، هڪ ئي وقت تي، متحد يا سڌريل مڪمل صورت ۾
urduMeaning: ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ، ملی جلی تعاون یا اتفاق میں، ایک ہی وقت پر، متحد یا منظم مکمل صورت میں

englishMeaning: The state of being close to one another in relationship or affection. A feeling of unity, warmth, and mutual support within a group. The quality of spending time and sharing experiences with others.
synonyms: Unity, Closeness, Fellowship, Solidarity, Camaraderie, Bonding, Harmony, Companionship
antonyms: Separation, Isolation, Loneliness, Division, Estrangement, Alienation
examples: The festival celebrates the togetherness of the community. The family felt a strong sense of togetherness during the holidays. Shared difficulties created a spirit of togetherness among the team. The room was filled with warmth and togetherness.
sindhiMeaning: تعلق يا محبت ۾ هڪ ٻئي ويجهي هجڻ جي حالت، گروهه ۾ اتحاد گرمي ۽ گڏيل حمايت جو احساس، ٻين سان وقت گذارڻ ۽ تجربا ڪرڻ جي ڪيفيت
urduMeaning: تعلق یا محبت میں ایک دوسرے کے قریب ہونے کی حالت، گروہ میں اتحاد گرمی اور مشترکہ حمایت کا احساس، دوسروں کے ساتھ وقت گزارنے اور تجربات کرنے کی کیفیت

englishMeaning: The practice of explaining complex things by reducing them to simpler or more basic parts. An approach that analyzes systems by breaking them down into their components. The tendency to oversimplify complicated issues or ideas.
synonyms: Oversimplification, Atomism, Component analysis, Breaking down, Minimalist explanation
antonyms: Holism, Emergentism, Systemic thinking, Integration, Synthesis, Complexity theory
examples: Critics accused the theory of crude reductionism. Reductionism helps scientists understand the building blocks of matter. The article warns against reductionism in studying human behavior. Some philosophers reject reductionism as an incomplete worldview.
sindhiMeaning: پيچيده شين کي سادي يا بنيادي حصن تائين گهٽائي سمجهڻ جي عمل، سسٽمن کي ان جي اجزا ۾ ورهائي تجزيو ڪرڻ وارو طريقو، ڏکئين مسئلن يا خيالن کي گهڻو سادي ڪرڻ جي رجحان
urduMeaning: پیچیدہ چیزوں کو سادہ یا بنیادی حصوں تک گھٹا کر سمجھنے کا عمل، سسٹمز کو اجزاء میں تقسیم کر کے تجزیہ کرنے کا طریقہ، مشکل مسائل یا خیالات کو زیادہ سادہ کرنے کا رجحان

englishMeaning: A lawyer who is legally qualified to advise or represent people. A person appointed to act for another in legal or business matters. An official authorized to conduct legal proceedings on behalf of a government or organization.
synonyms: Lawyer, Counsel, Advocate, Solicitor, Legal representative
antonyms: Client, Layperson, Opponent, Adversary
examples: The attorney reviewed the contract before her client signed it. He hired an attorney to represent him in court. Please send all legal documents to my attorney. The attorney presented new evidence during the trial.
sindhiMeaning: وڪيل يا قانوني صلاحڪار، عدالت ۾ ڪنهن جي نمائندگي ڪندڙ شخص، قانوني يا ڪاروباري معاملن ۾ ٻئي جي طرفان ڪم ڪرڻ لاءِ مقرر ڪيل شخص، حڪومت يا اداري طرفان قانوني ڪارروائي هلائيندڙ عملدار
urduMeaning: وکیل یا قانونی مشیر، عدالت میں کسی کی نمائندگی کرنے والا شخص، قانونی یا کاروباری معاملات میں کسی دوسرے کی طرف سے کام کرنے کے لیے مقرر شخص، حکومت یا ادارے کی جانب سے قانونی کارروائی کرنے والا افسر

englishMeaning: The season between summer and winter when temperatures fall and leaves change color. A period of maturity or gradual decline late in a person’s life or in the development of something.

englishMeaning: With praise, an academic distinction awarded for notably high achievement. A Latin honor generally indicating a strong academic record at graduation.
synonyms: With honors, With praise, With distinction
antonyms: Without honors, Ordinary pass, Academic failure
examples: He graduated cum laude with a degree in history. The university awarded her diploma cum laude. Consistent effort enabled him to finish cum laude. Her résumé notes that she graduated cum laude.
sindhiMeaning: اعزاز سان، قابل ذڪر اعليٰ تعليمي ڪاميابيءَ سان، گريجوئيشن وقت سٺي تعليمي ڪارڪردگي تي ملندڙ لاطيني اعزاز
urduMeaning: اعزاز کے ساتھ، نمایاں اعلیٰ تعلیمی کامیابی کے ساتھ، گریجویشن کے وقت اچھی تعلیمی کارکردگی پر ملنے والا لاطینی اعزاز

englishMeaning: Spoken, performed, or composed without preparation. Done on the spur of the moment rather than from a prepared text. An impromptu speech or performance. In an unrehearsed or spontaneous manner.
synonyms: Impromptu, Unrehearsed, Spontaneous, Offhand, Ad-lib, Unprepared
antonyms: Prepared, Rehearsed, Scripted, Planned, Premeditated
examples: The teacher asked each student to give an extempore speech. She answered the difficult question extempore. His extempore remarks were clear and thoughtful. The actor gave an entertaining extempore performance.
sindhiMeaning: بنا تياري جي ڳالهايل لکيل يا پيش ڪيل، اوچتو ۽ تيار ڪيل متن کان سواءِ ڪيل، بنا مشق تقرير يا پيشڪش، في البديهه انداز ۾
urduMeaning: بغیر تیاری کے بولا لکھا یا پیش کیا گیا، اچانک اور تیار شدہ متن کے بغیر کیا گیا، بے ساختہ تقریر یا پیشکش، فی البدیہہ انداز میں

englishMeaning: With great praise, an academic distinction awarded for very high achievement. A Latin graduation honor usually ranked below summa cum laude and above cum laude.
synonyms: With great honors, With high distinction, With great praise
antonyms: Without honors, Ordinary pass, Academic failure
examples: She graduated magna cum laude in economics. His transcript records the honor magna cum laude. Years of careful work helped him finish magna cum laude. The faculty selected twelve students to graduate magna cum laude.
sindhiMeaning: وڏي اعزاز سان، تمام اعليٰ تعليمي ڪاميابيءَ سان، گريجوئيشن جو اهڙو لاطيني اعزاز جيڪو عام طور سڀ کان اعليٰ اعزاز کان هيٺ ۽ اعزاز سان کان مٿي هجي
urduMeaning: بڑے اعزاز کے ساتھ، بہت اعلیٰ تعلیمی کامیابی کے ساتھ، گریجویشن کا ایسا لاطینی اعزاز جو عموماً سب سے اعلیٰ اعزاز سے نیچے اور اعزاز کے ساتھ سے اوپر ہو

englishMeaning: A business or company, especially one involving initiative or risk. A planned project or undertaking, often difficult or important. The ability and willingness to begin new ventures with energy and resourcefulness. Purposeful activity or industrious effort.
synonyms: Business, Company, Venture, Undertaking, Project, Initiative, Entrepreneurship
antonyms: Inactivity, Idleness, Apathy, Stagnation, Unwillingness
examples: She built a successful farming enterprise from a small plot. The research project was a difficult but rewarding enterprise. His energy and enterprise impressed the investors. The family enterprise now employs more than fifty people.
sindhiMeaning: ڪاروبار يا ڪمپني خاص ڪري خطري ۽ شروعات سان لاڳاپيل، رٿيل منصوبو يا اهم ڪم، نئين ڪم جي شروعات ڪرڻ جي همت ۽ قابليت، محنتي ۽ مقصد ڀري سرگرمي
urduMeaning: کاروبار یا کمپنی خصوصاً جس میں پہل اور خطرہ شامل ہو، منصوبہ بند مہم یا اہم کام، نئی سرگرمی شروع کرنے کی ہمت اور صلاحیت، محنتی اور بامقصد سرگرمی

englishMeaning: To gain someone’s support, approval, affection, or agreement. To persuade someone who was initially doubtful or opposed. To make someone like or trust you through words or actions.
synonyms: Persuade, Convince, Convert, Charm, Gain, Bring around, Woo
antonyms: Alienate, Repel, Deter, Lose, Estrange, Displease
examples: Her honesty helped her win over the skeptical audience. The coach gradually won over the unhappy players. A free trial may win over new customers. He used patience and humor to win his neighbors over.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن جي حمايت منظوري محبت يا رضامندي حاصل ڪرڻ، شڪ ڪندڙ يا مخالف ماڻهو کي قائل ڪرڻ، ڳالهين يا عملن سان ڪنهن جو دل يا ڀروسو کٽڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کی حمایت منظوری محبت یا رضامندی حاصل کرنا، شک کرنے والے یا مخالف شخص کو قائل کرنا، باتوں یا عمل سے کسی کا دل یا اعتماد جیتنا

englishMeaning: A cylindrical map projection introduced by Gerardus Mercator in which lines of constant compass direction appear straight. A world-map method that preserves local angles and shapes but greatly enlarges areas near the poles. A projection widely used for navigation and many online maps.
synonyms: Mercator map, Cylindrical conformal projection, Web Mercator
antonyms: Equal-area projection, Peters projection, Interrupted projection
examples: The navigator plotted the route on a Mercator projection. Greenland appears unusually large on a Mercator projection. A Mercator projection preserves compass bearings for sailors. Many web maps use a form of the Mercator projection.
sindhiMeaning: گيرارڊس مرڪيٽر جي پيش ڪيل سلنڊري نقشي جي پروجيڪشن جنهن ۾ هڪجهڙي قطب نما رخ واريون ليڪون سڌيون ڏسجن، اهڙو عالمي نقشو جيڪو مقامي زاويه ۽ شڪلون بچائي پر قطبن ڀرسان ايراضيون وڏيون ڏيکاري، سامونڊي رهنمائي ۽ آن لائن نقشن ۾ عام طريقو
urduMeaning: گیرارڈس مرکٹر کی پیش کردہ اسطوانی نقشہ سازی جس میں مستقل سمتی خطوط سیدھے نظر آتے ہیں، ایسا عالمی نقشہ جو مقامی زاویے اور شکلیں محفوظ رکھتا مگر قطبین کے قریب رقبے بہت بڑے دکھاتا ہے، بحری رہنمائی اور آن لائن نقشوں میں عام طریقہ

englishMeaning: An equal-area world-map projection associated with Arno Peters. A rectangular map that preserves the relative sizes of land areas while distorting their shapes. A projection promoted as an alternative to maps that exaggerate high-latitude countries.
synonyms: Gall–Peters projection, Equal-area projection, Equal-area world map
antonyms: Mercator projection, Conformal projection, Shape-preserving projection
examples: The class compared the Peters projection with the Mercator map. Africa occupies a more proportionate area on the Peters projection. The Peters projection preserves relative area rather than local shape. Some educators use the Peters projection to discuss map bias.
sindhiMeaning: آرنو پيٽرز سان لاڳاپيل برابر ايراضي وارو عالمي نقشي جو طريقو، مستطيل نقشو جيڪو زميني علائقن جي لاڳاپيل ماپن کي صحيح رکي پر شڪلون بگاڙي، اوچي ويڪرائي ڦاڪ وارن ملڪن کي وڏو ڏيکاريندڙ نقشن جو متبادل
urduMeaning: آرنو پیٹرز سے منسوب مساوی رقبے والی عالمی نقشہ سازی، مستطیل نقشہ جو زمینی علاقوں کے نسبتی رقبے درست رکھتا مگر شکلیں بگاڑتا ہے، بلند عرض بلد کے ممالک کو بڑا دکھانے والے نقشوں کا متبادل

englishMeaning: The slender stalk that attaches a leaf blade to a plant stem. A stalk supporting certain plant structures or, in zoology, a narrow connecting part between body sections. The narrow waist between the thorax and abdomen in some insects.
synonyms: Leafstalk, Stalk, Pedicel, Stem, Connecting stalk
antonyms: Sessile attachment, Stalkless base, Leaf blade
examples: The long petiole allows the leaf to reach toward the light. A tiny insect rested on the leaf’s petiole. The botanist measured each petiole before examining the blade. Damage to the petiole caused the leaf to droop.
sindhiMeaning: پن جي ڦر کي ٻوٽي جي ڏانڊي سان ڳنڍيندڙ سنهو ڳنڍو، ٻوٽي جي ڪنهن حصي کي سهارو ڏيندڙ ڏانڊي، ڪجهه جيتن ۾ جسم جي ٻن حصن وچ ۾ سنهو ڳانڍاپو
urduMeaning: پتے کے پھلک کو پودے کے تنے سے ملانے والی باریک ڈنڈی، پودے کے کسی حصے کو سہارا دینے والی ڈنڈی، بعض کیڑوں میں جسم کے دو حصوں کے درمیان باریک جوڑ

englishMeaning: Businesses or companies, especially those involving initiative and risk. Planned projects or undertakings that require effort. Activities showing energy, resourcefulness, and a willingness to take action. The plural form of enterprise.
synonyms: Businesses, Companies, Ventures, Undertakings, Projects, Firms, Initiatives
antonyms: Inactivities, Failures, Idleness, Stagnation, Abandonments
examples: Small enterprises provide many jobs in the region. The charity supports local social enterprises. Both scientific enterprises required years of careful research. Her family owns several agricultural enterprises.
sindhiMeaning: ڪاروبار يا ڪمپنيون خاص ڪري شروعات ۽ خطري واريون، رٿيل منصوبا يا وڏا ڪم، همت وسيلن ۽ عمل جي خواهش ڏيکاريندڙ سرگرميون، انٽرپرائز جو جمع
urduMeaning: کاروبار یا کمپنیاں خصوصاً پہل اور خطرے والی، منصوبہ بند منصوبے یا بڑے کام، ہمت وسائل اور عمل کی خواہش ظاہر کرنے والی سرگرمیاں، انٹرپرائز کی جمع

englishMeaning: To begin an activity, course, stage, or period. To start carrying out duties or occupying an office. To take possession of property or formally assume a right. To record information in a book, form, or system, in less common usage.
synonyms: Begin, Commence, Embark on, Undertake, Assume, Take up, Record
antonyms: End, Finish, Cease, Abandon, Withdraw from, Relinquish
examples: She is ready to enter on a new phase of her career. The minister will enter on his duties next Monday. After the legal transfer, the buyer may enter on the property. The clerk entered the payment on the official record.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم رستي مرحلي يا دور جي شروعات ڪرڻ، عهدو يا ذميواري سنڀالڻ شروع ڪرڻ، ملڪيت تي قبضو يا حق اختيار ڪرڻ، معلومات رجسٽر يا نظام ۾ داخل ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کام راستے مرحلے یا دور کا آغاز کرنا، عہدہ یا ذمہ داری سنبھالنا شروع کرنا، جائیداد کا قبضہ یا حق اختیار کرنا، معلومات رجسٹر یا نظام میں درج کرنا

englishMeaning: To persuade someone to support, agree with, or approve of you. To change a person’s initially negative or doubtful opinion. To gain someone’s affection or cooperation through patient effort.
synonyms: Persuade, Convince, Bring around, Win over, Convert, Sway
antonyms: Alienate, Repel, Dissuade, Deter, Estrange, Lose
examples: We finally won the manager round to our proposal. Her practical arguments won round the doubtful committee members. He hopes to win his critics round with better results. A friendly conversation may win her round.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي پنهنجي حمايت يا ڳالهه تي راضي ڪرڻ، شروعاتي ناڪاري يا شڪي راءِ بدلائڻ، صبر سان ڪنهن جي محبت يا سهڪار حاصل ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو اپنی حمایت یا بات پر راضی کرنا، ابتدائی منفی یا مشکوک رائے بدلنا، صبر سے کسی کی محبت یا تعاون حاصل کرنا

englishMeaning: An estimate or forecast of a future amount, trend, or situation. The act of displaying an image on a surface. A part that sticks out beyond a surface. The representation of the curved earth on a flat map. The unconscious attribution of one’s own feelings to another person. The act of throwing or extending something outward.
synonyms: Forecast, Estimate, Prediction, Display, Protrusion, Map representation, Attribution
antonyms: Retraction, Recession, Actual result, Concealment, Indentation
examples: The sales projection suggests steady growth next year. The projection of the film began at eight o’clock. A stone projection provided a narrow ledge above the path. This map projection distorts distances near the poles.
sindhiMeaning: مستقبل جي مقدار يا حالت جو اندازو، تصوير کي پردي يا سطح تي ڏيکارڻ جو عمل، سطح کان ٻاهر نڪتل حصو، گول زمين کي سڌي نقشي تي ڏيکارڻ جو طريقو، پنهنجا احساس ٻئي ماڻهو ڏانهن منسوب ڪرڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ٻاهر اڇلائڻ يا وڌائڻ
urduMeaning: مستقبل کی مقدار یا حالت کا اندازہ، تصویر کو پردے یا سطح پر دکھانے کا عمل، سطح سے باہر نکلا ہوا حصہ، گول زمین کو ہموار نقشے پر دکھانے کا طریقہ، اپنے جذبات دوسرے شخص سے منسوب کرنا، کسی چیز کو باہر پھینکنے یا پھیلانے کا عمل

englishMeaning: A member of the lower middle class, especially a small business owner or self-employed person. A person regarded as having conventional, materialistic, or narrowly middle-class values. Relating to the social group between the working class and the wealthy bourgeoisie.
synonyms: Lower-middle-class person, Small proprietor, Petty bourgeois, Shopkeeper, Conventionalist
antonyms: Proletarian, Working-class person, Haute bourgeois, Aristocrat
examples: The novel portrays a petit bourgeois shopkeeper struggling to protect his status. Critics described the character’s ambitions as petit bourgeois. The movement drew support from workers and the petit bourgeois. His concern with appearances reflected a petit bourgeois outlook.
sindhiMeaning: هيٺين وچولي طبقي جو فرد خاص ڪري ننڍو دڪاندار يا خود روزگار ماڻهو، روايتي مادي يا محدود وچولي طبقي واري سوچ رکندڙ شخص، پورهيت طبقي ۽ مالدار سرمائيدار طبقي جي وچ واري سماجي گروهه سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: نچلے متوسط طبقے کا فرد خصوصاً چھوٹا کاروباری یا خود روزگار شخص، روایتی مادی یا محدود متوسط طبقاتی اقدار رکھنے والا شخص، محنت کش طبقے اور امیر سرمایہ دار طبقے کے درمیان سماجی گروہ سے متعلق

englishMeaning: A synthetic opioid medicine used to relieve moderate to severe pain. A strong prescription painkiller also known as meperidine. A controlled drug that can cause dependence and serious side effects and is used under medical supervision.
synonyms: Meperidine, Opioid analgesic, Narcotic painkiller, Pain reliever
antonyms: Pain stimulant, No direct antonym, Opioid antagonist
examples: The doctor prescribed pethidine for severe postoperative pain. Pethidine must be administered under medical supervision. The nurse checked the dosage before giving the patient pethidine. Some hospitals now use alternatives to pethidine for pain relief.
sindhiMeaning: وچولي کان سخت سور گهٽائڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ مصنوعي اوپيئڊ دوا، ميپيريڊين نالي سان به سڃاتل طاقتور نسخي واري سور ختم ڪندڙ دوا، عادت ۽ سنگين ضمني اثر پيدا ڪري سگهندڙ ضابطي هيٺ دوا
urduMeaning: درمیانے سے شدید درد کم کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والی مصنوعی اوپیئڈ دوا، میپیریڈین کے نام سے بھی معروف طاقتور نسخے کی درد کش دوا، انحصار اور سنگین مضر اثرات پیدا کرنے والی زیر نگرانی دوا

englishMeaning: Attractively small, delicate, or dainty. Describing a woman who is short and has a small, slender build. A clothing size or range designed for shorter women. A woman or girl with a small and slender figure.
synonyms: Small, Dainty, Delicate, Slight, Diminutive, Compact, Short
antonyms: Tall, Large, Stout, Burly, Massive, Oversized
examples: She chose a jacket from the store’s petite section. The petite dancer moved gracefully across the stage. This brand offers trousers in regular and petite sizes. Although petite, she carried the heavy backpack with ease.
sindhiMeaning: سهڻي نموني ننڍي نازڪ يا نفيس، ننڍي قد ۽ سنهڙي جسم واري عورت لاءِ، ننڍي قد وارين عورتن لاءِ تيار ڪيل ڪپڙن جي ماپ، ننڍي ۽ نفيس جسم واري عورت يا ڇوڪري
urduMeaning: خوبصورتی سے چھوٹی نازک یا نفیس، کم قد اور پتلی جسامت والی عورت کے لیے، کم قد خواتین کے لیے تیار کردہ لباس کا سائز، چھوٹی اور نفیس جسامت والی عورت یا لڑکی

englishMeaning: A small, decorated cake or sweet pastry served as a dessert or with coffee. A bite-sized confection, often iced or glazed. A small savory pastry sometimes served as an appetizer.
synonyms: Small cake, Bite-sized pastry, Confection, Fancy cake, Sweetmeat
antonyms: Large cake, Main course, Entrée, Savory meal
examples: Each guest received a chocolate petit four with coffee. The bakery arranged colorful petits fours on a silver tray. She decorated the petit four with a tiny sugar flower. Savory petits fours were served before the main course.
sindhiMeaning: ننڍو سينگاريل ڪيڪ يا مٺو پيسٽري جيڪو مٺاڻ يا ڪافي سان ڏنو وڃي، هڪ گرهه جيترو آئسنگ يا چمڪ واري مٺائي، ڪڏهن شروعاتي کاڌي طور ڏنو ويندڙ ننڍو لوڻياٺو پيسٽري
urduMeaning: چھوٹا سجا ہوا کیک یا میٹھی پیسٹری جو میٹھے یا کافی کے ساتھ پیش کی جائے، ایک لقمے جتنی آئسنگ یا تہہ والی مٹھائی، کبھی ابتدائی کھانے کے طور پر پیش کی جانے والی چھوٹی نمکین پیسٹری

englishMeaning: Relating to trade, merchants, or commercial business. Characterized by a strong concern with buying, selling, and profit. Connected with the merchant class or commercial shipping.
synonyms: Commercial, Trading, Merchant, Business, Trade-related, Profit-oriented
antonyms: Noncommercial, Charitable, Nonprofit, Domestic, Agricultural
examples: The port became a major mercantile center. His family belonged to the city’s wealthy mercantile class. The museum preserves records from the region’s mercantile past. Mercantile interests strongly influenced the new policy.
sindhiMeaning: واپار واپارين يا تجارتي ڪاروبار سان لاڳاپيل، خريد فروخت ۽ نفعي تي زور ڏيندڙ، واپاري طبقي يا تجارتي جهاز راني سان واسطو رکندڙ
urduMeaning: تجارت تاجروں یا کاروباری سرگرمی سے متعلق، خرید و فروخت اور منافع پر زور دینے والا، تاجر طبقے یا تجارتی جہاز رانی سے وابستہ

englishMeaning: A synthetic stimulant drug of the cathinone class. A psychoactive substance that can produce euphoria and increased energy but carries serious health and dependence risks. An illegal or controlled recreational drug in many countries, sometimes called 4-MMC.
synonyms: 4-MMC, Synthetic cathinone, Stimulant, Psychoactive drug
antonyms: Depressant, Sedative, Tranquilizer, No direct antonym
examples: Mephedrone is classified as a controlled drug in many countries. Doctors warn that mephedrone can place dangerous strain on the heart. The seized powder was tested for mephedrone. Researchers continue to study the long-term effects of mephedrone use.
sindhiMeaning: ڪيٿينون قسم جي مصنوعي تحريڪ ڏيندڙ دوا، نشي آور مادو جيڪو خوشي ۽ وڌيل توانائي پيدا ڪري سگهي پر صحت ۽ عادت جا سنگين خطرا رکي، ڪيترن ملڪن ۾ غيرقانوني يا ضابطي هيٺ تفريحي نشو جنهن کي 4-MMC به چوندا آهن

englishMeaning: Devilish, wicked, or fiendishly cunning. Resembling Mephistopheles, the demonic tempter in the Faust legend. Showing sinister charm, malicious intelligence, or a temptation toward evil.

antonyms: Angelic, Benevolent, Virtuous, Saintly, Innocent, Good

sindhiMeaning: شيطاني بڇڙو يا نهايت مڪار، فاؤسٽ جي ڪهاڻي جي شيطاني آزمائيندڙ ميفسٽوفيليس جهڙو، خوفناڪ دلڪشي خراب ذهانت يا برائي ڏانهن لالچ ڏيکاريندڙ
urduMeaning: شیطانی بدکار یا نہایت مکار، فاؤسٹ کی داستان کے شیطانی بہکانے والے میفسٹوفیلس جیسا، خوفناک دلکشی شرارتی ذہانت یا برائی کی ترغیب ظاہر کرنے والا

englishMeaning: An economic system in which a government seeks national wealth and power by controlling trade, promoting exports, and limiting imports. The economic doctrine that national prosperity depends on accumulating precious metals and maintaining a favorable balance of trade. A strong commercial spirit or emphasis on profit.
synonyms: Economic nationalism, Protectionism, Trade regulation, Commercialism, Bullionism
antonyms: Free trade, Laissez-faire, Economic liberalism, Open markets
examples: Mercantilism shaped European trade policy for several centuries. Under mercantilism, governments often imposed high tariffs on imports. The historian explained how colonies supported the goals of mercantilism. Critics argue that strict mercantilism can restrict open trade.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙو معاشي نظام جنهن ۾ حڪومت واپار تي ضابطو رکي برآمد وڌائي ۽ درآمد گهٽائي قومي دولت ۽ طاقت وڌائي، اهو معاشي نظريو ته قيمتي ڌاتن جي ذخيرن ۽ فائدي واري واپاري توازن سان خوشحالي اچي ٿي، واپار ۽ نفعي تي تمام گهڻو زور
urduMeaning: ایسا معاشی نظام جس میں حکومت تجارت پر قابو رکھ کر برآمدات بڑھاتی اور درآمدات محدود کرتی ہے تاکہ قومی دولت اور طاقت بڑھے، یہ معاشی نظریہ کہ قیمتی دھاتوں کے ذخیرے اور موافق تجارتی توازن سے خوشحالی آتی ہے، تجارت اور منافع پر بہت زیادہ زور

englishMeaning: A supporter or practitioner of mercantilism. A person who favors government control of trade, export promotion, and import restriction to increase national wealth. Relating to or characteristic of mercantilism. Strongly focused on commerce or profit.
synonyms: Protectionist, Economic nationalist, Trade regulator, Commercialist, Mercantilism advocate
antonyms: Free trader, Economic liberal, Laissez-faire advocate, Internationalist
examples: The minister adopted a mercantilist approach to foreign trade. Mercantilist writers favored a positive balance of trade. The historian described him as a committed mercantilist. New tariffs reflected the government’s mercantilist priorities.
sindhiMeaning: مرڪنٽيلزم جو حامي يا عمل ڪندڙ، قومي دولت وڌائڻ لاءِ واپار تي سرڪاري ضابطي برآمد وڌائڻ ۽ درآمد گهٽائڻ جو حامي، مرڪنٽيلزم سان لاڳاپيل، واپار يا نفعي تي گهڻو ڌيان ڏيندڙ
urduMeaning: مرکنٹیلزم کا حامی یا اس پر عمل کرنے والا، قومی دولت بڑھانے کے لیے تجارت پر حکومتی کنٹرول برآمدات کے فروغ اور درآمدات کی پابندی کا حامی، مرکنٹیلزم سے متعلق، تجارت یا منافع پر زیادہ توجہ دینے والا

englishMeaning: With official permission granted by an authority or rights holder. Subject to the terms and conditions of a legal license. Produced, sold, used, or operated with authorized consent.
synonyms: With permission, By authorization, Officially approved, Licensed, Legally permitted
antonyms: Without permission, Unlicensed, Unauthorized, Illegally, Prohibited

sindhiMeaning: اختيار رکندڙ اداري يا حق مالڪ جي سرڪاري اجازت سان، قانوني لائسنس جي شرطن هيٺ، بااختيار رضامندي سان تيار وڪرو استعمال يا هلائيندڙ
urduMeaning: بااختیار ادارے یا حقوق کے مالک کی سرکاری اجازت سے، قانونی لائسنس کی شرائط کے تحت، مجاز رضامندی سے تیار فروخت استعمال یا چلایا جانے والا

englishMeaning: An opportunity, right, or business arrangement that makes it unusually easy to earn very large profits. synonyms: Gold mine, Cash cow, Money-making machine, Lucrative monopoly, Sure profit
antonyms: Money pit, Loss-making venture, Financial burden, Bad investment

sindhiMeaning: اهڙو موقعو حق يا ڪاروباري بندوبست جنهن سان تمام وڏو نفعو ڪمائڻ غيرمعمولي طور آسان هجي، گهٽ خطري يا مقابلي سان لڳ ڀڳ پڪي آمدني واري حالت، تمام فائديمند امتياز لاءِ مجازي اصطلاح نه ته ڪرنسي ٺاهڻ جي حقيقي اجازت
urduMeaning: ایسا موقع حق یا کاروباری بندوبست جس سے بہت بڑا منافع کمانا غیر معمولی طور پر آسان ہو، کم خطرے یا مقابلے کے ساتھ تقریباً یقینی آمدنی والی حالت، انتہائی منافع بخش فائدے کے لیے مجازی محاورہ نہ کہ کرنسی بنانے کی حقیقی اجازت

englishMeaning: The freedom to alter facts, reality, language, or conventional rules for a creative purpose. Permission accepted in art or literature to depart from strict accuracy. A deliberate creative deviation used to improve expression, drama, or effect.
synonyms: Creative freedom, Poetic license, Dramatic license, Creative liberty, Expressive freedom
antonyms: Literal accuracy, Strict fidelity, Factual precision, Verbatim representation
examples: The film used artistic license to simplify the historical timeline. Through artistic license, the painter gave the landscape brighter colors. The novelist took artistic license with several real events. A little artistic license made the stage adaptation more dramatic.
sindhiMeaning: تخليقي مقصد لاءِ حقيقت ٻولي يا روايتي قاعدن ۾ تبديلي ڪرڻ جي آزادي، فن يا ادب ۾ سخت درستگي کان هٽڻ جي قبول ڪيل اجازت، اظهار ڊرامي يا اثر کي بهتر ڪرڻ لاءِ ڄاڻي واڻي تخليقي ڦيرڦار
