urduMeaning: اسٹریچر کا ایک سرا اٹھانے والا شخص عموماً جوڑی یا ٹیم کا حصہ، زخمی یا بیمار افراد کو اسٹریچر پر منتقل کرنے والا طبی یا فوجی کارکن، زخمیوں کو محفوظ انداز میں لے جانے والا امدادی کارکن

englishMeaning: An attractive quality associated with beauty, excitement, wealth, or success. A charming and often idealized appeal that makes a person, place, or activity seem special. Stylish beauty and sophistication. Historically, a magical enchantment or spell.
synonyms: Allure, Charm, Elegance, Sophistication, Enchantment, Appeal, Splendor
antonyms: Dullness, Plainness, Drabness, Ugliness, Ordinariness
examples: The old cinema still retains a sense of glamour. Travel magazines often emphasize the glamour of distant cities. She brought elegance and glamour to the event. The job involves hard work despite its public glamour.
sindhiMeaning: حسن جوش دولت يا ڪاميابي سان لاڳاپيل پرڪشش خوبي، دلڪش ۽ اڪثر مثالي ڪشش جيڪا ماڻهو جاءِ يا سرگرمي کي خاص ڏيکاري، نفيس سونهن ۽ شان، تاريخي طور جادو يا طلسم
urduMeaning: حسن جوش دولت یا کامیابی سے وابستہ پُرکشش خوبی، دلکش اور اکثر مثالی کشش جو کسی شخص مقام یا سرگرمی کو خاص دکھائے، نفیس خوبصورتی اور شان، تاریخی طور پر جادو یا طلسم

englishMeaning: A portable frame used to carry a sick, injured, or unconscious person. A device or frame used to stretch, support, or shape something. A wooden frame over which an artist’s canvas is stretched. A brick laid with its long side visible in a wall.
synonyms: Litter, Gurney, Carrying frame, Canvas frame, Stretcher brick
antonyms: No direct antonym
examples: Paramedics placed the injured cyclist on a stretcher. The canvas was secured to a wooden stretcher. The rescue team carried a folding stretcher. Each stretcher in the brick wall was carefully aligned.
sindhiMeaning: بيمار زخمي يا بيهوش ماڻهو کڻڻ لاءِ هلڪو کٽ جهڙو ڍانچو، ڪنهن شيءِ کي ڇڪڻ سهارو ڏيڻ يا شڪل ڏيڻ وارو اوزار يا فريم، مصور جي ڪينواس ڇڪڻ لاءِ ڪاٺ جو فريم، ڀت ۾ ڊگهو پاسو ظاهر ڪري رکيل سر
urduMeaning: بیمار زخمی یا بے ہوش شخص کو اٹھانے کے لیے قابلِ حمل چارپائی نما فریم، کسی چیز کو کھینچنے سہارا دینے یا شکل دینے والا آلہ یا چوکھٹا، مصور کا کینوس کھینچنے والا لکڑی کا فریم، دیوار میں لمبا رخ نمایاں رکھ کر لگائی گئی اینٹ

englishMeaning: To extend as far as a particular place, point, amount, or time. To be sufficient for a specified purpose or quantity. To make an effort to reach or achieve a demanding level. To broaden a rule, meaning, or resource to include something.
synonyms: Extend to, Reach, Run to, Suffice for, Expand to
antonyms: Fall short of, Stop before, Contract from, Exclude
examples: The forest stretches to the edge of the lake. Our budget will not stretch to a luxury hotel. She had to stretch to reach the top shelf. That interpretation stretches the rule to its limit.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خاص جاءِ نقطي مقدار يا وقت تائين پکڙجڻ، مقرر مقصد يا مقدار لاءِ ڪافي ٿيڻ، ڏکئي سطح تائين پهچڻ يا حاصل ڪرڻ جي ڪوشش ڪرڻ، ضابطي معنيٰ يا وسيلي کي ڪجهه شامل ڪرڻ لاءِ وڌائڻ
urduMeaning: کسی خاص جگہ نقطے مقدار یا وقت تک پھیلنا، مقرر مقصد یا مقدار کے لیے کافی ہونا، مشکل سطح تک پہنچنے یا حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کرنا، کسی اصول معنی یا وسیلے کو کچھ شامل کرنے کے لیے وسعت دینا

englishMeaning: To reach out toward something one wants to take or touch. To extend the body or a limb in an attempt to obtain something. To strive for a goal that is difficult to achieve.
synonyms: Reach for, Extend toward, Grasp for, Strive for, Aim for
antonyms: Withdraw from, Recoil from, Give up on, Avoid
examples: The baby stretched for the bright toy. She stretched for the handle above the door. He stretched for the final note but missed it. The young athlete continues to stretch for excellence.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي وٺڻ يا ڇهڻ لاءِ اڳتي هٿ وڌائڻ، شيءِ حاصل ڪرڻ جي ڪوشش ۾ جسم يا عضوو ڊگهو ڪرڻ، حاصل ڪرڻ ڏکئي مقصد لاءِ جاکوڙڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو پکڑنے یا چھونے کے لیے آگے ہاتھ بڑھانا، کسی چیز کے حصول کی کوشش میں جسم یا عضو کو پھیلانا، مشکل مقصد کے حصول کے لیے جدوجہد کرنا

englishMeaning: To extend continuously into the distance. To spread from a point across a wide area. To appear long and uninterrupted as it recedes from view.
synonyms: Extend, Spread out, Reach into the distance, Run on, Continue
antonyms: End nearby, Stop abruptly, Contract, Shorten
examples: Green fields stretch away toward the mountains. The empty road stretched away into the mist. Sand dunes stretch away in every direction. From the tower, the city seemed to stretch away forever.
sindhiMeaning: پري فاصلي تائين لڳاتار پکڙجڻ، هڪ نقطي کان وسيع علائقي ۾ ڦهلجڻ، نظر کان پري ٿيندي ڊگهو ۽ اڻٽٽ ڏسڻ ۾ اچڻ
urduMeaning: دور فاصلے تک مسلسل پھیلنا، ایک نقطے سے وسیع علاقے میں پھیل جانا، نظر سے دور ہوتے ہوئے لمبا اور بلا رکاوٹ دکھائی دینا

englishMeaning: To restrict someone or something to a particular amount, number, place, group, or activity. To allow only a specified range or choice. To confine the effect, discussion, or use of something to a stated boundary.
synonyms: Restrict to, Confine to, Cap at, Reduce to, Keep to
antonyms: Expand to, Extend beyond, Broaden, Allow freely, Unrestrict
examples: Please limit your answer to two paragraphs. The offer is limited to new customers. We should limit the discussion to relevant facts. Doctors advised him to limit himself to light exercise.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ماڻهو يا شيءِ کي خاص مقدار انگ جاءِ گروهه يا سرگرمي تائين محدود ڪرڻ، رڳو مقرر دائري يا چونڊ جي اجازت ڏيڻ، اثر بحث يا استعمال کي ڄاڻايل حد اندر رکڻ
urduMeaning: کسی شخص یا چیز کو خاص مقدار تعداد جگہ گروہ یا سرگرمی تک محدود کرنا، صرف مقرر دائرے یا انتخاب کی اجازت دینا، اثر بحث یا استعمال کو بیان کردہ حد کے اندر رکھنا

englishMeaning: To restrict something according to a particular factor, rule, amount, or condition. To cause a person or thing to have less freedom, scope, or capacity because of something. To determine a boundary through a specified constraint.
synonyms: Restrict by, Constrain by, Bound by, Cap through, Hamper by
antonyms: Enable by, Expand through, Free from, Unrestrict, Enhance by
examples: Production is limited by the available supply of water. The project was limited by a small budget. Our choices are limited by time and distance. Growth may be limited by poor soil conditions.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي خاص سبب ضابطي مقدار يا شرط موجب محدود ڪرڻ، ڪنهن سبب ڪري ماڻهو يا شيءِ جي آزادي دائري يا سگهه گهٽائڻ، مقرر پابندي ذريعي حد طئي ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو خاص عامل اصول مقدار یا شرط کے مطابق محدود کرنا، کسی سبب سے شخص یا چیز کی آزادی دائرہ یا صلاحیت کم کرنا، مقرر پابندی کے ذریعے حد متعین کرنا

englishMeaning: An attractive or exciting quality that makes someone or something seem special or desirable. Charm created by beauty, luxury, fame, fashion, or mystery. A deceptively appealing appearance that can hide ordinary or unpleasant reality. To make something appear more attractive or romantic than it really is. An archaic enchantment or magic spell.
synonyms: Charm, Allure, Appeal, Enchantment, Fascination, Elegance, Splendor, Mystique, Glitz, Romanticize
antonyms: Dullness, Plainness, Ugliness, Drabness, Reality, Ordinariness, Repulsiveness
examples: The glamor of the film industry attracts many young performers. Travel magazines often add glamor to ordinary destinations. The old theater retains the glamor of a bygone age. Advertisers glamor the product with elegant photography.
sindhiMeaning: دلڪشي يا ڪشش، حسن شهرت يا عيش سبب پيدا ٿيندڙ موهيندڙ اثر، ڪنهن شيءِ کي حقيقت کان وڌيڪ خوبصورت يا پرڪشش ڏيکارڻ، ظاهري چمڪ دمڪ جيڪا حقيقت لڪائي، پراڻو جادوي اثر يا منڊ
urduMeaning: دلکشی یا کشش، حسن شہرت یا آسائش سے پیدا ہونے والا سحر، کسی چیز کو حقیقت سے زیادہ خوبصورت یا پرکشش دکھانا، ظاہری چمک دمک جو حقیقت کو چھپا دے، قدیم جادو یا طلسم

englishMeaning: Possessing exciting beauty, charm, elegance, or attractiveness. Associated with luxury, fame, fashion, or a desirable lifestyle. Appearing more appealing or romantic than everyday reality. Full of sophistication, spectacle, or prestige.
synonyms: Attractive, Alluring, Elegant, Chic, Dazzling, Luxurious, Stylish, Sophisticated, Prestigious
antonyms: Plain, Dull, Drab, Unattractive, Ordinary, Unfashionable, Shabby
examples: She wore a glamorous silver dress to the ceremony. The job sounds glamorous, but it involves long hours. They spent a glamorous weekend at a seaside resort. Old photographs show the glamorous side of city life.
sindhiMeaning: دلڪش ۽ حسين، شان شوڪت وارو، عيش ۽ شهرت سان لاڳاپيل، عام حقيقت کان وڌيڪ پرڪشش نظر ايندڙ، نفاست ۽ وقار سان ڀرپور
urduMeaning: دلکش اور حسین، شان و شوکت والا، آسائش اور شہرت سے وابستہ، روزمرہ حقیقت سے زیادہ پرکشش نظر آنے والا، نفاست اور وقار سے بھرپور

englishMeaning: In an attractive, elegant, exciting, or sophisticated manner. In a way associated with luxury, fame, fashion, or prestige. In a manner that makes something seem more appealing or romantic than it really is.
synonyms: Elegantly, Stylishly, Attractively, Luxuriously, Dazzlingly, Sophisticatedly
antonyms: Plainly, Dully, Drably, Shabbily, Unattractively, Simply
examples: She dressed glamorously for the evening reception. The hotel was glamorously decorated for the awards night. The magazine portrayed city life glamorously. He arrived glamorously in a classic car.
sindhiMeaning: دلڪش نموني سان، شان شوڪت ۽ نفاست سان، عيش يا فيشن واري انداز ۾، ڪنهن شيءِ کي حقيقت کان وڌيڪ پرڪشش نموني پيش ڪندي
urduMeaning: دلکش انداز میں، شان و شوکت اور نفاست کے ساتھ، آسائش یا فیشن والے طریقے سے، کسی چیز کو حقیقت سے زیادہ پرکشش انداز میں پیش کرتے ہوئے

englishMeaning: To make a person, activity, or situation seem more attractive, exciting, or desirable than it truly is. To present something in an idealized, romantic, or luxurious way. To conceal risks, hardships, or unpleasant facts by emphasizing appealing features.
synonyms: Idealize, Romanticize, Beautify, Embellish, Exalt, Adorn, Enhance, Glorify
antonyms: Depict realistically, Devalue, Disparage, Expose, Criticize, Demystify, Tarnish
examples: Films should not glamorize violence. The campaign glamorized life in the armed forces. Social media can glamorize unrealistic lifestyles. The novel does not glamorize poverty or hardship.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شخص ڪم يا حالت کي حقيقت کان وڌيڪ دلڪش يا دلچسپ ڏيکارڻ، مثالي يا رومانوي انداز ۾ پيش ڪرڻ، نقصانن يا ڏکيائين کي لڪائي رڳو وڻندڙ پهلو نمايان ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی شخص کام یا حالت کو حقیقت سے زیادہ دلکش یا دلچسپ دکھانا، مثالی یا رومانوی انداز میں پیش کرنا، خطرات یا مشکلات چھپا کر صرف خوش نما پہلو نمایاں کرنا

englishMeaning: The act or process of making something difficult, mysterious, or confusing easier to understand. A clear explanation that removes secrecy, misconceptions, or unnecessary complexity. The exposure of the ordinary reality behind an intimidating subject.
synonyms: Clarification, Explanation, Simplification, Elucidation, Illumination, Interpretation, Disclosure
antonyms: Mystification, Confusion, Obscurity, Complication, Concealment, Bewilderment
examples: The book offers a useful demystification of modern economics. Demystification of the legal process helped the families. Her lecture began the demystification of genetic testing. Good science writing encourages demystification rather than confusion.
sindhiMeaning: ڏکئي يا پراسرار موضوع کي آسان ۽ سمجهڻ جهڙو بڻائڻ جو عمل، غلط فهمين رازن يا پيچيدگين کي صاف وضاحت سان ختم ڪرڻ، ڪنهن خوفناڪ لڳندڙ ڳالهه جي اصل حقيقت پڌري ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: مشکل یا پراسرار موضوع کو آسان اور قابل فہم بنانے کا عمل، غلط فہمیوں رازوں یا پیچیدگیوں کو واضح تشریح سے دور کرنا، خوفناک نظر آنے والی بات کی اصل حقیقت ظاہر ہونا

englishMeaning: The quality of being silly, empty, pointless, or lacking sense. A foolish, trivial, or meaningless remark, action, or idea. Intellectual emptiness or a lack of serious thought or value.
synonyms: Foolishness, Silliness, Absurdity, Nonsense, Emptiness, Stupidity, Triviality, Vacuity
antonyms: Wisdom, Sense, Intelligence, Seriousness, Substance, Meaning, Profundity
examples: She was tired of the inanity of the conversation. The article exposed the inanity of the proposal. Viewers complained about the program's endless inanity. His remark was an inanity that added nothing to the debate.
sindhiMeaning: بيوقوفي يا بي معنيٰ هجڻ جي حالت، بي مقصد ۽ خالي ڳالهه، احمقاڻو يا معمولي قول عمل يا خيال، سنجيده سوچ ۽ قدر جي کوٽ
urduMeaning: بے وقوف یا بے معنی ہونے کی حالت، بے مقصد اور کھوکھلی بات، احمقانہ یا معمولی قول عمل یا خیال، سنجیدہ سوچ اور قدر کی کمی

englishMeaning: In a silly, foolish, empty, or meaningless manner. In a way that lacks sense, purpose, substance, or intelligence. With a vacant or unthinking expression.
synonyms: Foolishly, Silly, Senselessly, Mindlessly, Vacantly, Absurdly, Pointlessly
antonyms: Wisely, Sensibly, Intelligently, Meaningfully, Thoughtfully, Purposefully
examples: He grinned inanely at the camera. They chatted inanely about nothing important. The character wandered inanely through the scene. She repeated the slogan inanely without questioning it.
sindhiMeaning: بيوقوفي سان، بي معنيٰ يا بي مقصد نموني، عقل سوچ يا وزن کان سواءِ، خالي ۽ بي خبر انداز ۾
urduMeaning: بے وقوفی سے، بے معنی یا بے مقصد انداز میں، عقل سوچ یا وزن کے بغیر، خالی اور بے خبری والے انداز میں

englishMeaning: Silly, foolish, or lacking sense. Empty of meaning, purpose, substance, or value. Tediously trivial, superficial, or intellectually vacant.
synonyms: Silly, Foolish, Senseless, Absurd, Vacuous, Empty, Trivial, Mindless, Pointless
antonyms: Sensible, Wise, Intelligent, Meaningful, Profound, Substantial, Thoughtful
examples: The meeting was delayed by several inane questions. I turned off the show because of its inane jokes. His inane response failed to address the problem. They spent an hour discussing an inane rumor.
sindhiMeaning: بيوقوفاڻو يا بي عقل، بي معنيٰ ۽ بي مقصد، اهميت يا وزن کان خالي، سطحي معمولي ۽ بور ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: احمقانہ یا بے عقل، بے معنی اور بے مقصد، اہمیت یا وزن سے خالی، سطحی معمولی اور اکتا دینے والا

englishMeaning: Not alive and having none of the qualities of living things. Showing no sign of movement, life, or consciousness. Lifeless or apparently dead. Grammatically, belonging to a noun class referring chiefly to nonliving things.
synonyms: Lifeless, Nonliving, Insentient, Motionless, Inert, Dead, Still, Unconscious
antonyms: Living, Animate, Alive, Sentient, Moving, Active, Conscious
examples: A stone is an inanimate object. The doll lay inanimate on the floor. The actor remained completely inanimate during the scene. Some languages distinguish animate nouns from inanimate nouns.
sindhiMeaning: بي جان يا غير جاندار، زندگي حرڪت يا شعور کان خالي، مئل يا مئل جهڙو، گرامر ۾ غير جاندار شين سان لاڳاپيل اسم جو درجو
urduMeaning: بے جان یا غیر جاندار، زندگی حرکت یا شعور سے خالی، مردہ یا مردہ سا، قواعد میں غیر جاندار چیزوں سے متعلق اسم کا درجہ

englishMeaning: A woman with whom someone is in love. A female lover, sweetheart, or beloved woman. A woman who is the object of romantic affection, especially in literary or humorous use.
synonyms: Beloved, Sweetheart, Lover, Girlfriend, Lady love, Paramour, Darling
antonyms: Enemy, Rival, Adversary, Stranger, Foe
examples: He dedicated the poem to his inamorata. The hero crossed the sea to find his inamorata. At dinner, he proudly introduced his inamorata. The old letters reveal how deeply he loved his inamorata.
sindhiMeaning: محبوب عورت، اها عورت جنهن سان ڪو پيار ڪري، عورت عاشق يا پياري، رومانوي محبت جو مرڪز بڻيل عورت خاص ڪري ادبي انداز ۾
urduMeaning: محبوب عورت، وہ عورت جس سے کوئی محبت کرے، خاتون محبوبہ یا پیاری، رومانوی محبت کا مرکز بننے والی عورت خصوصاً ادبی انداز میں

englishMeaning: Not recommended because it is unwise, unsafe, unsuitable, or likely to cause problems. Imprudent or inappropriate under the circumstances. Better avoided despite being possible or lawful.
synonyms: Unwise, Imprudent, Ill-advised, Unsuitable, Risky, Inappropriate, Foolhardy
antonyms: Advisable, Wise, Prudent, Sensible, Suitable, Recommended, Appropriate
examples: It is inadvisable to drive during the storm. Discussing private matters in public would be inadvisable. Doctors said that strenuous exercise was inadvisable for now. It may be legal, but it is still inadvisable.
sindhiMeaning: نامناسب يا غير دانشمنداڻو، صلاح ڏيڻ جهڙو نه، خطري يا مسئلي سبب پاسو ڪرڻ لائق، حالتن موجب اڻ وڻندڙ يا غير موزون
urduMeaning: نامناسب یا غیر دانش مندانہ، مشورے کے قابل نہیں، خطرے یا مسئلے کی وجہ سے گریز کے لائق، حالات کے مطابق غیر موزوں

englishMeaning: Not done deliberately or by conscious choice. Happening accidentally, inadvertently, or without a planned purpose. Causing an effect that the person did not mean to cause.
synonyms: Accidental, Inadvertent, Unplanned, Unintended, Unwitting, Incidental, Unconscious
antonyms: Intentional, Deliberate, Planned, Purposeful, Willful, Conscious, Premeditated
examples: The omission was unintentional. His unintentional joke made everyone laugh. An unintentional error changed the final total. The new rule had unintentional effects on small businesses.
sindhiMeaning: اڻ ڄاتل يا اڻ ارادي، ڄاڻي واڻي نه ڪيل، حادثاتي طور ٿيندڙ، بنا منصوبي يا مقصد جي، اهڙو نتيجو جيڪو پيدا ڪرڻ جو ارادو نه هجي
urduMeaning: غیر ارادی یا انجانے میں، جان بوجھ کر نہ کیا گیا، اتفاقاً ہونے والا، بغیر منصوبے یا مقصد کے، ایسا نتیجہ جس کا ارادہ نہ ہو

englishMeaning: Done deliberately and with a clear purpose. Planned or meant rather than accidental. Relating to a conscious aim, decision, or design. In philosophy, directed toward or representing an object.
synonyms: Deliberate, Purposeful, Planned, Conscious, Willful, Premeditated, Designed, Meant
antonyms: Accidental, Unintentional, Inadvertent, Unplanned, Unconscious, Random
examples: The change was intentional, not a mistake. She made an intentional effort to listen carefully. Intentional practice helped him improve quickly. The novel's repetition is an intentional stylistic choice.
sindhiMeaning: ڄاڻي واڻي ۽ ارادي سان ڪيل، واضح مقصد سان رٿيل، حادثاتي نه پر سوچيل، شعوري ارادي يا فيصلي سان لاڳاپيل، فلسفي ۾ ڪنهن شيءِ ڏانهن ذهن جي رخ سان لاڳاپيل

englishMeaning: Existing, conducted, or agreed between two or more governments. Relating to cooperation among national, regional, or local government bodies. Involving an organization whose members are governments.

englishMeaning: Getting involved in other people’s affairs without invitation or need. Tending to obstruct, disturb, or prevent a process. Producing unwanted interaction between signals, waves, or systems.

englishMeaning: A protein produced by body cells in response to viruses and other threats. Any of a group of signaling proteins that help regulate the immune system. A manufactured form of such a protein used to treat certain diseases.

englishMeaning: To prevent, delay, or make an activity more difficult. To disturb the operation or progress of something. To touch, alter, or tamper with something without permission. To sexually molest someone, especially in legal or formal usage.

antonyms: Assist, Help, Facilitate, Support, Promote, Leave untouched

sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ۾ رڪاوٽ يا دير وجهڻ، عمل يا واڌ کي خراب ڪرڻ، اجازت کان سواءِ هٿ چراند ڪرڻ، قانوني معنيٰ ۾ جنسي بدسلوڪي ڪرڻ

englishMeaning: To become involved in a situation or another person’s affairs without being asked. To intervene in a matter where one has no proper role or authority. To influence a process improperly.

antonyms: Stay out of, Avoid, Withdraw from, Ignore, Respect

englishMeaning: During the time between two events or periods. Until a particular event happens or a permanent arrangement is made. Temporarily or for the time being.
synonyms: Meanwhile, In the meantime, Temporarily, For now, Pending
antonyms: Permanently, Eventually, Thereafter, Subsequently

sindhiMeaning: ٻن واقعن جي وچ واري عرصي ۾، مستقل بندوبست ٿيڻ تائين، عارضي طور يا في الحال

englishMeaning: A spreading series of consequences caused by a single event or action. An indirect influence that moves outward and affects other people, places, or systems. A chain reaction resembling ripples spreading across water.

sindhiMeaning: پاڻيءَ جي مٿاڇري تي ننڍڙي لهر، لهر جهڙي نرم حرڪت يا شڪل، آهستي پکڙجندڙ آواز يا احساس، ننڍيون لهرون پيدا ڪرڻ، نرم نموني پکڙجڻ

englishMeaning: One after another in a repeated sequence. By turns between two states, actions, or people. Sometimes one way and sometimes another. A less common form of alternatively, meaning as another possibility.
synonyms: By turns, In rotation, Successively, Reciprocally, Alternatively
antonyms: Simultaneously, Together, Continuously, Concurrently
examples: The lights flashed alternately red and green. The baby laughed and cried alternately. The two nurses watched the patient alternately. Add the flour and milk alternately to the mixture.

englishMeaning: Pairs of angles formed on opposite sides of a transversal crossing two lines. Interior alternate angles lie between the two lines on opposite sides of the transversal. Exterior alternate angles lie outside the two lines on opposite sides. When the crossed lines are parallel, each pair of alternate angles is equal.
synonyms: Alternate interior angles, Alternate exterior angles, Z-angles, Equal angles
antonyms: Corresponding angles, Co-interior angles, Adjacent angles, Same-side angles
examples: The teacher asked us to identify the alternate angles. Alternate interior angles are equal when the lines are parallel. Draw a transversal to create two pairs of alternate exterior angles. She used alternate angles to prove that the lines were parallel.
sindhiMeaning: ٻن لڪيرن کي ڪاٽيندڙ ٽين لڪير جي سامهون پاسن تي ٺهندڙ ڪنڊون، اندروني متبادل ڪنڊون ٻن لڪيرن جي وچ ۾، ٻاهرين متبادل ڪنڊون ٻاهر، متوازي لڪيرن ۾ اهي برابر ٿين ٿيون
urduMeaning: دو خطوط کو کاٹنے والے خط کے مخالف جانب بننے والے زاویے، داخلی متبادل زاویے دونوں خطوط کے درمیان، خارجی متبادل زاویے باہر، متوازی خطوط میں یہ زاویے برابر ہوتے ہیں

englishMeaning: The process of reducing the number of data points, samples, pixels, or observations in a dataset or signal. Converting digital media to a lower resolution or sampling rate. Selecting a smaller representative subset from a larger body of data. In machine learning, reducing the size of a majority class to balance a dataset.
synonyms: Decimation, Subsampling, Resolution reduction, Data reduction, Compression
antonyms: Upsampling, Oversampling, Interpolation, Enlargement, Expansion
examples: Downsampling reduced the image file to a manageable size. The engineer used downsampling to lower the audio rate. Careful downsampling preserved the main trends in the data. Downsampling the majority class improved the model’s balance.
sindhiMeaning: ڊيٽا يا سگنل ۾ نمونن يا نقطن جو انگ گهٽائڻ، تصوير يا آواز جي ريزوليوشن يا سيمپلنگ ريٽ گهٽائڻ، وڏي ڊيٽا مان ننڍو نمائنده حصو چونڊڻ، مشين لرننگ ۾ اڪثريتي درجي کي گهٽائڻ
urduMeaning: ڈیٹا یا سگنل میں نمونوں یا نقاط کی تعداد کم کرنا، تصویر یا آواز کی ریزولوشن یا سیمپلنگ ریٹ گھٹانا، بڑے ڈیٹا سے چھوٹا نمائندہ حصہ منتخب کرنا، مشین لرننگ میں اکثریتی زمرہ کم کرنا

englishMeaning: The process of making something smaller. Reducing the number of employees to lower costs or restructure an organization. Moving to a smaller home, vehicle, or operation. Reducing the physical dimensions, capacity, or scale of a product or system.

urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو چھوٹا کرنا، اخراجات کم کرنے کے لیے ملازمین کی تعداد گھٹانا، چھوٹے گھر یا گاڑی میں منتقل ہونا، مصنوعات یا نظام کے حجم یا گنجائش کو کم کرنا

englishMeaning: To reduce the size, extent, or scope of something. To reduce the number of employees in an organization, usually to lower costs. To move to a smaller home or adopt a simpler lifestyle with fewer possessions. To replace something with a smaller version.
synonyms: Reduce, Shrink, Cut Back, Scale Down, Streamline, Trim
antonyms: Expand, Enlarge, Upsize, Grow, Increase

englishMeaning: The sale or distribution of articles, columns, television programs, radio shows, or other content to multiple outlets. englishMeaning: A figure of speech in which a part is used to represent the whole. A figure of speech in which the whole represents a part. An expression in which a specific term represents a broader class or a broad term represents something specific.
synonyms: Figure of Speech, Trope, Metonymy, Figurative Expression
antonyms: Literal Expression
examples: Using wheels to mean a car is an example of synecdoche. The teacher explained synecdoche with the phrase all hands on deck. Poets often use synecdoche to create vivid imagery. Calling workers hired hands is a familiar synecdoche.

englishMeaning: In a way that combines different elements so their total effect is greater than their separate effects. Through cooperative interaction. In a mutually reinforcing or complementary manner.

antonyms: Independently, Separately, Antagonistically

englishMeaning: The process of selecting and examining a representative portion of a larger group. The act of trying small amounts of food, drink, or other products. The process of measuring a continuous signal at regular intervals. The use of part of an existing sound recording in a new musical work. A selection or collection that represents a larger whole.

antonyms: Complete Enumeration, Census, Total Examination

englishMeaning: To reduce the sampling rate of a digital signal. To decrease the resolution or number of data points in an image, audio file, video, or dataset. To create a smaller or less detailed representation from higher-resolution data.

antonyms: Upsample, Upscale, Increase Resolution

englishMeaning: To say exactly what has been prepared or written. To follow an agreed plan, message, or procedure without deviation. To behave according to expectations rather than improvise or act independently.

sindhiMeaning: پاڙ/ بنياد/ سبب، ٻوٽي جو زمين هيٺ حصو جيڪو پاڻي جذب ڪري ۽ ٻوٽي کي جهلي، ڪنهن شيءِ جو بنيادي سبب اصل يا سرچشمو، خاندان ثقافت يا تاريخ سان تعلق، لفظ جو بنيادي جزو، رياضي ۾ مساوات کي پورو ڪندڙ قدر، پاڙون هڻڻ يا هڻائڻ، کوٽيندي يا ڦولهيندي ڳولڻ، ڪنهن جي حمايت يا همٿ افزائي ڪرڻ، زمين مان مڪمل ڪڍڻ
urduMeaning: جڑ/ بنیاد/ سبب، پودے کا زیرِ زمین حصہ جو پانی جذب کرے اور اسے قائم رکھے، کسی چیز کی بنیادی وجہ اصل یا ماخذ، خاندان ثقافت یا تاریخ سے تعلق، لفظ کا بنیادی جز، ریاضی میں مساوات پوری کرنے والی قدر، جڑ پکڑنا یا لگانا، کھودتے یا ٹٹولتے ہوئے تلاش کرنا، کسی کی حمایت یا حوصلہ افزائی کرنا، زمین سے مکمل طور پر نکالنا

englishMeaning: To support, encourage, or cheer for a person, team, or cause. To hope strongly that someone succeeds. To express loyalty during a competition or difficult situation. To give emotional encouragement to someone.
synonyms: Support, Cheer for, Back, Encourage, Champion, Applaud, Wish well
antonyms: Oppose, Boo, Discourage, Undermine, Root against, Condemn
examples: We will be rooting for you during the final interview. Most of the crowd rooted for the home team. I always root for the underdog in a close contest. Her whole family rooted for her recovery.
sindhiMeaning: ماڻهو ٽيم يا مقصد جي حمايت همٿ افزائي يا واکاڻ ڪرڻ، ڪنهن جي ڪاميابيءَ جي دل سان اميد رکڻ، مقابلي يا ڏکئي حالت ۾ وفاداري ڏيکارڻ، ڪنهن کي جذباتي سهارو ڏيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی شخص ٹیم یا مقصد کی حمایت حوصلہ افزائی یا داد دینا، کسی کی کامیابی کی دل سے امید کرنا، مقابلے یا مشکل حالت میں وفاداری دکھانا، کسی کو جذباتی حوصلہ دینا

englishMeaning: To find and remove something harmful, hidden, or unwanted completely. To discover someone or something after a thorough search. To eliminate corruption, disease, bad habits, or other deeply established problems. To pull a plant out by its roots.
synonyms: Eradicate, Eliminate, Uproot, Expose, Discover, Track down, Stamp out
antonyms: Plant, Conceal, Preserve, Protect, Encourage, Establish
examples: The inquiry aims to root out corruption in the department. Detectives rooted out the source of the false documents. Farmers must root out the infected plants. She worked hard to root out her habit of delaying tasks.
sindhiMeaning: لڪل نقصانڪار يا اڻ وڻندڙ شيءِ ڳولي مڪمل ختم ڪرڻ، گهري ڳولا کان پوءِ ڪنهن ماڻهو يا شيءِ کي لڀڻ، ڪرپشن بيماري بري عادت يا پاڙ پختي مسئلي کي ختم ڪرڻ، ٻوٽي کي پاڙن سميت ڪڍڻ
urduMeaning: چھپی ہوئی نقصان دہ یا ناپسندیدہ چیز تلاش کر کے مکمل ختم کرنا، گہری تلاش کے بعد کسی شخص یا چیز کو ڈھونڈ نکالنا، بدعنوانی بیماری بری عادت یا گہرے مسئلے کا خاتمہ کرنا، پودے کو جڑ سمیت نکالنا

englishMeaning: To search among things by moving them about, often untidily. To look for something in a drawer, bag, room, or similar place. To investigate informally or curiously. To dig or push around with the nose or snout, as an animal does.
synonyms: Rummage, Search, Scrounge, Hunt, Dig around, Poke around, Investigate
antonyms: Organize, Tidy, Ignore, Overlook, Leave untouched, Arrange
examples: She rooted around in her bag for the keys. I rooted around the attic and found an old photograph. The journalist began rooting around in the company’s history. Wild pigs rooted around beneath the trees.
sindhiMeaning: شيون اٿلائي پٿلائي اڪثر بي ترتيبي سان ڳولڻ، دراز ٿيلهي ڪمري يا اهڙي جاءِ ۾ شيءِ ڳولڻ، غير رسمي يا تجسس سان جاچ ڪرڻ، جانور وانگر نڪ يا ٿوتڻي سان کوٽڻ
urduMeaning: چیزیں الٹ پلٹ کر اکثر بے ترتیبی سے تلاش کرنا، دراز تھیلے کمرے یا ایسی جگہ میں کوئی چیز ڈھونڈنا، غیر رسمی یا تجسس سے تحقیق کرنا، جانور کی طرح ناک یا تھوتھنی سے زمین کھودنا

englishMeaning: To search carefully through a collection of things, often by moving them aside. To rummage in a container or place for a particular item. To examine records or information in detail to find something. To disturb an ordered group of objects while searching.
synonyms: Rummage through, Search through, Sift through, Comb through, Dig through, Examine
antonyms: Ignore, Bypass, Leave untouched, Arrange, Overlook, Avoid
examples: He rooted through the drawer for a spare battery. She rooted through old records to verify the date. The children rooted through the costume box excitedly. I had to root through dozens of emails to find the address.
sindhiMeaning: شين جي مجموعي ۾ شيون پاسي ڪري غور سان ڳولڻ، ڪنهن دٻي يا جاءِ ۾ خاص شيءِ لاءِ ڦولهڻ، ڪجهه ڳولڻ لاءِ رڪارڊ يا ڄاڻ تفصيل سان جاچڻ، ڳولا دوران ترتيب وار شين کي اٿلائڻ
urduMeaning: چیزوں کے مجموعے میں اشیا ہٹا کر غور سے تلاش کرنا، کسی ڈبے یا جگہ میں مخصوص چیز کے لیے کھوج لگانا، کچھ ڈھونڈنے کے لیے ریکارڈ یا معلومات تفصیل سے دیکھنا، تلاش کے دوران ترتیب شدہ اشیا الٹ پلٹ کرنا

englishMeaning: To pull a plant or tree completely out of the ground with its roots. To dig up soil or plants, often roughly. To discover hidden facts or objects through determined searching. To remove or destroy something that is firmly established.
synonyms: Uproot, Dig up, Tear out, Unearth, Expose, Eradicate, Remove
antonyms: Plant, Bury, Conceal, Establish, Preserve, Embed
examples: The storm rooted up several young trees. The pigs rooted up the grass near the fence. Reporters rooted up new evidence about the scandal. The reform was designed to root up long-standing discrimination.
sindhiMeaning: ٻوٽي يا وڻ کي پاڙن سميت زمين مان مڪمل ڪڍڻ، مٽي يا ٻوٽا اڪثر زور سان کوٽي ڪڍڻ، مسلسل ڳولا سان لڪل حقيقتون يا شيون معلوم ڪرڻ، پاڙ پختي شيءِ کي ختم ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: پودے یا درخت کو جڑوں سمیت زمین سے مکمل نکالنا، مٹی یا پودے اکثر سختی سے کھود نکالنا، مسلسل تلاش سے چھپی حقیقتیں یا چیزیں دریافت کرنا، مضبوطی سے قائم چیز کو ختم کرنا

englishMeaning: With even stronger reason. All the more certainly because a stated fact or conclusion provides a stronger case. By an argument showing that if one proposition is true, another more obvious or compelling proposition must also be true. A Latin expression used in logic, law, and formal writing.
synonyms: With stronger reason, All the more, Even more certainly, By greater force, Necessarily
antonyms: A minori, With weaker reason, Less certainly, Doubtfully, Conversely
examples: If a child cannot enter, a fortiori an unaccompanied infant cannot enter. The law protects private letters and, a fortiori, confidential medical records. A minor error requires correction; a fortiori, a serious falsehood does. If the cheaper option is unaffordable, a fortiori the luxury model is beyond our budget.
sindhiMeaning: اڃا وڌيڪ مضبوط سبب سان، بيان ڪيل حقيقت يا نتيجي سبب وڌيڪ يقيني طور، اهڙو منطقي دليل جنهن ۾ هڪ ڳالهه صحيح هجي ته وڌيڪ واضح ڳالهه لازمي صحيح ٿئي، منطق قانون ۽ رسمي لکڻي ۾ استعمال ٿيندڙ لاطيني اصطلاح
urduMeaning: اور بھی مضبوط وجہ کے ساتھ، بیان شدہ حقیقت یا نتیجے کی بنا پر زیادہ یقینی طور پر، ایسا منطقی استدلال جس میں ایک بات درست ہو تو زیادہ واضح بات لازماً درست ہو، منطق قانون اور رسمی تحریر میں استعمال ہونے والی لاطینی اصطلاح

englishMeaning: Endlessly. Again and again in the same way; without limit or end.
synonyms: Endlessly, Forever, Perpetually, Indefinitely
antonyms: Briefly, Momentarily
examples: The debate continued ad infinitum without reaching any conclusion. He repeated the same excuse ad infinitum until no one believed him anymore. The committee argued the point ad infinitum, wasting hours of everyone's time. She joked that the meeting could go on ad infinitum if no one called it to a close.
sindhiMeaning: بي انت، لامحدود طرح، هميشه لاءِ، لڳاتار بغير ڪنهن حد جي
urduMeaning: لامتناہی، بے انتہا، بلا توقف، ہمیشہ کے لیے بغیر کسی حد کے

englishMeaning: Mentioned or referred to previously in a text or speech.
synonyms: Aforesaid, Previously Mentioned, Above-Mentioned, Preceding
antonyms: Following, Subsequent
examples: The aforementioned witness confirmed the details of the incident to the police. Please refer to the aforementioned document for further clarification. The aforementioned rules apply to all employees without exception. As stated in the aforementioned paragraph, the contract will expire next month.
sindhiMeaning: مٿي ذڪر ٿيل، اڳ ۾ بيان ڪيل، مٿي بيان ڪيل شيءِ يا شخص
urduMeaning: مذکورہ بالا، پیشتر بیان کردہ، اوپر ذکر کیا گیا

englishMeaning: Into conflict or difficulty with. In violation of rules, customs, or the law, especially in the phrase ‘run afoul of’.
synonyms: In Conflict, At Odds, In Violation, Entangled
antonyms: In Accord, Compliant, Conforming
examples: The company ran afoul of environmental regulations and faced heavy fines. He ran afoul of the law after failing to pay his taxes. Their new policy ran afoul of local customs and caused public outrage. She was careful not to run afoul of her strict manager.
sindhiMeaning: ٽڪراءَ يا تڪرار ۾، قانون يا اصولن جي خلاف ورزي ۾، مشڪل ۾ ڦاٿل
urduMeaning: تصادم یا تنازع میں، قانون یا قواعد کی خلاف ورزی میں، مشکل میں پھنسا ہوا

englishMeaning: Thought, intention, or planning formed in advance, especially before committing an act. Premeditation, chiefly in the legal phrase ‘malice aforethought’.
synonyms: Premeditation, Forethought, Deliberation, Prior Intent
antonyms: Impulse, Spontaneity, Afterthought
examples: The prosecutor argued that the murder was committed with malice aforethought. The evidence suggested aforethought rather than a sudden impulse. Courts distinguish between an impulsive act and one committed with aforethought. His careful preparations showed clear aforethought.
sindhiMeaning: اڳواٽ سوچ، اڳ ۾ ڪيل ارادو، سوچي سمجهي ڪيل رٿ، قانوني طور اڳواٽ بدنيتي
urduMeaning: پیشگی سوچ، پہلے سے کیا گیا ارادہ، سوچا سمجھا منصوبہ، قانونی طور پر پہلے سے قائم بد نیتی

englishMeaning: Goodbye, especially a formal, emotional, or final farewell. An expression used when parting.
synonyms: Farewell, Goodbye, Valediction, Leave-Taking
antonyms: Greeting, Welcome, Salutation
examples: She bid adieu to her friends before boarding the plane. With a heavy heart, he said his final adieu to the old house. They exchanged a tearful adieu at the train station. He waved adieu as the ship slowly left the harbor.
sindhiMeaning: الوداع، خدا حافظ، رسمي يا آخري موڪلاڻي، جدا ٿيڻ وقت چيو ويندڙ لفظ
urduMeaning: الوداع، خدا حافظ، رسمی یا آخری رخصتی، جدائی کے وقت کہا جانے والا لفظ

englishMeaning: Relating to, consisting of, or containing animal fat. Fatty connective tissue that stores energy, insulates the body, and cushions organs.
synonyms: Fatty, Fat, Lipid-Rich, Corpulent
antonyms: Lean, Fat-Free, Nonadipose
examples: Adipose tissue helps insulate the body and store energy for later use. The scan showed excess adipose tissue around the abdomen. Researchers studied how adipose cells respond to insulin. The fish has a small adipose fin near its tail.
sindhiMeaning: چرٻي سان لاڳاپيل، چرٻيءَ مان ٺهيل، جسم ۾ توانائي ذخيرو ڪندڙ ۽ عضون کي بچائيندڙ چرٻيءَ وارو بافتو
urduMeaning: چربی سے متعلق، چربی پر مشتمل، جسم میں توانائی ذخیرہ کرنے اور اعضا کو تحفظ دینے والا چربی دار بافتہ

englishMeaning: Out of nothing. Created without pre-existing material, especially in philosophical or theological discussion.
synonyms: From Nothing, Out Of Nothing, Without Prior Material
antonyms: From Existing Matter, From Something
examples: Many religious traditions teach that the universe was created ex nihilo. Philosophers have long debated whether anything can truly arise ex nihilo. The theologian explained the doctrine of creation ex nihilo to his students. The artist seemed to create an entire imaginary world ex nihilo.
sindhiMeaning: عدم مان، ڪنهن اڳ موجود مادي کان سواءِ پيدا ٿيل، فلسفي يا مذهب ۾ ڪجهه به نه هئڻ مان تخليق
urduMeaning: عدم سے، کسی پہلے سے موجود مادے کے بغیر پیدا کیا گیا، فلسفے یا مذہب میں نیست سے تخلیق

englishMeaning: To take part in an activity casually, occasionally, or without serious commitment. To try a subject or pursuit only superficially.
synonyms: Experiment With, Tinker With, Toy With, Sample, Try
antonyms: Specialize In, Master, Commit To, Devote Oneself To
examples: He likes to dabble in painting during his free weekends. She dabbled in stock trading before deciding it was not for her. Many students dabble in different hobbies before finding their true passion. He has dabbled in politics but never pursued it seriously.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ۾ هلڪي يا غير سنجيده دلچسپي وٺڻ، ڪڏهن ڪڏهن شوق طور ڪرڻ، ڪنهن موضوع کي رڳو مٿاڇري طور آزمائڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کام میں سرسری یا غیر سنجیدہ دلچسپی لینا، کبھی کبھار شوق کے طور پر کرنا، کسی موضوع کو محض سطحی طور پر آزمانا

englishMeaning: To suddenly become very angry with someone and speak or shout harshly at them.
synonyms: Explode At, Snap At, Yell At, Lash Out At, Berate
antonyms: Speak Calmly To, Reassure, Console, Praise
examples: She blew up at her coworker after a minor misunderstanding. He rarely loses his temper, but yesterday he blew up at his brother. The coach blew up at the team for their careless mistakes. Try not to blow up at the children when they make small errors.
sindhiMeaning: اوچتو ڪنهن تي سخت ڪاوڙجي پوڻ، ڪنهن تي رڙيون ڪرڻ، غصي ۾ سخت لفظ چوڻ
urduMeaning: اچانک کسی پر شدید غصے سے بھڑک اٹھنا، کسی پر چیخنا، غصے میں سخت باتیں کہنا

englishMeaning: The liquid naturally contained in fruit, vegetables, or meat. A drink made from fruit or vegetable liquid. The flavorful liquid released from food during cooking. Informally, electricity, energy, power, influence, or vitality. Informally, alcohol, fuel, or performance-enhancing steroids. To extract juice from something. To add juice, energy, power, or excitement to something.
synonyms: Liquid, Extract, Sap, Nectar, Power, Energy, Influence, Squeeze
antonyms: Pulp, Dryness, Powerlessness, Weakness, Drain
examples: She squeezed fresh orange juice for breakfast. The battery ran out of juice halfway through the trip. His connections gave him enough juice to secure a meeting. Juice the lemons before adding the liquid to the sauce.
sindhiMeaning: ميوي  ڀاڄي يا گوشت ۾ موجود قدرتي رس، ميون يا ڀاڄين جي رس مان ٺهيل مشروب، پچائڻ دوران نڪرندڙ ذائقيدار رس، غير رسمي طور بجلي يا توانائي، اثر رسوخ يا جوش، غير رسمي طور شراب، ٻارڻ يا طاقت وڌائيندڙ اسٽيرائيڊ، رس ڪڍڻ، طاقت يا دلچسپي وڌائڻ
urduMeaning: پھل  سبزی یا گوشت میں موجود قدرتی رس، پھل یا سبزی کے رس سے بنا مشروب، پکانے کے دوران نکلنے والا ذائقے دار عرق، غیر رسمی طور پر بجلی یا توانائی، اثر و رسوخ یا جوش، غیر رسمی طور پر شراب، ایندھن یا کارکردگی بڑھانے والے اسٹیرائیڈ، رس نکالنا، طاقت یا دلچسپی بڑھانا

englishMeaning: To make something more lively, exciting, attractive, powerful, or effective. To increase power, energy, speed, or performance. To stimulate or enliven a person or group.
synonyms: Boost, Enhance, Energize, Enliven, Intensify, Amplify
antonyms: Weaken, Dampen, Dull, Reduce, Drain
examples: The designers juiced up the old website with clearer images and livelier language. The mechanic juiced up the engine to improve its performance. A short pep talk juiced up the team before the final. The chef juiced up the bland sauce with fresh herbs and spices.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي وڌيڪ جاندار  دلچسپ يا پرڪشش بڻائڻ، طاقت  توانائي  رفتار يا ڪارڪردگي وڌائڻ، ڪنهن شخص يا ٽولي ۾ جوش پيدا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو زیادہ جاندار  دلچسپ یا پرکشش بنانا، طاقت  توانائی  رفتار یا کارکردگی بڑھانا، کسی شخص یا گروہ میں جوش پیدا کرنا

englishMeaning: To include a fact, amount, possibility, or circumstance when making a calculation, plan, judgment, or decision. To take something into account.
synonyms: Include, Consider, Account For, Incorporate, Allow For
antonyms: Exclude, Ignore, Disregard, Overlook
examples: You need to factor in the cost of shipping before setting the final price. The planners factored in bad weather when scheduling the outdoor event. She factored in her commute time when planning her daily routine. Investors must factor in inflation when calculating long-term returns.
sindhiMeaning: حساب  رٿا  راءِ يا فيصلي ۾ ڪنهن حقيقت  رقم  امڪان يا حالت کي شامل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه کي ڌيان ۾ رکڻ
urduMeaning: حساب  منصوبے  رائے یا فیصلے میں کسی حقیقت  رقم   امکان یا صورت حال کو شامل کرنا، کسی بات کو مدنظر رکھنا

englishMeaning: A circumstance, fact, influence, or element that contributes to a result. A number or algebraic expression that divides another exactly or is multiplied by another to produce a given product. A level of multiplication or scale. A commercial agent or a business that buys and collects accounts receivable. To express a number or algebraic expression as a product of factors. To act as a factor in a result.
synonyms: Element, Component, Cause, Influence, Divisor, Agent, Constituent
antonyms: Whole, Result, Product, Irrelevance
examples: Price was a major factor in her decision to buy the smaller car. Seven is a factor of twenty-one because it divides it exactly. Students learned to factor quadratic expressions in class. The company sold its unpaid invoices to a factor for immediate cash.
sindhiMeaning: نتيجي ۾ حصو وٺندڙ حالت  حقيقت  اثر يا عنصر، رياضي ۾ اهڙو عدد يا اظهارو جيڪو ٻئي عدد کي پورو ورهائي يا ضرب سان گهربل حاصل ڏئي، واڌ يا پيماني جو درجو، واپاري ايجنٽ يا واجب الادا رقمون خريد ڪندڙ ادارو، عدد يا اظهاريي کي ضربي جزن ۾ ورهائڻ، نتيجي تي اثرانداز ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: کسی نتیجے میں کردار ادا کرنے والی صورت حال  حقیقت  اثر یا عنصر، ریاضی میں ایسا عدد یا اظہاریہ جو دوسرے عدد کو پورا تقسیم کرے یا ضرب سے مطلوبہ حاصل دے، ضرب یا پیمانے کی مقدار، تجارتی ایجنٹ یا واجب الوصول رقوم خریدنے والا ادارہ، عدد یا اظہاریے کو ضربی اجزاء میں تقسیم کرنا، نتیجے پر اثر انداز ہونا

englishMeaning: To be one of the facts, circumstances, or influences that help produce a result. To include something as a contributing element in a calculation, plan, judgment, or decision.
synonyms: Contribute To, Enter Into, Influence, Affect, Be Included In

englishMeaning: Material used to reduce the transfer of heat, sound, or electricity. The act or process of protecting something by insulating it. Separation or protection from outside influence, hardship, or contact. A protective layer around a wire, building, or object.
synonyms: Lagging, Padding, Shielding, Isolation, Protection, Barrier
antonyms: Conduction, Exposure, Connection, Contact, Vulnerability
examples: Good roof insulation keeps the house warm in winter. The electrician found a crack in the cable's insulation. Thick walls provide some insulation from street noise. Wealth can create insulation from everyday hardships.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي جي منتقلي گهٽائڻ وارو مادو، بچاءَ لاءِ الڳ ڪرڻ جو عمل، ٻاهرين اثر رابطي يا تڪليف کان تحفظ، تار عمارت يا شيءِ چوڌاري حفاظتي تهه
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرنے والا مادہ، حفاظت کے لیے الگ کرنے کا عمل، بیرونی اثر رابطے یا مشکل سے تحفظ، تار عمارت یا چیز کے گرد حفاظتی تہہ

englishMeaning: A hormone made by the pancreas that helps glucose move from the blood into cells. A medicine containing this hormone used to control blood sugar in people with diabetes. A protein hormone that regulates carbohydrate and fat metabolism.
synonyms: Pancreatic hormone, Blood-sugar-regulating hormone, Antidiabetic hormone
antonyms: Glucagon, Insulin deficiency, Hyperglycemic hormone
examples: The pancreas releases insulin after a meal. She takes insulin to manage her diabetes. Insulin helps the body's cells absorb glucose. The doctor adjusted his insulin dose carefully.
sindhiMeaning: لبلبي مان ٺهندڙ هارمون جيڪو رت جي گلوڪوز کي خلين ۾ پهچائڻ ۾ مدد ڪري، ذيابيطس ۾ رت جي کنڊ سنڀالڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ دوا، ڪاربوهائيڊريٽ ۽ چرٻي جي ميٽابولزم کي ضابطو ڪندڙ پروٽين هارمون
urduMeaning: لبلبے میں بننے والا ہارمون جو خون کی گلوکوز کو خلیوں میں پہنچانے میں مدد دے، ذیابیطس میں خون کی شکر قابو کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والی دوا، کاربوہائیڈریٹ اور چکنائی کے استحالے کو منظم کرنے والا پروٹین ہارمون

englishMeaning: A material or object that does not readily conduct heat, sound, or electricity. A device used to support and separate electrical conductors safely. A person or thing that protects another from outside influence or change.
synonyms: Nonconductor, Dielectric, Barrier, Protector, Shield
antonyms: Conductor, Conduit, Transmitter, Carrier
examples: Rubber is a good electrical insulator. Ceramic insulators support the power lines. The foam acts as an insulator against heat. Her close family was an insulator from public pressure.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي آساني سان نه هلائيندڙ مادو يا شيءِ، برقي تارن کي محفوظ سهارو ۽ الڳ رکڻ وارو اوزار، ٻاهرين اثر يا تبديلي کان بچائيندڙ ماڻهو يا شيءِ
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی آسانی سے منتقل نہ کرنے والا مادہ یا چیز، برقی تاروں کو محفوظ سہارا دے کر الگ رکھنے والا آلہ، بیرونی اثر یا تبدیلی سے بچانے والا شخص یا چیز

englishMeaning: Serving to reduce the transfer of heat, sound, or electricity. Protecting or separating someone or something from outside influence. The present participle of insulate.
synonyms: Shielding, Protecting, Isolating, Nonconductive, Heat-resistant
antonyms: Conducting, Exposing, Connecting, Transmitting
examples: The workers are insulating the attic today. Wool has excellent insulating properties. She wore an insulating layer beneath her coat. The policy is insulating small firms from sudden price changes.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي جي منتقلي گهٽائيندڙ، ٻاهرين اثر يا رابطي کان بچائيندڙ يا الڳ ڪندڙ، عايق بڻائڻ جو عمل، انسوليٽ ڪرڻ وارو
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرنے والا، بیرونی اثر یا رابطے سے بچانے یا الگ کرنے والا، عایق بنانے کا عمل، انسولیٹ کرنے والا

englishMeaning: To cover or surround something with material that reduces heat, sound, or electrical transfer. To protect someone or something from outside influence, pressure, or harm. To isolate or separate from contact.
synonyms: Isolate, Protect, Shield, Separate, Cushion, Weatherproof
antonyms: Expose, Connect, Conduct, Uncover, Endanger
examples: We need to insulate the walls before winter. Plastic is used to insulate electrical wires. Parents cannot completely insulate children from disappointment. The fund helps insulate farmers from sudden market losses.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي اهڙي مادّي سان ڍڪڻ جيڪو گرمي آواز يا بجلي گهٽ منتقل ڪري، ٻاهرين اثر دٻاءَ يا نقصان کان بچائڻ، رابطي کان الڳ ڪرڻ، عايق بڻائڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو ایسے مادے سے ڈھانپنا جو حرارت آواز یا بجلی کی منتقلی کم کرے، بیرونی اثر دباؤ یا نقصان سے بچانا، رابطے سے الگ کرنا، عایق بنانا

englishMeaning: Covered or protected with material that reduces heat, sound, or electrical transfer. Protected from outside influence, pressure, or harm. Separated from direct contact or communication.
synonyms: Protected, Shielded, Isolated, Padded, Nonconductive
antonyms: Exposed, Unprotected, Connected, Conductive, Vulnerable
examples: The insulated bottle kept the water cold all day. Always use insulated tools near live wires. The village remained insulated from the conflict. His position left him insulated from ordinary financial worries.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي آواز يا بجلي روڪيندڙ مادّي سان ڍڪيل، ٻاهرين اثر دٻاءَ يا نقصان کان محفوظ، سڌي رابطي يا لاڳاپي کان الڳ، عايق ڪيل
urduMeaning: حرارت آواز یا بجلی روکنے والے مادے سے ڈھکا ہوا، بیرونی اثر دباؤ یا نقصان سے محفوظ، براہ راست رابطے یا تعلق سے الگ، عایق کیا ہوا

englishMeaning: Making a particular result likely or easier to achieve. Helpful or favorable to a desired outcome. Providing suitable conditions for something to happen or develop.
synonyms: Favorable, Helpful, Beneficial, Supportive, Advantageous, Promoting
antonyms: Unfavorable, Harmful, Obstructive, Detrimental, Inhibiting
examples: A quiet room is conducive to careful study. Regular feedback creates an environment conducive to growth. The warm, wet climate is conducive to mosquito breeding. Mutual respect is conducive to productive discussion.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن نتيجي کي ممڪن يا آسان بڻائيندڙ، گهربل نتيجي لاءِ مددگار يا سازگار، واڌ يا واقعي لاءِ مناسب حالتون پيدا ڪندڙ، موافق
urduMeaning: کسی نتیجے کو ممکن یا آسان بنانے والا، مطلوبہ نتیجے کے لیے مددگار یا سازگار، نشوونما یا وقوع کے لیے مناسب حالات پیدا کرنے والا، موافق

englishMeaning: The ability of a material or component to allow electric current to flow. The reciprocal of electrical resistance, measured in siemens. The capacity to transmit heat, electricity, or another form of energy.
synonyms: Conductivity, Admittance, Electrical conduction, Current-carrying capacity
antonyms: Resistance, Impedance, Insulation, Nonconductance
examples: The technician measured the conductance of the wire. Conductance increases when electrical resistance decreases. The sensor detects small changes in skin conductance. Salt water has greater conductance than pure water.
sindhiMeaning: مادّي يا جز جي برقي وهڪري کي گذرڻ ڏيڻ جي صلاحيت، برقي مزاحمت جو اُلٽو مقدار جيڪو سيمينس ۾ ماپجي، گرمي بجلي يا توانائي منتقل ڪرڻ جي سگهه، چالڪتا
urduMeaning: مادے یا جزو کی برقی رو کو گزرنے دینے کی صلاحیت، برقی مزاحمت کا معکوس جو سیمنز میں ناپا جاتا ہے، حرارت بجلی یا توانائی منتقل کرنے کی قابلیت، موصلیت کے برعکس چالکتا

englishMeaning: A very large vulture native to the Americas. Either of two species, the Andean condor and the California condor. A broad-winged scavenging bird that feeds mainly on carrion.
synonyms: Vulture, New World vulture, Andean condor, California condor, Scavenger
antonyms: Prey bird, Small songbird, Herbivorous bird
examples: An Andean condor soared above the canyon. The condor uses rising air to remain aloft. Conservationists released a young California condor into the wild. We watched the huge condor spread its wings.
sindhiMeaning: آمريڪا جو تمام وڏو ڳجهو، اينڊين ڪنڊور يا ڪيليفورنيا ڪنڊور مان ڪو هڪ پکي، ويڪرن پرن وارو مردار خور پکي، مئل جانورن جو گوشت کائيندڙ وڏو پکي

englishMeaning: A building or complex containing individually owned homes and jointly owned common areas. An individually owned apartment or unit in such a development. A system of property ownership combining private units with shared facilities. Joint control of a territory by two or more states, especially historically.
synonyms: Condo, Apartment unit, Strata unit, Commonhold, Residential unit
antonyms: Detached house, Single-family home, Sole ownership, Separate property
examples: They bought a condominium near the city center. Residents share the condominium's pool and garden. The condominium association approved the repairs. She rents out her two-bedroom condominium during the summer.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي عمارت يا رهائشي مجموعو جنهن جا گهر الڳ مالڪن جا ۽ عام حصا گڏيل ملڪيت هجن، اهڙي عمارت ۾ ذاتي ملڪيت وارو فليٽ، نجي يونٽن ۽ گڏيل سهولتن وارو ملڪيت جو نظام، ٻن يا وڌيڪ رياستن جي گڏيل حڪمراني وارو علائقو
urduMeaning: ایسی عمارت یا رہائشی مجموعہ جس کے گھر الگ مالکان کے اور مشترکہ حصے اجتماعی ملکیت ہوں، ایسی عمارت میں ذاتی ملکیت والا فلیٹ، نجی یونٹوں اور مشترکہ سہولیات پر مبنی ملکیتی نظام، دو یا زیادہ ریاستوں کے مشترکہ اقتدار والا علاقہ

englishMeaning: Able to conduct heat, electricity, or sound. Relating to the transfer of energy through a material. Tending to transmit rather than insulate.
synonyms: Conducting, Transmissive, Current-carrying, Heat-conducting, Electrically active
antonyms: Nonconductive, Insulating, Resistive, Dielectric
examples: Copper is highly conductive. The conductive coating carries electricity across the surface. Wet soil is more conductive than dry soil. Wear protective gloves when handling conductive materials near live circuits.
sindhiMeaning: گرمي بجلي يا آواز منتقل ڪرڻ جي قابل، مادّي مان توانائي جي منتقلي سان لاڳاپيل، عايق ٿيڻ بدران وهڪرو گذاريندڙ، چالڪ
urduMeaning: حرارت بجلی یا آواز منتقل کرنے کے قابل، مادے کے ذریعے توانائی کی منتقلی سے متعلق، عایق ہونے کے بجائے رو گزرنے دینے والا، موصل

englishMeaning: The ability of a substance to conduct electricity, heat, or sound. A measure of how readily energy passes through a material. Electrical conductance adjusted for a material's dimensions.
synonyms: Conductance, Transmission capacity, Electrical conduction, Thermal conduction
antonyms: Resistivity, Resistance, Insulation, Nonconductivity
examples: Copper has high electrical conductivity. The lab tested the thermal conductivity of the insulation. Water quality can be estimated by measuring conductivity. Temperature affects the conductivity of many materials.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن مادّي جي بجلي گرمي يا آواز منتقل ڪرڻ جي صلاحيت، توانائي جي مادّي مان گذرڻ جي آسانيءَ جو ماپ، مادّي جي ماپن مطابق برقي چالڪتا، وهڪرو گذارڻ جي خاصيت
urduMeaning: کسی مادے کی بجلی حرارت یا آواز منتقل کرنے کی صلاحیت، توانائی کے مادے سے گزرنے کی آسانی کا پیمانہ، مادے کے ابعاد کے مطابق برقی چالکتا، رو گزارنے کی خصوصیت

englishMeaning: The transfer of heat or electricity through a substance without movement of the substance as a whole. The act or process of carrying or transmitting something. In physiology, the transmission of impulses through nerves or tissue.
synonyms: Transmission, Transfer, Conveyance, Conducting, Propagation
antonyms: Insulation, Isolation, Resistance, Interruption
examples: Heat moves through the metal rod by conduction. Copper wires allow efficient electrical conduction. Nerve conduction carries signals to the muscles. Thick gloves reduce the conduction of heat from your hands.
sindhiMeaning: مادّي جي مجموعي حرڪت کان سواءِ ان مان گرمي يا بجلي جي منتقلي، ڪنهن شيءِ کي کڻي يا منتقل ڪرڻ جو عمل، اعصاب يا بافتن مان تحريڪ جي روانگي، گرمي يا برقي چال
urduMeaning: مادے کی مجموعی حرکت کے بغیر اس میں حرارت یا بجلی کی منتقلی، کسی چیز کو لے جانے یا منتقل کرنے کا عمل، اعصاب یا بافتوں میں تحریک کی ترسیل، حرارتی یا برقی ایصال

englishMeaning: A person with an intense love of knowledge and learning. Someone strongly driven to discover, understand, and acquire information. A person characterized by intellectual curiosity, especially to an unusually high degree.
synonyms: Knowledge lover, Philomath, Inquisitive person, Intellectual, Lifelong learner
antonyms: Ignoramus, Anti-intellectual, Knowledge-averse person, Uncurious person
examples: As an epistemophiliac, she is always enrolled in a new course. The library is a natural refuge for an epistemophiliac. His friends call him an epistemophiliac because he asks questions about everything. An epistemophiliac often enjoys exploring subjects far beyond a formal curriculum.
sindhiMeaning: علم ۽ سکيا سان شديد محبت رکندڙ ماڻهو، ڄاڻ حاصل ڪرڻ ۽ سمجهڻ جي زبردست خواهش رکندڙ شخص، تمام گهڻي ذهني تجسس وارو ماڻهو، علم جو عاشق
urduMeaning: علم اور سیکھنے سے شدید محبت رکھنے والا شخص، معلومات حاصل کرنے اور سمجھنے کی زبردست خواہش رکھنے والا فرد، بہت زیادہ ذہنی تجسس رکھنے والا انسان، علم کا عاشق

englishMeaning: Relating to the ideas, customs, arts, beliefs, and social behavior of a society. Connected with intellectual and artistic activity. Relating to the cultivation of microorganisms, plants, or cells in controlled conditions. Shared by or characteristic of a particular group.
synonyms: Social, Ethnic, Traditional, Artistic, Intellectual, Civilizational
antonyms: Uncultural, Noncultural, Natural, Biological, Philistine
examples: The festival celebrates the region's cultural heritage. Cultural differences can shape how people communicate. The city offers many cultural events throughout the year. Researchers used cultural methods to identify the bacteria.
sindhiMeaning: سماج جي خيالن رسمن فنن عقيدن ۽ سماجي روين سان لاڳاپيل، علمي ۽ فني سرگرمين سان تعلق رکندڙ، ڪنهن خاص گروهه جي گڏيل سڃاڻپ وارو، جراثيم ٻوٽن يا خلين جي سنڀاليل واڌ سان لاڳاپيل
urduMeaning: معاشرے کے خیالات رسموں فنون عقائد اور سماجی رویوں سے متعلق، علمی اور فنی سرگرمیوں سے وابستہ، کسی خاص گروہ کی مشترکہ شناخت والا، جراثیم پودوں یا خلیات کی قابو شدہ افزائش سے متعلق

englishMeaning: In a way that relates to the customs, beliefs, arts, or social behavior of a society. From the perspective of a particular culture. In terms of intellectual or artistic development. By means of laboratory culture, in scientific contexts.
synonyms: Socially, Traditionally, Ethnically, Artistically, Civilizationally
antonyms: Naturally, Biologically, Individually, Unculturally

englishMeaning: Income received by a business from its normal activities, especially sales, before expenses are deducted. Money collected by a government through taxes, fees, and other sources. The total amount of money generated by an organization or activity. Historically, a return or yield from property.
synonyms: Income, Turnover, Sales, Receipts, Proceeds, Earnings, Yield
antonyms: Expenditure, Expense, Cost, Loss, Outlay
examples: The company reported record revenue this quarter. Ticket sales provide most of the theater's revenue. Tax revenue funds public services. Advertising has become an important revenue stream for the website.

urduMeaning: کاروبار کو اخراجات منہا کرنے سے پہلے فروخت یا معمول کی سرگرمیوں سے حاصل آمدنی، حکومت کو ٹیکس فیس اور دیگر ذرائع سے ملنے والی رقم، ادارے یا سرگرمی سے پیدا ہونے والی کل رقم، جائیداد سے حاصل ہونے والی آمد یا پیداوار

englishMeaning: A small piece or short extract of text, speech, music, video, or code. A brief piece of information or news. A reusable fragment of computer code. A very small part cut or taken from something.
synonyms: Extract, Excerpt, Fragment, Clip, Bit, Scrap, Passage
antonyms: Whole, Entirety, Complete work, Full version
examples: She read a short snippet from the interview. The trailer includes snippets of the film's best scenes. I saved the code snippet for later use. He shared a snippet of news during lunch.

urduMeaning: متن تقریر موسیقی ویڈیو یا کوڈ کا چھوٹا ٹکڑا، مختصر معلومات یا خبر، دوبارہ استعمال ہونے والا کمپیوٹر کوڈ کا حصہ، کسی چیز سے کاٹا یا لیا گیا بہت چھوٹا جز

englishMeaning: The process of earning money from an asset, product, service, audience, or activity. The conversion of something into a source of revenue. The act of converting an asset or debt into money. The formal adoption of something as legal currency, in economic usage.

antonyms: Demonetization, Decommercialization, Free distribution, Noncommercial use
examples: The app's monetization relies on monthly subscriptions. Creators discussed monetization options for their videos. Careful monetization can generate revenue without annoying users. The government considered the monetization of certain assets.
sindhiMeaning: اثاثي پيداوار خدمت سامعين يا سرگرمي مان پئسا ڪمائڻ جو عمل، ڪنهن شيءِ کي آمدني جو ذريعو بڻائڻ، اثاثي يا قرض کي نقد رقم ۾ بدلائڻ، ڪنهن شيءِ کي قانوني ڪرنسي بڻائڻ جو عمل
