examples: Rainwater is diverted into large storage tanks. He diverted his anger into hard work at the gym. The government diverted extra funds into education. Engineers diverted the stream into a new canal.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي نئين هنڌ يا واهه ۾ موڙڻ، پئسوn  توانائي يا محنت ٻئي ڪم ۾ لڳائڻ، درياهه يا ٽريفڪ جو رخ ٻئي رستي ڏانهن ڦيرائڻ، ڌيان يا صلاحيت نئين سرگرمي ۾ لڳائڻ، وسيلا ڪنهن خاص منصوبي ۾ منتقل ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو نئی جگہ یا نالی میں موڑنا، رقم  توانائی یا محنت کو دوسرے کام میں لگانا، دریا یا ٹریفک کا رخ دوسرے راستے میں موڑنا، توجہ یا صلاحیت کو نئی سرگرمی میں لگانا، وسائل کسی خاص منصوبے میں منتقل کرنا

englishMeaning: To move something away from a place, path, or purpose. To draw attention away from an unwanted issue. To steer people or traffic away from danger or congestion. To shift resources away from one area to another. To keep someone away from harmful influences or activities.
synonyms: Steer away, Deflect, Turn away, Redirect, Distract, Avert, Draw off, Shift, Reroute, Keep away
antonyms: Attract, Draw toward, Focus on, Direct to, Keep, Retain, Lead to, Concentrate, Channel toward
examples: Police diverted traffic away from the flooded road. The minister tried to divert blame away from himself. The program diverts young people away from crime. Resources were diverted away from research to marketing.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ کي ڪنهن هنڌ  رستي يا مقصد کان پري ڪرڻ، ناپسنديده مسئلي کان ڌيان هٽائڻ، ماڻهن يا ٽريفڪ کي خطري يا رش کان پري موڙڻ، وسيلا هڪ شعبي کان ٻئي ڏانهن منتقل ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي نقصانڪار اثرن کان پري رکڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کو کسی جگہ  راستے یا مقصد سے دور کرنا، ناپسندیدہ مسئلے سے توجہ ہٹانا، لوگوں یا ٹریفک کو خطرے یا رش سے دور موڑنا، وسائل ایک شعبے سے دوسرے کی طرف منتقل کرنا، کسی کو نقصان دہ اثرات سے دور رکھنا

englishMeaning: A person who seizes another person's goods legally to recover a debt. A landlord or creditor who takes property to obtain unpaid rent or money. An official who carries out a legal seizure of property. A party who holds goods as security until a debt is paid. One who exercises the legal right of distress.
synonyms: Seizer, Creditor, Distrainor, Bailiff, Collector, Levier, Impounder, Confiscator, Sequestrator, Repossessor
antonyms: Debtor, Distrainee, Tenant, Borrower, Owner, Payer, Obligor, Defaulter
examples: The distrainer took the tenant's furniture to cover three months' rent. A distrainer must follow strict legal procedures. The court ruled that the distrainer had acted unlawfully. The distrainer agreed to return the goods once the debt was paid.
sindhiMeaning: اهو ماڻهو جيڪو قرض جي وصوليءَ لاءِ قانوني طور ٻئي جو سامان ضبط ڪري، اهو مالڪ يا قرض خواهه جيڪو ڀاڙي يا رقم لاءِ ملڪيت قبضي ۾ وٺي، ملڪيت قرق ڪندڙ سرڪاري عملدار، قرض ادا ٿيڻ تائين سامان ضمانت طور رکندڙ ڌر، قرقي جو قانوني حق استعمال ڪندڙ
urduMeaning: وہ شخص جو قرض کی وصولی کے لیے قانونی طور پر دوسرے کا سامان ضبط کرے، وہ مالک یا قرض خواہ جو کرایہ یا رقم کے لیے جائیداد قبضے میں لے، جائیداد قرق کرنے والا سرکاری اہلکار، قرض ادا ہونے تک سامان ضمانت کے طور پر رکھنے والا فریق، قرقی کا قانونی حق استعمال کرنے والا

englishMeaning: To criticize or abuse someone harshly and angrily. To use bitter and insulting language against someone. To scold or condemn someone severely. To attack someone verbally with strong contempt. To rail against a person or thing in a violent manner.
synonyms: Revile, Berate, Castigate, Denounce, Upbraid, Abuse, Vilify, Scold, Rail, Lambaste, Condemn, Insult
antonyms: Praise, Commend, Compliment, Acclaim, Applaud, Laud, Extol, Flatter, Honor, Glorify
examples: The coach vituperated the players after their careless defeat. Critics vituperated the film as a complete waste of money. He vituperated against the corrupt officials in his speech. There is no need to vituperate; let us discuss this calmly.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن تي سخت ۽ ڪاوڙ ڀري تنقيد ڪرڻ، ڪنهن خلاف ڪڙي ۽ بي عزتي ڀري ٻولي استعمال ڪرڻ، سخت ڇينڀڻ يا ملامت ڪرڻ، نفرت سان زباني حملو ڪرڻ، ڪنهن کي گاريون ڏيڻ يا لعنت ملامت ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی پر سخت اور غصے بھری تنقید کرنا، کسی کے خلاف تلخ اور توہین آمیز زبان استعمال کرنا، سختی سے ڈانٹنا یا ملامت کرنا، حقارت کے ساتھ زبانی حملہ کرنا، کسی کو گالیاں دینا یا لعن طعن کرنا

englishMeaning: Full of bitter, harsh, and abusive language. Bitterly critical and insulting. Expressing strong anger and contempt in words. Severely scolding or condemning. Characterized by verbal attacks and harsh blame.
synonyms: Abusive, Insulting, Scathing, Vitriolic, Venomous, Caustic, Harsh, Derogatory, Offensive, Denunciatory, Acrimonious, Bitter
antonyms: Complimentary, Laudatory, Flattering, Approving, Admiring, Kind, Gentle, Respectful, Polite, Praising
examples: The debate turned into a vituperative exchange of insults. She received a vituperative letter from an angry customer. His vituperative remarks offended everyone in the meeting. Social media is often filled with vituperative comments.
sindhiMeaning: ڪڙي ۽ بي عزتي ڀري ٻوليءَ سان ڀريل، سخت تنقيدي ۽ توهين آميز، لفظن ۾ شديد ڪاوڙ ۽ نفرت ظاهر ڪندڙ، سخت ملامت ڪندڙ، زباني حملن ۽ الزامن وارو
urduMeaning: تلخ اور توہین آمیز زبان سے بھرا ہوا، سخت تنقیدی اور ہتک آمیز، الفاظ میں شدید غصہ اور حقارت ظاہر کرنے والا، سخت ملامت کرنے والا، زبانی حملوں اور الزامات والا

englishMeaning: Bitter and abusive language used against someone. Harsh and angry criticism or condemnation. The act of insulting or scolding someone severely. Verbal abuse full of contempt and hostility. A violent outburst of blame or censure.
synonyms: Abuse, Invective, Insults, Vilification, Condemnation, Censure, Denunciation, Obloquy, Tirade, Berating, Scolding, Revilement
antonyms: Praise, Acclaim, Commendation, Compliments, Flattery, Approval, Tribute, Admiration, Applause, Eulogy
examples: The politician faced a storm of vituperation after the scandal. Her speech was filled with vituperation against her rivals. He endured years of vituperation from his critics. Calm reasoning is more persuasive than vituperation.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خلاف ڪڙي ۽ بي عزتي ڀري ٻولي، سخت ۽ ڪاوڙ ڀري تنقيد يا ملامت، ڪنهن کي سخت بي عزتو ڪرڻ يا ڇينڀڻ جو عمل، نفرت ۽ دشمني ڀريل زباني گار، الزام يا ملامت جو شديد اظهار
urduMeaning: کسی کے خلاف تلخ اور توہین آمیز زبان، سخت اور غصے بھری تنقید یا مذمت، کسی کو سختی سے برا بھلا کہنا یا ڈانٹنا، حقارت اور دشمنی سے بھری زبانی بدسلوکی، الزام یا ملامت کا شدید اظہار

englishMeaning: Relating to grammar or the rules of a language. Concerning the structure and formation of sentences. Connected with the correct arrangement of words in a sentence. Related to grammatical rules, forms, or structures. Concerning the way words function and relate to one another in a language. Related to the study or analysis of grammar. Describing something that follows the rules of grammar.
synonyms: Grammatical, Syntactic, Linguistic, Structural, Language-related, Related to grammar, Rules-based
antonyms: Ungrammatical, Incorrect, Nonstandard, Illogical, Irregular, Non-grammatical
examples: The teacher explained the grammatic structure of the sentence. The book provides a detailed analysis of grammatic patterns in the language. Students should understand the grammatic rules before writing complex sentences. The researcher examined the grammatic features of the two languages.
sindhiMeaning: ٻوليءَ جي گرامر يا قواعد سان لاڳاپيل، جملن جي بناوت ۽ جوڙجڪ سان تعلق رکندڙ، لفظن جي صحيح ترتيب ۽ استعمال سان لاڳاپيل، ٻوليءَ جي نحوي اصولن سان واسطو رکندڙ، لفظن جي صورت، ڪم ۽ جملن ۾ سندن تعلق سان لاڳاپيل، ٻوليءَ جي قواعد جي مطالعي يا تجزيي سان تعلق رکندڙ، اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا گرامر جي اصولن مطابق هجي
urduMeaning: زبان کے قواعد یا گرامر سے متعلق، جملوں کی ساخت اور ترتیب سے متعلق، الفاظ کے درست استعمال اور ترتیب سے متعلق، زبان کے نحوی اصولوں سے تعلق رکھنے والا، الفاظ کی ساخت، صورت اور جملے میں ان کے کردار سے متعلق، ایسی چیز جو گرامر کے اصولوں کے مطابق ہو

englishMeaning: A pale purple color with a soft, delicate appearance. A light violet shade that may contain pink, gray, or lavender tones. A muted or subdued form of purple. A color that lies between purple, violet, pink, and lavender. A soft, elegant color commonly used for clothing, interior decoration, cosmetics, flowers, and design. It refers to the color itself. Something that has this particular pale purple color. Mauve can range from a pinkish purple to a grayish purple, depending on the particular shade. The word is also associated with a synthetic purple dye discovered in the 19th century. In everyday use, mauve generally suggests a soft, understated, and slightly dusty purple rather than a bright purple.
synonyms: Lavender, Lilac, Violet, Light purple, Pale purple, Dusty purple, Pinkish purple, Muted purple, Pale violet, Amethyst
antonyms: Yellow, Golden yellow, Bright yellow, Orange, Bright green
examples: She wore a beautiful mauve dress to the wedding. The walls of the bedroom were painted a soft mauve color. The florist arranged mauve roses with white flowers. He chose a mauve tie to match his light gray suit.
sindhiMeaning: هلڪو واڱڻائي رنگ جيڪو نرم ۽ هلڪو نظر اچي، اهڙو جامني رنگ جنهن ۾ ٿورو گلابي يا خاڪي مائل رنگ شامل هجي، واڱڻائي ۽ گلابي جي وچ وارو نرم رنگ، هلڪو ۽ مدهم جامني رنگ، اهڙو رنگ جيڪو عام طور ڪپڙن  گلن  سينگار ۽ گهر جي سجاوٽ ۾ استعمال ٿيندو آهي، هن رنگ ۾ واڱڻائي  گلابي  ۽ ڪڏهن ڪڏهن سرمائي رنگ جون هلڪيون جھلڪيون هونديون آهن،
urduMeaning: ہلکا جامنی رنگ جو نرم اور مدھم نظر آتا ہے، ایسا بنفشی رنگ جس میں ہلکی سی گلابی یا سرمئی جھلک ہو، جامنی اور گلابی کے درمیان کا ایک نرم رنگ، مدھم یا ہلکا جامنی رنگ، یہ رنگ عموماً کپڑوں، پھولوں، کاسمیٹکس، اندرونی سجاوٹ اور ڈیزائن میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، بطور صفت یہ کسی ایسی چیز کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جس کا رنگ ہلکا جامنی یا بنفشی ہو، اس رنگ میں جامنی، گلابی اور بعض اوقات سرمئی رنگ کی ہلکی جھلک شامل ہوتی ہے، یہ عام طور پر شوخ جامنی کے بجائے نرم اور مدھم جامنی رنگ ہوتا ہے

englishMeaning: A person who lives in the house, apartment, or area next to yours. A person who lives nearby, even if they do not live immediately next door. A person who is located near another person, place, or thing. A nearby country or region, especially when discussing geographical relationships. A person who lives close enough to another person to have regular social or community contact. In a broader sense, a fellow human being who should be treated with kindness and consideration. To be situated or located next to something. To be next to or near another place, building, or area.
synonyms: Housmate, Resident, Local resident, Nearby resident, Hoodie (informal, uncommon), Adjacent resident, Hemsman (archaic), Adjacent, Nearby, Bordering, Abutting, Contiguous, Next-door
antonyms: Stranger, Distant person, Outsider, Nonresident, Faraway person
examples: My neighbor helped me carry the heavy boxes into my house. We invited our new neighbors to dinner. She has been my neighbor for more than ten years. The school neighbors a large public park.
sindhiMeaning: پاڙيسري/ پاڙيسري ماڻهو/ ڀرسان رهندڙ ماڻهو، اهو ماڻهو جيڪو توهان جي گهر جي ڀرسان يا ويجهو رهندو هجي، ويجهي علائقي يا پاڙي ۾ رهندڙ شخص، ڪو اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو جغرافيائي طور ڪنهن ٻئي شخص يا جاءِ جي ويجهو هجي، وسيع معنى ۾  انسانن مان اهڙو ماڻهو جيڪو اسان جي ويجهو هجي ۽ جنهن سان سٺو ورتاءُ ڪرڻ گهرجي، ڪنهن شيءِ يا جاءِ جي ڀرسان يا ويجهو واقع ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: پڑوسی/ ہمسایہ/ قریب رہنے والا شخص، وہ شخص جو آپ کے گھر کے ساتھ یا قریب رہتا ہو، ایک ہی محلے یا مقامی برادری میں رہنے والا فرد، وسیع معنی میں  کوئی ایسا انسان جو ہمارے قریب ہو اور جس کے ساتھ اچھا سلوک کیا جانا چاہیے، کسی چیز یا جگہ کے ساتھ یا قریب واقع ہونا

englishMeaning: Truly: In a way that is true or genuine. Indeed: Used to emphasize the truth of a statement. Certainly: Used to express strong certainty about something. In truth: Used to introduce or emphasize a fact. Without doubt: Used when the speaker is completely sure about something. Really: Used to emphasize that something is genuinely the case. Undoubtedly: Used to indicate that something is unquestionably true. Actually: Used to emphasize the reality of a situation. Surely: Used to express strong confidence in a statement. In all truth: Used in formal, literary, religious, or archaic language to affirm the truth of something.
synonyms: Truly, Indeed, Certainly, Really, Surely, Actually, Undoubtedly, Definitely, Unquestionably, In truth, Genuinely, Absolutely
antonyms: Uncertainly, Doubtfully, Possibly, Perhaps, Maybe, Questionably, Falsely, Untruthfully, Apparently, Supposedly
examples: Verily, this is one of the greatest achievements of our time. Verily, he was a man of great courage and wisdom. Verily, the truth will eventually be revealed. Verily, I tell you that kindness can change a person's life.
sindhiMeaning: سچ پچ: حقيقت ۾ يا سچائيءَ سان، بيشڪ: ڪنهن ڳالهه جي پڪ ۽ يقين سان تصديق ڪرڻ لاءِ، واقعي: ڪنهن ڳالهه جي حقيقت يا سچائي تي زور ڏيڻ لاءِ، حقيقت ۾: اصل حقيقت بيان ڪرڻ لاءِ، يقيناً: ڪنهن ڳالهه بابت مڪمل يقين ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ، بلاشڪ: اهڙي ڳالهه جيڪا بنا ڪنهن شڪ جي درست هجي، سچائيءَ سان: ڪنهن ڳالهه کي سچ طور بيان ڪرڻ، بي شڪ ۽ شبهي: ڪنهن ڳالهه جي قطعي درست هجڻ جو اظهار، حقيقتاً: ڪنهن ڳالهه جي اصل حيثيت تي زور ڏيڻ لاءِ، پڪ سان: يقين ۽ اعتماد سان ڳالهائڻ
urduMeaning: یقیناً: کسی بات کے یقینی طور پر درست ہونے کو ظاہر کرنا، بے شک: کسی بات کی قطعی تصدیق یا تاکید کے لیے، واقعی: کسی حقیقت یا بات پر زور دینے کے لیے، سچ مچ: حقیقت اور سچائی کے معنوں میں، حقیقتاً: اصل حقیقت بیان کرنے کے لیے، درحقیقت: کسی معاملے کی اصل صورت واضح کرنے کے لیے، بلاشبہ: ایسی بات جس میں کسی قسم کا شک نہ ہو، ضرور: کسی بات کے یقینی یا قطعی ہونے پر زور دینے کے لیے، یقینی طور پر: مکمل یقین کا اظہار کرنے کے لیے، سچائی سے: کسی بات کو حقیقت کے طور پر بیان کرنے کے لیے

englishMeaning: Having tiny holes or spaces through which liquids or gases can pass. Able to absorb or allow water, air, or other substances to enter. Not completely solid or sealed because it contains small openings. Having a structure full of microscopic spaces or cavities. Able to absorb moisture because of its open structure. In a figurative sense, easily allowing people, information, ideas, or influences to pass through or enter. Describing a boundary, system, or organization that is not strictly closed or protected. Having gaps or openings that make something less resistant to penetration. In geology, describing rocks or materials that contain spaces through which water or other fluids can move.
synonyms: Permeable, Absorbent, Penetrable, Pervious, Spongy, Leaky, Open-textured, Holey, Sponge-like, Porous-textured
antonyms: Nonporous, Impermeable, Impervious, Sealed, Solid, Dense, Waterproof, Impenetrable, Nonabsorbent, Closed
examples: A sponge is porous and can absorb a large amount of water. Porous rocks allow water to pass through their tiny spaces. This material is too porous to be used as a waterproof container. The porous soil allows rainwater to penetrate deep into the ground.
sindhiMeaning: سوراخدار/ مسامدار/ جنهن مان پاڻي يا هوا گذري سگهي، اهڙي شيءِ جنهن ۾ ڪيترائي ننڍڙا سوراخ يا خال هجن، اهڙو مادو جنهن مان پاڻي  هوا يا ٻيو مادو گذري سگهي، اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا پاڻي يا نمي کي جذب ڪري سگهي، ننڍن ننڍن مسامن يا خالن سان ڀريل، اهڙو مواد جيڪو مڪمل طور تي بند يا مضبوط نه هجي ۽ جنهن مان سيال يا گئس گذري سگهي، اهڙي مادي جي خاصيت جنهن ۾ اندروني خال موجود هجن، پٿر يا مٽي لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ لفظ  جنهن مان پاڻي اندر داخل ٿي يا گذري سگهي، مجازي طور تي اهڙي نظام يا حد لاءِ استعمال ٿئي ٿو جيڪا آسانيءَ سان ٻاهرين اثرن کي اندر اچڻ ڏئي
urduMeaning: مسام دار، سوراخ دار، جس میں سے پانی یا ہوا گزر سکے، ایسی چیز جس میں بہت سے باریک سوراخ یا خلا موجود ہوں، ایسا مادہ جس میں سے پانی  ہوا یا کوئی دوسرا مادہ گزر سکے، ایسی چیز جو پانی یا نمی کو جذب کر سکے، باریک مساموں یا خالی جگہوں سے بھرا ہوا، ایسا مواد جو مکمل طور پر بند یا غیر منفذ نہ ہو، ایسی مادی ساخت جس میں اندرونی خلا موجود ہوں، چٹان  مٹی یا دوسرے مادے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جس میں سے پانی گزر سکتا ہو، مجازی طور پر ایسے نظام یا حد کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جو بیرونی اثرات کو آسانی سے اندر آنے دے

englishMeaning: Thought or careful consideration: Deep or serious thinking about something. Contemplation: The process of considering an idea, experience, or situation carefully. Careful thinking about your own actions, feelings, or experiences. An image produced when light from an object is reflected by a mirror or another surface. The appearance of something in water, glass, metal, or another reflective surface. The process by which light, sound, heat, or another wave is sent back after striking a surface. Something that shows or represents the nature or qualities of something else. Something that reveals the state, character, or influence of a person, group, or society. A serious thought or observation about an experience or subject. Thinking carefully about something that has already happened in order to understand or learn from it. The transformation of a figure into its mirror image across a line or plane. The change in direction of a wave when it encounters a surface and returns into the original medium.
synonyms: Reflection, Thought, Consideration, Contemplation, Meditation, Deliberation, Introspection, Thoughtfulness, Pondering, Examination
antonyms: Absorption, Refraction, Distortion, Thoughtlessness, Thoughtlessness, Neglect, Inattention, Impulsiveness, Disregard
examples: After some reflexion, she realized that she had made the wrong decision. He saw his reflexion in the calm water of the lake. The reflexion of sunlight from the glass was very bright. The teacher encouraged students to spend time in reflexion after the activity.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڳالهه بابت غور ۽ فڪر ڪرڻ، ڪنهن مسئلي يا تجربي تي سنجيدگيءَ سان سوچڻ، پنهنجي عملن  احساسن يا تجربن جو جائزو وٺڻ، آئيني ۾ نظر ايندڙ تصوير يا عڪس، پاڻي  شيشي يا چمڪندڙ سطح تي نظر ايندڙ ڪنهن شيءِ جو عڪس، روشني  آواز يا لهر جو ڪنهن سطح سان ٽڪرائجڻ کان پوءِ واپس موٽڻ، اهڙي شيءِ جيڪا ڪنهن شخص  حالت يا سماج جون خاصيتون ظاهر ڪري، ڪنهن واقعي بابت سوچڻ ۽ ان مان سبق حاصل ڪرڻ، رياضي ۾ ڪنهن شڪل جو آئيني عڪس يا مخالف طرف منتقل ٿيل ساڳي شڪل، فزڪس ۾ روشني يا لهر جو سطح سان ٽڪرائڻ کان پوءِ واپس موٽڻ
urduMeaning: کسی معاملے کے بارے میں گہری اور سنجیدہ سوچ، کسی خیال  مسئلے یا تجربے پر غور کرنا، اپنے اعمال  احساسات اور تجربات کا جائزہ لینا، آئینے میں نظر آنے والی تصویر یا عکس، پانی  شیشے یا کسی چمک دار سطح پر نظر آنے والا عکس، روشنی  آواز یا کسی لہر کا سطح سے ٹکرا کر واپس آنا، ایسی چیز جو کسی شخص  حالت یا معاشرے کی خصوصیات ظاہر کرے، کسی گزرے ہوئے واقعے پر غور کرکے اس سے سبق حاصل کرنا، ریاضی میں کسی شکل کا آئینے جیسا عکس، طبیعیات میں کسی سطح سے ٹکرانے کے بعد روشنی یا لہر کا واپس آنا

englishMeaning: To insert a word between to and the base form of a verb. To separate the two parts of a to-infinitive with an adverb or another word. A grammatical construction in which the infinitive marker to is separated from its following verb. To interrupt an infinitive phrase by placing a modifier between to and the verb. A structure commonly used to make the meaning of a sentence clearer, stronger, or more natural. A construction traditionally criticized by some grammar authorities, although it is widely accepted in modern English. A way of placing an adverb exactly where its meaning is most clearly connected to the verb. A grammatical choice in which an infinitive such as to go becomes to quickly go. A construction that can sometimes be avoided by moving the adverb elsewhere, although the resulting sentence may sound less natural. The term does not mean that the verb itself is divided; it means that to and the verb are separated by another word.
synonyms: Split infinitive, Insert an adverb, Separate an infinitive, Grammar construction, Infinitive separation
antonyms: Keep an infinitive together, Unsplit infinitive, Join the infinitive, Avoid separation
examples: In the phrase to clearly explain, clearly splits the infinitive. Some teachers once told students not to split an infinitive. Modern English often accepts split infinitives when they sound natural. She chose to carefully review the contract. It is not always wrong to split an infinitive.
sindhiMeaning: مصدر کي جدا ڪرڻ/ مصدر جي ٻن حصن جي وچ ۾ لفظ رکڻ، ٽو ۽ فعل جي بنيادي صورت جي وچ ۾ ڪو ٻيو لفظ رکڻ، ٻن حصن کي ڪنهن لفظ  خاص طور تي ظرف  جي ذريعي جدا ڪرڻ، مصدر جي نشاني ٽو ۽ ان کان پوءِ ايندڙ فعل جي وچ ۾ لفظ داخل ڪرڻ، اهڙي گرامري جوڙجڪ جنهن ۾ ٽو ۽ فعل گڏ نه هجن پر انهن جي وچ ۾ ٻيو لفظ اچي، انگريزي گرامر ۾ اهڙي ساخت جنهن کي روايتي طور ڪجهه گرامر دان ناپسند ڪندا هئا  پر جديد انگريزي ۾ اها عام طور قبول ٿيل آهي
urduMeaning: مصدر کو جدا کرنا، مصدر کے درمیان لفظ رکھنا، مصدر کے دونوں حصوں کو الگ کرنا، ٹو اور فعل کی بنیادی شکل کے درمیان کوئی دوسرا لفظ رکھنا، مصدر کی علامت ٹو اور اس کے بعد آنے والے فعل کے درمیان کوئی لفظ داخل کرنا، ایسی گرامری ساخت جس میں ٹو اور فعل ایک ساتھ نہ ہوں بلکہ ان کے درمیان دوسرا لفظ آ جائے، انگریزی گرامر کی ایسی ساخت جسے روایتی طور پر بعض ماہرینِ قواعد ناپسند کرتے تھے  لیکن جدید انگریزی میں یہ عام طور پر قابل قبول ہے

englishMeaning: A four-sided plane figure with one pair of parallel sides. A quadrilateral whose two opposite sides are parallel. A shape with four sides and four angles, in which the parallel sides are called bases. A quadrilateral in which the non-parallel sides are called legs. A trapezoid in American English. In anatomy, the trapezium is one of the eight small bones in the wrist. The anatomical trapezium is located at the base of the thumb and connects with the first metacarpal bone. In astronomy, the Trapezium is a group of stars in the Orion Nebula.
synonyms: Trapezium, Trapezoid, Quadrilateral, Four-sided figure, Polygon
antonyms: Triangle, Circle, Pentagon, Sphere, Curve
examples: A trapezium has four sides and four angles. The teacher asked the students to calculate the area of the trapezium. The two parallel sides of the trapezium are called its bases. The trapezium is an important shape in elementary geometry.
sindhiMeaning: چئن پاسن واري هندسي شڪل  هڪ جوڙي متوازي پاسن واري چوڪنڊي، اهڙي چئن پاسن واري هندسي شڪل جنهن جا هڪ جوڙو پاسا متوازي هجن، اهڙي چوڪنڊي شڪل جنهن جا ٻه سامهون وارا پاسا هڪ ٻئي سان متوازي هجن، ٽريپيزيم جا متوازي پاسا عام طور تي ان جا بنياد سڏجن ٿا، ان جا غير متوازي پاسا ان جا ٻئي پاسا يا ڪنارا سڏجن ٿا، طب ۾ کلائي جي هڪ ننڍڙي هڏي جو نالو پڻ آهي، اها هڏي آڱوٺي جي بنياد وٽ کلائي ۾ موجود هوندي آهي، علم فلڪيات ۾ اورائن نيبولا ۾ موجود ستارن جي هڪ گروهه جو نالو پڻ آهي
urduMeaning: چار اضلاع والی ایسی ہندسی شکل جس کے ایک جوڑے اضلاع متوازی ہوں، ایسی چوکور شکل جس کے دو مخالف اضلاع ایک دوسرے کے متوازی ہوں، امریکی انگریزی میں اسی شکل کو عموماً  کہا جاتا ہے، طب میں  کلائی کی ایک چھوٹی ہڈی کا نام بھی ہے، یہ ہڈی انگوٹھے کی بنیاد کے قریب کلائی میں موجود ہوتی ہے، علم فلکیات میںذوزنقہ  چار اضلاع والی ہندسی شکل، ایک جوڑے متوازی اضلاع والی چوکور شکل

englishMeaning: A person chosen by God to convey His message to humanity. A person who receives divine revelation and communicates it to others. A religious messenger who teaches people about God, faith, worship, morality, and righteous conduct. A person who calls people toward obedience to God and away from wrongdoing. A divinely appointed teacher who guides people according to religious revelation. A person regarded as an intermediary through whom a divine message is communicated to a community.
synonyms: Messenger, Divine messenger, Prophetic messenger, Seer, Spokesperson of God, Religious teacher, Spiritual guide, Revelator, Visionary, Oracle
antonyms: Disbeliever, Unbeliever, Skeptic, Denier, Impostor, False prophet, Nonbeliever
examples: Muslims believe that Prophet Muhammad was the final prophet sent by Allah. The prophet taught his people to worship God and live righteous lives. The people listened carefully to the prophet's message. The prophet warned his people against injustice and wrongdoing.
sindhiMeaning: نبي/ پيغمبر/ الله جو موڪليل رسول خدائي پيغام پهچائيندڙ، الله تعاليٰ طرفان چونڊيل اهو شخص جيڪو ماڻهن تائين سندس پيغام پهچائي، اهو مقدس شخص جنهن تي الله تعاليٰ وحي نازل ڪري ۽ جيڪو اها وحي ماڻهن تائين پهچائي، الله جو اهو موڪليل بندو جيڪو ماڻهن کي توحيد  عبادت  نيڪي ۽ سٺي اخلاق جي تعليم ڏئي، اهو شخص جيڪو ماڻهن کي الله جي فرمانبرداري ۽ سڌي رستي ڏانهن سڏي
urduMeaning: نبی/ پیغمبر/ اللہ کا برگزیدہ بندہ، اللہ کا پیغام پہنچانے والا، اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے منتخب کیا گیا وہ شخص جو لوگوں تک اس کا پیغام پہنچائے، وہ مقدس شخص جس پر اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے وحی نازل ہو اور جو اسے لوگوں تک پہنچائے، اللہ تعالیٰ کا وہ برگزیدہ بندہ جو لوگوں کو توحید  عبادت  نیکی اور اچھے اخلاق کی تعلیم دے

englishMeaning: A small edible fruit that grows on a gooseberry bush. A fruit that is usually round or oval and has thin, slightly translucent skin. A fruit that can taste very sour, especially when unripe. A fruit that may become sweeter as it ripens. A fruit commonly used for making jams, jellies, pies, desserts, sauces, and preserves. The plant or bush that produces this fruit. In British English, gooseberry can also refer to a person who is unintentionally present with two people who are spending time together romantically. Gooseberry can refer to different plants and fruits in different parts of the world, so the exact fruit can depend on regional usage.
synonyms: Berry, Fruit, Gooseberry fruit, Gooseberry berry, Gooseberry plant, Gooseberry bush
antonyms: No direct antonym
examples: The gooseberries in our garden are still green and very sour. She made delicious gooseberry jam from the fresh fruit. Gooseberries can be used in pies, desserts, and sauces. He felt like a gooseberry when his two friends started talking about their relationship.
sindhiMeaning: گوزبيري/ هڪ ننڍڙو کٽو مٺو ميوو، هڪ ننڍڙو گول يا بيضوي شڪل وارو ميوو جيڪو گوزبيري جي ٻوٽي تي لڳندو آهي، اهڙو ميوو جنهن جو رنگ ڪچو هئڻ وقت عام طور سائو ۽ پچڻ سان پيلو  ڳاڙهو يا واڱڻائي ٿي سگهي ٿو، گوزبيري جو ذائقو اڪثر کٽو هوندو آهي  خاص طور تي جڏهن ميوو ڪچو هجي، پچڻ سان ان جو ذائقو نسبتاً مٺو ٿي سگهي ٿو، هن ميوي مان مربو  جام  جيلي  شربت ۽ مختلف مٺا کاڌا تيار ڪيا ويندا آهن، ان ٻوٽي لاءِ به استعمال ٿيندو آهي جنهن تي هي ميوو پيدا ٿئي ٿو، انگريزي جي ڪجهه استعمالن ۾ اهڙي ٽئين شخص لاءِ به استعمال ٿيندو آهي جيڪو ٻن ماڻهن جي ذاتي يا رومانوي ملاقات دوران اڻڄاڻائيءَ سان موجود هجي
urduMeaning: گوز بیری/ ایک چھوٹا کھٹا میٹھا پھل، ایک چھوٹا گول یا بیضوی پھل جو گوز بیری کے پودے پر لگتا ہے، اس پھل کا رنگ عموماً کچی حالت میں سبز اور پکنے پر زرد، سرخ یا جامنی ہو سکتا ہے، گوز بیری کا ذائقہ عموماً کھٹا ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب پھل کچا ہو، پکنے کے ساتھ اس کا ذائقہ نسبتاً میٹھا ہو سکتا ہے، اس پھل سے مربہ  جام  جیلی  شربت اور مختلف میٹھے پکوان تیار کیے جاتے ہیں، اس پودے یا جھاڑی کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جس پر یہ پھل پیدا ہوتا ہے، انگریزی میں ایسے تیسرے شخص کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دو لوگوں کی نجی یا رومانوی ملاقات میں غیر ارادی طور پر موجود ہو

englishMeaning: A small, dark-colored berry that grows in clusters on elder trees or shrubs. The fruit of plants belonging to the Sambucus genus. A berry that is usually dark purple, bluish-black, or nearly black when ripe. A fruit commonly used to make syrups, jams, jellies, juices, sauces, and beverages. A traditional ingredient used in some herbal preparations. The fruit of the European elder (Sambucus nigra), which is one of the best-known elderberry species. A small berry with a naturally tart or slightly bitter flavor when raw. A fruit often cooked before consumption because some parts of elder plants, particularly unripe fruit, seeds, leaves, and stems, can contain compounds that may cause illness if consumed improperly. A berry traditionally associated with various folk remedies and culinary preparations. The term can refer generally to the edible fruit produced by several species of elder.
synonyms: Elder fruit, Elder tree berry, Sambucus fruit, Elderberry fruit, Black elderberry, European elderberry
antonyms: No direct antonym.
examples: Elderberries are often used to make syrup, jam, and juice. The elderberry has a deep purple or almost black color when ripe. She bought elderberry syrup from the local market. Elderberries are usually cooked before they are used in food.
sindhiMeaning: ايلڊر بيري/ ايلڊر جو ٻير/ ايلڊر وڻ جو ميوو، سامبوڪس جو ميوو ، ايلڊر نالي وڻ يا ٻوٽي تي لڳندڙ ننڍو  ڪارو يا ڪارو واڱڻائي رنگ جو ٻير، سامبوڪس نسل جي وڻن يا ٻوٽن جو ميوو، اهڙو ننڍو ميوو جيڪو عام طور تي گُڇن جي صورت ۾ لڳندو آهي، پڪل حالت ۾ هن جو رنگ واڱڻائي  نيرو ڪارو يا لڳ ڀڳ ڪارو ٿي سگهي ٿو، هن ميوي کي شربت  جام  جيلي  رس ۽ ٻين کاڌي پيتي جي شين ۾ استعمال ڪيو ويندو آهي، ڪچو ايلڊر بيري ذائقي ۾ ترش يا ڪجهه قدر ڪڙو ٿي سگهي ٿو، هن ميوي کي روايتي طور ڪجهه جڙي ٻوٽين وارين تيارين ۾ پڻ استعمال ڪيو ويندو آهي، ايلڊر ٻوٽي جا ڪچا ٻير ۽ ٻيا ڪجهه حصا غلط طريقي سان کائڻ سان نقصانڪار ٿي سگهن ٿا  تنهنڪري مناسب تياري ضروري آهي
urduMeaning: ایلڈر بیری/ ایلڈر کے درخت کا بیر، سامبوکس کے پودے کا پھل، ایلڈر نامی درخت یا جھاڑی پر لگنے والا چھوٹا  سیاہ یا گہرے جامنی رنگ کا بیر، سامبوکس نسل کے درختوں یا جھاڑیوں کا پھل، ایک چھوٹا پھل جو عموماً گچھوں کی شکل میں پیدا ہوتا ہے، پکنے پر اس کا رنگ جامنی، نیلا سیاہ یا تقریباً سیاہ ہو سکتا ہے، اسے شربت  جام  جیلی  جوس  چٹنی اور دیگر غذائی اشیا میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، کچی ایلڈر بیری ذائقے میں ترش یا کسی حد تک کڑوی ہو سکتی ہے، اسے روایتی طور پر بعض جڑی بوٹیوں سے تیار کردہ اشیا میں بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، ایلڈر کے کچے بیر اور پودے کے بعض دوسرے حصے مناسب طریقے سے تیار نہ کیے جائیں تو نقصان دہ ہو سکتے ہیں

englishMeaning: To physically fall forward and land with your face against the ground. To lose your balance and fall forward onto your face. To suffer a sudden and embarrassing physical fall. To fail completely at something you attempted to do. To fail in a very obvious, disappointing, or embarrassing way. To make an attempt that produces an unsuccessful result. To have a plan, project, idea, or performance fail badly. To experience a humiliating failure after being confident about success. To fail publicly after making a strong effort or claim. To be unsuccessful despite having high expectations or confidence.
synonyms: Fall headlong, Collapse, Fail completely, Flop, Come to grief
antonyms: Succeed, Triumph, Flourish, Prosper, Land safely
examples: He tripped over the stone and fell flat on his face. She slipped on the wet floor and fell flat on her face. The company launched an expensive advertising campaign, but it fell flat on its face. He was extremely confident about his plan, but it fell flat on its face.
sindhiMeaning: منهن ڀر ڪري پوڻ/ منهن ڀر زمين تي ڪرڻ، سخت ناڪام ٿيڻ/ شرمناڪ نموني ناڪام ٿيڻ، توازن وڃائڻ سبب منهن ڀر ڪري پوڻ/اهڙيءَ طرح ڪرڻ جو منهن سڌو زمين سان لڳي وڃي، ڪنهن منصوبي يا خيال جو تمام خراب نموني ناڪام ٿيڻ، ماڻهن جي سامهون شرمناڪ نموني ناڪام ٿيڻ، وڏي اميد يا اعتماد سان شروع ڪيل ڪم جو مڪمل طور ناڪام ٿي وڃڻ، ڪنهن ڪوشش جو اهڙو خراب نتيجو نڪرڻ جو ناڪامي واضح ٿي وڃي، ڪنهن منصوبي يا ڪارڪردگي جو اميدن جي ابتڙ تمام خراب ثابت ٿيڻ، مجازي طور تي اهڙي ناڪامي جو شڪار ٿيڻ جنهن سان ماڻهو کي شرمندگي محسوس ٿئي
urduMeaning: منہ کے بل گرنا/ اوندھے منہ گرنا، بری طرح ناکام ہونا/ شرمناک انداز میں ناکام ہونا/اپنا توازن کھو کر منہ کے بل گرنا، کسی کام یا کوشش میں مکمل طور پر ناکام ہونا، کسی منصوبے یا خیال کا بری طرح ناکام ہو جانا، لوگوں کے سامنے شرمناک انداز میں ناکام ہونا، بہت زیادہ اعتماد یا امید کے ساتھ شروع کیے گئے کام کا مکمل طور پر ناکام ہو جانا، کسی کوشش کا ایسا خراب نتیجہ نکلنا کہ ناکامی بالکل واضح ہو جائے، کسی منصوبے یا کارکردگی کا توقعات کے بالکل برعکس بری طرح ناکام ہونا، مجازی طور پر ایسی ناکامی کا سامنا کرنا جس سے انسان کو سبکی یا شرمندگی محسوس ہو

englishMeaning: Strongly attracted by magnets and able to become magnetized. Describing materials like iron, nickel, and cobalt with high magnetic permeability.
synonyms: Magnetic, Magnetizable, Magnetically permeable
antonyms: Non-magnetic, Diamagnetic, Paramagnetic, Non-ferromagnetic

sindhiMeaning: جواب طور چيل يا لکيل ڳالهه، واقعي عمل سوال يا تحريڪ تي ردعمل، حالت يا هنگامي واقعي کي منهن ڏيڻ لاءِ ڪيل ڪارروائي، ڪنهن سبب پيدا ٿيل جسماني يا جذباتي تبديلي، ڄاڻ ملڻ کان پوءِ شخص يا نظام جو ورتاءُ، مذهبي عبادت ۾ ڏنل گڏيل جواب، علاج سان پيدا ٿيندڙ اثر جو درجو

englishMeaning: A long, slender fish with a snakelike body. Any of various freshwater or marine fishes of the order Anguilliformes. A slippery or evasive person, used figuratively. englishMeaning: Reacting quickly and positively to a request, suggestion, or influence. Answering or replying readily. Sensitive to changes, signals, treatment, or stimulation. sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم ڪرڻ جو سبب يا ارادو، لڪل مقصد، عمل تي اڀاريندڙ خواهش يا جذبو، فن يا موسيقي ۾ بار بار ايندڙ موضوع يا نمونو، حرڪت پيدا ڪندڙ

englishMeaning: To create favorable conditions for something to happen. To make people ready to accept an idea, change, or proposal. To do the preliminary work needed for a later action. Literally, to make soil or a site ready for planting or construction
synonyms: Lay the Groundwork, Pave the Way, Set the Stage, Make Ready, Facilitate
antonyms: Hinder, Obstruct, Impede, Disrupt, Block
examples: The minister's speech prepared the ground for major economic reforms. Teachers prepared the ground for the new curriculum with staff training. The negotiators prepared the ground for a peace agreement months in advance. Farmers prepared the ground before sowing the winter crop.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن ڪم لاءِ سازگار حالتون پيدا ڪرڻ، ماڻهن کي خيال يا تبديلي قبول ڪرڻ لاءِ تيار ڪرڻ، ايندڙ ڪم لاءِ ابتدائي بنياد رکڻ، پوک يا تعمير لاءِ زمين تيار ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کام کے لیے سازگار حالات پیدا کرنا، لوگوں کو خیال یا تبدیلی قبول کرنے کے لیے تیار کرنا، آئندہ کام کے لیے ابتدائی بنیاد رکھنا، کاشت یا تعمیر کے لیے زمین تیار کرنا

englishMeaning: A rare or nonstandard form usually intended to mean give ground. To retreat or yield a position, territory, advantage, or point in an argument. To concede under pressure. Literally, to provide land or a surface for a purpose
synonyms: Give Ground, Yield, Retreat, Concede, Withdraw, Provide Land
antonyms: Hold Ground, Stand Firm, Resist, Advance, Withhold
examples: The troops refused to give ground despite the heavy attack. In the debate, she would not give ground on her main argument. The company gave ground to its competitor after months of pressure. The council agreed to give the ground for a new community garden.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ناياب يا غير معياري روپ جيڪو عام طور گِو گرائونڊ جي معنيٰ ڏئي ٿو، پوزيشن علائقو فائدو يا دليل ڇڏڻ، دٻاءَ هيٺ پوئتي هٽڻ، ڪنهن مقصد لاءِ زمين يا جاءِ مهيا ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: ایک نادر یا غیر معیاری صورت جو عموماً گِو گراؤنڈ کے معنی دیتی ہے، پوزیشن علاقہ فائدہ یا دلیل چھوڑ دینا، دباؤ میں پیچھے ہٹنا، کسی مقصد کے لیے زمین یا جگہ فراہم کرنا

englishMeaning: To hide or become inaccessible in order to avoid capture, attention, or trouble. To go into hiding or lie low. Of a hunted animal, especially a fox, to enter its burrow. To withdraw temporarily from public view or communication
synonyms: Hide, Disappear, Lie Low, Go Underground, Take Cover, Withdraw
antonyms: Surface, Emerge, Appear Openly, Come Forward, Reveal Oneself
examples: After the scandal broke, the politician went to ground for several weeks. The fugitive went to ground in the mountains to avoid the police. The fox went to ground in its den when the hounds approached. Facing intense media scrutiny, the celebrity decided to go to ground.
sindhiMeaning: پڪڙ ڌيان يا تڪليف کان بچڻ لاءِ لڪي وڃڻ، روپوش يا ماٺ ٿي رهڻ، شڪار ٿيندڙ جانور جو ٻر ۾ گهڙي وڃڻ، ڪجهه وقت لاءِ عوامي نظر يا رابطي کان پري ٿيڻ
urduMeaning: گرفتاری توجہ یا پریشانی سے بچنے کے لیے چھپ جانا، روپوش ہونا یا خاموش رہنا، شکار کیے جانے والے جانور کا بل میں گھس جانا، کچھ عرصے کے لیے عوامی نظر یا رابطے سے دور ہونا

word: Have your feet on the ground
englishMeaning: To be sensible, practical, and realistic. To understand ordinary life and real conditions. To remain emotionally balanced and not be carried away by hopes, pride, or success
synonyms: Be Grounded, Be Practical, Be Realistic, Be Sensible, Be Down-to-earth
antonyms: Be Unrealistic, Have One's Head in the Clouds, Be Impractical, Be Deluded
examples: Despite her sudden fame, she still has her feet on the ground. A good leader has his feet on the ground and listens to ordinary people. He has his feet on the ground when making financial decisions. Even after winning the lottery, they had their feet on the ground.
sindhiMeaning: سمجهدار عملي ۽ حقيقت پسند هجڻ، روزمره زندگي ۽ حقيقي حالتن کي سمجهڻ، اميد غرور يا ڪاميابي ۾ وهجي وڃڻ بدران متوازن رهڻ
urduMeaning: سمجھ دار عملی اور حقیقت پسند ہونا، روزمرہ زندگی اور حقیقی حالات کو سمجھنا، امید غرور یا کامیابی میں بہہ جانے کے بجائے متوازن رہنا

word: Keep your feet on the ground
englishMeaning: To remain sensible, practical, and realistic. To stay humble despite success, praise, excitement, or wealth. To maintain a balanced judgment and proper perspective
synonyms: Stay Grounded, Remain Humble, Stay Realistic, Keep Perspective, Be Sensible
antonyms: Get Carried Away, Become Arrogant, Lose Perspective, Be Unrealistic
examples: She advised her son to keep his feet on the ground after his promotion. It is important to keep your feet on the ground when dealing with sudden wealth. He kept his feet on the ground despite becoming an overnight sensation. Coaches remind young athletes to keep their feet on the ground after early victories.
sindhiMeaning: سمجهدار عملي ۽ حقيقت پسند رهڻ، ڪاميابي تعريف جوش يا دولت باوجود عاجز رهڻ، متوازن سوچ ۽ صحيح نظر برقرار رکڻ
urduMeaning: سمجھ دار عملی اور حقیقت پسند رہنا، کامیابی تعریف جوش یا دولت کے باوجود عاجز رہنا، متوازن سوچ اور درست نقطۂ نظر قائم رکھنا

englishMeaning: To refuse to retreat, yield, or change one's position under pressure. To defend a physical position against attack. To maintain an opinion, demand, or principle during disagreement. To remain steady and confident in a difficult situation
synonyms: Stand Firm, Stand Fast, Resist, Maintain One's Position, Not Budge
antonyms: Back Down, Give In, Retreat, Yield, Capitulate
examples: Despite the criticism, she held her ground and refused to change her opinion. The soldiers held their ground against the enemy attack. He held his ground during the negotiation and got a better deal. Even when everyone disagreed, the scientist held her ground on the evidence.
sindhiMeaning: دٻاءَ هيٺ پوئتي هٽڻ يا موقف بدلائڻ کان انڪار ڪرڻ، حملي خلاف جاءِ جو بچاءُ ڪرڻ، اختلاف ۾ راءِ مطالبي يا اصول تي قائم رهڻ، ڏکي حالت ۾ ثابت قدم ۽ پراعتماد رهڻ
urduMeaning: دباؤ میں پیچھے ہٹنے یا مؤقف بدلنے سے انکار کرنا، حملے کے خلاف جگہ کا دفاع کرنا، اختلاف میں رائے مطالبے یا اصول پر قائم رہنا، مشکل حالت میں ثابت قدم اور پراعتماد رہنا

englishMeaning: Unable to be measured or judged by the same standard. Having no common measure or shared unit. So different in nature that meaningful comparison is impossible. In mathematics, having a ratio that cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers
synonyms: Incomparable, Unmeasurable, Disparate, Incongruous, Incompatible
antonyms: Commensurable, Comparable, Measurable, Proportionate, Compatible
examples: The two philosophical systems are incommensurable and cannot be compared directly. Scientists argue that some scientific paradigms are incommensurable with one another. Their values were so incommensurable that agreement seemed impossible. The mathematician explained why the two quantities were incommensurable.
sindhiMeaning: ساڳئي معيار سان ماپي يا پرکي نه سگهجندڙ، گڏيل ماپ يا ايڪو نه رکندڙ، فطرت ۾ ايترو مختلف جو ڀيٽ ممڪن نه هجي، رياضي ۾ اهڙو تناسب جيڪو صحيح عددن جي نسبت سان ظاهر نه ٿي سگهي
urduMeaning: ایک ہی معیار سے ناپا یا پرکھا نہ جا سکنے والا، مشترک پیمانہ یا اکائی نہ رکھنے والا، نوعیت میں اتنا مختلف کہ بامعنی موازنہ ممکن نہ ہو، ریاضی میں ایسا تناسب جو صحیح اعداد کی نسبت سے ظاہر نہ ہو سکے

englishMeaning: To cause inconvenience, discomfort, or trouble to someone. To hinder, obstruct, or hamper an activity. To put someone to difficulty or disturb their comfort
synonyms: Inconvenience, Trouble, Bother, Hinder, Hamper, Disturb
antonyms: Accommodate, Assist, Help, Facilitate, Ease, Comfort
examples: I hope my late arrival did not incommode you in any way. Heavy traffic incommoded travelers trying to reach the airport. She was reluctant to incommode her hosts by asking for special meals. The construction work has incommoded local residents for months.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن کي زحمت تڪليف يا پريشاني ڏيڻ، ڪم ۾ رنڊڪ يا روڪ وجهڻ، ڪنهن کي ڏکيائي ۾ وجهڻ يا آرام خراب ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی کو زحمت تکلیف یا پریشانی دینا، کام میں رکاوٹ ڈالنا، کسی کو مشکل میں ڈالنا یا آرام میں خلل پیدا کرنا

englishMeaning: Not corresponding in size, degree, duration, or importance. Out of proportion to something else. Inadequate or excessive in relation to a need, standard, responsibility, or result. Lacking a common basis for comparison
synonyms: Disproportionate, Inadequate, Unequal, Mismatched, Inappropriate
antonyms: Commensurate, Proportionate, Adequate, Equivalent, Appropriate
examples: His salary is incommensurate with the amount of work he does. The punishment seemed incommensurate with the severity of the crime. Funding for the project was incommensurate with its actual needs. The rewards offered were incommensurate with the risks involved.
sindhiMeaning: ماپ درجي مدت يا اهميت ۾ برابر نه هئڻ، غير متناسب، ضرورت معيار ذميواري يا نتيجي جي ڀيٽ ۾ گهٽ يا وڌ، ڀيٽ لاءِ گڏيل بنياد نه رکندڙ
urduMeaning: حجم درجے مدت یا اہمیت میں موافق نہ ہونا، غیر متناسب، ضرورت معیار ذمہ داری یا نتیجے کے مقابلے میں کم یا زیادہ، موازنے کے لیے مشترک بنیاد نہ رکھنا

englishMeaning: Unable, unwilling, or forbidden to communicate with others. Kept in isolation without access to visitors, legal advice, or outside contact. Temporarily unreachable or unavailable by phone, internet, or other means
synonyms: Isolated, Unreachable, Cut Off, Out of Contact, Secluded, Detained
antonyms: Reachable, Accessible, Communicative, Available, In Contact
examples: The prisoner was held incommunicado for several weeks without access to a lawyer. After the accident, he was incommunicado in the hospital for two days. She went incommunicado during her vacation and switched off her phone. The hostages were kept incommunicado by their captors.
sindhiMeaning: ٻين سان رابطو ڪرڻ کان قاصر يا منع ٿيل، ملاقات قانوني مدد يا ٻاهرين رابطي کان سواءِ اڪيلائي ۾ رکيل، فون انٽرنيٽ يا ٻين ذريعن سان عارضي طور نه ملي سگهندڙ
urduMeaning: دوسروں سے رابطہ کرنے سے قاصر یا ممنوع، ملاقات قانونی مدد یا بیرونی رابطے کے بغیر تنہائی میں رکھا ہوا، فون انٹرنیٹ یا دوسرے ذرائع سے عارضی طور پر ناقابل رسائی

englishMeaning: The state or quality of being impossible or unsuitable to compare. The quality of having no equal because of exceptional excellence. Fundamental difference between things that lack a common standard of comparison
synonyms: Uniqueness, Matchlessness, Peerlessness, Incommensurability, Unrivaled Excellence
antonyms: Comparability, Similarity, Equivalence, Equality, Sameness
examples: The incomparability of her talent made her the top choice for the role. Critics praised the incomparability of the artist's unique style. The incomparability of the two theories makes it hard to judge which is superior. His incomparability as a chess player was evident in every match.
sindhiMeaning: ڀيٽ ڪرڻ ناممڪن يا نامناسب هجڻ جي حالت، بي مثال يا لاثاني هجڻ، اهڙين شين جو بنيادي فرق جن لاءِ گڏيل معيار نه هجي
urduMeaning: موازنہ کرنا ناممکن یا نامناسب ہونے کی حالت، بے مثال یا لاثانی ہونے کی کیفیت، ایسی چیزوں کا بنیادی فرق جن کے لیے مشترک معیار نہ ہو

englishMeaning: So excellent, remarkable, or extreme that nothing else is its equal. Unable or unsuitable to be compared because of a fundamental difference. Without a peer or match
synonyms: Unmatched, Peerless, Matchless, Unequaled, Unrivaled, Inimitable
antonyms: Comparable, Equaled, Ordinary, Common, Mediocre
examples: The view from the mountain top was incomparable in its beauty. She has an incomparable talent for storytelling. His knowledge of ancient history is incomparable among his peers. The chef's incomparable skill made the restaurant famous worldwide.
sindhiMeaning: ايترو شاندار يا غير معمولي جو ڪو برابر نه هجي، بنيادي فرق سبب ڀيٽ نه ٿي سگهندڙ، بي مثال لاثاني ۽ بي نظير
urduMeaning: اتنا شاندار یا غیر معمولی کہ کوئی برابر نہ ہو، بنیادی فرق کے باعث ناقابل موازنہ، بے مثال لاثانی اور بے نظیر

englishMeaning: In a way that is beyond comparison. To a degree far greater or better than anything similar. In an unequalled or unmatched manner. So exceptionally that no fair comparison can be made.
synonyms: Unmatchably, Unequalledly, Peerlessly, Uniquely, Supremely, Exceptionally, Inimitably
antonyms: Comparably, Equally, Ordinarily, Similarly, Commonly, Indifferently
examples: The mountain scenery was incomparably beautiful at sunrise. Her latest performance was incomparably better than the earlier one. This fabric is incomparably softer than the cheaper alternative. He wrote with an incomparably clear and graceful style.
sindhiMeaning: اهڙي نموني جو مقابلو نه ٿي سگهي، بي مثال انداز ۾، ٻين سڀني کان تمام گهڻو بهتر يا وڌيڪ، ايتري غيرمعمولي حد تائين جو ڀيٽ ممڪن نه هجي
urduMeaning: ایسے انداز میں جس کا مقابلہ نہ ہو سکے، بے مثال طور پر، دوسروں سے کہیں زیادہ بہتر یا بڑھ کر، اس قدر غیر معمولی طور پر کہ موازنہ ممکن نہ رہے

englishMeaning: A container used for storing honey. Something attractive that draws people toward it. A person, place, or opportunity used as a lure or trap. A computer system or resource deliberately set up to attract and detect cyberattackers. A desirable area that attracts investment, visitors, or activity.
synonyms: Lure, Bait, Trap, Decoy, Attraction, Magnet, Snare, Honey jar
antonyms: Deterrent, Repellent, Disincentive, Safeguard, Protection, Warning
examples: The old ceramic honeypot sat beside the breakfast tray. The police used the abandoned warehouse as a honeypot for thieves. The security team deployed a honeypot to study suspicious network activity. Low taxes turned the region into a honeypot for new businesses.
sindhiMeaning: ماکي رکڻ جو ٿانو، ڪا دلڪش شيءِ جيڪا ماڻهن کي پاڻ ڏانهن ڇڪي، ڦاسائڻ لاءِ استعمال ٿيندڙ ماڻهو جڳهه يا موقعو، سائبر حملي ڪندڙن کي ڇڪڻ ۽ سڃاڻڻ لاءِ ٺاهيل ڪمپيوٽر نظام، سيڙپڪاري يا سياحن کي ڇڪيندڙ پرڪشش هنڌ
urduMeaning: شہد رکھنے کا برتن، کوئی پرکشش چیز جو لوگوں کو اپنی طرف کھینچے، کسی کو پھنسانے کے لیے استعمال ہونے والا شخص جگہ یا موقع، سائبر حملہ آوروں کو متوجہ کرکے شناخت کرنے والا کمپیوٹر نظام، سرمایہ کاری یا سیاحوں کو کھینچنے والا پرکشش مقام

englishMeaning: The quality of being able to be compared. A sufficient degree of similarity that allows a fair comparison. The condition in which data, objects, or results are measured on consistent terms. The extent to which financial information can be evaluated alongside other information.
synonyms: Similarity, Equivalence, Correspondence, Compatibility, Commensurability, Likeness
antonyms: Incomparability, Dissimilarity, Disparity, Incompatibility, Difference, Inequivalence
examples: Researchers questioned the comparability of the two surveys. Standard units improve the comparability of international data. Differences in accounting rules reduce comparability between the reports. The teams used identical tests to ensure comparability.
sindhiMeaning: ڀيٽ ڪري سگهڻ جي خاصيت، ايتري مشابهت جو منصفاڻي مقابلو ٿي سگهي، انگن اکرن شين يا نتيجن کي ساڳين معيارن تي پرکڻ جي حالت، مالي معلومات کي ٻي معلومات سان گڏ جانچڻ جي قابليت
urduMeaning: موازنہ کیے جانے کی صلاحیت، اتنی مماثلت کہ منصفانہ تقابل ممکن ہو، اعداد و شمار اشیا یا نتائج کو یکساں معیار پر جانچنے کی حالت، مالی معلومات کو دوسری معلومات کے ساتھ پرکھنے کی قابلیت

englishMeaning: In a way that is equal in size, degree, or importance. In correct proportion to something else. To an extent corresponding to the value, effort, risk, or responsibility involved. Suitably or appropriately in relation to circumstances.
synonyms: Proportionately, Correspondingly, Equivalently, Suitably, Appropriately, Comparably
antonyms: Disproportionately, Unequally, Inadequately, Inappropriately, Incommensurately
examples: As her responsibilities increased, her salary rose commensurately. The price should fall commensurately when the quality declines. Greater risks must be rewarded commensurately. The budget expanded commensurately with the size of the project.
sindhiMeaning: ماپ درجي يا اهميت ۾ برابر نموني، ڪنهن ٻي شيءِ جي صحيح تناسب سان، قدر محنت خطري يا ذميواري جي مطابق، حالتن جي مناسبت سان مناسب انداز ۾
urduMeaning: حجم درجے یا اہمیت میں برابر طور پر، کسی دوسری چیز کے درست تناسب سے، قدر محنت خطرے یا ذمہ داری کے مطابق، حالات کی مناسبت سے موزوں انداز میں

englishMeaning: In a way that deserves praise or approval. In an admirable and worthy manner. To a notably high moral or practical standard. In a manner showing good effort, courage, restraint, or responsibility.
synonyms: Admirably, Praiseworthily, Creditably, Excellently, Nobly, Meritoriously
antonyms: Disgracefully, Poorly, Shamefully, Blameworthily, Reprehensibly
examples: The volunteers responded commendably during the emergency. She acted commendably by admitting her mistake. The young team performed commendably against experienced opponents. He remained commendably calm under intense pressure.
sindhiMeaning: ساراهه جي لائق نموني، قابل تعريف ۽ عزت جوڳي انداز ۾، اعليٰ اخلاقي يا عملي معيار سان، سٺي ڪوشش همت ضبط يا ذميواري ڏيکاريندي
urduMeaning: تعریف کے لائق انداز میں، قابل تحسین اور باوقار طریقے سے، بلند اخلاقی یا عملی معیار کے ساتھ، اچھی کوشش ہمت ضبط یا ذمہ داری کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے

englishMeaning: Too great, vast, or intense to be measured. Impossible to calculate precisely. Extremely large in amount, degree, or importance. Beyond any practical standard of measurement. Limitless or seemingly without bounds.
synonyms: Boundless, Limitless, Incalculable, Vast, Infinite, Enormous, Inestimable
antonyms: Measurable, Finite, Limited, Calculable, Definite, Quantifiable
examples: Her support was of immeasurable value to the project. The disaster caused immeasurable suffering across the region. He felt immeasurable relief when the child was found safe. The library has made an immeasurable contribution to education.
sindhiMeaning: ماپ کان ٻاهر تمام وڏو يا شديد، صحيح حساب ڪرڻ ناممڪن، مقدار درجي يا اهميت ۾ بي حد وڏو، عملي ماپ جي هر معيار کان مٿي، لامحدود يا بي ڪنار
urduMeaning: ناپ سے باہر بہت بڑا یا شدید، درست حساب کرنا ناممکن، مقدار درجے یا اہمیت میں بے حد وسیع، عملی پیمائش کے ہر معیار سے بڑھ کر، لامحدود یا بے کنار

englishMeaning: To an extent too great to measure. By an extremely large amount or degree. In a way that cannot be calculated precisely. Beyond ordinary limits or comparison.
synonyms: Infinitely, Incalculably, Enormously, Boundlessly, Inestimably, Vastly
antonyms: Slightly, Measurably, Marginally, Moderately, Insignificantly
examples: The new treatment improved her quality of life immeasurably. We are immeasurably grateful for your kindness. His confidence grew immeasurably after the successful presentation. The quiet garden made the house immeasurably more appealing.

sindhiMeaning: ماڻهن کي غور سان ڌيان ڏيڻ لاءِ چوڻ، ايندڙ ڳالهه ڏانهن متوجه ٿيڻ، اهم هدايت ٻڌڻ ۽ سمجهڻ، خاص ڪري جماعت ۾ پوري ڌيان سان ٻڌڻ
urduMeaning: لوگوں کو غور سے توجہ دینے کے لیے کہنا، آنے والی بات کی طرف متوجہ ہونا، اہم ہدایت سننا اور سمجھنا، خصوصاً گروہ میں پوری توجہ مرکوز کرنا

englishMeaning: To try to hear a particular sound. To pay attention for an expected word, signal, or announcement. To use hearing to detect something specific. To wait attentively for an audible sign.
synonyms: Attend for, Wait to hear, Keep an ear out for, Detect, Monitor, Hear out for
antonyms: Ignore, Miss, Tune out, Disregard, Overlook
examples: Listen for the click before opening the lid. The doctor listened for changes in the patient’s breathing. We stood quietly and listened for the owl. Students listened for their numbers to be called.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن خاص آواز کي ٻڌڻ جي ڪوشش ڪرڻ، امڪاني لفظ اشاري يا اعلان لاءِ ڌيان ڏيڻ، ٻڌڻ جي حس سان ڪا مخصوص شيءِ سڃاڻڻ، ٻڌڻ جهڙي نشاني لاءِ ڌيان سان انتظار ڪرڻ
urduMeaning: کسی خاص آواز کو سننے کی کوشش کرنا، متوقع لفظ اشارے یا اعلان کے لیے توجہ دینا، سماعت کے ذریعے کسی مخصوص چیز کا پتا لگانا، سنائی دینے والی علامت کا توجہ سے انتظار کرنا

englishMeaning: To hear an entire recording, speech, or piece of music from beginning to end. To continue listening despite difficulty or interruption. To review audio carefully and completely. To hear all parts before forming an opinion.
synonyms: Hear completely, Play through, Hear out, Review, Attend throughout
antonyms: Stop listening, Tune out, Interrupt, Skip, Ignore
examples: I listened through the entire album on my journey home. Please listen through the recording before editing it. She listened through his long explanation without interrupting. The producer listened through every track twice.
sindhiMeaning: رڪارڊنگ تقرير يا موسيقي شروع کان آخر تائين ٻڌڻ، ڏکيائي يا رنڊڪ باوجود ٻڌندو رهڻ، آڊيو کي ڌيان سان مڪمل جائزو وٺڻ، راءِ ٺاهڻ کان اڳ سمورا حصا ٻڌڻ
urduMeaning: ریکارڈنگ تقریر یا موسیقی کو شروع سے آخر تک سننا، دشواری یا رکاوٹ کے باوجود سنتے رہنا، آڈیو کا پوری توجہ سے مکمل جائزہ لینا، رائے قائم کرنے سے پہلے تمام حصے سننا

englishMeaning: A thing that is swollen or enlarged. A herring that has been lightly salted and smoked whole. A person or thing considered excessively large or inflated. In computing, software or a file that has become unnecessarily large.

antonyms: Lean item, Compact program, Fresh herring, Slim object
examples: The fishmonger sold bloaters for breakfast. A traditional bloater has a strong smoky flavor. Developers called the oversized program a bloater. The dead fish became a bloater in the summer heat.
sindhiMeaning: سُڄيل يا وڌيل شيءِ، سڄي حالت ۾ هلڪو لوڻ لڳائي دونهين ۾ پچايل هيرنگ مڇي، حد کان وڌيڪ وڏي يا ڦوڪيل سمجهيل ماڻهو يا شيءِ، ڪمپيوٽنگ ۾ غيرضروري طور وڏي ٿيل سافٽ ويئر يا فائيل
urduMeaning: سوجی ہوئی یا بڑھی ہوئی چیز، پوری حالت میں ہلکا نمک لگا کر دھوئیں میں پکائی گئی ہیرنگ مچھلی، حد سے زیادہ بڑا یا پھولا ہوا شخص یا چیز، کمپیوٹنگ میں غیر ضروری طور پر بڑی ہو جانے والی فائل یا سافٹ ویئر

englishMeaning: Software that uses excessive storage, memory, or processing power. Unwanted software preinstalled on a device. A program overloaded with unnecessary features. Software that has grown inefficiently large and complicated.
synonyms: Junkware, Crapware, Unwanted software, Bundled software, Bloated software
antonyms: Lightweight software, Leanware, Essential software, Optimized program, Minimal application
examples: I removed the manufacturer’s bloatware from my new laptop. Too much bloatware can slow a phone down. The update turned a simple tool into frustrating bloatware. Users wanted a clean installation without bundled bloatware.
sindhiMeaning: تمام گهڻي اسٽوريج يادگيري يا پروسيسنگ طاقت استعمال ڪندڙ سافٽ ويئر، ڊوائيس ۾ اڳواٽ انسٽال ٿيل اڻ گهربل پروگرام، غيرضروري خاصيتن سان ڀريل پروگرام، بي ترتيبيءَ سان تمام وڏو ۽ پيچيده ٿيل سافٽ ويئر

englishMeaning: In a mild, kind, or tender manner. With little force or pressure. Slowly and carefully to avoid damage or distress. In a gradual, slight, or moderate way. With a soft sound, movement, or slope.

antonyms: Roughly, Harshly, Violently, Abruptly, Forcefully, Cruelly

englishMeaning: Wonderful, delightful, or splendid. Remarkably joyful or excellent. Used playfully to describe something highly pleasing. Fabulous in an imaginative or whimsical way.
synonyms: Wonderful, Fabulous, Splendid, Delightful, Marvelous, Excellent, Glorious
antonyms: Awful, Dreadful, Miserable, Terrible, Unpleasant, Wretched

englishMeaning: To get, acquire, or secure something through effort, request, or purchase. To become accepted, established, or commonly used. To be present or prevail in a particular place or situation.

examples: She obtained permission to enter the archive. You can obtain a copy of the form online. These customs still obtain in some rural areas. The evidence was obtained through careful research.

englishMeaning: Flexible and able to bend or move easily without stiffness. Graceful and smoothly moving. Able to adapt readily to changing conditions or ideas. Soft and pliable in texture.

antonyms: Stiff, Rigid, Inflexible, Brittle, Unyielding

englishMeaning: Easily bent, shaped, or folded without breaking. Soft and flexible in texture. Easily influenced, persuaded, or controlled. Adaptable to new purposes or conditions.

englishMeaning: Easily bent or shaped without breaking. Flexible and supple in movement or texture. Able and willing to adapt. Easily influenced, persuaded, or controlled.
synonyms: Flexible, Supple, Pliable, Malleable, Adaptable, Compliant
antonyms: Rigid, Stiff, Inflexible, Unyielding, Obstinate
examples: The basket is woven from pliant reeds. Her pliant body made the pose look effortless. A pliant organization can respond quickly to change. The ruler wanted a pliant adviser who never disagreed.

antonyms: Separation, Disconnection, Simplicity, Isolation

englishMeaning: A courteous, refined, and well-mannered woman. Historically, a woman of high social rank or good family. A woman considered honorable and dignified.

antonyms: Urban decline, Deterioration, Disinvestment, Decay

englishMeaning: To renovate and improve a poorer urban area so that wealthier people and businesses move in. To make a place more fashionable or expensive. To cause social and economic change that may displace existing residents.

examples: The washing machine has a delicate mode for fragile fabrics. In this data set, the mode is seven. The composer used the Phrygian mode in the melody. She switched into panic mode when she saw the deadline.
sindhiMeaning: طريقو، ڍنگ، انداز، ڪم ڪرڻ جي حالت يا سيٽنگ، شماريات ۾ سڀ کان گهڻو ايندڙ قدر، موسيقيءَ ۾ سرن جو مخصوص نمونو، گرامر ۾ فعل جو انداز، رائج فيشن
urduMeaning: طریقہ، ڈھنگ، انداز، کام کرنے کی حالت یا سیٹنگ، شماریات میں سب سے زیادہ آنے والی قدر، موسیقی میں سروں کا مخصوص نمونہ، قواعد میں فعل کا انداز، رائج فیشن

englishMeaning: A physical, visual, or mathematical representation of something. A person who displays clothing or poses for art or photography. A simplified system used to explain, calculate, or predict. An excellent example worthy of imitation. A particular design or version of a product. To shape, represent, demonstrate, or serve as an example. Relating to an ideal example or a person employed to display products.
synonyms: Prototype, Replica, Representation, Mannequin, Paradigm, Exemplar, Version
antonyms: Original, Reality, Anomaly, Deviation, Imperfection
examples: The architect built a detailed model of the proposed tower. The fashion model walked confidently down the runway. Economists developed a model to predict inflation. She is a model of patience and dedication.
sindhiMeaning: ڪنهن شيءِ جو جسماني يا تصويري نمونو، ڪپڙا ڏيکاريندڙ يا تصوير لاءِ پوز ڏيندڙ شخص، وضاحت يا اڳڪٿي لاءِ سادو نظام، پيروي لائق مثالي مثال، پيداوار جو خاص قسم، شڪل ڏيڻ يا نمائندگي ڪرڻ، نموني طور ڏيکارڻ
urduMeaning: کسی چیز کا جسمانی یا تصویری نمونہ، لباس دکھانے یا تصویر کے لیے پوز دینے والا شخص، وضاحت یا پیش گوئی کے لیے سادہ نظام، قابل تقلید مثالی مثال، مصنوعات کی خاص قسم، شکل دینا یا نمائندگی کرنا، نمونے کے طور پر دکھانا

englishMeaning: A medical condition causing abnormally excessive growth, usually because too much growth hormone is produced before the growth plates close. Abnormal enlargement of the whole body or one of its parts. The state or quality of being gigantic.
synonyms: Giantism, Excessive growth, Overgrowth, Hypersomatism
antonyms: Dwarfism, Stunted growth, Undergrowth
examples: The doctor diagnosed the boy with gigantism after noticing his rapid growth. Gigantism is often caused by a tumor on the pituitary gland. The specialist explained how gigantism differs from acromegaly. Untreated gigantism can cause serious health complications.
sindhiMeaning: غير معمولي گهڻي جسماني واڌ جي بيماري، واڌ واري هارمون جي زيادتي سبب تمام ڊگهو يا وڏو ٿيڻ، سڄي جسم يا ڪنهن عضوي جو حد کان وڌيڪ وڌڻ، تمام وڏي جسامت واري حالت
urduMeaning: غیر معمولی حد سے زیادہ جسمانی نشوونما کی بیماری، گروتھ ہارمون کی زیادتی سے بہت لمبا یا بڑا ہونا، پورے جسم یا کسی عضو کا حد سے زیادہ بڑھنا، بہت بڑی جسامت کی حالت

englishMeaning: A unit of frequency equal to one billion hertz. A measure commonly used for processor clock speed, radio waves, and wireless frequency bands. One billion cycles per second.
synonyms: GHz, Billion hertz, Frequency unit
antonyms: Hertz, Kilohertz, Megahertz, Lower frequency
examples: The new processor runs at 3.5 gigahertz. Many wireless routers use the 2.4-gigahertz and 5-gigahertz bands. Engineers measured the signal frequency in gigahertz. The specification lists a clock speed of four gigahertz.
sindhiMeaning: هڪ ارب هرٽز برابر تعدد جي ايڪائي، هڪ سيڪنڊ ۾ هڪ ارب چڪر، ڪمپيوٽر پروسيسر يا ريڊيو لهرن جي رفتار ماپڻ جي ايڪائي، گيگاهرٽز
urduMeaning: ایک ارب ہرٹز کے برابر تعدد کی اکائی، ایک سیکنڈ میں ایک ارب چکر، کمپیوٹر پروسیسر یا ریڈیو لہروں کی رفتار ناپنے کی اکائی، گیگاہرٹز

englishMeaning: Inclined to giggle frequently. Laughing in a light, nervous, playful, or silly way. Easily amused or unable to suppress small laughs.
synonyms: Laughing, Chuckling, Bubbly, Playful, Amused, Tittering
antonyms: Serious, Solemn, Somber, Grave, Unamused
examples: The giggly schoolchildren could not stop laughing during the lesson. She became giggly after hearing the private joke. His giggly mood made the meeting less formal. The children were giggly with excitement before the party.
sindhiMeaning: گهڻو ککڙيون هڻندڙ، هلڪي کل کلندڙ، شرارتي يا بي اختياريءَ سان کلندڙ، آسانيءَ سان کل ۾ پوندڙ، نروس ٿي کلندڙ
urduMeaning: بار بار کھلکھلانے والا، ہلکی ہنسی ہنسنے والا، شرارتی یا بے اختیار ہنسنے والا، آسانی سے ہنس پڑنے والا، گھبراہٹ میں ہنسنے والا

englishMeaning: A man paid to accompany or entertain a woman socially. A male escort or lover supported financially by a woman. A man who forms relationships primarily for money, gifts, or material support.
synonyms: Male escort, Kept man, Companion, Paid lover, Playboy
antonyms: Independent partner, Unpaid companion, Female escort
examples: The wealthy widow hired a gigolo to accompany her to social events. The film portrayed the glamorous but lonely life of a gigolo. He was rumored to have worked as a gigolo in his youth. The word gigolo often carries a negative social judgment.
sindhiMeaning: پئسن عيوض عورت جو سماجي ساٿي بڻجندڙ مرد، عورت کان مالي مدد وٺندڙ مرد ساٿي يا عاشق، پئسي يا تحفن لاءِ تعلق رکڻ وارو مرد، مرد پيشه ور ساٿي
urduMeaning: پیسوں کے عوض عورت کا سماجی ساتھی بننے والا مرد، عورت سے مالی مدد لینے والا مرد ساتھی یا عاشق، دولت یا تحائف کے لیے تعلق رکھنے والا مرد، پیشہ ور مرد ساتھی

englishMeaning: A leg of lamb or mutton prepared as food. A cut of meat from the hind leg of a sheep. A sleeve that is very full at the shoulder and narrow at the wrist, also called a leg-of-mutton sleeve.
synonyms: Leg of lamb, Leg of mutton, Haunch, Leg-of-mutton sleeve
antonyms: No exact antonym, Forequarter cut, Sleeveless design
examples: The chef roasted a gigot of lamb for Sunday dinner. She ordered gigot at the French restaurant. The dress featured fashionable gigot sleeves. Traditional recipes pair slow-cooked gigot with garlic and rosemary.
sindhiMeaning: رڍ يا گهيٽي جي ٽنگ جو گوشت، پٺئين ران مان ڪٽيل گوشت، ڪلهي وٽ ڦوڪيل ۽ کلائي وٽ سوڙهي بازو جي ڊيزائن، ليگ آف مٽن آستين
urduMeaning: بھیڑ یا دنبے کی ٹانگ کا گوشت، پچھلی ران سے کاٹا ہوا گوشت، کندھے پر پھولی اور کلائی پر تنگ آستین، لیگ آف مٹن آستین

englishMeaning: A lively dance of the Baroque period derived from the jig. Music written for that dance, usually in a rapid compound meter. A movement commonly placed at the end of a Baroque suite.
synonyms: Jig, Baroque dance, Dance movement, Lively dance
antonyms: Sarabande, Slow dance, Adagio
examples: Bach composed a lively gigue to close the suite. The orchestra performed a spirited gigue at the concert. The dancers moved quickly to the rhythm of the gigue. A gigue often forms the final movement of a Baroque suite.
sindhiMeaning: باروڪ دور جو تيز ۽ جاندار ناچ، جِگ مان نڪتل رقص، تيز گڏيل تال ۾ لکيل موسيقي، باروڪ سوئٽ جي آخري حرڪت
urduMeaning: باروک دور کا تیز اور جاندار رقص، جگ سے نکلا ہوا ناچ، تیز مرکب تال میں لکھی موسیقی، باروک سوئٹ کی آخری موومنٹ

englishMeaning: In a precise, accurate, or exact manner. In every detail and without any difference. At precisely the stated time, place, amount, or point. Used to confirm complete agreement or that a statement is correct. Used in questions to request precise information.
synonyms: Precisely, Accurately, Perfectly, Just, Correctly, Absolutely
antonyms: Approximately, Roughly, Inaccurately, Imprecisely, Nearly
examples: The train arrived exactly on time. She measured exactly two cups of flour. That is exactly what I meant to say. He copied the design exactly as instructed.
sindhiMeaning: بلڪل صحيح نموني، ٺيڪ ٺيڪ، هر تفصيل ۾ ساڳيءَ طرح، مقرر وقت يا مقدار تي، مڪمل اتفاق ظاهر ڪرڻ لاءِ، صحيح ڄاڻ پڇڻ لاءِ
urduMeaning: بالکل درست طور پر، ٹھیک ٹھیک، ہر تفصیل میں یکساں، عین مقرر وقت یا مقدار پر، مکمل اتفاق ظاہر کرنے کے لیے، صحیح معلومات پوچھنے کے لیے

englishMeaning: Used to say that something is not completely true, accurate, or correctly described. A mild or polite way of disagreeing, denying, or correcting. Used to understate that a person or thing clearly lacks a quality. Not precisely or not quite.
synonyms: Not quite, Not really, Not precisely, Hardly, Not entirely
antonyms: Exactly, Precisely, Absolutely, Certainly, Completely
examples: The result was not exactly what I had expected. Are you angry, or not exactly? He is not exactly known for arriving on time. The instructions were not exactly clear to the new users.
sindhiMeaning: بلڪل صحيح نه، پوري طرح سچ نه، نرم نموني اختلاف يا انڪار ڪرڻ، ڪنهن ڳالهه جي کوٽ کي گهٽ لفظن ۾ ظاهر ڪرڻ، ٺيڪ ٺيڪ نه، ايترو به نه
urduMeaning: بالکل درست نہیں، پوری طرح سچ نہیں، نرم انداز میں اختلاف یا انکار کرنا، کسی کمی کو ہلکے انداز میں بیان کرنا، ٹھیک ٹھیک نہیں، ایسا بھی نہیں

word: Does exactly what it says on the tin
englishMeaning: An idiom meaning that something performs precisely as its name, description, or advertising promises. Straightforward, reliable, and free from hidden surprises. Suitable for a product, service, title, or person whose function is accurately described.
synonyms: As advertised, True to its description, Reliable, Straightforward, Fit for purpose
antonyms: Misleading, Deceptive, Unreliable, Not as advertised, False advertising
examples: This stain remover does exactly what it says on the tin. The app promises simple budgeting and does exactly what it says on the tin. The guide does exactly what it says on the tin by explaining every basic step. It is not glamorous software, but it does exactly what it says on the tin.
sindhiMeaning: محاورو جنهن جو مطلب آهي ته شيءِ بلڪل بيان موجب ڪم ڪري ٿي، نالي يا اشتهار ۾ ڪيل واعدو پورو ڪري ٿي، سادي ۽ قابلِ ڀروسو آهي، جنهن ۾ لڪل حيرت يا دوکو نه هجي
urduMeaning: محاورہ جس کا مطلب ہے کہ چیز بالکل بیان کے مطابق کام کرتی ہے، نام یا اشتہار میں کیا وعدہ پورا کرتی ہے، سادہ اور قابل اعتماد ہے، جس میں کوئی چھپا دھوکا یا حیرت نہ ہو
